ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got a broad selection here. Best in all of D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱这货全华盛顿特区拔尖儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00005d53_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: x3dnpccarnegie15
ESP.TRADUIT: x3dnpccarnegie15

ESP.ORIGINAL: "A slave is a knife, sharp and bloody. As your master, I've put you in my hand and given you a place at the table."
ESP.TRADUIT: "奴若利刃，嗜血锋寒。吾执尔于掌，赐尔席次。"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_greeting_00001c21_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "A slave is not a man. He's a tool. And a tool has no soul. It deserves no pity. It feels no pain."
ESP.TRADUIT: "奴隶非人，乃工具。工具无魂，不配怜悯，不觉苦痛。"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_greeting_00001c19_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "As a slave you have no mind. It's only through my will that you stop being a savage."
ESP.TRADUIT: "为奴者无心智，唯遵吾命，方可脱蛮。"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_greeting_00001c1d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Greener Pastures Disposal." Is that like when people piss on your leg and tell you it's raining?
ESP.TRADUIT: "绿色牧场处理公司"？这名字听着就像人往你腿上撒尿还骗你说下雨了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: "How sharper than a serpent's tooth it is to have a thankless child."
ESP.TRADUIT: 忘恩负义的孩子，比毒蛇的利齿更伤人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_000013cd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "It's good to see you Carah. I'm glad you didn't get your ass blown off by raiders Carah." Jesus, who gives a shit about your supplies?
ESP.TRADUIT: "见到你真好卡拉，没被掠夺者炸烂屁股真走运卡拉。" 操，谁在乎你的破补给？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carah [1100813F] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel10f_00008158_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Research notes on quantum gravity." Hold on...is this what I think it is? Is this the fucking cookbook?
ESP.TRADUIT: "量子引力研究笔记"...等等...这难道是...那本操蛋的配方？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcbutchdocsc_0000b08f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "The Church of Atom." What the fuck is atom?
ESP.TRADUIT: "原子神教"...原子他妈的是啥玩意儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_00003dab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "The Faded Pomp Estates." I don't even know what that means, but it sure sounds fancy. Doesn't look it though.
ESP.TRADUIT: "褪色华宅"...鬼知道什么意思，听着挺唬人，看着可寒酸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00003db6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "The Family." Sounds like a bunch of mobsters. But the mob never killed people like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: "家族"？听着像黑帮。可黑帮不这么杀人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018498_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "We were never equal, you and me. That was a lie. And when the war was over, you learned the truth."
ESP.TRADUIT: "你我从未平等，此乃谎言。战终之日，尔方知真相。"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_greeting_00001c1c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Your pride will be your failing, beast. You don't know yourself." Heh. That one he said with my hands on his throat.
ESP.TRADUIT: "野兽，尔之骄狂终致覆灭——尔不自知耳。" 呵，这句是掐着他脖子时说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_greeting_00001c1e_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]行吧，但玛拉要肯认错能省多少事

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2b1_00008813_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Success] Shit, you might be right. How much was it, 300 caps? That's a drop in the bucket for me anyway.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Selma [11001640] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcselma01a_00001b6e_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]话是这么说，但我们付不起
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2b3_00008810_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]平时是布奇的活儿，不过那废物跟尸鬼吃消辐宁似的，你倒可以试试

ESP.ORIGINAL: A barracks. And where there's a barracks, there's an armory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军营啊。有军营的地方准有军火库。

ESP.TRADUIT: 正经医生在奴隶市场能卖个好价钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2b3_00008810_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A car fort, how lovely. Back in my day we used to call this rush hour.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汽车堡垒，真可爱。我们那会儿管这叫堵车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000355cf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A chalkboard would've been nice. Something to write on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有块黑板该多好…好歹能写两笔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000c581_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A comedy in which it hurts to laugh. A battlefield where we can shed our blood, if not our tears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 笑着笑着就疼了的喜剧，流血流泪的战场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplaymonol_000013ca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Cuppa Joe 2
ESP.TRADUIT: 《乔二号的咖啡》
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pre-War Radio Broadcast [110034D9] (mod) Quest : ([110034DA]x3DNPCRadio3DNPCQuest) Atomic Radio EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcradio3dnpcvoice\x3dnpcradi_radiohello_0000f808_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A few months back, he got a tip about a boatload of caps hidden in one of these luxury resorts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几个月前，他听说某豪华度假村藏着一船瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs03_00001fba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A foursome, huh. Am I invited or do I at least get to watch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 四人行？我能加入还是旁观？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friend gave it to me a while back. Well, not really a friend so much as a guy I knew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前一熟人给的，算不上朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03_00006c9b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Geronimo scope? Oh I get it now. You're a moron.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么杰罗尼莫瞄准镜？哦，我懂了。你是个白痴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A grenade made of bleached soda would be a formidable weapon, provided our enemies are well dressed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 漂白汽水瓶改的手雷威力不小，当然前提是敌人得穿着体面衣裳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A long dress and a few curves can conceal a lot of things Doctor Watkins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一件长礼服加上曲线玲珑的身材能藏不少东西呢，沃特金斯医生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice2\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007275_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A long, long time ago, I heard it on the radio, sound so good to me, to be an army infantry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久很久前，收音机里听着当兵真带劲！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00007994_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot happened while you were away, Captain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不在时发生了很多事，上尉

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of people say that. Some are just making a double entendre.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多人这么说，有人就是玩双关语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4b1_0000272b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of the ghouls started to point fingers and blame the humans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不少尸鬼开始指责人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3_000052ab_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of the mercs Carver hired seem suspect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡弗雇佣的很多雇佣兵看起来都可疑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of these raider gangs are a bunch of rookies who couldn't piss out of their own dick unless you held it for them. Let 'em die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这群掠夺者菜鸟撒尿都找不准地方，死就死吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_00002c30_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A man is never drunk if he can lie on the floor without holding on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能躺地上不扶东西就不算醉
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d0_1.ogg Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d0_1.ogg Faction : Agatha's Faction Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A man without a soul is a slave to himself. And if you believe in slavery, you and me, we have a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没灵魂的人就是自己的奴隶。你要信奴隶制，咱俩没完。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Message From Your Father
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自你父亲的信息

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Message From Your Mother
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自你母亲的信息

ESP.ORIGINAL: A new client, huh? Go upstairs. Can't sell you so much as a candy bar until you talk to the boss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 新主顾？上楼见老大。没他点头，连块糖都不卖您。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_000087b4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A new holotape! It's like Christmas in Des Moines. Only in this version, Des Moines doesn't suck!
ESP.TRADUIT: 新全息磁带！像得梅因的圣诞节，只不过这版得梅因不烂！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00003429_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A number. One of five in total.
ESP.TRADUIT: 编号，总共五个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey03_00004bce_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A password? Did it say what kind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 密码？说啥类型了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00000d35_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Pre-War invention that ran on batteries and gasoline.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一种战前发明，靠电池和汽油驱动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A raider mystic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者巫师？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A scientist is proofing the theory. Findings will be announced on this channel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一位科学家正在验证这个理论。研究结果将在这个频道上公布。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A secret hatch, a ham radio and two dead Chinese soldiers. Granted, I'm no doctor, but it looks like they were bored to death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 暗门、无线电、俩中国军人尸体。我虽不是医生，但看着像无聊致死的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0002a22f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave from Vault 101. He convinced me if I wanted to be free, I had to become the monster they said I was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 101避难所的奴隶。他说想自由就得变成他们口中的怪物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followersfired_00001c2b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave named Jackson told me the owner was dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫杰克逊的奴隶告诉我，这里的主人已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Socialist's Fortune
ESP.TRADUIT: 《社会主义者的财富》
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pre-War Radio Broadcast [110034D9] (mod) Quest : ([110034DA]x3DNPCRadio3DNPCQuest) Atomic Radio EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcradio3dnpcvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpcradio3dnp_00010c01_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A survival guide is a good idea, but you'd know what I'd like to see? A wasteland cookbook.
ESP.TRADUIT: 生存指南挺好，但更想要本废土食谱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079b7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A third his age and half of ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 年纪只有他三分之一，体力只有我们一半。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5E] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler01\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c50_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: A vault dweller and a raider. Heh. Wait until they get a load of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所居民加掠夺者？哈！够他们喝一壶的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_goodbye_00002c38_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所居民变奴隶？时间对不上，但前天在坎特伯雷集市见过穿制服的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Abraham Lincoln. I think he chopped down a cherry tree while flying a kite in a thunderstorm. Yeah, I know my history.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I was wondering if I could spend the night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实想问能不能借宿一晚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I wouldn't mind living here if you let me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实你要同意，我挺想住这儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I'm here for the journal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我是来拿这本日记的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, it's the only thing that's happened so far that makes any sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，这是到目前为止唯一发生过的有意义的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I've come to rescue him from you awful people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我是来把她从你们这些坏人手里救出来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, my name's Emma. But I can't change the sign, so I figured, might as well change my name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真名叫艾玛，但招牌改不了，干脆改名算了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot01_0000536a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, the building's in shambles, and one of the doors is still locked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，这栋楼已经是一片废墟了，其中一扇门还锁着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, they're already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，他们都已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, this time I'm asking for a friend. And just to prove I'm not making her up, I brought her here to explain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次是帮朋友问的。怕你不信，特地带她来说明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB25]x3DNPCMQ02) The Free and Pure EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq02_x3dnpctsenaudre_0000ee21_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, this time I'm asking for a friend. And just to prove I'm not making him up, I even brought him here to explain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次是帮朋友问的。怕你不信，特地带他来解释。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB25]x3DNPCMQ02) The Free and Pure EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq02_x3dnpctsenaudre_0000ee22_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, you pretty much saved yourself, if you recall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实你算是自救的，记得不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, your friend here decided that instead of trying to make himself better, he's going to help other people instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实你这位朋友想通了：与其提升自己，不如帮助他人。

ESP.ORIGINAL:
After placing the explosive, a tiny flag pops out of the Teddy Bomb's head.
A message is written on it in barely legible handwriting.
It says, "TAEK KOVR!!!"
ESP.TRADUIT:
放置炸药后，泰迪炸弹的头上弹出一面小旗。
上面用难以辨认的笔迹写着一条信息。
上面写着:“TAEK KOVR!!”

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, maybe get married, have kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后结婚生子。

ESP.TRADUIT: 那辆装满尸体的马车？想解释一下吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel19j_00005f06_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the Wasteland is saved. Well, for the humans anyway. We ghouls don't mind a little radiation in our tea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土得救啦！人类得救而已。咱尸鬼下午茶里加点辐射更香。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0003ba25_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then I said, "Shit, I could I live in this dump!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后我说："妈的，我怎么能住在这种破地方！"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar02_00001c03_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then it hits me, that world never existed. It was all in my head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后我突然意识到，那个世界从未存在过。那全是我脑海中的幻想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_0000807c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then it was high fives and nuka-cola for everyone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后就是击掌庆祝，每人一瓶核子可乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc6d_0000261f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then there's funding that goes to wars you might fight after that future comes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后还有资金会流向那个未来到来后你们可能要打的战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01d_00002337_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then when things got stale, they could totally bring back Ralph as a ghoul! I think he's got real comedic chops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后等故事变得乏味时，他们完全可以让拉尔夫作为尸鬼回归！我觉得他真有喜剧天赋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then you cut the tip off and it's like "Holee thit, there's nuthin ther afther all."
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后你切掉尖儿，那感觉就像"我勒个擦，结果啥也没有嘛。"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there it was, like a sign from god. The place the Free Men would call home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它就在那儿，像是上帝的启示。自由民们将称之为家的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_00015f36_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there's that one moment where you lock your eyes and the two of you are on the same page, because you want the same thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总会有那么一刻，你们目光交汇，两人想法一致，因为你们想要的是同一个东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynxmonol_00001c4e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they lived happily ever after.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从此，他们幸福地生活下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc6_00002617_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they're dead. Well done, darling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有他们都死了。干得好，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_combattonormal_000369f5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And this town must be full of thieves if she feels the need to hire one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可她要专门雇人看店，说明城里小偷多得防不过来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And to answer your question, no, I don't come with the car. But I do love it when people ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要回答你的问题：不，我可不随车附送。但我特别喜欢别人这么问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c8f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And to get that high, you gotta meet the lowest of the low. You gotta deal with us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想上那种天堂，你得先下到最底层的地狱。你得跟我们打交道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2b_00008808_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And Virgil trusts you? I think he needs to get his eyes checked. Or at the very least, his brain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维吉尔信任你？我觉得他该去检查眼睛了。再不济，也该检查检查脑子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00c_00004c9b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we were so close. To think she almost made it out the door fully rehabilitated!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们明明就差一步了。眼看她就要以完全康复的状态走出大门了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007276_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we were so close. To think she almost made it out the door fully rehabilitated!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们明明就差一步了。眼看她就要以完全康复的状态走出大门了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007286_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we will! The Phantom would never give up, and neither will we!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会的！幻影永不放弃，我们也一样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc1c_00001c5b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we're gonna need every bit of crazy to blow up this monument. Probably more than we got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得拿出所有的疯狂劲儿才能炸掉这座纪念碑。可能还不够。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00c_0000342d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we're paying customers. Imagine what they'll do when we run out of caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在是付钱的顾客。想象一下等我们瓶盖花光时他们会干出什么事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007484] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern02\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern03c_000074aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what do you call walking up and down those railings? It certainly feels like a workout.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你管在栏杆上走来走去叫什么？这感觉绝对像在锻炼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempkrist_000180f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what do you know, a giant robot makes its appearance in the final chapter, just to spite me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 果不其然！终章非得冒出巨型机器人给我添堵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0003ba1f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what if the phone rings again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那要是电话又响了怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_00003e6d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what if the phone rings again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那要是电话又响了怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegiei_00003e6f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what is war but a play. A stage upon which the soul is bared. A drama in which villains are cast and heroes are made.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战争是什么？不过是一出戏。一个灵魂被暴露的舞台。一部反派被选定、英雄被造就的戏剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplaymonol_00003210_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when I figure out how to kill you, you'll be too dead to realize you fucked up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我琢磨出怎么杀你的时候，你早就死透了，连自己搞砸了都意识不到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx00a1_00002c0b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when they find the bodies outside, I doubt anyone will speak to me again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等他们在外面发现那些尸体，我怀疑不会再有人跟我说话了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank04_0000ab03_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And where they're going now, they won't need the beds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正他们现在去的地方用不着床了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc01_0000083b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And who authorized that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是谁批准的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000043b6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And who do we have to thank for that? War. The one thing that never changes. The only thing that can save us from-
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得感谢谁？战争。唯一不变的东西。唯一能把我们从……中拯救出来的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_00003217_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And why is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是为什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo03_00005d02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And with every hostile we kill, we add to our collection of junk. Splendid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每杀一个敌人，我们的垃圾收藏就多一件。太棒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_combattonormal_000369f2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And with the vault in trouble, we needed to make contact. Some of the others asked me to scout the wastes and make sure it was safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所陷入困境，我们需要取得联系。其他人让我去废土侦察，确保安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_0001427d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And without thinking, I walked over and picked it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想都没想就走过去把它捡了起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_0000537f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And without those pages, there would be no theory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有那些纸页，就不会有理论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc1_0000b064_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And yet here I stand like some Pre-War dame, sad over a woman I couldn't pick out of a two person lineup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可我却像个战前贵妇似的站在这儿，为一个我连两人排都认不出的女人伤心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00c_0000ab19_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And yet the things she said...Heavens to Betsy...I nearly fainted! I think there's something wrong with that girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可她说的那些话……我的老天爷啊……我差点晕过去！我觉得那姑娘脑子有问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e31_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And yet you're my better half.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可你依然是我的另一半。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00003e1d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you do it well. It's too bad you're an outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且你做得很好。可惜你是个外人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00c_00001c75_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you got five seconds to drop your gun before I shove it down your throat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还有五秒钟放下枪，不然我就把它塞进你喉咙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you killed her for that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就为这个杀了她？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053d0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you think you'll find it here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得你能在这里找到它？

ESP.ORIGINAL: And your business don't mean fuck-all to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那点破事对我来说屁都不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_0000956e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: And your kid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你孩子呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: And your point is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你想说什么？

ESP.TRADUIT: 而你是个老朽不堪的老头子。你想表达什么？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000299b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL:
Android Model KC-38472 has shown remarkable ingenuity during the tests. On many occasions he has used the weight of his power and influence to resolve seemingly toxic situations. This of course was not our original intent when we started these experiments, but Dr. Cheng points out that regardless of how unsavory his methods are, no one has been killed as a result.
This next trial will tell us more, however, given his previous interactions with the Android model Garcia. Dr. Cheng insists this kind of sado-masochistic foreplay might be a good way for the machines to feed their predilection for the violence in a safe, consensual environment. However, I wonder if we are merely reinforcing this behavior by allowing it to continue.
ESP.TRADUIT:
合成人KC-38472在测试中表现出了非凡的独创性。在许多场合，他利用自己的权力和影响力来解决看似有害的情况。当然，这并不是我们开始这些实验的初衷，但郑博士指出，无论他的方法多么令人讨厌，都没有人因此而死亡。
然而，考虑到他之前与合成人模型加西亚的互动，下一次试验将告诉我们更多。郑博士坚持认为，这种施虐受虐的前戏可能是机器在一个安全、双方同意的环境中满足其暴力偏好的好方法。然而，我想知道，如果我们允许这种行为继续下去，是否只是在强化这种行为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Android Rehabilitation Research Notes Logs and Status
ESP.TRADUIT: 合成人康复研究笔记 日志和状态

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you the one in charge?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是管事的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you trying to get rid of me too?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也想除掉我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_000053db_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you waking him up? Is he going to get better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要叫醒他？他会好起来吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop01_0000264c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you? Damn if I can tell. The last set of teeth I ever saw was on a deathclaw, and he wasn't grinning, I can tell you that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在笑？鬼才看得出来。我上次看见一口牙是在死亡爪身上，而且我敢保证，它那可不是在露齿而笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03a_00001c3d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Army of the Free Men
ESP.TRADUIT: 自由人军队
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : Caucasian Clas : Vault Dweller

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a ghoul, everything about you is soft. So your organs tend to blend together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 身为尸鬼，浑身器官都泡烂了，难免沤成一团浆糊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_000355d1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a matter of fact, there is. Every so often I pick up supplies from the scavenger who lives in the old train car to the west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，确实有。我时不时会去西边住在旧火车车厢里的那个拾荒者那儿拿补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplay04_00003c58_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As am I, believe it or not. If we want to get close to this organization, we'll need to go undercover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是，信不信由你。如果我们想接近这个组织，就得去卧底。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000b1f7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As am I. Hopefully we can share this discovery and save ourselves in the process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是。希望我们能分享这个发现，顺便自救。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0a_0000b06a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As are you, soldier. I salute you, on behalf of America.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也是，士兵。我代表美利坚向你致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins02_00005a53_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As colors go, one's usually associated with purity, the other with blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 颜色嘛，一个象征纯洁，一个象征鲜血
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a3_00000d22_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as I know they're all still there. Well, all except for Gabe, but I haven't seen him since the day we took that test.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知他们都还在那儿。呃，除了盖布，但自从那天我们做完测试后我就没见过他了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia04_00015f0a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as I'm concerned, bad karma is good karma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，坏业力就是好业力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as I'm concerned, that name is cursed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，那个名字是受诅咒的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053d2_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as I'm concerned, we're even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，我们扯平了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack000d_000187ac_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as the guards know, I sell junk and fortunes. The junk you can see, the fortunes, I tell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 守卫们只知道我卖破烂和算命。破烂你看得见，算命嘛，我靠嘴说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic2_0000ee31_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for the fire, well, I think they were trying to make an example of us. First it was Chet, then Randy, then Marie. I was next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于纵火，他们想杀鸡儆猴，先是切特，再兰迪，再玛丽，下一个是我
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00006c9d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for the rest, well, just because it survived doesn't mean it was any good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于其他的，嗯，活下来并不代表它就有多好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, I'm sure you've had your fill of this place. The key to the door on my left should be on Mara's body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，我敢说你也待够这地方了。我左边那扇门的钥匙应该在玛拉的尸体上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob90b_0000727c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, I'm sure you've had your fill of this place. The key to the door on my left should be on Mara's body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，我敢说你也待够这地方了。我左边那扇门的钥匙应该在玛拉的尸体上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob90c_0000727d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As have I. It's a terrible pollutant of both the body and mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是。它对肉体和精神都是可怕的污染物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0d4_0000b07c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As in radiation rads. Hot, you know? Like ow, it burns!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是辐射拉德啊。热，懂吗？就像嗷，烫死了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq0a1_00002736_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As much as I'd like to believe that, I get the nagging feeling that some of them didn't deserve it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我很想相信这点，但我总有种挥之不去的感觉：他们中有些人罪不至此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01d_0001570d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As much as I'd like to, that would render all the forms ineligible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我很想这么做，但那会让所有表格都作废。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02d_00001b23_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As the Hero of Vault 101, there's no one better suited than you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为101避难所的传奇英雄，除你之外无人可担此任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_greeting_0001428f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you can see, I'm the only adult in our group, so yes, that puts me in charge. Hopefully Oscar was only half right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所见，我是我们这群人里唯一的成年人，所以没错，是我管事。希望奥斯卡只说对了一半。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplay03_0000321d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you can see, Maddie's pet roach is dead. What I can't figure out is who gave Sally the gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所见麦迪的宠物蟑螂死了。但谁给莎莉的枪还没搞清。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cc4_2.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 尘归尘，土归土

ESP.ORIGINAL: At first I tried to convince her to use the trailers, but she wouldn't leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 起初我试图说服她住拖车屋，但她不肯离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053a5_2.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 至少我留在这儿，还能有种我们还在并肩作战的错觉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4_0000b087_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least the processor is fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少处理器是好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least, that's what I'd like. And yeah, none of it's real, but does that really matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少，那是我的愿望。而且没错，这一切都不是真的，但那真的重要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: At long last, we're gonna find out what happens to Greg and that hideous vault monster! I can't wait!
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于啊，我们就要知道格雷格和那个丑陋的避难所怪物到底怎么样了！我等不及了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00005a40_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: At number 14 this week is a a show tune from the 1949 Rodgers and Hammerstein musical, "South Pacific."
ESP.TRADUIT: 本周排名第14位的是一首1949年罗杰斯与汉默斯坦音乐剧《南太平洋》中的演出曲目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Top 40 [11004E95] (mod) Quest : ([11004F36]x3DNPCRadioTop40) x3dnpcRadioTop40quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpctop40trac_00004f3f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the moment, we mostly rely on bounty hunters and wastelanders like yourself. It's not ideal, but c'est la guerre.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前，我们主要依靠赏金猎人和像你这样的废土游民。这不理想，但这就是战争（C'est la guerre）。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b0e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the Post, I found a dead Brotherhood Outcast. He had this holotape on him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在邮局，我发现了一个死掉的钢铁兄弟会弃誓者。他身上有这盘全息磁带。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the risk of sounding full of myself, I'll take that compliment. To be honest, I can't remember the last time I've gotten one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然这么说有点自夸的嫌疑，但这恭维我收下了。说实话，我都记不清上次有人夸我是什么时候了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcprojectpu_000034d5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aunt Gina's mean. I don't care if I can't shoot straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吉娜阿姨真凶！打不准又怎样？

ESP.TRADUIT: 吉娜阿姨在教我们格斗。没排戏好玩，但出过那档子事...我懂为啥要学了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 澳大利亚人？那是一个战前社会吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, don't say that! I may not be able to get you caps, but I can get other stuff...I mean come on, just a taste, I'm not greedy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，别这么说嘛！我可能没法给你瓶盖，但我能弄到别的东西……我是说拜托，就尝一口，我不贪心的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I guess when you're a machine armor isn't supposed to be heavy.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90b_000072fd_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I hurt my leg on the last trip, and I'm still having a tough time walking around.

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I know better than anyone that there's no point in begging.

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I suppose it doesn't matter. It's not like there's anyone on this stale, brown dot that wouldn't bore me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过无所谓了。反正这颗发霉的星球上也没谁不让我犯困。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I suppose it doesn't matter. You're here, and I'll take whatever help I can get.
