ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're ever in need of company, well, I think I've had enough parties for one lifetime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你要是缺伴儿……咳，我这辈子派对可开够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90e_0000730d_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're going to make trouble, then I'm letting you know right now, I'll fight you with every last bullet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你要敢惹事，丑话说前头：老子拼尽最后一颗子弹也跟你干到底。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_0000537d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'll submit a request to have the coffee maker moved to a more secure location.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我会打报告申请把咖啡机挪到更安全的位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirscollect_0000200c_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm fairly certain if I had a heart, it was absorbed into my liver. Because now I drink more and care less than I ever did as a human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但很确定——假如我曾有颗心，早被肝脏吸收了。所以现在酒量见长，操心倒比当人时少。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_000355d1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm no soldier. Best I could do was stay here and watch for people leaving the vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可我不是当兵的料。顶多守在这儿盯着避难所出来的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank04_0000ab01_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm not even a person. Who's to say what is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 连我都不算人，谁又说得清啥是呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01d_00008088_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm not so sure there's a place for good people in this world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这世道，好人真能有立足之地吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000ab1c_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm on your side here. I don't wanna see an American icon like Casey Clarkson catch a bad rap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我站你这边。可不想看凯西·克拉克森这种美国招牌背黑锅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00d_00003377_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm pretty much the only person here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这里几乎只有我一个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm sure she brought you here for a reason. What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她带你来肯定有原因。我能帮什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic0_0000ee2c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm sure the moment you stepped into that sim, you got lost in that world too. Like a trance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你一进那模拟舱，肯定也迷失了——像中了邪似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001847c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm very good with numbers. Betsy even said so. In fact, I've been doing a cost variable analysis of the next ten years, and...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我算数特牛。贝琪都这么说。其实我算了未来十年的成本变量分析，然后……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e50_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But in all seriousness, I do think we could've been more civil. Some of those "soldiers" weren't even fighting back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说正经的，咱们本可以更体面。有些“士兵”根本没还手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_0001570a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But in all seriousness, I don't like it when bad things happen to people who don't deserve it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，我不爱看无辜的人遭罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00b_0000ab1a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But in all seriousness, I think we showed quite a bit of restraint in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 平心而论，咱们在里面够克制了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_000142bb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But intelligence is overrated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但聪明也未必是福。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005967_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it also felt wrong. So I guess I haven't forgotten who I am. Not yet. Hopefully not ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可心里就是不得劲。看来我还没忘本。希望永远不忘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008092_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it doesn't matter, does it. Either he makes the chem, or he dies. No other way this ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无所谓了。要么他制药，要么他死路一条。没第三种结局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_00009575_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it is junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这就是破烂啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_00003216_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it should be enough to fool those Outcasts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糊弄那帮弃誓者应该够用了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_00002331_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's gonna be hard to convince anyone else of that fact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可要让别人信这事，难了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00c_000033c1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's hard to really give you a description when all them laowais look alike.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你们老外长得都一个样，实在不好描述啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4e3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's hard to really give you a description when all you laowais look alike.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你们老外长得都一个样，实在不好描述啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4e4_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's not about the fact that she did wrong. We all know that. It's about trust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关键不是她做错事——大伙儿都知道——而是信任崩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70f_000063f3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's the act of giving and helping others that keeps a town strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 城镇的强大，靠的是守望相助，同心协力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03c_00006ce3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's up to men like us to dismantle the bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但拆掉坏东西得靠我们这种人
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_00000d34_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's you we should feel sorry for. You're the one who got snitched on. Tell me Mara, why shouldn't I feel sorry for him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们应该为你感到难过。你是那个被告密的人。告诉我玛拉，我为什么不该为他感到难过？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_00006407_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I've slept here every night for about a year now, and outside of what Vernon says, I haven't noticed anything unusual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我在这里睡了差不多一年，除了弗农说的那些，我没注意到有什么不寻常的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50g_00003e68_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Jangles has more important mission. He must stay here and help fix country.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但小丑有更重要任务，他得留下帮忙修复国家
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc01_000008f3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Jangles has more important mission. She must stay here and help rebuild country.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但小丑有更重要任务，她得留下帮忙重建国家
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc01_000008f2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But knowing me, I doubt I'll be out here for long. Molerat always finds a way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过以我的性格，我不会在这里待太久。鼹鼠总有办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a5_00006ca4_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But let’s not pretend I’m some sort of hero. You took us to the moon, all I did was plant the flag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们别假装我是某种英雄。你带我们上了月球，我所做的只是插上旗帜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But let's not pretend I'm some sort of hero. You took us to the moon, all I did was plant the flag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们别假装我是某种英雄。你带我们上了月球，我所做的只是插上旗帜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01_0003b9f2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But long story short, after that we were inseparable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长话短说，那之后我们就形影不离
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_00005cca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But mark my words. Someday, all these vaults will belong to the free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但记住我的话：终有一日，所有避难所都将重归自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_greeting_00014278_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But maybe you like blowing ass. If so, then by all means, take the low road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也许你喜欢**炸屁股**。如果是这样，那就请便，走低下的路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll0c_000059c2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But me, I don't do needles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我，我不碰针剂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02b_00002c47_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But me? There's only one reason I do what I do. I like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但至于我？我做我所做的事只有一个原因。我喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a_00002c3e_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But nobody really cared enough to find out if it was true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但没有人真正关心这件事是否属实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia04_00015f0a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But nope, nope, can't do it. Not without people noticing. Rules, you know!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但不行，不行，不能这么做。不让人发现可不行。有规矩的，你懂的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00004cb5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now I know I never had a choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在我知道我从没有选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb36_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now I'm like a fish out of water. Out here, it doesn't really matter how well I can swim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在我像条离开水的鱼。在这里，我游得多好真的不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008089_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now that they've tasted freedom, they're living in fear again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在他们尝到了自由的滋味，他们又开始生活在恐惧中了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_0001427f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now that you're here, you're really the only person who isn't emotionally involved. I know that's asking a lot, but maybe you can help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但既然你在这里，你真的是唯一一个没有情感卷入的人。我知道这要求很高，但也许你能帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30350d_000063dc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now's not the time to lose our heads. I'd wager his friends outside heard you fighting. I'll wait here while you finish them off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在不能慌。外头同伙肯定听见动静了，你解决他们，我等着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_000087d1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But one day I lost it and never got it back. Can't seem to get the eyebrows right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但有一天我把它弄丢了，再也找不回来了。眉毛怎么弄都不对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4d_00002723_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But pappy was smart. He started attaching notes to those Enclave bots, like messages in a bottle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是老爸很聪明。他开始在那些英克雷夫机器人上绑纸条，就像瓶中信一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs03_00001fba_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But perhaps showing a little empathy for once is a good thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也许偶尔表现出一点同情心是件好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudreyfin_00016cbe_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But raiders aren't much for dancing, and shooting them is more fun anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但掠夺者不怎么跳舞，而且射杀他们反正更有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey04_00005971_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But regardless of the way it went down, I'm glad you came back for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但无论结果如何，我很高兴你回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01f_00015712_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But regardless of the way it went down, I'm glad you came back for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但无论结果如何，我很高兴你回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But right now, my problem isn't with them so much as where they're living.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在，我的问题与其说是他们，不如说是他们住的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_00001c7a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But right now, they're just too young. You keep the gun. I want nothing to do with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在，他们太小了。你留着这把枪吧。我不想和它有任何关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplay04_00003c59_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But she has such small cans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但她有这么小的罐头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But she was also old and stubborn. She couldn't have had more than five years left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但她也又老又固执。她剩下的日子不会超过五年了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_00005383_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But she wouldn't have wanted me to stand by and do nothing either. At the very least, I've got to try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但她也不会希望我袖手旁观，什么都不做。至少，我得试试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01d2_00003c8e_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But shit, I like your style. Right now I need someone to take charge. It might as well be you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，妈的，我喜欢你的风格。现在我需要有人来负责。不如就是你吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00d_00001f27_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But shit, I'm not unreasonable. Thing is, you have your hustle, and I have mine. You wanna see the Doc? You gotta pay the toll.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他妈的，我不是不讲道理。问题是，你有你的买卖，我有我的。你想见医生？你就得交过路费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_00009571_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But shit, I'm not unreasonable. Thing is, you have your hustle, and I have mine. You wanna see the Doc? You gotta pay the toll.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他妈的，我不是不讲道理。问题是，你有你的买卖，我有我的。你想见医生？你就得交过路费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_0000956e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But shit, tell you what. Why don't you go down to the Doc's laboratory, see if he has anything worth your package. Hell, see if he's worth it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他妈的，我告诉你。你为什么不下去医生的实验室，看看他有没有什么值得你拿遣散费的东西。去他妈的，看看他值不值得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2b3_00008810_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But sniff a little Abraxo and all of the sudden I'm the devil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但只要吸一点点“亚布拉克索”，突然之间我就成了魔鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2b_00003473_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But thanks. I feel a little less sad now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但谢谢。我现在感觉没那么难过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1a_0000267b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that filthy bug attacked me! I was only defending myself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那个肮脏的虫子攻击了我！我只是自卫！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcstage110p_00003cb4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that means he is broken! If Beep Beep can't run and play and be my friend, what good is he!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这不就意味着他坏了吗！如果哔哔不能跑、不能玩、不能做我的朋友，那他还有什么用！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_boop0c_000030a2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that might take a while...hm...I suppose we could go through the Taft-Hartley Labor Act instead, provided you're from out of state.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这可能需要一段时间……嗯……我想我们可以通过《塔夫脱-哈特利劳工法》来解决，前提是你来自外州。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02c_00001b22_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that's actually good news!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这其实是好消息！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq5a_0000b0cb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that's how you are. It's been seven years. And I bet you still haven't apologized to the man you stole from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你就是这样。七年过去了。我敢打赌你甚至还没向你偷钱的那个人道歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_00006403_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that's neither here nor there. What I wanna know is, have you ever heard it ring?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那无关紧要。我想知道的是，你有没有听过它响？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00d_000030dc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that's only two places total! So I say we try one, then the other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但总共只有两个地方！所以我说我们先试试一个，然后再试另一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas04_000033fb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the bins might not have what you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但垃圾桶里可能没有你需要的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdotcarneg_00000ef5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the doctor, he's our employee of the month, and every month for the rest of his life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但医生，他是我们本月的最佳员工，而且他余生的每个月都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_0000956f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the drink stone cold knocked him out, so we were defenseless when the raiders came through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是那杯饮料把他彻底放倒了，所以当掠夺者进来时，我们毫无防备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a1duplic_00007a54_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the fact of the matter is, it's the best thing for this town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但事实是，这对这个镇子是最好的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02_00006cbb_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the jocks need us, and we need them. So we try and keep our horses the same height. Good thing ours are allowed to slouch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但运动员需要我们，我们也需要他们。所以我们尽量让马保持一样高。幸运的是，我们的马可以弯腰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3b1_0000271b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the locker back there had clothes that fit me. I assume this is closer to what I was wearing before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但后面的储物柜里有合身的衣服。我猜这更接近我以前穿的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90a_00007300_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the password has to be entered down below.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但密码得在下面输入
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00000d36_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But then I think about all the things we've done and I snap back out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但当我想到我们所做的一切时，我就清醒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001847a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But then one day this guy comes in with boots caked in mud. That was Gabriel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但有一天，一个穿着沾满泥土的靴子的人进来了。那就是加布里埃尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank02_0000b1ef_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But then one of them tries to beat you with a tire iron, and you realize there's no room for pity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可当某个家伙抡着轮胎扳手冲过来...心软就是找死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But then that'd be like doing yourself. That's a whole lotta nope. Unscientific, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那样就像和自己做。那可真是大大的不行。很不科学，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq0d_000026f0_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But then you're both arguing, and someone's always wrong. Sounds like a pretty shitty friendship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那样你们两个总是在争吵，总有人是错的。听起来这种友情很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq1d_000026f5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But they're the exception, not the rule. Look at our class. None of us really know what we want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他们是例外，不是规则。看看我们的班级。我们没有人真正知道自己想要什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel03_0000819e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But thing is, around midnight, one of the guards goes down and checks on the chef.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但问题是，午夜时分，其中一个守卫会下去查看厨师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_00008106_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But things change. I just have to make sure I survive long enough to see it happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但事情会改变。我只需要确保我活得够久，能看到那一天的到来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel03_000081a0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But things change. I just have to make sure I survive long enough to see it happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但事情会改变。我只需要确保我活得够久，能看到那一天的到来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel03_000081ae_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But think about what you're saying. You can't stay here, not after all this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你想想你在说什么。你不能留在这里，发生了这么多事之后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130k_00005356_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this ain't about one-upping each other. I just hope my men got out safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这无关乎互相超越。我只希望我的手下都安全脱身了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03e_00001c49_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this is a different show. It might end as happy, or it might be even better! Tune in to find out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这是另一场秀。它可能以快乐收场，也可能更好！敬请收看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc6c_0000261e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this is the last time. If she so much as breathes on me again, I'm gonna shove her forms so far up her ass she'll be coughing up ink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这是最后一次。如果她再敢对我喘气，我就把她的表格塞进她的屁股深处，让她咳出墨水来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Selma [11001640] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcselma01a_00001b6e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this is way better! I don't know what to say! Other than thank you. Not saying that would be rude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这比那好多了！我不知道该说什么！除了谢谢你。不说就太不礼貌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq5a_0000b0cb_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this is your home. You and Susie practically grew up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这是你的家。你和苏西****几乎是在这里长大的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel50c_00008113_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But those are the best kind! Hello! Real life is boring! Fake life is so much better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那才是最好的！喂！现实生活多无聊啊！虚构的生活好得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas01d_00003409_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But to actually find it...I don't know what to say! Other than thank you. Not saying that would be rude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但居然真的找到了……我不知道该说什么！除了谢谢你。不说就太不礼貌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq5a_0000b0c9_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But truth is, I hadn't seen her around in a while. Word is she did something batshit and got her ass locked up by her own people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但事实上，我有一段时间没见过她了。有传言说她做了什么疯事，被自己人关起来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam3_000087c6_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But unlike the Brotherhood or the Outcasts, our goal is to dismantle this tech before it becomes a threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但与钢铁兄弟会或流放者不同，我们的目标是在这些科技构成威胁之前将其拆除。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac02_00003e49_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But we can just take whatever we want without paying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们可以不付钱，想要什么就拿什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But we don't have much in the way of law. When there's a dispute, we get together and try to iron things out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们没有太多法律方面的内容。当有争议时，我们聚在一起试图解决问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01duplica_00006cd5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what about the message? It might be a clue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那信息呢？可能是线索
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_000037a4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what about the message? It might be a clue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那信息呢？可能是线索
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130n_00005359_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what if this thing is try to tell us something? Shouldn't we at least try to communicate with it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果这个东西试图告诉我们什么呢？我们难道不该至少尝试和它沟通吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00c_00005a92_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But when I go to sleep tonight, I'm totally gonna turn that reality into a dream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但今晚睡觉的时候，我肯定要把这个想法变成梦想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But when the blast of war blows in our ears, then imitate the action of the tiger! Stiffen the sinews, summon up the blood!

ESP.TRADUIT: 沃特金斯医生

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Watkins! Are you all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃特金斯医生！您没事吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice2\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007287_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Watkins, please! This is a sensitive issue!
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃特金斯医生！请注意这是个敏感话题！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice2\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000726c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor, if I may have a word?
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生，我能说句话吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcpatientze_00003572_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctors are people too. They have friends, lives, families...asking them to move isn't easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生也是人。他们有朋友、生活、家庭……要求他们搬家并不容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2a_00007af2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does anyone else live in the chapel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 教堂里还住别人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does anyone in the city know it's an act?
ESP.TRADUIT: 城里有人知道这是装出来的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it matter if you're ready? Those children need you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备好了又有什么关系？那些孩子需要你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it really need to be called the Underworld? If these ghouls want to be respectable, they should work on their branding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非得叫"冥界"吗？这些尸鬼要想体面点，该换个招牌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000234a9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that actually work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那真的有用吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq4_0000271f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that mean you won't be doing any more plays?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是不是意味着你不会再演戏了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the phone ring every night?
ESP.TRADUIT: 电话每晚都响吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does what work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么东西管用？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter what's inside. These chem fiends are too stupid to tell the difference.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管它里头是啥，恶魔帮那群蠢货分得清个屁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter. It doesn't do diagnostics anymore. It's been reprogrammed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。它不再进行诊断了。它已经被重新编程了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dog
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be a stranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别见外
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_goodbye_00000938_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be alarmed, but I think it sounded like a scream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别慌，但我听起来像一声尖叫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_0000236b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be silly. You're rehabilitated! Violence is beneath you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别犯傻。你已经痊愈了！暴力手段配不上现在的你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007272_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't beat yourself up. I had a lot of fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别自责，我玩得挺开心

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't blame the old fart, it's hard to see when your head's up your butt. Especially with all the farting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别怪那个老屁股，他的头塞在屁股里，当然看不见东西。尤其是还老放屁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq4_00002703_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't bother with bloatflies and molerats brother, I've got a date with a deathclaw's mother!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别去管那些肿胀苍蝇和鼹鼠兄弟，我要去和死亡爪的老妈约会！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00007995_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't drop your guard. We assume it's trap until we know otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别放松警惕。在知道真相之前，我们都把它当作陷阱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't even ask. He joined some gun-toting crazies out east.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别提了，他加入东边一群持枪疯子
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DAB] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000dd0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't forget to ask a salesman for a test drive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 试驾记得找销售员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_goodbye_00035c94_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't forget to get Three Dog's autograph. May not be worth shit now, but what if we run into one of his relative's or something? Shit might be worth a whole lotta caps to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记得要三狗签名！现在不值钱…万一撞见他亲戚？能换海量瓶盖！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c70_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't forget to set the land mines before bedtime, honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别忘了睡前埋地雷，亲爱的
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcminefield_hello_00000e15_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get lost out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 荒野当心迷路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_goodbye_000180fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't I know it. I arm wrestled a mutant once, and it was like trying to bench press a truck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂，有次跟变种人掰手腕，感觉像在举卡车
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DAB] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000dd2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know, but there's only two sets of stripes on the flag, white and red.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道，国旗就红白条纹
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a3_00000d22_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know. Can't say I'm not curious, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道。但我不能说我不好奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam3_000087c7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know. She'd be insulted if I even asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道，问了她准生气
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DA7] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000dd5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know. Supposedly people on the other side say chips are french fries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道。据说大洋彼岸的人把薯片叫做炸薯条。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007484] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern02\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern01a_0000748b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know. Supposedly people on the other side say chips are french fries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道。据说大洋彼岸的人把薯片叫做炸薯条。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007484] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't look up, but the sky is now lava.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别看天，现在天上是岩浆
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00006e56_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't mind me, just taking care of this dust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甭管我，正除尘呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mike [110081A1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmikevoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000081b5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't pay him any mind dear. I think you fit right in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别理他，亲爱的。我觉得你很合群。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempkrist_000180d5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't pay him any mind dear. I think you fit right in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别理他，亲爱的。我觉得你很合群。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempster1_000180fa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't pick up that phone. Nothing good can come out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别接那电话，没好事
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_goodbye_0000097e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't play dumb, asshole. We know you hired those thugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别装傻了，混蛋。我们知道是你雇了那些暴徒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't play dumb. I know about the corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别装傻了。我知道那具尸体的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't take it the wrong way if I bite you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我咬你别误会
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00006e59_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't tell anyone, but I'm scared out of my mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别告诉任何人，我快吓疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't tell anyone, but when Maddie missed Sally she shot me in the arm. I patched myself up though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别告诉别人——麦迪没打中莎莉，子弹擦了我胳膊。自己包扎好啦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cd3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think so. I had dust on my boots, but there was concrete under my feet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不觉得。我靴子上有灰尘，但我脚下是水泥地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03f_00001c47_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't underestimate that preacher. You can't know what crazy does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别小看那个传教士。你永远不知道疯狂会干出什么事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_00003da4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't walk away! Let me show you the time of your life!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别走啊！包您体验极乐巅峰！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ivy [110019E4] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_hello_00001a4c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't walk away. Let me show you the time of your life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别走啊！包您体验极乐巅峰！.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benedict [110056A2] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_hello_00005d5c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about me. Just make sure you and Sarah stay behind the glass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心我。只要确保你和莎拉待在玻璃后面就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcprojectpu_00018b4e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about that. Worry about what the zombie will do if you don't talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心那个。如果你不说话，担心僵尸会做什么吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about what my husband says. You'll fit right in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甭听我丈夫瞎叨叨，您合得来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_greeting_000180cf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, as long as none of us pick up the phone, we'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，只要没人接电话我们就没事
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00003e66_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I can handle myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我能照顾好自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I can't sweat it, because I think my pores are sealed shut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我无法为此出汗，因为我的毛孔我觉得已经封闭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_00004bc4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I have complete faith in your abilities. When you're done, come by the bar and we'll plan what comes next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放一百个心！完事了来酒馆商量下一步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_000052aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I just want to talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我只是想和他谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, it was just a virtual flesh wound.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，那只是一个虚拟的皮肉伤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, it's nothing serious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，没什么大不了的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I've got thick skin. It goes hand in hand with living in my town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我脸皮厚。这跟我住的小镇是相辅相成的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic6_00002661_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I've got your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我罩着你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_followerstactic_000187d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I've got your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我罩着你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcfollowtac_00014906_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, I've had my fill. I guess I just wanted to go back to a time when things felt normal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我已经喝够了。我想我只是想回到一切感觉正常的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb34_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, the commies will never break me. You can count on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，共党永远打不垮我。你可以相信这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins02_00005a55_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, we'll find who did this to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我们会找到是谁对她下手的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, when those brats aren't looking, I’m gonna spit in their food. Way better than fighting, am I right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，等小屁孩不注意，我往他们饭里吐口水！比打架强多了对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066D8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_00025c96_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, you don't have to take me anywhere. I just want to see what's out there, and it'd a little less scary if you were by my side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，你不必带我去任何地方。我只是想看看外面是什么样子，如果你在我身边，就不会那么害怕了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90g_00007294_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, you'll get used to Mara slandering me. I know I have. Where are you from, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，你会习惯玛拉诽谤我的，我都习惯了，话说你从哪来？

ESP.ORIGINAL:
Given her previous trials, both Doctor Watkins and I feel that the Mara personality type is the most promising of all the models we've previously programmed. This is a strange twist, as we had expected the meeker Sean personality type to be the least violent of the three.
However, while it seems Sean is less inclined to incite violence, his internalization of that rage only seems to make things worse. While the odds of him being involved in a fight are lower than that of his peers, his instability and lack of social qualities makes him an unlikely candidate for the outside world.
ESP.TRADUIT:
考虑到她之前的试验，沃特金斯博士和我都觉得玛拉的人格类型是我们之前编写的所有模型中最有前途的。这是一个奇怪的转折，因为我们原以为温和的肖恩性格类型是三个人中最不暴力的。
然而，虽然肖恩似乎不太倾向于煽动暴力，但他内心的愤怒似乎只会让事情变得更糟。虽然他卷入斗殴的几率比同龄人要低，但他的不稳定和缺乏社交能力使他不太可能成为外部世界的候选人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Given most raiders read at an elementary school level, I guess it's natural they'd end up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毕竟掠夺者多半只念过小学，聚在这儿倒不意外。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good thinking. Let me know if I can be of further assistance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好主意。如果我能提供进一步帮助，请告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good timing. I could do with a hot meal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来得正是时候。我正好想吃顿热饭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you.

ESP.TRADUIT: 厨房里的那家伙在卖弱效品。你知道的，狂暴针，杰特。但如果你想要量子，我想你得和老板谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_00008105_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Talent! So you are proud of your little trick. No need to hide it Jonesy. Just own it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！才能！所以你为你的小把戏感到自豪。没必要藏着掖着，琼西。承认吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002b04_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! You told a joke! Groucho Marx, right? Ah Jonesy, I always knew you had it in you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！你讲了个笑话！格劳乔·马克斯，对吧？啊，琼西，我一直都知道你有幽默感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjoneshammo_0000b0e9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, I never imagined when we paired up that I would be the sentimental one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我从没想到我们俩搭档之后，我会变成那个多愁善感的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00c_0000ab19_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, and they said machines can't have emotions. But it was pretty agonizing not being able to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，他们还说机器不能有感情。但不能帮忙确实很煎熬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001b9f7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, be careful what you wish for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，小心你的愿望成真。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30320e_00005cd3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, fair enough asshole. So who won this fictional arm wrestling match of yours?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，够损混蛋，所以你编的掰手腕谁赢了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DA7] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000ddc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, far be it for me to argue with my best customer. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我可不敢跟我最好的顾客争辩。给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b3_00005390_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, figured you'd be back to see how we took care of the Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，猜到你会回来看咱们怎么料理那老东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000c582_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, hardly. That was the first time you saved my life. As for the others, well, I've lost count.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，才不是。那是你第一次救我的命。至于其他几次，嗯，我已经数不清了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcprojectpu_000034d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, hardly. That was the first time you saved my life. As for the others, well, I've lost count.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，才不是。那是你第一次救我的命。至于其他几次，嗯，我已经数不清了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcprojectpu_00018b50_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, human is one thing I shall never be. But if you'll allow me to fake it, I'd like to say a word or two.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，人类是我永远不会是的东西。但如果你允许我假装一下，我想说一两句话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudreyfin_00016cc2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, I always knew you had a mischievous side. Probably why I stayed away. If there's one thing I hate, it's drama.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我就知道你也有调皮的一面。可能这就是我一直避开你的原因。如果有什么是我讨厌的，那就是戏剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00l_0000b1da_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, I forgot you're not from the old world. Don't worry, it's not important. At least, not anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我忘了你不是来自旧世界。别担心，这不重要。至少，现在不重要了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb2d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, I guess it's just as well. This face was made for TV anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我想这正好。反正我这张脸是为电视而生的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00002ca4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, if anything, he needs to put more on. The only exercise he gets is when he's hiding in a corner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，如果说有什么的话，他需要穿得更多。他唯一的运动就是躲在角落里的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30320a_00005cd6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, I'm actually not speaking in metaphors this time. When I say key, I mean that quite literally. Come on, walk with me and I'll explain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我这次其实没说比喻。我说“钥匙”，是真的字面意思。走吧，跟我来，我给你解释。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4ed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, it ain't work, that's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，那肯定不是工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a4_00002c45_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, it's not often those words are spoken to a ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，很少有人对尸鬼说这话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_000052a5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, it's not that bad. At least, once you get used to that rusted iron smell. But I can see why an outsider would hate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，没那么糟。至少，一旦你习惯了那股铁锈味。但我能理解为什么一个外来者会讨厌它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpchs0c_000180cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, it's that obvious, huh? Well, I wasn't always like this, but the wastes have a way of changing you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，这么明显吗，是吧？嗯，我以前不这样，但废土总有办法改变你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50e_00003e67_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, maybe I oughta start praying to your god then, cause mine got a little too much wax in the ears, if you know what I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，也许我应该开始向你的神祈祷了，因为我的神耳朵里塞了太多耳屎，如果你懂我意思的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar00d_000026bc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, now that's funny. Why don't you reach into that ass of jokes you got there and go fuck yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，那才好笑。你为什么不从你那个装满笑话的屁股里掏出来操你自己呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx00c_00002c08_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, pretty much. We've got the Pride and the Robot. Two robots, actually, but who's counting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，差不多。我们有傲军和机器人。实际上是两个机器人，但谁在乎呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001b9fe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, that sounds familiar. I'm glad you got out a little faster than I did. I don't know if I could've waited two hundred years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，听起来很熟悉。我很高兴你比我早一点出来了。我不知道我是否能等上两百年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001846e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, that would be fun for a little bit. But long term, I imagine most people would want something less violent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，那会有点乐趣。但长期来看，我想大多数人会想要不那么暴力的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001847b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, that's all right. It'd be stranger if you weren't. That's kind of where I'm at.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，没关系。如果你不紧张才奇怪呢。我现在就是这种状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001b9fd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, that's what you said yesterday, and the day before that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你昨天和前天也是这么说的
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdotcarneg_00000942_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, there was a body there when I moved in too. Topside can be a pretty dangerous place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我搬进来的时候这里也有一具尸体。地表可能是一个非常危险的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia05c_00015f10_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, we'll see about that. If there's one thing I was good at, it was making sure my customers leave happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我们拭目以待。如果说我有什么擅长的，那就是确保我的顾客开心离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb23_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, well, I suppose I can't win 'em all. Besides, I'm not paying you to have an opinion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，嗯，我想我不能赢得所有。再说，我付钱给你不是让你发表意见的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00a_000033c5_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，嗯，虫子越大，枪就越大。我只是庆幸你没有被卷入交火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar00c_000026bb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, what a dumb fuck, writing all this shit down. Now all we got to do is find someone who can cook it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！这蠢蛋居然全写下来了！现在只要找个会配药的就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b09d_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你一分钱一分货，对吧？是啊，我个人认为他是慈善案件，但谁知道呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam5_0000a2e7_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你把我难住了，小子。希望你的咬合力能和你的叫声一样响亮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00d_00004c9c_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你说的好像我是个英雄。我所做的不过是按了几个按钮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcprojectpu_00018b4d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, you make it sound like we're a family. I suppose it does feel like that sometimes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你说的好像我们是一家人。我想有时确实是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage10_00002344_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, you think I don't know that? But apply enough pressure, and smart enough guy can turn junk into Jet.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightball1_0000bece_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, you're kidding right? Your dad would be pretty disappointed if he found out you were a thief.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你在开玩笑吧？如果你爸爸知道你是个小偷，他会很失望的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00h_00009646_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你说得对。我想这里有些人忘了我们都曾是鼹鼠。
