ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha-ha-ha! Silly me. Where does the time fly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈，我真傻。时间都去哪儿了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e32_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha-ha-ha, and then you went up to her, made a bunch of gestures, and the next thing I know you're both on the floor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈，然后你走上前去，做了些手势，下一秒我就看到你们俩都倒在地上了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_00005cc7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha-ha-ha, good point. Maybe it's me that's the problem. Wouldn't be the first time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈，说得也是。也许问题在我身上。这也不是头一次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail oh Hail oh infantry, bring the battle or follow me, a wasteland ranger’s life for me, where nothing in this world is free!
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬啊，致敬啊，步兵，带来战斗或者跟随我，荒原游骑兵的生活属于我，在这世上没有什么是免费的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00007993_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Half the battalion's already wet their pants, and the other half is holding on by the skin of their willies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一半的士兵已经尿裤子了，另一半也快撑不住了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000043b4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hand me the dynamite, will ya? I need to blow this safe to smithereens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把炸药递我，我要把这保险箱炸成渣
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_000033cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hands up motherfucker! You got five seconds to tell me who you are and what you're doing here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱头蹲下杂种！五秒内交代身份来意！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001fdc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hank
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉克
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : Caucasian Clas : Settler

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hank Williams - Lovesick Blues
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉克·威廉姆斯 - 《相思病布鲁斯》
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pre-War Radio Broadcast [110034D9] (mod) Quest : ([110034DA]x3DNPCRadio3DNPCQuest) Atomic Radio EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcradio3dnpcvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpcradio3dnp_000034f4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hank's always forgetting his tools.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉克总忘带工具。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_0000b1e2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hannibal's a brave man to stay in one place. But he cares more about helping people than helping himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉尼拔能坚守一处，是个勇敢的人。但他更关心帮助别人，而非自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hannibal's right. Ridding the Memorial of Super Mutants and slavers is a good idea. But moving in seems like a terrible one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉尼拔说得对。清剿纪念馆的变种人和奴隶贩子是好事。但搬进去住？蠢透了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9f4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happy birthday!
ESP.TRADUIT: 生日快乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066D8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000066da_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happy hunting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狩猎愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_goodbye_00003e4d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hardly. It's more of a parlor trick than anything. You give me any two integers to multiply, and I can produce an answer in a matter of seconds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几乎不是。这更多是个小把戏。你给我任何两个整数相乘，我都能在几秒钟内给出答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002b00_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Has there ever been a successful integration?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有成功的案例吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haskins
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈斯金斯
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : Ghoul Clas : Shopkeeper

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hate to say it, but I'd be willing to bet old man Wilks ain't among the living. The kid might be better off moving to Megaton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然不太愿意说，但我猜老威尔克斯估计已经不在了。那孩子可能搬到梅加顿会更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079b8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a good time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩尽兴！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benedict [110056A2] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_goodbye_00005d56_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a seat, supper will be ready in just a minute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坐！晚饭马上好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcminefield_greeting_00001cba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have some Nuka-Cola. It'll give you some pep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喝点核子可乐。它会让你精神抖擞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have there been any more incidents?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you always been this combative?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你总是这么好斗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you considered expanding the town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你考虑过扩建城镇吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever considered training those children yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有想过自己训练那些孩子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever met someone who works in entertainment? Idiots, every last one of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见过娱乐圈混的没？全是草包！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005967_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever seen President Kimball? I heard he has the wit of an Einstein and the mustache of a Civil War general. No wonder he's the President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过金博尔总统吗？听说他有爱因斯坦的脑子加内战将军的胡子，难怪能当总统
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_000033d3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever thought about going back to help the other androids?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有想过回去帮助其他的仿生人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard anything about anyone else escaping Vault 101?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有听说过还有其他人从101号避难所逃出来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard of the Army of the Free Men?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过自由人军队吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you thought about looking for your militia?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有想过寻找你的民兵团？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you tried highlighting certain sections to make it more clear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有试过高亮某些部分，让它更清晰？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haven't seen you around here before. What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 头回见你啊，需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c84_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Having the password won't mean a damn thing if we can't defend ourselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们不能自卫，密码就毫无意义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hawk
ESP.TRADUIT: 鹰
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : Hispanic Old Clas : 06015675

ESP.ORIGINAL: He can be found all over the wastes, wherever slaves hide. Which for you, is good and bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在废土各处出没，只要有奴隶藏身的地方他都会去。对你来说，这既是好事也是坏事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic4_0000f4dd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He can't do high fives! His body won't move!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不能击掌！他的身体动不了了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcboopbeu3_000030c7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He did. He's the only one who knew. Well, besides Kate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是他。只有他知道。嗯，除了凯特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30350b_000063da_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He didn't lend me anything. That was a lie he made up so I'd cover his tracks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他什么都没借给我。那是他编造的谎言，好让我替他掩盖行踪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He didn't tell you? We're Luddites. We hunt old technology, and take it apart so it can't do any more harm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他没告诉你吗？我们是卢德分子。我们追查旧科技，然后拆解它，这样它就不能再造成伤害了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_00004c9d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He found me in a cage, believe it or not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信不信由你，他是在一个笼子里找到我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq1b_00008801_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has information that's irrelevant to your operation. That's all I'm here for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他掌握的信息与你的行动无关。我来这里就是为了这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is you. You are him. Monkey from the moon. Sidekick to Cosmos.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是你，你是他，月球来的猴子，科斯莫斯的跟班
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc02a_000008d4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He just...talked. He said my life was worth more than the entire store, and that value is what gave me strength, and made my master weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他只是……跟我说话。他说我的生命比整个商店都更有价值，而这种价值给了我力量，让我的主人变得软弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind

ESP.ORIGINAL: He keeps pushing my buttons, and it won't be the pages that go missing. Butcher will see to that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一直在挑战我的底线，到时候失踪的就不会是那几页了。屠夫会确保那一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e5a_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He keeps saying we're close. Well, so are they.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一直说我们快成功了。好吧，他们也快到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e56_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He knows that if you want to cripple an army of slaves, you don't put a gun to their heads. You go after their stomachs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他清楚得很：要废掉奴隶大军，枪指脑袋没用——得掐断他们粮道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_00010931_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He said all we need is a babbly thingy, right? Then let's go get it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他说我们只需要一个“叭叭”的东西，对吧？那我们去找吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_boop0c_000030a2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He saved us. He wrestled that raider to the ground and kicked the gun away. That's when I shot him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他救了我们！把掠夺者扑倒在地踢开枪，我趁机补的枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c7a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sure loved that thing. More than his own family even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他确实很爱那玩意儿。甚至超过了自己的家人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He took the body and left. Didn't say a word. Poor boy was probably sick with grief.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他带着尸体离开了，一句话也没说。可怜的孩子大概悲痛欲绝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00c_00008121_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used to live in Megaton, but word is he came into quite a sum of money and moved into the Resort Homes near Reclining Groves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他以前住在兆吨镇，但有消息说他得到了一大笔钱，搬进了斜坡林附近的度假屋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b20_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a real shaman looking motherfucker too, like feathers and shit coming out of his helmet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他也是个真正的萨满模样混蛋，头盔上还插着羽毛什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c40_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was bitter. He worked two jobs and we still made more than him. You heard him, he even did the math.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他心怀怨恨。他打两份工，我们赚得还是比他多。你听到了，他甚至算了账。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcmara01_00005d2b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was crazy. Don't let it get to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他疯了。别往心里去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was definitely acting weird that day. Like he already knew the result.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他那天表现得很奇怪。好像他已经知道了结果。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was great! The witch was like "Grrrr!" and Beep-Beep was like "Whooosh!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 他太棒了！女巫是“吼吼吼！”而哔哔是“咻！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc6d_0000261f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was plenty thankful, if I recall. He was shedding tears of joy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我没记错，他非常感激。他流下了喜悦的泪水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BF] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect03\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect6_0000a403_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was the barber. Ten years he shaved that man's neck and didn't give him so much as a nick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是理发师。十年间他给那个人刮胡子，连一点点刮伤都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03e_00001c29_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was thinking about what song would best commemorate Detective Conrad's death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他正在想哪首歌最能纪念康拉德警探的死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was trying to save his career.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想挽救自己的事业。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was trying to save his career.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想挽救自己的事业。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He would've succeeded to, if I didn't stop him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我没阻止他，他也会成功的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He’s been living in the VIP suite for three days now, and we don’t exactly have the muscle to get rid of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在VIP套房住了三天了，我们没那本事赶他走
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00d_000008b7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard about places like this. You stick a corpse in the ground, and they wake up zombies. It's like planting seeds or some shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说过这种地方。把尸体埋进土里，它们就会变成僵尸。就像种种子之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_00003da3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh, I never did make an effort to bond with anyone here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵，我从来没有努力和这里的人建立关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here we are hanging on by a thread and this guy's got both feet on his desk, stroking his dick on some commie bullshit.

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you take the lead, and I go home?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来带路怎么样，我回家了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are things with you? Staying healthy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你过得怎么样？身体健康吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are those calculations coming along?

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can a person be with someone if he is alone? It is like the cell that becomes a man. Without division, there is no life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个人如果孤独一人，他怎么能和另一个人在一起呢？这就像一个变成人的细胞。没有分裂，就没有生命。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_00014293_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh, you're back. After the shit you pulled, I didn't think I'd ever see your face again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嚯，居然敢回来？搞完那出破事，我以为你这张脸早该烂在臭水沟了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0b4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? A phone? Argh, I'm going back to sleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？电话？啊，我要回去睡觉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcphone_000015d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? I'm not following your logic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？我不明白你的逻辑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humanity comes with a lot of perks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做人好处多多

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humanoid or not, robots have no place in society.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论是不是人形，机器人在社会上都没有立足之地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hunting rifle, huh. What you hunting? Is it people? Haha, yeah, it's people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 猎枪啊。你在打什么？是人吗？哈哈，没错，是人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_000034c3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry up, I ain't got all day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞快点！老子没闲工夫耗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000a2fa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually found the first episode in that safe we unlocked. And let me tell you, it is fantastic!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我实际上是在我们解锁的那个保险箱里找到了第一集。让我告诉你，它太棒了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02d_00002afd_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually got great fashion sense. What I don't have is the money to pay for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老子审美顶级，缺的是付钱的子儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000065ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually meant for you to give it to Richard. Just as an option. Ultimately, they're his kids, so it's his call.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我其实是想让你把它交给理查德。只是一种选择。最终，他们是他的孩子，所以由他来决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01c3_000035aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually prefer cars that are fuel efficient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我其实更喜欢省油的汽车。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually thought Kate was a mute. So I tried learning sign language just to say hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我那时真的以为凯特是个哑巴。所以我试着学手语，只为和她说声“你好”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_00005cc6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. At least the graveyard tells the truth about what it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。至少墓地如实地说了它是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. But when they're done, we kill them too. We give them all graves to sleep in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。但等他们做完，我们也杀了他们。我们给他们所有人一个坟墓安息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00b_0000815c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. I'm just trying to nudge him toward my way of thinking. And maybe it'd be a little easier to accept coming from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。我只是想把他往我的想法上引导。而且，如果你来说，他可能更容易接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01c4_000035ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. No reason not to give everyone four walls and a roof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。没有理由不给每个人四面墙和一个屋顶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. Not until they're knocking on your door, anyway. I just wanted to point out how different our perspectives are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。反正直到他们敲响你的门之前都不会。我只是想指出我们的观点有多么不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba29_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. There's no reason to pay her anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。没有理由付她任何钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. We need furnaces to heat our homes, and a fridge to store our food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。我们需要熔炉来取暖，冰箱来储存食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac02d_00001c84_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. Whatever it is, I doubt it's paranormal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。不管那是什么，我怀疑都不是超自然的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. You've built a good home here. One mistake doesn't change that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。你在这里建了一个好家。一个错误改变不了这一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I almost feel sorry for the poor fellow who has to clean up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我几乎为那个可怜的家伙感到难过，他得负责打扫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_00010928_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I almost feel sorry for these clones. It's not their fault they are the way they are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 差点可怜这些克隆人。长成这样又不是他们的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001845e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already bought my boy Junior his first glove. He's going to play for the Congressmen some day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早给小杰买了第一只棒球手套，这小子将来要进国会队的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcminefield_greeting_00001cb1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already know how this ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经知道结局会如何。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_00014284_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I also saw a giant robot shooting lasers out of its eyes, and a unicorn dropping grenades out of its ass. So take what I say with a grain of salt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还看到了一个巨大的机器人眼睛里射出雷射，和一只独角兽屁股里掉出手榴弹。所以对我说的话，你听听就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_00007342_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I always knew you'd come back. In a way, it's like you never left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道你会回来。从某种意义上说，你从未离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel50a_00007a68_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am certainly not against shooting people in the name of improving the world. Saving people, well...it's just not as fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然不反对以改善世界的名义去杀人。拯救人们，嗯……就没那么有趣了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01d_00004bc3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am man enough to handle anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我够男人，能处理任何事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not saying a thing until I speak to my lawyer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我见到我的律师之前，我什么都不会说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am rather hideous, but mostly on the inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实相当丑陋，但主要是内在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00d_00004bb5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am sorry as well. You know not what your actions mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也很抱歉。你不知道你的行为意味着什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc190b_0000b0ad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the skipper. And you're Skip. And this peanut butter on my thumb is Skippy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才是船长。而你是斯基普。我拇指上的这块花生酱是“斯基比（Skippy）”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_00003536_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am. But I have two eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是。但我有两只眼睛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000043a0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate it, but I'd rather just have caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感激，但我宁愿只要瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate it. I actually do feel like one of the locals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感激。我确实感觉自己像个本地人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate the support. Sometimes when people have so little, they find it hard to give.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感谢你的支持。有时当人们拥有的很少时，他们会发现很难给予。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03c_00006ce3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate your help, Beulah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助，比尤拉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ask him why we we're still here when he has the journal, and he keeps on spewing this bullshit about missing pages.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我问他为什么他有了日记我们还留在这里，他却一直胡扯什么缺少了几页。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e5a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I barely talk to anyone from my teenage years. I envy you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我几乎不和我青少年时期的任何人说话。我很羡慕你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe every man is innocent until proven guilty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信每个人在被证明有罪之前都是无辜的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe if you have an objection you should speak your words with conviction. Only then will you earn the respect of others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信如果你有异议，你应该充满信念地说出来。只有那样，你才能赢得他人的尊重。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Casilla [11002740] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcknightcasillavoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_0000b131_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe in peace, but not pacifism. I'm a warrior, but I don't like war. Although you gotta admit, it's pretty fun to fight 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我崇尚和平，但并非和平主义。我是个战士，但我不喜欢战争。不过你得承认，跟他们战斗还挺有趣的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000029a7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you have a delivery to make.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您该去送货了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0ba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you, but my ghoul friend over here has her doubts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你，但我旁边的尸鬼朋友有她的疑虑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you, but my ghoul friend over here has her doubts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你，但我旁边的尸鬼朋友有她的疑虑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you. I don't think you're to blame.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你。我不认为你该被责备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet he's saving it for a special occasion. Or when he runs out of material.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我赌他要留到压轴，或者没货了才放。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0c0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet if we dug up the pavement, we'd find an Indian burial ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌挖开路面准能找到印第安墓地
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_000037ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet it must've come as a shock to open the door and see Casey fucking Clarkson on the other side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开门看见凯西·克拉克森本尊肯定吓尿了吧
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00001f28_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you're here to score some Quantum G, right? Think you can get me some? I'm totally good for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来搞量子引力的吧？能匀我点儿不？保证守信用！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_000080f8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet. Some of the technology they're using is beyond anything I could ever imagine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢打赌。他们使用的一些技术超出了我所能想象的任何东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001b9f5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can and I will. If Vernon's right about the phone, then all we have to do is not answer it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能，而且我会。如果弗农关于电话的理论是对的，那么我们所要做的就是不接电话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130l_00005357_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can help you find what you're looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以帮你找到你要找的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can name a few off the top of my head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我随口就能说出几个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can never fault a soldier for doing their duty. Even if it means dying in a hole like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从不责怪士兵履行职责。哪怕这意味着要死在这破洞里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00003db4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can only hope this transmission finds you in time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只希望这份电波能及时找到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([11005510]3DNPCScribeRadioPA) 3DNPC Scribe Radio PA

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can only hope this transmission finds you, and that you recognize the importance of the knowledge I keep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只能希望这信号能传到你那里，也希望你能意识到我所掌握的知识的重要性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([11005510]3DNPCScribeRadioPA) 3DNPC Scribe Radio PA EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can see why people like canned food. But food in a box? Most of it tastes like mold and mothballs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罐头食品受欢迎我能理解。但盒装食品？吃起来多半像发霉的樟脑丸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000065aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can see why people like canned food. But food in a box? Most of it tastes like mold and mothballs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罐头食品受欢迎我能理解。但盒装食品？吃起来多半像发霉的樟脑丸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_000034bf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can spare a can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能省下一个罐头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't actually sell you a car sweetie. You'll have to talk to a salesman for that. What I can do is show you the ins, and the outs of this big, bad
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，我不能真的把车卖给你。你需要去和销售员谈。我能做的是向你展示这个大家伙的里里外外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c90_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't be sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能确定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe Richard lets that roach just waddle around here like it's a pet. That thing is gross.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理查德竟让蟑螂当宠物乱爬...恶心死了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003580_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe we're helping these slavers. I expected more from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不敢相信咱们在帮奴隶贩子。看错你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001848e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe what happened..poor Jessica...she was still so young.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信发生了什么...可怜的杰西卡...她还那么年轻
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00003e60_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you told Zimmer about Harkness. If you did the same thing back when we met, I'd still be in that sim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你居然向季默出卖哈克尼斯？要是当初对我这么干，我还在那破虚拟世界里蹲着呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018492_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you're making jokes. We almost died there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信你还在开玩笑。我们差点死在那里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't change the sign, but I've been calling it Vernon's Chop Shop instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 改不了招牌，但我一直叫它弗农切肉店
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon03_00000975_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't go back to wandering the wastes, and I can't go back to town. I need this diner. There's nowhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能再回去流浪废土，也不能回城镇。我需要这家餐馆。没有别的地方了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053ae_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't help you if you lie to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你对我撒谎，我帮不了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't imagine why anyone would say they were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法想象为什么会有人说他们是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't kill one life to save another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能为了救另一条命而杀掉一条命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't leave the diner, and I don't know how to use a gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能离开餐馆，也不会用枪
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon04_00000977_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't leave. Not now when I'm so close. I can't risk the travel no more than I can risk defying those mercenaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能离开。我现在离成功如此之近。我不能冒险旅行，也同样不能冒险反抗那些雇佣兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4_0000b087_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't make any promises, but sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不敢保证，但行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_00009450_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't make any promises, but sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不敢保证，但行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcslashesse_000034c8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't move as fast as I used to. Looks like Father Time is gonna get another notch in his belt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 腿脚不比当年利索喽…死神腰带又得多刻道痕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcprospectors_greeting_0000a40a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't replace him. I can only be myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能取代他。我只能做我自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't wait to see the kitchen. You're gonna love my recipe for radroach pie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等不及要进厨房啦！我的辐射蟑螂派保准馋哭你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066E2] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_00008196_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I certainly felt the impact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实感觉到了撞击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I come from a small town about thirty miles west of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自这里以西约三十英里外的一个小镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3_0000231f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I coughed up blood this morning. I think I'm really sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今早咳血了…怕是真病了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022DB] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000066e1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could be, I very well could, but would a communist want to blow up a famous socialist landmark? Because I totally would. Wink-wink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可能是，我很有可能，但一个共产主义者会想炸掉一个著名的社会主义地标吗？因为我完全会这么做。眨眼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpcaranaskin_00003410_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could get on good terms with them. Maybe they'll let me inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能和他们搞好关系。也许他们会让我进去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could go for bottle of wine. Something old and expensive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒是想喝一瓶葡萄酒。那种陈年又昂贵的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba27_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could never leave this place. The life I had before was ten times worse than what we're dealing with here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我永远离不开这儿，以前的日子比现在糟十倍
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005369_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't disagree more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完全不同意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't for the life of me figure out what it was for. But hey, maybe you can use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死活想不起是开哪的，但你说不定能用
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc101exita_00000824_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't go back to town. Not after what happened. I needed this place. It had to be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能回城镇。发生了那件事之后。我需要这个地方。它必须在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053af_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't muster up the hate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法聚集起仇恨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank01_0000aaff_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't really tell you why. Maybe there's a part of me that thinks every man deserves a place to rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的说不出为什么。也许我内心深处认为每个人都应该有一个安息之地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc03e_000022b9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could've told you that five years ago. The vault was a much happier place without him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 五年前我就能告诉你。没有他，避难所会更快乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia04b_00009664_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cried too, the moment I realized we weren't getting a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也哭了，当我意识到我们没有得到任何奖励的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BE] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect02\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect6_0000a400_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did no such thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有做过这种事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did, and while I don't want to be rude, I have to say I have reservations about the new delivery girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拿了，虽然不想失礼，但我对新送货员有顾虑
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e1e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did, didn't I. Granted, Sentinel Lyons could've done the same. I have a sneaking suspicion she's an android, judging by her fondness for metal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做到了，不是吗。当然，莱昂斯哨兵也能做到同样的事。我有点怀疑她是个机器人，从她对金属的热爱来看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01_0003b9f2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did, didn't I. Granted, Sentinel Lyons could've done the same. I have a sneaking suspicion she's an android, judging by her fondness for metal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做到了，不是吗。当然，莱昂斯哨兵也能做到同样的事。我有点怀疑她是个机器人，从她对金属的热爱来看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did. And you two were working at McKinley's store, right? I remember you told me how you used to swipe cash from the register.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得。你和你们俩在麦金利的商店工作，对吧？我记得你告诉我你们以前是怎么从收银机里偷钱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cc1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't even notice you were gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至没注意到你离开了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't know how much things like dresses and perfume cost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道像裙子和香水这些东西要多少钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70c_000063ee_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't know there was one until you mentioned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到你提起，我才知道有一个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't know what I wanted...vengeance, forgiveness, or just something familiar...but the point was moot. I didn't remember where it was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我想要什么……复仇、原谅，还是只是想找点熟悉的东西……但这个想法没有意义。我不记得它在哪里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_00015f36_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't mean to do it...I swear!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是故意的...真的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cbe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't need your help, and I'd appreciate it if you stayed out of my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要你的帮助，如果你能别挡我的路，我会很感激。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't say they did. You, on the other hand, are the biggest parasite I have ever known. What do you want this time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没说他们吸。你，另一方面，是我所知最大的寄生虫。这次你又想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB25]x3DNPCMQ02) The Free and Pure EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpcmq02_x3dnpctsenaudre_0000ee1f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't see anything, but it was a lot to process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么也没看见，但有太多需要处理的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot01_0000614c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't think America's last great patriot was also a Nazi sympathizer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没想到美国最后一个伟大的爱国者竟然也是个纳粹同情者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00005a4b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't understand a word you just said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你刚才说的话我一个字都没听懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I disagree compadre. I'd say your "luck" is a product of good planning, talent, and being an unstoppable badass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不同意，我的朋友。我会说你的“好运”是周密的计划、天赋和作为一名势不可挡的硬汉的产物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortarque_00008dc9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I disagree. Wars are a part of life, and the better your weapon, the better your
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不同意。战争是生活的一部分，你的武器越好，你的

ESP.ORIGINAL: I disagree. Yes, it's dangerous, but you know as well as I that it's the same wherever you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不同意。是的，这里很危险，但你和我一样清楚，无论你走到哪里都一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel50e_0000811a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do detest violence, however. So I'll be waiting outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我确实憎恶暴力。所以我会去外面等着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyfin_0000ab12_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do love your casseroles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我超爱你的砂锅
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e10_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not know this "Hall of Fame." So I have no opinion on what being inside it constitutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道这个“名人堂”。所以对于身处其中意味着什么，我没有意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjoneshammo_0000b0ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do say so. In fact, I insist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实是这么说的。事实上，我坚持这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq5b2_0000b0d1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do what I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尽力而为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do, as a matter of fact. It's right here. This should make things easier to parse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实有。就在这里。这应该能让事情更容易理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac02_00001c7b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do. The people at the Lantern are probably sick of my face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实会。灯笼那里的人可能已经厌倦了看到我的脸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempkrist_000180ec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe in souls or gods of any kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信灵魂或任何神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care about your egghead experiments, Doc. Just tell me how to get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生，我不在乎你那些书呆子实验。告诉我怎么出去就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care how I look! It's my reputation that's on the line here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎我看起来怎么样！这里关乎的是我的名声。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30350a_00005d1f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care how much treasure is in that grave, there's some things a man just can't do. Call it a code, if you will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管那坟墓里有多少宝藏，有些事我是做不出来的。如果你愿意，可以称之为我的准则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect1_0000a3e2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care what people say about me, so long as it's interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 评价随你便，够劲爆就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000595e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care, but Audrey insisted we check up on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎，但奥黛丽坚持要我们来看看你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't drink alcohol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喝酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000a413_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even know who your brother is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不知道你哥哥是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even want to speculate who that President might be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不想猜测那位总统可能是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't expect you to believe anything. I think you've already made up your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没指望你相信任何事。我想你已经下定决心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000a417_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't get this whole praying to a bomb nonsense. Praying to a gun, now that makes sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我实在搞不懂向炸弹祈祷这种荒唐事。向枪祈祷，这还说得过去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000299d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't get why these Big Town kids don't just invade Little Lamplight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白这些大镇小子为啥不直接端了小灯火镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034a3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have a conductor. Something tells me we don't really need it though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有列车长。不过，有种感觉我们并不真的需要它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have a problem with them. I used to be friends with Gob in Megaton. Good guy, bad skin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟他们没问题。我以前在兆吨镇和戈布是朋友。好人，皮肤不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Selma [11001640] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcselma03_00001b6c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have a sign because I don't believe in horse shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有招牌，因为我不相信鬼扯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have a steam gauge assembly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有蒸汽压力表组件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have many clients who are comfortable having sex with a ten foot mutant standing in the corner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可没多少客人愿意在角落里站着一个十英尺高的变种人的情况下做爱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_0000352f_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have to do shit. It's easier to find the journal and leave you here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要做什么狗屁事。找到日记，然后把你留在这里更简单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't just listen to it. I hear it. Sometimes in my sleep. But mostly when I press the play button.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不只是听。我是在听见它。有时在睡梦中。但大多数时候是在我按下播放按钮时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas01b_00004c62_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know a Greg Haskins, but I know a Holotape. As in, Holotape Haskins the Holotape King?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认识格雷格·哈斯金斯，但我认识一个全息磁带。就是那个，全息磁带之王，全息磁带·哈斯金斯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas01_00004c63_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know about that. He nearly blew the whole thing up so you could escape. I'd say that tells you everything you need to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不这么认为。他为了让你逃脱，差点把整个东西都炸了。我想这已经说明了一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001ba03_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know about this. I don't like taking orders from no machine. But when in Rome, wear a toga.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让机器发号施令？我可不乐意。但入乡随俗嘛...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know and I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我也不在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know how anyone can stomach walking around here. Here you have people bought and sold like pieces of meat and no one bats an eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不懂别人怎么忍心在这儿逛。活人像肉块似的买卖，居然没人眨眼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017dac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know how I'm gonna explain this to the boys back at the station.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道该怎么向局里的伙计们解释这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know how to swim, and I don't care to learn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会游泳，也不想学。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx04_00003dad_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if fixing them leaky pipes was a good idea. I think I'd enjoy watching people take showers outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 修水管这事儿未必高明…看人露天洗澡多带劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c61_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I like following someone with your reputation. Then again, I ain't exactly an angel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道跟着你这样的人是不是明智之举，不过话说回来，我也不算什么天使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000305e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I wanna hang out any more though. Dad likes you too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我不想再混了，我爸太中意你
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Susie [11006CC3] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00009563_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I want to. In a weird way, it's kind of peaceful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我是否想知道。说来奇怪，这有点平静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90a_0000728d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I'd be comfortable sleeping there though, a little creepy if you ask me. But if you want, you can use one of the booths.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我睡在那里可能不太舒服，如果你问我的话，感觉有点毛骨悚然。但如果你愿意，你可以用其中一个卡座。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50g_00003e6a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I'd go that far, but you're right, it's no Manhattan condo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道该不该这么说，但你是对的，那可不是曼哈顿的公寓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30320c_00005cd7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I'll ever be able to answer that. Probably better to just keep things simple. Take things one day at a time
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我是否能回答这个问题。也许最好还是保持简单。走一步看一步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01c_00008086_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if it's a good idea to give Sierra any more quantum. Then again, I'm afraid she might go ballistic if we don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不该再给塞拉量子可乐了...可又怕她发疯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018488_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if it's safer than the Temple, but it's easier to find, and that's just as important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 未必比神殿安全，但位置好找，这点同样要紧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I've seen it all. but Deathclaw pussy will clip your balls! Corvega and a barrel of rads, needle full of psycho and foot on the gas!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道自己是不是什么都见识过了，但死亡爪的逼会把你的蛋蛋咬下来！喝下可维佳汽水，再吃上一桶辐射，打一针心理稳定剂，然后猛踩油门！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000305f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if spreading trees across the wastes is a good idea. What if they start talking like Harold? An entire forest of that noisy motherfucker would make it hard to sleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土种树未必好…要都像哈罗德那样唠叨？满森林话痨树精…还睡个屁
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007365_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if that’s something to be proud of. It's like spilling a glass of wine, then patting yourself on the back after you clean up the mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道那是不是值得骄傲的事。这就像打翻了一杯酒，然后清理完残局后拍拍自己的背。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c1e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if these guys are for real. But it don't matter to me whether you're a vampire or a Frankenstein. Murder's murder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定这些人是不是真的存在，但不管是吸血鬼还是科学怪人，杀人就是不对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079bf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if this will satisfy your handlers, but it will have to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道这是否能满足你的操纵者，但只能如此了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightballh_0000b0b9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if you'd want to. Right around the time he was here, a couple settlers got snatched up by slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你是否会想这么做。就在他来这里的时候，有几个定居者被奴隶贩子抓走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempster2_000180dc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know much about music. Most of it got buried with the war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对音乐了解不多。大部分都随着战争被埋没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000caa2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what came over me. I just snapped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知怎么突然失控爆发了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_greeting_000072fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what the hell that preacher's saying, but it sure as hell ain't English.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道那个牧师在说些什么，但肯定不是英语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000299e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what the hell that preacher's saying, but it sure as hell ain't English.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道那个牧师在说些什么，但肯定不是英语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000299f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what you mean, but laugh all you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你是什么意思，但你随便笑吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins02_00005a52_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what you want from me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你想要我做什么！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyfin_0000aafd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what you want me to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你想让我说什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cfd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what you're expecting to get out of this partnership. But that doesn't really matter, does it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不指望这合作有啥收获…但无所谓对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00030c9a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你在说什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00004c7b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know you. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认识你。滚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000ee1a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know you. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认识你。滚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000ee23_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, I might sell you to slavers when this is all over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，等这一切结束，我可能会把你卖给奴隶贩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, I thought you were paying attention to that shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我以为你对那些狗屁很关注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BE] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect02\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect3_0000a3f6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, it's pretty far from okay. Far, like, toward awesome town, not what it usually means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，这离“好”还差得远。远，就像，朝着“棒呆镇”的方向，不是它通常的意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq0b1_00002737_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Anne said they died saving the vault. But I can't even see myself saving Amata from Butch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。安妮说他们是为了拯救避难所而牺牲的。但我甚至无法想象自己能从布奇手里救出阿玛塔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE:
NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind
Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel01_000081b1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. But I didn't like her attitude. Neither did the caller.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。但我就是不喜欢她的态度。打电话的人也一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. He could just be a coward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。他可能只是个胆小鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I could turn the place into a fix-it shop, but I don't think the Tower people are throwing away nuts and bolts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我能把这地方改成修理店，但我可不觉得高塔的人会扔掉螺丝螺栓什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053d2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I guess I just want closure. I want to be able to talk about those days without it being so goddamn awkward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我猜我只是想要个了结。我希望能谈论那些日子，而不会感到那么尴尬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcmara02_000063e1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I heard the phone ring, and I picked it up, just like he said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我听到电话响了，就接了，就像他说的那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I just can't imagine my blood swimming around in some other guy's dick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我就是无法想象我的血在另一个人的鸡巴里游来游去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern02d_000074a7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I'm getting cold feet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我有点退缩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11009627] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul02\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul01a_0000963e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It just felt awkward, giving her a proper burial knowing what happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。想到发生了什么，再给她一个体面的葬礼，我总觉得很别扭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_0000537e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It was seven years ago. I do know she didn't talk to me for like two years after that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。那是七年前的事了。我只知道那之后她有两年没理我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70a_000063e9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It's probably best you check with him first. In the end, they're his kids, not mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。你最好还是先和他商量。归根结底，他们是他的孩子，不是我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01c2_000035ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It's robot food, isn't it? Like, don't leave any scraps on the table!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。那是机器人食物，不是吗？就像，不要在桌上留下任何碎料！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc7a_00002305_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I've heard they use the tunnel system to move, but I can't tell you much else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我听说他们用隧道系统移动，但我不能告诉你更多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank04_0000ab03_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Maybe we spooked it. Or maybe it was raiders. We all know Jessica didn't belong to any choir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。也许我们把它吓跑了。或者也许是掠夺者。我们都知道杰西卡不属于任何唱诗班。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_000030e9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Out in the wastes, the answer could be any number of things, but I'd be careful, just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。在废土上，答案可能是很多种，但我会小心，以防万一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac03_00001c7c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Pure water, dirty water, it's not that big of a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。纯水、脏水，没那么重要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. She was living here when I found the diner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我找到这家餐馆时她就住在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053a5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. They just told me the order came down from Gabriel himself. I suppose it's because the vault dwellers were his slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。他们只告诉我命令来自加布里埃尔本人。我想是因为避难所的居民曾是他的奴隶主。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank01_000096a6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. They just told me the order came down from Gabriel himself. I suppose it's because the vault dwellers were his slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。他们只告诉我命令来自加布里埃尔本人。我想是因为避难所的居民曾是他的奴隶主。.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank01_000319e7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. To be honest, ever since that night, I've been going to sleep way before then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。说实话，自从那晚之后，我都在那个时间之前很久就睡觉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon03_000053d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. You weren't exactly thrilled to see us. It's like you knew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。你看到我们时并不怎么兴奋。就好像你早就知道了一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Your moral compass is the least of my concerns at the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。你的道德指南针是我目前最不关心的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know...you're messing with forces you don't understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道...你在玩火
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon01c_00000971_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like how the other boys tease you. But don't worry, when those brats aren't looking, I’m gonna spit in their food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 讨厌其他男生欺负你。等小屁孩不注意，我往他们饭里吐口水！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066D8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_00025c95_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like it, Virgil. We've never been the type to rely on outsiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢这出维吉尔，咱们从不靠外人
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac70conv_00000d27_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like soap. Baths are for town folk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢肥皂。洗澡是镇上的人才做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc6b_0000261d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like the idea of breaking into a place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢闯入一个地方的想法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like thieves, but I'm not against giving a first-time offender a slap on the wrist. I just make sure to use a machete.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恨小偷，但初犯可网开一面…用砍刀给点剁手警告就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000595f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like what you're implying, stranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢你的暗示，陌生人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00004c7a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't mean to tell you how to do your business, but writing a survival guide feels backwards to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是想对你指手画脚，不过写生存指南这事我觉得搞反了方向——
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370bf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't mind the test per se, but I question the timing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本身不介意考试，但我质疑它的时机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel03_00008197_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need a gun. I have Roachard to protect me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不用枪呢！有罗查德保护我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003ce4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need to tell you what I have to offer. Go upstairs and take a look for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 货色不必我夸，上楼自瞧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00005698_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need to tell you what I have to offer. Go upstairs and take a look for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 货色不必我夸，上楼自瞧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_00002e84_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need you to defend me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要你为我辩护。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need your help, but fine, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要你的帮助，但好吧，随便你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't owe that man anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不欠那个人任何东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_00006405_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really care what you do to Harold, but I will say this. He should feel lucky he can't move. Because the outside world is much, much worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈罗德爱咋处理随你，但话说回来。他该庆幸自己动不了，外头世界可比这糟心千万倍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9fa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't run from who I am. And I don't hide from any slaver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不逃避自己是谁。也不躲避任何奴隶贩子。
