ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack02_0000155d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't see why I have to wait. The whole system is ridiculous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞不懂为啥要等，这破规矩真扯
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006c99_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't suppose it would do any harm. Tell you what, you get him out of here, and I'll make it worth your while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这应该没什么坏处。这样吧，你把他弄出去，我给你好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_00002e84_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think he meant it as a compliment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为他意在表达恭维。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03_00006c9b_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I should get involved. You two need to hash this out yourselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得我最好别插手。你们俩需要自己解决这件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I wanna know the answer to that. And I don't have a clue what I'm supposed to do next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想知道答案。我也不知道接下来该做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90a_00007309_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I'd have the patience to live in a town like Springvale. And the raiders tend to lower the property value.
ESP.TRADUIT: 春谷镇这种地方我可住不惯。掠夺者最擅拉低房价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000369fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I'll be playing cowboys and injuns. It's not fun anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想玩"牛仔打红皮"了，没意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cd4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I'm getting drunk fast enough for my liking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 醉得不够快…急死我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_hello_00007491_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think Roy's skin is a bad fit for Tenpenny Tower. His choice in clothing is the much more grave offense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗伊那身皮进十便士塔不算糟。他挑衣服的品味才是重罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9fe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think siding with Father Birch is right. He cares more about his cult than the trees.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得不该帮桦树长老。他更在乎邪教，不是树木。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001849d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think so. Alicia was frying up the same gamey squirrels Joe was cooking, and it didn't taste like balls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么认为。艾丽西亚炸的是乔正在烹饪的同样的野味松鼠，但尝起来不像蛋蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maury [11015DE9] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmauryvoice\x3dnpcmq01b_x3dnpcmaury0b_00015e0d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think so. You find a dead man with half his face blown off, the last thing you are is hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么认为。你发现一个半边脸被炸飞的死人，你最不可能感到饥饿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc03b_000022b8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think that's what they mean by doggy style.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这怕不是"遛狗式"真谛吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benedict [110056A2] (mod) NPC : Ivy [110019E4] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_hello_00001a4d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think you give two caps whether Alicia's alive or not. Maybe if we chop off a few fingers, you might start giving us some honest answers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不相信你会在乎艾丽西亚是死是活。也许如果我们砍掉你几根手指，你才会开始给我们一些诚实的回答。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_0000aace_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think you were meant to join us, actually. They were ready to make their move before you walked in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你本不该加入我们。在你走进来之前，他们就已经准备好动手了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01d_00010912_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think you're supposed to be up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿小孩不能来吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c5a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand the motivation behind cloning yourself, not when you're one of a kind. But I suppose "Gary" was never really all that unique to begin with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞不懂克隆自己图啥，尤其你这号独苗。不过"盖瑞"这名字本来也烂大街。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba03_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand. What do you mean by "ID?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白。你说的“ID”是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't wanna be the one to dig your grave, Cooper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想成为那个给你挖坟的人，库珀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel50f_00008115_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't wanna know you. I don't want to talk to you. I'm here to collect two things. Caps and kills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想认识你。我不想跟你说话。我来这里是为了收两样东西：瓶盖和人命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a_00003dbd_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to talk about the details. It happened. I don't regret it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想谈论细节。事情已经发生了。我也不后悔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a1_00008131_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt anyone here knows anything. We'll need to talk to this "Family" to find out more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿的人怕是啥都不知道。得找那个"家族"打听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370ca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt I can do much of anything. He seems rather adamant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑我能帮上什么忙。他看起来相当坚持。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt it will. Animals stick to a pattern. They hunt in the day or at night, never both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑。野兽有固定的模式。它们要么白天捕猎，要么晚上捕猎，绝不会两者都来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50d_00003e59_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt the US government went to these sort of lengths to build the world's most ethically superior soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑美国政府会费这么大劲去制造世界上道德最高尚的士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00d_00003e45_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt things will change in the short term, even for people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑短期内事情会有所改变，即使对人类来说也是如此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt things will change in the short term, even for people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑短期内事情会有所改变，即使对人类来说也是如此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dunno. When I asked him why, he said, "Detective Brooks doesn't strike me as the kind of guy who listens to Top 40 radio."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。当我问他为什么时，他说：“布鲁克斯警探在我看来不是那种会听 Top 40 广播的人。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo01_000055fa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I enjoy it when we get in fights. Even more when we win.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢我们打架。更喜欢我们赢的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_combattonormal_000369ed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I even did the math, and you were making like 40 dollars an hour. That's a helluva lot of money for selling pop and jelly beans, that's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至算了下，你每小时能赚40美元。卖汽水和果冻豆能赚这么多钱，真是见鬼了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cd9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fear that won't be enough to sway them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我担心那不足以动摇他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4c2_0000beae_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel like some of these wasteland diners ought to serve their food in bucket.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我说，废土餐馆该用桶装饭
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000065ad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel like this is one of those old pulp mysteries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感觉像在看老式廉价侦探小说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018497_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fight the law routinely. I'm not a good person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我经常对抗法律。我不是个好人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured as much. Sorry to bother you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜也是。抱歉打扰你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured since I was up, I'd go have a smoke over by the diner, you know, to relax. Only clumsy me, I drop my matches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然醒了就去餐馆抽根烟放松下，结果笨手笨脚掉了火柴
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured someone would open that dumpster up sooner or later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜迟早有人会开那垃圾箱
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005384_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I forget, do you like to drink before or after a fight? Just don't say both or neither, I wouldn't tolerate either answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我忘了，你喜欢在战斗前还是战斗后喝酒？别跟我说都喝或者都不喝，这两种答案我都不能接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_combattonormal_000369f1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found a Vault 101 jumpsuit. It might have belonged to a someone I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了一件101号避难所的连体衣。它可能属于我认识的一个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found another dead soldier at L.O.B. Enterprises. Enclave this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在L.O.B.企业又发现具尸体，这次是英克雷的人

ESP.ORIGINAL:
I found the terminal with the first clue and destroyed the terminal per Protector Casdin's orders.
Unfortunately, I am so far unable to decipher the clue. The password I'm assuming is numeric, but the terminal suggested the clue could be found by looking at the Capitol Post logo. I've been staring at the logo for ten minutes now, and I don't see any numbers. All I see is the picture of a building.
ESP.TRADUIT:
我找到了有第一条线索的终端机按照守护者卡斯丁的命令摧毁了终端机。
不幸的是，到目前为止我还无法破译这条线索。我猜密码是数字的，但终端显示可以通过国会邮报的标志找到线索。我已经盯着商标看了十分钟了，我没有看到任何数字。我看到的只是一栋建筑的图片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this note on one of the leaders. It says you weren't to be harmed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这位领头身上找到这张纸条。上面说不能伤害你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gave 'em nicknames. Nosering, Manjaw, Cunt Lips...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给他们起了绰号。鼻环、人下巴、小穴嘴……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a1_00003dc2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gave 'em nicknames. Nosering, Manjaw, Cunt Lips...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给他们起了绰号。鼻环、人下巴、小穴嘴……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a1_00003dc3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get it. Mama always said one day I couldn't play pretend. That I'd have to be myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。妈妈总是说有一天我不能再玩假装游戏了。我得做我自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1a_0000267c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get nervous sometimes before plays. Not sure why. It's not like anyone's watching.
ESP.TRADUIT: 排戏前我老紧张，明明没人看的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003052_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get that she's trying to help, but these kids need to learn there's more to life than violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白她想帮忙，但这些孩子需要明白，生活中不止有暴力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplay04_00003c59_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get that they're ghouls, but Jet's a pretty addictive chem. Any more potent and it'll melt your brain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然他们只是尸鬼，但杰特这玩意儿真的会上瘾，再吸多点脑子都快烧坏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079b1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get that you hunt raiders, but how did you find out about this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白你追捕掠夺者，但你是怎么发现这个地方的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get that you want the wasteland to be green again, but is this the way to go about it? It just feels wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道你想让废土变绿，可非得这么干吗？总觉得不对劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001849e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get that you're being nice, but fetching soda ain't exactly in my job description. Maybe it ain't a good idea to help every person who asks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂你是好心，可跑腿买汽水不在我业务范围内。见人就帮未必是好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dcd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I getcha. One hand washes the other, am I right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂了。一手交钱，一手交货，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00c_00003375_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I go wherever the fuck I please, and you're in my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈想去哪儿就去哪儿，你挡了我的路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got a gal in Rivet City, she got freckles on her titties! Bubblegum, mutfruit, apples and cram, dinner with your spouse and a date with your hand!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在铆钉城有个妞，她胸部有雀斑！泡泡糖、变异果、苹果和饱饱牌肉罐头，跟老婆共进晚餐，跟自己手来场约会！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00003060_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got a notice saying I was owed a refund. Ten caps. The timing couldn't be better. I need the money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通知单说退我十瓶盖…太及时了！正等钱用呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [11001B2F] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001b5b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got it. All that's left to do now is find Gabriel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。现在剩下的就是找到加布里埃尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got something that'll fix you up real good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这里有东西能把你治好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got stuck in a simulation of a Pre-War suburb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被困在一个战前郊区的模拟程序里了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got stuff to chew if you want it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你想吃，我这儿有东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026C7]x3DNPCfollowersmortar) Post-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_00003057_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got the directions from the girl, I'll meet you there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问清姑娘路线了，那儿碰头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_goodbye_000052b6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got this one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我搞定这一个！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfollowerquest_attack_000369e8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess being a Free Man comes with some perks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜当个“自由人”还是有些好处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4eb_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess he won't be doing any more dedications.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想他不会再做任何献词了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess he won't be doing any more dedications.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想他不会再做任何献词了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I better brush up on my history then. There's a man in Rivet City who knows a lot about Pre-War government. I'll talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我最好恶补一下历史了。铆钉城有个人对战前政府了解很多。我会去和他谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00002a42_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess if I'm her friend, I'm supposed to shoulder her burdens. I just wish she'd do the same for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜作为她的朋友，我应该替她分担。我只希望她也能为我做同样的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70d_000063df_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll just do whatever it is normal humans do. I just have to figure out what that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我只会做普通人会做的事。我只是要弄明白那是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90e_0000730d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll just run it as a diner for now. I'm not changing my name to Dot though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我暂时还是继续开餐馆吧。但我可不会把名字改成多特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053d2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess not. I just thought he'd be hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想不是。我只是以为他会饿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc7a_00002306_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess our business is done. Shame about you and me though. Carver's starting to stink, and you'd look pretty good on a coffee table.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们的交易结束了。不过你和我的事可就可惜了。卡弗开始发臭了，而你放在咖啡桌上会很好看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightball1_0000becd_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess Richard was right. Guns are dangerous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理查德说得对，枪太危险了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cbb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess she never really came out of her camper. She didn't like being around the others. The poor thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想她从未真正走出过她的房车。她不喜欢和别人待在一起。可怜的孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50d_00003e65_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so. I know I'm not gonna be much of a parent. And I don't think I'll ever love those kids like I loved my own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜是吧。我知道我不会是个称职的父母。而且我也不觉得我会像爱我自己的孩子一样爱那些孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01d3_00003c90_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's as close as you'll get. They aren't exactly people persons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这已经是你能得到的最近距离了。他们可不是那种善于交际的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00006797_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's you then. So what happened here? Whose blood is that on the ground?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来是你了，这儿发生啥？地上谁的血？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00002cc4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the best thing to do is just block it out. Take things one day at a time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想最好的办法就是把它屏蔽掉。走一步看一步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01b_00008087_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the best thing to do is talk it over between the three of us, and go from there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们三个最好先谈谈，再决定怎么办。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c63_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the best thing to do is talk it over between the three of us, and go from there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们三个最好先谈谈，再决定怎么办。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003c82_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the mirelurk farmers decided the offer themselves up as food. Now that's dedication to your craft.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沼蟹养殖户主动献身当饲料？行…够敬业。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c64_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess we better go check it out. I don't give a shit about the town, but I can't have merchants getting scared to come north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们最好去看看，我不在乎镇子但不能让商人不敢北上
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00008159_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess what I'm saying is, I don't really like this world, but I like you. And if you're staying here, then so am I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想说的是，我并不真正喜欢这个世界，但我喜欢你。如果你留在这里，那么我也会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001847a_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess what I'm saying is, I'm starving. Let's go grab a bite to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说白了…老子饿疯了！搓饭去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_0000ab14_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess when I didn't come back, they got their answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想当我没有回来时，他们就得到了答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_0001427d_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you can't run a store nowadays without an armed guard. It makes sense, but I don't think I'll ever get used to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如今开店不配武装保安不行。道理我懂，可就是看不惯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018480_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you have a point, and I can't say I'm mad about the company. But you don't believe this nonsense about the phone, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，而且有伴挺好，但你不信电话那套鬼话吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcsecondrin_00000990_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you weren't ready for society after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你终究还是没准备好融入社会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess. I just did what anybody else would've done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜是吧。我只是做了任何其他人都会做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003c81_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had a feeling Chief Harkness was a droid. For one, he doesn't seem all that bothered by the stench.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我早就觉得哈克尼斯警长是机器人。首先，他好像压根不在意那股臭味。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370c7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had nothing to do with it, I swear!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这件事跟我无关，我发誓！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000aaf6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had to save you because your experiment failed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须救你，因为你的实验失败了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had to. The Android wasn’t fit for society.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须这么做。那个仿生人不适合社会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate losing my stuff. But I’d rather not lose my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌丢东西，但更不想丢命
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carah [1100813F] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00008153_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate those things too. I wish to subscribe to your newsletter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也讨厌那些东西。我希望订阅你的时事通讯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a friend who swears by zapping. Poor girl doesn't know what she's missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个朋友对电击情有独钟。可怜的女孩不知道她错过了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3e_00002713_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a present for you. A BB gun that fires real bullets, plus a gun manual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带了一份礼物。一把发射真子弹的BB枪，还有一本枪支手册。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have memories of airplanes like this, but they were made out of metal. Which probably makes me sound even crazier now that I think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记得这种飞机模型，不过是金属做的。现在说这个显得我更疯了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000080a5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have my moments. By the way, do you know where I left my shotgun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也有靠谱的时候。对了，知道我把霰弹枪放哪了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e47_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea why these ghouls were so hostile toward us. It must be the suit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞不懂尸鬼为啥这么凶，肯定是这身衣服闹的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0002a22c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea. For all I know, Casey killed this chem fiend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。据我所知，凯西杀了这个毒瘾犯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have nothing to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你没话说
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_000053ad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have so many questions, I'm not sure if I'm ready. What if the others don't accept me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有很多问题，我不确定自己是否准备好了。如果其他人不接受我怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child of Atom [11008210] (mod) Quest : ([11008212]x3DNPCmegatonchurch) Megaton Church EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleatom01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpcchurch02b_00008228_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some errands to run. Meet me at the RobCo facility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有些事情要办。在罗科设施见我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告辞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告辞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告辞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告辞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告辞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to resist the urge to act like a tourist in places like this. Part of me wants to walk up to that fountain and make a wish. The other part of
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这种地方得忍住别像游客似的。一半我想去喷泉许愿，另一半...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9df_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have Uncle Richard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我吸取了，理查德叔叔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcstage120p_00003cce_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have what I came for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要的东西到手了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经有了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have. Here's the proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拿到了。这是证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't the faintest idea. Nor do I care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一点都不知道。我也不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c44_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear that a lot, but I don't get it. Does having a soul make you more likely to file the wrong paperwork?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我经常听到这种说法，但我就是不明白。有灵魂就更容易填错表格吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs03a_00001b17_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear they got a rocket ship up in this joint. I say we fix that sucker up and sell it to the Chinese.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说这儿藏火箭？修好卖给中国人回本！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000349d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear ya. Right now I bet that Washo's running through their veins like a bad chill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂你。现在我敢打赌那股“沃肖”正像一场糟糕的寒意一样流淌在他们的血管里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60c_00002005_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you're selling chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你在卖毒品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard about Wally. I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说沃利的事了。我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard gunpowder came from the Far East, and I don't mean Annapolis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说火药来自远东，可不是安纳波利斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00007514_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard there was some free men living in Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说铆钉城住着一些自由人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack000a_000187a9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard this was the place to buy chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说这里是买毒品的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard you can't study for the G.O.A.T. But I crammed all night anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说"羊考"没法复习？可老子照样熬通宵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066E2] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_0000817d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard you did some good work for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说您替咱们办成事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jet [110056A0] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_hello_000056a9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope it's not on account of our last date. Unfortunately for our dance partners, it wasn't the kind you could walk away from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望不是因为我们上次约会。不幸的是，对于我们的舞伴来说，那可不是一场能轻易脱身的舞蹈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope our service was to your liking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 望您满意本店服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_goodbye_00001bed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope Roachard and woof-woof get along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望罗查德和汪汪处得来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003ca0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope some of the thugs around here follow your shining example!
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望这儿的混混们以你为榜样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [1100A2EE] (mod) Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem2\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136dd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope this Doctor you met knows what he's doing. Between him, me, and Jonesy, that would make at least one of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 盼着你遇见那博士心里有数。他加上我和琼西，总得有个明白人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0c1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope to see you soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 盼重逢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lily [1100106D] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_goodbye_00001a5e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you know what you're doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但愿你知道自己在做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000bed4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you'll visit the church when you have a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得空请来教堂坐坐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_greeting_0002c370_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope your lessons are going well. Your mother and I know how you like to play pretend, so we programmed your friend with that in mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望你的课程进展顺利。你妈妈和我都知道你喜欢玩假装游戏，所以我们在编程你的朋友时考虑到了这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11012ECA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopholotape1_000029e6_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're right. In my family, a good conscience is usually seen as a weakness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你是对的。在我家里，良知通常被视为一种弱点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000ab23_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I imagine Dickerson used to be like this. A place where people leave their hopes and prayers, and nobody bothers to answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想迪克森以前也是这样的。一个人们留下希望和祈祷的地方，却没人理会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000ebe8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I imagine if canned goods and soda pop were marked down any lower, they'd have to pay the customers to take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罐头汽水再降价，怕是要倒贴钱请人拿走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I imagine so. But one person doesn't amount to much. If everyone gives him a few weeks, he'll have almost as much as the rest of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想也是。但一个人也做不了多少。如果每个人都给他几周时间，他就会和我们其他人差不多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03a_00006ce2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I inherited my family caravan last fall. I told Izzy and she said I needed to pay taxes on the Brahmin. So I paid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去年秋天继承家族商队。伊兹说双头牛要缴税…我缴了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [11001B2F] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001b31_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just came to mingle, actually. I heard this party was where all the fashionable raiders come to maim, chem, and fornicate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是来社交的，其实。我听说这个派对是所有时髦的掠夺者来残害、嗑药、寻欢作乐的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey03_00004bc5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just find it easier to deflect my inadequacies instead of tackling them head on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是觉得回避我的不足比正面解决它们更容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01c_0001570c_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just followed the bread crumbs. You open up a terminal and maybe it mentions a top secret project.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是顺藤摸瓜。你打开一个终端，也许它提到了一个绝密项目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01e_00002338_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just kept walking and walking until that sun rose up behind me, and there it was. A chapel, and a grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就这么一直走啊走，直到太阳在我身后升起，然后它就在那里。一座教堂，一个坟墓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a2_00008132_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just know that in a bleeding contest, it takes longer for me to pass out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仔细想想也说得通。那些高墙把掠夺者挡在外面，和把杀手关在里面一样好用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher4_00003485_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just lost a friend. If he had something to do with it, he'll pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚失去一个朋友。如果这件事和他有关，他会付出代价的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just stumbled into this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是偶然闯入这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just think sometimes I fit better in that world, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是觉得有时我更适合那个世界，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001847a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just took out an entire town of raiders. What you're suggesting is suicide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚刚消灭了一整个镇子的掠夺者。你建议的事情是自杀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just try and give her space and let her know I'm here if she needs me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是尽量给她空间，让她知道如果她需要我，我随时都在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage10_00002344_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just want to get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just want to make sure you're safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想确保你安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just want to thank you once more for all you've done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就想再谢你一次
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_0000811d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted to say...I've been around a long time. Too long. And for the most part it's been a show on endless repeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想说……我活了很长时间。太久了。而且大部分时间都像是一场无休止的重复表演。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01h_00014986_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wish the conflicts we introduced didn't have so many variables.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是希望我们设定的冲突没有那么多变量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob02d_00007263_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I kind of did, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我好像有，其实。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew Dot back when she was Emma. The name change's still a little weird at times, but I'll get used to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识多特时她还叫艾玛，改名有时挺别扭，但我会习惯的
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot04_00000936_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew from the start she was trouble. She had bad news written on her like October of '77.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从一开始就知道她是麻烦。她的脸上写满了坏消息，就像七七年的十月。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcmackdamem_0000439b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know about the dumpster, Dot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道那个垃圾桶的事，多特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know in Pre-War times, people used them to communicate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道在战前，人们用它们来交流。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it was him. You have to get him to admit it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道是他干的，你得让他认罪
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_000063e2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it would be sacrificing a lot - everything, really - but it's his choice, not ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这等于放弃一切——真的是所有——但该由他自己选。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it's a rather selfish way of doing things, but we all have our weaknesses darling, you understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这是一种相当自私的做法，但我们都有各自的弱点，亲爱的，你懂的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_0002de09_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it's a sore spot with some folks, and I realize it can get cold out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这对某些人来说是个痛处，并且我意识到在外面可能会很冷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02_00006cbb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it's hard but we've got to keep moving. The people here are depending on us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道难受，但得接着走。这儿的人都指望咱们呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9eb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it's rough, losing your pops, but now's not the time for tears. We'll cry when we're safe in our beds and the Enclave is dead in the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爹没了是难受，但现在不是哭的时候。等咱们躺安全床上、英克雷烂地里，有的是时间哭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000870d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know just the kid to give it to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正好知道该送给哪个孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know she was using, but she was trying to quit. It just isn't easy for someone with her history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道她在吸毒，但她一直在努力戒。对她有那种过往的人来说，这不容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50a_00003e62_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that, I'm just asking you to pretend for a little bit. Come on, it'll only take a second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我只是让你假装一下。来吧，只要一秒钟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb22_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know the password. We shouldn't have any problems getting in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道密码。我们进去应该不会有什么问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know the way I talk isn't very knightly, or scribely, for that matter. But I can't help it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我的说话方式不太像骑士，也不像文书。但我没办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3a1_0000271a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know we lost a lot of karma, but I still call that progress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 业报值亏归亏，好歹算进步吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0001090f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what I ask isn't easy, but if we lose this opportunity, this knowledge may be lost forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我所要求的并不容易，但如果我们失去这次机会，这些知识可能会永远失传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4_0000b087_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what it's like to lose your men. I may have lost mine, but I'll be damned if Reilly loses hers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道失去手下是什么滋味。我也许已经失去了我的人，但要是瑞利也失去了她的手下，那我可就该死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000029a2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what you want me to say, so I'll just come out and say it. You're welcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你想让我说什么，所以我直接说了。不客气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00c_00005a3c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what you want. And I know how to give it to you, right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您要什么我门儿清…现在就能满足。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lily [1100106D] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00001a5d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, but that’s why it’s not a big deal. Tell me when you have good news, and then I’ll act surprised.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，但这就是为什么这没什么大不了的。等你有好消息了再告诉我，然后我会表现得很惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c1c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, I'm sorry. You just wanted to come to the party, not deal with all this...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我很抱歉。你只想来参加派对，而不是处理这些……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30350d_000063dc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, right? And at least your memory's still working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂，对吧？至少你的记忆还在工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00e_00009644_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, right? I can just imagine Amata's dad sitting in his office, looking at the cameras thinking, "Just have sex already!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂，对吧？我能想象阿玛塔的爸爸坐在他的办公室里，看着监视器，心想：“快去上床吧！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01a_00009651_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, right? I couldn't have planned it better in my head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对吧？剧本都写不了这么完美。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a_00005f0e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, right? You pull the trigger and microwave a son of a bitch right in the face!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，对吧？你扣下扳机，把一个狗娘养的脸直接微波了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3e_00002713_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. I feel like I hardly knew her. Probably because we never met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。我感觉我几乎不认识她。可能是因为我们从未见过面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. It doesn't make the burden any easier, but that's mine to bear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。这并不会让负担变轻，但那是我的责任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053bc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. They got to me before they got to you. Left me for dead, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。他们在对付你之前先找到了我。实际上，他们把我当作死人丢下了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001b9f6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like how they built this town on a crater. They're not afraid to own their past.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喜欢他们把镇子建弹坑上。倒是不避讳过去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017dad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like shaking hands with ghouls. Them hands are soft.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢跟尸鬼握手。那手可软了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034ba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like that the Brotherhood's trying to bring back pieces of the old world. I just hope they're willing to share it with the rest of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钢铁兄弟会想复原老物件挺好。就盼着他们别藏着掖着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9e3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like the air in the mornings. Smells fresh. But by the afternoon, it's already rotten.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢清晨的空气，闻着新鲜，但到下午就腐臭了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00005830_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like the air in the wastes. Smells like maggots and cheap cigars. This place is just too clean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢荒原上的空气。闻起来像蛆虫和廉价雪茄。这地方太干净了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000029a9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like the smell of this town. Same as it looks. Full of rust and bone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢这个镇子的味道。跟它的样子一样。到处都是锈迹和骨头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000caa3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like the way Doctor Lesko thinks. It don't matter how many people you kill, so long as you got a good excuse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱斯科医生这思路妙——杀多少人无所谓，借口好听就成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000734e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like the way you do things. You keep it up, and I might have to cancel your funeral plans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢你办事风格，继续这样我可能得取消你的葬礼计划
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_greeting_00003daa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like to bury a corpse a good eight feet down, in a strong piece of oak. It's not a coffin so much as a prison. And there's no getting out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢把尸体埋在八英尺深的厚实橡木棺材里。这与其说是棺材，倒不如说是牢笼。而且，绝无逃脱的可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00005839_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like to quote my so-called master. It keeps the blood at the right temperature.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢引用我所谓的“主人”的话。它能让血液保持在合适的温度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack04_00001c14_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like your dad. He doesn't know the meaning of quit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喜欢你爹这人，他字典里压根没"放弃"俩字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I liked you better before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢你以前的样子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I live here! You're standing on private property, my friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我住这儿！你站在私人领地上，我的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar02_00001c02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love it when a trip to the grocery store turns into a firefight. What a time to be alive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，以前去趟杂货店都能碰上枪战，那感觉还挺刺激的，真是个奇葩年代。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079a9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love seeing places like this reduced to rubble. All the money in the world couldn’t save these top hat wearing jackoffs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢看到这种地方被夷为平地。就算全世界的钱也救不了这些戴着高顶礼帽的混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_00005873_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love the smell of barbecue in the morning!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢清晨的烧烤味！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmortarquest_attack_00001c37_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love what the raiders did with this place. I've always said the best way to decorate a house is to blow it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢掠夺者对这个地方的改造。我一直都说，装饰房子最好的办法就是把它炸掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_0000aa4e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made him better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我让他好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop14_0000265a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean no disrespect ma'am. I just like being in the trenches. Back home, the only thing worth killing is time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无意冒犯，夫人。我只是喜欢在前线。在家里，唯一值得打发的就是时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Casilla [11002740] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcknightcasillavoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002cf9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, do you know how long I've waited just to have some time to myself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，你知道我等了多久才有了些独处的时间吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marie [11005F1B] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef2\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc05_00006cac_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, if the Railroad is helping them escape, then I think I want to be a part of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，如果铁路组织正在帮助他们逃离，那么我想成为其中的一员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcharkness_00018494_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, I'm not totally against the idea, but with those boys? No, thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，我并不完全反对这个想法，但和那些男孩？不，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01a_00009651_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, she wasn't right in the head. Plus she was old and rude and...I know it just sounds like I'm making excuses but...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，她精神不正常。而且她又老又粗鲁，还有……我知道这听起来像是在找借口，但是……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053a5_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, when I sent you on that mission, it was kind of like "Turn over a rock and see if 'the theory of everything' is under it." You know, sarcasm!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，当我派你去执行那个任务时，有点像是在说“翻开一块石头，看看‘万物理论’是不是在下面。”你知道，是在讽刺！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq5a_0000b0c9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, you get hungry, right? So you'll need a place to eat! See, I'm much more useful to you alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，你总得吃饭吧？所以你需要一个吃饭的地方！看，我活着对你更有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_0000680a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I met President Eden, actually. He's a machine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过伊登总统，实际上。他是一个机器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I might be able to help you write that survival guide. Chapter One. If it moves, kill it. Chapter Two. When it stops moving, eat it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 写废土生存指南我能帮一手：第一章《能动就杀》。第二章《不动就啃》。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007348_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I miss Roachard. Hopefully some of his cousins will come to the funeral.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想罗查德了。希望它表亲能来参加葬礼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cbd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must've died and went to Med-X heaven. Cause this here looks like a hospital. And where there's a hospital, there's drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准是死了上了吗啡-X天堂。因为这地儿看着像医院。有医院的地方，就有药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034a7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要喝一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a few days to grieve. Carnegie said he was going to clean up the camper if you wanted to stay the night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要几天时间来悼念。卡内基说他会清理那辆房车，如果你想过夜的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50g_00003e6a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need the words. Lucky for us, the other prototype has them. We just need to switch one for the other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要那些词。幸运的是，另一个原型机里有。我们只需要把一个换成另一个就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulah80b_0000378b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to get me one of those. But hard to do on my salary. Where's the body?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也得弄一间。但在我这点薪水下很难做到。尸体在哪儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00002cb3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to turn on the machine. The code is 2-4-7.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你打开机器。密码是2-4-7。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help, Boop. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的帮助，哔啵。跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help, Boop. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的帮助，哔啵。跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help, Boop. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的帮助，哔啵。跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help, Boop. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的帮助，哔啵。跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要你帮忙。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要你帮忙。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要你帮忙。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要你帮忙。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要你帮忙。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要你帮忙。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要你帮忙。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never explain why I do what I do. You're going to make your own conclusions, so why bother making myself a liar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从不解释行为。反正你会自圆其说，何必让我当骗子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000595b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never had any intention of doing so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从未有过这样的意图。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never really thought about it to be honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，我从未真正想过这个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never said anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么也没说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never sent anyone to the altar though. You're way better at it than I was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我自己从没撮合成一对。你比我强多啦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never told anyone this, but sometimes I loot a dead fiend's armor because I want to see them naked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这事儿没跟人提过——我有时扒恶魔帮装备，就为看他们光腚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000034ce_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never understood the appeal of drinks like quantum. You want something with bite, take a shot of gin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来都不明白像量子酒这类饮品有什么吸引力。要是想喝点有劲的，来杯杜松子酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fbc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never understood what the deal was with science and space rockets. Sure, this planet's a hot turd on a stale bun, but Mars ain't no picnic either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直搞不懂科学和太空火箭到底是怎么回事。没错，这颗星球就像个发馊的面包上的臭屎，但火星也绝不是什么好地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000299c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I offered to help Dot fix the streetlight, but she said it'd just attract coyotes, or worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我主动提出帮点修路灯，但她说那只会吸引郊狼，或更糟的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon04_000053d6_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I once met a girl who told me to "love your life." Well, I suppose it's not the first time I've been in an abusive relationship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有姑娘劝我"热爱人生"，呵…又不是头回遭PUA了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005965_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only helped you because I thought you'd help me get rich.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮助你只是因为我以为你会帮助我致富。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I prefer to clang my opponents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我更喜欢用撞击来对付我的对手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I prefer to surround myself with people who think differently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我更喜欢和那些想法不同的人待在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I probably can't convince either of you to stay, but I want you to know you'll always be welcome here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大概留不住你们，但记住这里永远欢迎你们
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_0000811d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I probably shouldn't mention Coyote Ridge to Scribe Yearling. Bitch might straight up invade us, if she knew how many books were in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好别跟文书叶琳提郊狼岭…那娘们要知道书库规模…怕不直接杀过来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c78_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I put it in a little of both. Some fried iguana for now, and some snacks for later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把它们分开放了。一些炸鬣蜥肉现在吃，一些零食留着以后吃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b2_00005391_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ran into someone who looked a lot like Susie Mack yesterday. Only it couldn't have been her, because she was actually nice to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我昨天遇到了一个长得很像苏西·麦克的人。但那不可能是她，因为她对我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00e_00009644_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I read a comic book once where a boy piloted a mech that large. I don't think this is what the author was trying to inspire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我读过本漫画，小孩开着这么大的机甲。作者肯定没想激励出这玩意儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_0000679d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I realize that, but it's over now. We move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白，但现在都过去了。我们继续前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really am the luckiest guy on earth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真是地球上最走运的崽
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006cb4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really appreciate you doing this for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这份恩情我记着了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_000052b7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't care about your motivations. I just want to prevent more deaths.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不在乎你的动机。我只想防止更多人死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't have an opinion on them either way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对它们真的没什么意见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really enjoyed cooking for everyone. It's gonna be sad to see all the empty chairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给大家做饭很开心，看着空椅子会难受
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00009564_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really need to get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really should've put that on the list.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真该把那写清单上
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_0000332e_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember reading about a National Guard Depot that was supposed to be a fallback location for troops. Might want to check there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记得有个国民警卫队仓库是部队撤退点，建议查查
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a3_00000c5f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I respectfully disagree. They had no trouble interacting with you, albeit some with rather unfortunate results.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢苟同。他们和你互动并没有问题，尽管有些结果很不理想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob01c_0000725e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I said "no" once already, didn't I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是已经说过一次“不”了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01d_000035a0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw it, I swear! You believe me, don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看见了，我发誓！你信我对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005a8f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw this camp when I came to Rivet City. Never thought about going inside, but you crazy like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来铆钉城时见过这营地…没想进去…您是真疯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c76_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I say we give the quantum to that perv Ronald. Man will pay twice as much if he thinks he's gonna get laid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我说把量子引力卖给变态罗纳德——那货以为能睡姑娘，价钱能翻倍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007351_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see a lot of empty shells around here. Might be some ammunition crates nearby. And seeing as these raiders ain't got use for them, well, we might as well take what we can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 满地弹壳...附近该有弹药箱。反正死人用不着，咱们笑纳了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dd6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see Mr. Thatcher, may I ask about your father's whereabouts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了，撒切尔先生，请问您父亲现在何处？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcmarcusizzy_00001ff8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. But not all ghouls can talk, can they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。但不是所有尸鬼都能说话，对吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child of Atom [11008210] (mod) Quest : ([11008212]x3DNPCmegatonchurch) Megaton Church EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleatom01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpcchurch03b_00008229_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. I didn't recognize you because you're a super mutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。我没认出你来，因为你是个超级变种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. It's too bad you couldn't also find a way to come here alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。真可惜你没能想办法一个人来这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0_0000b062_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Perhaps it's better they learn to defend themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。也许他们学会自卫更好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. So we hit them where they sleep, and hit them where they eat. I like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 懂了。趁他们酣睡突袭，用膳时强攻——这路子对我胃口！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000cc9b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. So you would give that journal to Brotherhood, and set us all back a millennium.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。所以你会把那本日记交给兄弟会，让我们所有人倒退一千年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc190a_0000b0ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shoot people. Raiders, to be precise. Sometimes for money, but mostly for fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀人。准确地说，是掠夺者。有时为了钱，但大部分时候是为了好玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey02_00004bc6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should ask you the same. Since apparently you're all living in an old ruin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也应该问你同样的问题。既然你们都住在一个古老的废墟里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should mention there's also a manual in there that'll teach 'em the basics. But in the end it's not exactly rocket science.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该提一下，里面还有本手册会教他们基础知识。但说到底，这玩意儿也不是什么高科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01c4_000035ab_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should've figured. Pretty much everyone who works for the IRS is a soulless bastard, you included.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我早该想到的。几乎所有为国税局工作的人都是没有灵魂的混蛋，包括你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60b_00001fe2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sincerely doubt it. Like all technological advances, their goal is to deprive the public of its use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此深表怀疑。像所有技术进步一样，他们的目标是剥夺公众的使用权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc2_0000b085_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spent a night in the Statesman once, and given how filthy the beds were, I can see why they built a hospital next to it.
