ESP.TRADUIT: 我在国宾馆住过一晚，床铺那么脏，难怪隔壁要建医院。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000255ee_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I stand corrected. You proved this town could survive a mutant attack. Let's just hope that's the worst of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收回之前的话。你证明了这镇子能扛住变种人袭击。但愿这就是最糟的情况。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I started The Army of the Free Men so no one will ever have to experience the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我创立了自由人军团，这样就没有人会再经历同样的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_00014288_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still can't believe it. I'm an android. I'm not even real. What do I do now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是不敢相信。我是一个仿生人。我甚至不是真实的。我该怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90b_0000728e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still need the key to the garage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还缺车库钥匙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suggest you be glad for what you got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我建议你为自己得到的东西感到庆幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06031ECA] (ID) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\maleadult02\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcjoemauryt_00015dfa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suggest you hurry. We have a reputation to protect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 建议您抓紧。咱招牌不能砸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_greeting_0000164c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I owe you an apology. Mack told me it was you who gave him the gun. I shudder to think what would've happened without it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该给你道歉。麦克说了枪是你给的——没它后果不敢想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cdc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose if the manual has tips on proper firearm safety, it wouldn't be a big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想如果手册里有正确的枪械安全提示，那就没什么大不了的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcchildreng_00003c5f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose if there was any place fit to call home, it'd be this dump.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想如果有什么地方能被称为家的话，那就是这个垃圾场了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose it's back to square one for this model.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这个模型得重新开始了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007277_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose that's possible, although I did check the entire building for weapons. Twice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这是有可能的，尽管我检查了整栋楼有没有武器。两次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003ca8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose this is a classic case of judging a book by its cover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这大概就是典型的以貌取人吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000724b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose we can ask for their forgiveness in the next life, if not this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们可以在来世请求他们的原谅，如果今生不行的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01g_0001570f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose we'll have to resort to fighting fire with fire. Or in this case, pulp with pulp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们不得不以火攻火。或者在这种情况下，以纸浆对纸浆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba23_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you might say, well, what's one more? But you have to admit it, it does add up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能会说，嗯，多杀一个又有什么关系呢？但你必须承认，这确实会累积起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01d_0001570d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you weren't in there very long. Glad you're okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你没有在里面待很久。很高兴你没事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001846d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you wouldn't. It's hard to think about anything except survival.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你不会的。除了生存之外，很难去思考其他事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001847c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you're right. Although I'd say ninety percent of the world's bullets are in this bar. What's another ten percent?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你是对的。不过我会说世界上百分之九十的子弹都在这个酒吧里了。再多百分之十又算什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest

ESP.ORIGINAL: I surmised as much. I swear to you I never meant for things to turn out this way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是这么推断的。我向你发誓，我从没想过事情会变成这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc1_0000b064_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear he practically ran to that control panel the moment I floated the idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢发誓，我一提出这个主意，他就几乎是跑向那个控制面板。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, I've told you everything. Now let me go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓全交代了！放我走！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_goodbye_0000ab05_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take it you mean President Kimball.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你指的是金博尔总统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take it you mean the three well-armed strangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你指的是那三个全副武装的陌生人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take it you'll be heading back home now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你现在要回家了吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thank you friend. You've completed your part of the bargain. Now it's time I complete mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感谢你，朋友。你完成了你的那部分交易。现在是我完成我的部分了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc180a_0000b0b8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thank you friend. You've completed your part of the bargain. Now it's time I complete mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感谢你，朋友。你完成了你的那部分交易。现在是我完成我的部分了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thank you friend. You've completed your part of the bargain. Now it's time I complete mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感谢你，朋友。你完成了你的那部分交易。现在是我完成我的部分了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc180c_0000bed7_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think Butch said something about you and Amata kissing in a tree, so I have to ask...what's a tree?
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇说你跟阿玛塔在树上亲嘴…所以树是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066D8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000066de_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think Carnegie's a little too hard on Jessica though. She's a runaway, and girls like that have been through hell and back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我觉得卡内基对杰西卡有点太严厉了。她是个离家出走的女孩，像她那样的女孩经历过地狱般的磨难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage10_00002344_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think Dr. Braun had something to do with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想布劳恩博士和这件事有关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think he may have been captured by slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想他可能被奴隶贩子抓走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I do. If you'll come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我准备好了。如果你愿意和我一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h_0000643b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I found something that might be of use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我找到了一些可能有用的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I hear voices, although naturally it sounds like gibberish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我好像听见说话声，虽然听着像胡言乱语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00020cc2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I prefer my meat a little less "well done."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我更喜欢我的肉不要那么“全熟”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac02d_00001c84_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I saw it in Junior's crib.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我好像在宝宝床里见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e48_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I swallowed my tongue. Oh wait, still there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我好像吞了舌头！...啊还在呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00002f3a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I was about two seconds from screaming for a light when all of the sudden the streetlamp flickers on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 差点就要喊人开灯时，路灯突然闪了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon01_00000960_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'd rather make it with an actual snake than those two tunnel brats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我宁愿和一条真正的蛇做，也不愿和那两个隧道里的小屁孩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01d_00009654_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'd rather make it with an actual snake than those two tunnel brats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我宁愿和一条真正的蛇做，也不愿和那两个隧道里的小屁孩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01d_00009656_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'm gonna be sick. Hold on, give me a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得我要吐了。等等，给我点时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [11005A13] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcarabos01c_00005a2b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'm gonna explore a bit today. I gotta soft spot for the outdoors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想今天去探索一下。我对户外活动情有独钟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Underworld Resident [11009626] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul01\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul00b_0000162d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's a good idea to break a rule every now and then, just to be sure you can think for yourself. Even better if the rule is one of your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 偶尔犯禁挺好，至少证明脑子归自己管。犯自定的戒律更妙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005953_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's a little too late for that. I'm not gonna keep hanging around here pretending like none of this ever happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得现在说这话有点晚了。我不会再像过去一样，假装这一切从未发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo04_00005d12_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's awesome. A giant, laser shooting robot. What's not to like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得很棒。一个巨大的、会发射激光的机器人。有什么不喜欢的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's best we part ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最好分头行动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's best we part ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最好分头行动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's for the best. Don't worry about the girl. If she's lasted this long without her parents, she'll be fine on her own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为这是最好的。别担心那个女孩。如果她没有父母能撑这么久，她一个人也会没事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulah80g3_0000263a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's time we parted ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是时候分道扬镳了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I've gotten enough information.
ESP.TRADUIT: 情报够用了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think moving to the Memorial makes sense. Lincoln was a liberator, but he was also a badass. Ain't no muties gonna fuck with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搬去林肯纪念堂靠谱！解放者兼狠角色…变种人都不敢惹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007354_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think so too. It really is the blue jumpsuit of graves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么认为。它真的是坟墓般的蓝色连体衣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudreyfin_00016cbe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think that's all the items on the list.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这就是清单上的所有东西了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think that's part of the reason I'm traveling these wastes. Maybe someone knows how to fix them. Maybe there's a way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这就是我行走在这些废土上的部分原因。也许有人知道如何修复他们。也许有办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara02_00008099_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think the same could be said for the trees here. They may be green, but that doesn't mean they aren't toxic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得这儿的树也一样。看着绿油油的，不代表没毒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think there's something wrong with the food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 饭菜好像有问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022DB] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000066e0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we just need help understanding the timeline here. So Casey lent you his apartment. Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要理清时间线，凯西为啥借你公寓？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00002cc7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we should arrange a meeting with a friend of mine in Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为我们应该安排在铆钉城和我的一位朋友见面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000b1f7_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we should travel together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们应该一起旅行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we're already past that point. Because if I don't make it, I want you to tell my chems I love them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们已经过了那个点了。因为如果我活不下来，我想让你告诉我的化学品我爱它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_00007339_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you did it, but I also don't think you did anything wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为是你做的，但我也认为你没有做错任何事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you got it wrong, it's the humans they keep in cages. If anything, they're the pets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你搞错了，他们关在笼子里的是人类。如果有什么区别的话，他们才是宠物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Underworld Resident [11009626] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul01\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul04c_0000161e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you have me mistaken for someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你把我错当成别人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you know how I feel about Zimmer. We should tell Harkness who he is, what he is. He has a right to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我对季默的态度。该告诉哈克尼斯真相——他是谁、是什么。他有知情权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018490_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you know what I want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你知道我想要什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_00003495_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you should lead the way, and I'll cover the rear. What do you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你该打头阵我断后，咋样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005362_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you'd have better luck teaching a molerat to mamba.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你教鼹鼠跳曼巴舞会更容易些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempkrist_000180f4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought about cutting the cord, but Carnegie says we shouldn't touch the phone. For once, I agree with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想过剪电话线，但卡内基说别碰电话，这次我同意他
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005363_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought about it. I spent hours thinking of new ways to piss on his corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想过。我花了几个小时想着用新的方式在他的尸体上撒尿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a4_00008134_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought after sending you on that errand you'd want to strangle me instead. I even bought a neck brace just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为把你派去跑腿后，你会想掐死我呢。我甚至买了个颈托以防万一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00c_00003e47_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought Big Town would be, well...bigger. I don't get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大镇就这规模？搞不懂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000af34_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought given her taste in attire, something simple would be nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞧她穿衣品味，琢磨着简约为妙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00032095_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought he was making fun of me. I thought you both were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为他在取笑我。我以为你们俩都在取笑我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kate [110055E6] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_00005cc9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought I knew better, but look at me. I'm just standing here doing nothing while the world rots around me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为我更懂事，但看看我。我只是站在这里无所事事，任由这个世界在我身边腐烂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01d3_00003c8f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought I was sick of it all, but your friendship is proof there are still things worth living for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为我厌倦了这一切，但你的友谊证明，仍然有值得活下去的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01h_00014986_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought maybe if I did this small deed, it'd feel like I was doing some good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，也许如果我做了这件小事，会感觉我做了一些好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudreyfin_00016cbf_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought our goals were the same, but now it's obvious we no longer see eye to eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为我们的目标是一样的，但现在很明显，我们已经意见相左了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([11005510]3DNPCScribeRadioPA) 3DNPC Scribe Radio PA

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought this might be a good place to ask if anyone's seen that barber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这可能是个好地方，可以问问有没有人见过那个理发师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack000a_000187a9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you didn't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为你不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5E] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler01\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c48_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you looked a little young. Well, rules are rules. Looks like it's soda and chocolate milk for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为你看起来有点年轻。好吧，规矩就是规矩。看来你只能喝苏打水和巧克力牛奶了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb2e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you said my name was Skip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为你说我的名字是斯基普。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_00003543_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you said you were a private eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为你说你是个私家侦探。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_0000439e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you were going to say you found a ghost inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还以为你要说你在里面找到了一个鬼魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a4_000053a0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought, given her taste in attire, something simple would be nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞧她穿衣品味，琢磨着简约为妙。.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03audre_00016cb5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told the Doc to stay down in the metro, at least until Butch calms down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我让博士待在地铁里，至少等到布奇冷静下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e5b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you, sweet pea, you should stick to revolvers. Always reliable and made in America!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过小甜心，你该用左轮，可靠又美国造！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e0d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took it with me. I didn't know where I was going, I just kept walking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带着他一起走了。我不知道要去哪里，只是一直走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a2_00008132_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried it on every lock in the house and the station, and nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把站里所有锁试了个遍都没用
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc101exita_00000827_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried looking. I tried staying in one place. Neither seem to be working all that well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试着找过。我试着待在一个地方。两者似乎都没什么用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c4b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried, but I couldn't bring myself to do it. Killing my master was one thing, but another man's?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试过了，但我下不了手。杀死我的主人是一回事，但另一个人的主人呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank01_0000aaff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I trust you got what you came for? Either way, we're done here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你拿到了你想要的东西？不管怎样，我们在这里的事已经办完了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightball1_0000bed3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I try and stay neutral on most things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尽量对大多数事情保持中立。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand completely, honey pie. But you have to realize society has been undergoing a gradual decline in values for the last three hundred years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完全理解，甜心派。但你必须意识到过去三百年来社会价值观在逐渐堕落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e44_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand if you both want to go. But I'm staying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我理解你们俩都想走。但我要留下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130h_00005353_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. I just hope the kids can hold out until it heals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白。我只希望孩子们能坚持到它愈合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplay04b_00002f00_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. Maybe you're like me, and have trouble making new friends. That's kind of why I haven't moved away from home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂。也许你和我一样，很难交到新朋友。这就是为什么我没搬离家的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30320b_00005cd1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to build couch forts as a kid. Couch cushions are a little easier to lift though. I have no idea who or what could've made this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小时候我也拿沙发搭堡垒，但垫子可比这轻多了。真猜不出谁搬得动这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000141bf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to dread our turn in the shed. Every night I'd curl up in this chair and pray my father wouldn't come near me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前我最怕轮到棚屋值夜，每晚蜷在这椅子上祈祷我爸别靠近我
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_0000812b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to guard a caravan, you see. But some ghoul-hating asshole started spreading rumors that I killed my client.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我以前是看守商队的。但一些仇恨尸鬼的混蛋开始散布谣言说我杀了我的客户。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq2_0000a2e5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to have a pet molerat. I scratched him behind the ears, he bit off a piece of mine...it was all very, very sweet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前养过一只鼹鼠。我给它挠挠耳朵，它咬掉了我一块肉……那真是非常非常甜蜜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00007517_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to live in the sticks, selling scraps to caravans. I was about thirteen when a friend asked me if I wanted to join a gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前住在乡下，卖废品给商队。我大概十三岁的时候，一个朋友问我要不要加入一个帮派。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a_00003dbc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to play Cupid all the time. Didn't have any luck with Sean or Kate, but now it makes sense why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前老当红娘。肖恩和凯特死活不成，现在总算明白为啥了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000a88c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I walked out the front door. Right after I put them slavers in the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从前门走出去。就在把奴隶贩子埋进土里之后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03_00001c28_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanna be a wasteland ranger! Iron, steel, blood guts and danger! Hoo-ah! Hoo-ah! Hoo-ah! Hoo-ah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想当荒野游侠！铁、钢、血、肉和危险！呼啊！呼啊！呼啊！呼啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmortarquest_attack_0000305d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanna be alone for a bit, if that's okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想静静…行吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_000026ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanna take that corpse down and bury it. But I guess if we did that, we'd have to bury all the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想把那具尸体弄下来埋了...可埋了他就得埋所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00010c83_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 我想讨论我找到的线索。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to discuss these clues.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想讨论一下这些线索。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我想把你的理论公之于众。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to go back to my earlier questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到先前的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to go back to my earlier questions.

ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道更多关于你正在进行的测试。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道更多关于你的化学家。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道更多关于你父母的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk about our fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈谈我们的争吵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk about Tranquility Lane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈谈宁静巷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk to Carver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和卡弗说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you not to attack enemies unless I've already engaged them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你不要攻击敌人，除非我已经先和他们交战了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to attack enemies the moment you see them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你一看到敌人就攻击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to change your combat style.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你改变你的战斗风格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to use melee combat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你用近身攻击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to use melee combat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你用近身攻击。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你用远程攻击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to use ranged weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你使用远程武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was a robotimacyst because Beep-Beep needed me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾是机器人药剂师，因为哔哔需要我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc5_000022d7_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was considering proposing to Emma, I mean, Dot. I'm just not sure with Jessica gone, it's the right time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在考虑向艾玛求婚，我是说多特，只是杰西卡刚走，不确定是不是时候
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_000053e2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was glad to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴能帮上忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was going to display it on the counter here. That way every customer who comes into my store will know just how much I love this country.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打算把它陈列在柜台上。这样每个进我店里的顾客都会知道我有多么爱这个国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins02_00005a46_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was going to say President Reagan, but sure, that guy works too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来想说里根总统，不过好吧，那个人也行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00005a48_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was going to say President Reagan, but sure, that guy works too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来想说里根总统，不过好吧，那个人也行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00005a4a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just going to throw it away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来打算把它扔掉的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was kidding. Dot caused all this. Carnegie was an unfortunate casualty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我开玩笑的。这一切都是多特造成的。卡内基是个不幸的受害者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was living out in Canterbury for a while, but then some weirdos in costumes showed up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在坎特伯雷住了一段时间，但后来一些穿着奇装异服的怪人出现了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia03_00009659_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was looking for that robot's battery. Too bad its damaged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在找那个机器人的电池。太可惜了，它坏了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was never a fan of Top 40 music anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正我从来就不是Top 40音乐的粉丝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was never in any danger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来都没有危险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was never in any real danger. But I bet you thought I was. Because acting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实我压根没危险！但你们都被骗到了对吧？这才叫演技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was only trying to be polite, dear. If I was angry I would've shot her in the chest and not the foot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想表现得礼貌些，亲爱的。要是我生气就会射她胸口而不是脚了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e30_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was pants on head stupid, so I had no idea what that really meant. He was fucking selling me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当时蠢透了，根本不知道那意味着什么。他妈的，他是在卖我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a_00003dbc_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was praying for a big galoot with a machine gun to show up, and here you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直在祈祷一个拿着机关枪的大傻瓜会出现，然后你就出现了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was singing "America the Beautiful" while you and your pinko friends were too busy cowering in the vaults!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唱着《美丽的亚美利加》的时候，你和你的赤党朋友正忙着躲在避难所里！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00004c7a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was sixteen, Sean! Sixteen! And the fact that you're taking his side, even now, it breaks my heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我那时才十六岁，肖恩！十六岁！而你现在还在为他说话，这让我心碎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo07_00006413_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was sure I'd welcome this day, but I find myself oddly disappointed. Well, no need for goodbyes, I'm sure our paths will cross again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本以为会欢庆这天到来，现在却莫名失落。也罢，不必道别，有缘自会重逢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followersfired_0000966c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL:
I was taken to the factory where the machine will be built, and for all the General's talk of secrecy, there was little attempt to hide the location, just north of the planned site for the Anchorage Memorial.
I suppose there's something to said about hiding in plain sight, but I wonder if some tourist won't walk onto some rooftop, point his binoculars the wrong way and see our machine staring back at him.
ESP.TRADUIT:
我被带到了制造机器的工厂，尽管将军一直在说要保密，但他并没有试图隐瞒工厂的位置，就在安克雷奇纪念馆的规划地点以北。
我想在众目睽睽之下隐藏是有道理的，但我想知道，如果有游客走上屋顶，把双筒望远镜指向错误的方向，会不会看到我们的机器在盯着他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was thinking maybe you could pick the song too. Something those romantic types like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想着也许你也可以选歌。那种浪漫的人喜欢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcbrooksdedi_00002cb8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was too, but then I got robbed, yeah, robbed, and now I don't have enough caps to get the good stuff!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是，但后来我被抢了，是啊，被抢了，现在我没有足够的瓶盖去买好东西了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_000080fc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾很软弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03_00001c0e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was wondering if that technology existed...if people had the chance to live in another world instead of this one. Do you think you'd do it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想，如果那种技术存在……如果人们有机会生活在另一个世界而不是这个世界里。你觉得你会这样做吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_00018470_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was working two jobs and taking classes. And to be honest, I can be a little self-absorbed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打了两份工，还得去上课。老实说，我可能有点自我中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70b_000063eb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't aware anyone died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道有人死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't aware that vaults used old world shops for cover. Well, I suppose if you want to stay hidden, it's always good to hide yourself in something
ESP.TRADUIT: 没想到避难所拿旧世界的商店当掩护。不过想藏起来的话，这倒是个办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba10_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't planning on it. I actually tried to get as far away from the vault as I could.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没打算这么做。我其实是想离避难所越远越好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia03_00009659_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't there. I wouldn't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当时不在场。我不会知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I welcome death. For one, it means no more waking up in the middle of the night. Not unless you're hungry for brains.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎死神光临！至少不用半夜惊醒…除非馋脑子啃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005956_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I went in and told the girl at the register I was his daughter, and I needed the key to his office.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我进去告诉收银台的女孩我是他女儿，需要他办公室的钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h_0000643a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will do whatever the fuck I please, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我想做什么就做什么，你管不着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will say this though. It was the most fun I had in a long, long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我得说一句。这是我很久很久以来玩得最开心的一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02c_00002c46_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will. Thanks friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会的。谢谢，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [11005A13] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcarabos03_00005a2c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I could be that trusting of people. It's the one thing I miss about youth.Well, besides the skin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望自己能像她那样信任别人。这是我怀念青春的一点。嗯，除了皮肤之外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00a_00004bb2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish it weren't so, but the world's a bad place, and you need to arm yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望不是这样，但这个世界是个糟糕的地方，你需要武装自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish. It'd be so great to see it topple. All that rubble, all that mayhem!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望如此。能看到它倒下一定很棒。那些废墟，那些混乱！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00004cb5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if I ask nicely, if some of them sexy vampires will bite me. But oh yeah, we should get back to Mr. King and tell him the news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是嘴甜点…性感吸血鬼会咬我不？哦对…该回去给金先生报信了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007360_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if it ever occurred to these raiders that they could rebuild this house. Oh who am I kidding, a bomb would make for a better carpenter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说掠夺者想过重修这房子吗？哈，开什么玩笑，炸弹都比他们懂木工。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0002a22b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if my skin is starting to get as thin as my hair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道我的皮肤是不是开始变得像我的头发一样薄了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_0001570b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if polygamy would be introduced to help diversify the gene pool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道是否会引入一夫多妻制来帮助基因库多样化。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if they'll just let me live up here. There's a bed, plenty of supplies. I might need a lightning rod though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知能否长住…有床有补给，就差根避雷针了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [11005A13] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00005a2d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder what people in the old world did with their trash. Did they actually put it somewhere? Can't just toss it outside like we do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想旧世界的人怎么处理垃圾。他们真找个地方放？总不能像咱们这样往外一扔了事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034bc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't deny that. In fact, I'm sure your talents go far beyond dealing with muties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会否认这一点。事实上，我确信你的才能远不止对付变种人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00a_00002e78_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't try to stop you. But your actions today will change the course of human civilization. And I'm afraid it's for the worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会试图阻止你。但你今天的行动将改变人类文明的进程。我恐怕是变得更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightballh_0000b0ae_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like to see Sean in a dress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒想看看肖恩穿裙子的样子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would love to have you around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你能待在我身边。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would never let that journal out of my sight. Unfortunately, I can do little else but serve witness to this folly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我绝不会让那本日记离开我的视线。不幸的是，我除了见证这场愚蠢之外，几乎无能为力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc190d_0000b0b1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would prefer a hot bath and some camomile tea. Failing that, some indication we're on the right track would be nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要热泡澡和一些洋甘菊茶。如果不行，能有些迹象表明我们在正确的轨道上就好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would put it to the airwaves. Let it spread from station to station across the continental United States.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把它通过电波传播出去。让它从美国大陆的一个电台传到另一个电台。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc2_0000b086_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would tell you, but it'd only confuse you further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会告诉你，但这只会让你更困惑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't call that shock, dear. Shock is when I stick your finger in a socket and poor boiling water on your head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不觉得那是震惊，亲爱的。震惊是当我把你的手指插进插座，然后把开水浇在你头上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't call us friends, but they aren't hostile, if that's what you mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会说我们是朋友，但如果你的意思是他们不怀有敌意的话，那倒是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't call us friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会说我们是朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't have to if you'd done a better job of parenting, machine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这个机器能更好地扮演父母的角色，我就不必这样了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't know. He barely talked to anyone, let alone me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。他几乎不跟任何人说话，更别说我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia04c_00009668_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't know. It tastes okay, but I could never tell the difference. I guess time will tell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。尝起来还行，但我一直分辨不出有什么不同。我想时间会证明一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001ba04_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't mind taking a bite of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: z真相咬你一口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ivy [110019E4] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00001a47_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't miss it for the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会错过这个机会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would've never figured Chief Harkness was an android. I guess that's why I'm a soldier and not a detective. I don't get paid to think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我压根没往那方面想——哈克尼斯警长居然是机器人？难怪我只能当兵当不了侦探，这行不动脑子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dd3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, for one, will not be a prisoner to my own nostalgia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，绝不会成为自己怀旧情绪的囚徒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_00004bc1_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, on the other hand, plan to die in the most unique way possible. Although I'll settle for an uncommon one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于我？死法必须独一无二。退而求其次也得标新立异。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002747_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...I barely knew the woman. And to be honest, I always thought her cooking was lousy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我几乎不认识那个女人。老实说，我一直觉得她厨艺很烂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053ca_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...I don't know. Where am I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...我不知道。我在哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patron [11000EF7] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00c_0000109c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...I don't understand. The voices on the radio...were they talking to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...我不明白，电台里的声音...是在跟我说话？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_00006428_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...I think I understand. Papa used to say that too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我想我明白了。爸爸以前也这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1a_00002675_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...I think I understand. Papa used to say that too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我想我明白了。爸爸以前也这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1b_00002676_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...I think I'll take that drink. To be honest, I've never tasted it clean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我想我要喝那杯酒。老实说，我从未尝过纯净的酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000a419_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd at least entertain the thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我至少会考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be all for it, provided we saved enough caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完全赞同，前提是我们攒够了瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c2e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be careful around prostitutes. There's about a hundred different ways they can screw you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在妓女身边可得小心，她们坑害你的招数多得数不清。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fc6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be careful around them. Being social isn't their strong point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好小心他们。社交不是他们的强项。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00b_00002a43_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be careful saying stuff like that. Casey's an American icon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说这种话要小心。凯西是美国的偶像。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00a_000033b1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be careful what books I gave to the Scribes. The right knowledge in the wrong hands can be deadly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得小心给文书们送什么书。错误的人掌握了正确的知识可能会致命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0001567c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be skeptical of any clue given to us by a murderer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会对谋杀犯给我们的任何线索持怀疑态度。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd bite people, throw dirt in their eyes, even kick 'em in the nuts if I had to.
ESP.TRADUIT: “杀手”是一种混合了“精神”和“吗啡-X”的化学品。我听说在西部更流行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher3_00003478_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd exercise caution. Stay back and let the robot do the work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会小心行事。待在后面，让机器人来做这件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd give it to you, but it's single use, and what if I meet someone else just as rad later?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把它给你，但它是一次性的，万一我以后遇到另一个同样棒的人怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_000026ff_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like that. But right now I've got to get back home. Truth is, I've only got about a week to tell my wife goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意。但现在我必须回家了。说实话，我只剩下大约一周的时间和我妻子告别了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop06_00002652_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to know more about this code of yours, if you don't mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不介意的话…想请教您的行动准则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BF] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect03\x3dnpcprospectors_hello_0000a3f3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to know more about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想多了解你一些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to say it took a little more sleuthing on my part, but it's really just an adult version of connect the dots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想说我花了一些侦查功夫，但它实际上只是一个成人版的连连看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01e_00002338_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather not owe your Uncle anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我宁愿不欠你叔叔任何东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c30_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather not say, to be honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，我宁愿不说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather not. Someone with your skills is more useful to me alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我宁愿不。像你这样有技能的人活着对我更有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd start with a fellow by the name of Orin Thatcher.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会从一个叫奥林·撒切尔的人开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b20_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd tear the whole thing down if Dot would let me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多特同意的话我早把它拆了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon02_00000973_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Idle Chatter
ESP.TRADUIT: 闲聊

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he abused you, then he got what he deserved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他虐待你，那他罪有应得。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I can't find my own men, then reuniting you with your pop is gonna be my main goal in life. I don't care if there's a 100 deathclaws between us and him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我找不到我的人，那我这辈子最大的任务就是帮你找到你爸。就算前面有100只死亡爪，我也不会退缩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079b2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I get sick or drop dead, that's how they know a place is too hot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我生病或猝死，他们就知道一个地方太危险了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam1_000087be_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I had to guess, this must be where wealthy people throw away the children they don't like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我猜啊，这儿准是富人扔讨厌孩子的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I was sure of that, I wouldn't be taking this test. At this point I'm not hoping for an answer, just more time to find one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我对此有把握，我就不会参加这次考试。现在我不期望得到一个答案，只希望能有更多时间去寻找一个答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel03_0000819d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I wasn't, I'd be wearing this collar, but I wouldn't be wearing this head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我不是，我会戴着这项圈，但不会戴着这个头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03_00001c05_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I'm about to die, the last thing I'm gonna do is swallow a grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我即将死去，我绝不会吞下手榴弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00006e5a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it doesn't destroy it first. I don't think the concept of avoiding collateral damage is built into its programming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果它没有先摧毁它的话。我不认为避免附带损害的概念被内置在它的程序中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba21_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it gets me out of here, I'll let you follow me just about anywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这能让我离开这里，我会让你跟着我，去任何地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it isn't chems, then what good are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是化学品，那你还有什么用？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it wasn't suicide, it wouldn't be any fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是自杀，那就没什么乐趣了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx01a_00002c03_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it wasn't you, who do you think ratted them out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是你，你觉得是谁告的密？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it weren't for those machines, this place would be crawling with raiders. Maybe they kept the armory safe too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不是那些机器，这地方早就被掠夺者挤满了。也许它们还保护了军火库的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fbd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it weren't for your heroics, my skin would be as thin as my hair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是你的英勇事迹，我的皮肤就会像我的头发一样薄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_0001497b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it's more than fifty caps, then you ought to treat yourself to my bridge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果超过五十个**瓶盖**，那你应该犒劳自己，走我的桥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll1_000059c3_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If my guess is correct and you're here on their behalf, I'd ask that you reconsider your goals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我的猜测是正确的，你是代表他们来的，我请求你重新考虑你的目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc2_0000b085_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If need be. There's a few scorpions around here and some raiders to the north, but we're pretty high up so I can usually spot 'em early.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有必要的话，这儿有些蝎子和北边的掠夺者，但我们位置高，通常能提前发现
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot03_00000937_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If nothing else, you keep things interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少，你让事情变得有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba27_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If only there was another guy next to him armored with strings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是他旁边有另一个穿着盔甲、拿着弦乐器的家伙就好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3c_00002711_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If only you were right. Maybe then he would've never taken my girl up on her offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你说得对就好了。也许那样他就永远不会接受我女孩的提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01b_00002e81_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If people think you're a chem addict, why stay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，土狼岭那边用香烟当钱。而这里，他们只收瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If she just let Emma use the diner this never would've happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果她让艾玛使用这家餐馆，这一切就不会发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_00005383_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If so, where's your spaceship?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是这样，那你的宇宙飞船在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that were true, then so is everyone in this diner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果那是真的，那么餐馆里每个人都是如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00b_00005a91_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's the case, then what are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果真是这样，你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's the case, then why didn't I marry a prince?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要那样我为啥没嫁个王子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000df8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's the case, we better not have a zombie apocalypse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果真是这样，我们最好不要有僵尸末日。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's true, I'm sorry. I'm glad Beep-Beep was there to rescue you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果那是真的，我很抱歉。我很高兴哔哔在那里救了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Brotherhood's in control here, it makes you wonder how much say they have over the content. The moment Three Dog says something they don't like, I imagine his show will be canceled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果兄弟会掌控这里，那就会让人怀疑他们对内容有多大的决定权。一旦三狗说了什么他们不喜欢的话，我想他的节目就会被取消。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015671_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the station's under siege, we better help. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 电台被围就得帮。走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000184a1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Wasteland's saved, they have you to thank.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果废土得救了，他们得感谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If these androids were programmed to kill, it's too dangerous to let them out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这些仿生人被设定为杀戮，那么让他们出去太危险了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If these ghouls want more potent Jet, then they ought to just stick their heads up a Brahmin's backside. Or do they not know where it comes from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼想要更纯的杰特？不如把头伸进双头牛屁股。他们难道不知原料哪来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If these horrors are trying to frighten us with their poor grasp of English, then I believe they're succeeding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是这些鬼东西想用蹩脚英语吓唬我们，那他们成功了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they choose to resolve their issues with violence, we reset the memories and replace them with a different set.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果它们选择用暴力解决问题，我们就会重置记忆，并替换成另一套记忆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob02_0000725f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we can give our people a moment to themselves, even if it's just for a few months, I feel like it'd make a world of difference.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们能给居民一点独处的时间，哪怕只有几个月，我觉得这会带来巨大的改变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02a_00006cdb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we can't find a way into Vault 87, I can go in alone. It'll be weird without you, but at some point I'll need to. Might as well start now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是进不去87号避难所，我就自己来。没你在是别扭，可迟早得单干，不如现在练手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9ed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we can't remove the booth, I think I'll ask Dot if I can cut the receiver cord.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是拆不了电话亭我就问多特能不能剪听筒线
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00003e5e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we speak fast and use plenty of syllables, it's possible he won't understand a word we say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们的语速够快，并且使用足够多的音节，他可能一个字都听不懂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0_0000b062_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ask me, the old dog's just slowing us down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我说？老狗净拖后腿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BE] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect02\x3dnpcprospectors_greeting_0000aab1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you do that, then the Brotherhood will get access to this knowledge too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你那样做，那么兄弟会也会得到这些知识。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't believe in astrology, why ask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不相信占星术，为什么还要问？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't find what you're looking for here, perhaps you could follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在这里找不到你要找的东西，也许你可以跟我走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't have anything on you, I've got some on the shelf, stashed behind a carton of cigarettes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要没带的话，架子后面烟盒里藏了点
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_0000338a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't have caps we can trade quantum for Psycho and Jet. Then when everything flips we'll sell it for twice as much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没瓶盖？咱们用量子换狂暴杰特，等局势乱了翻倍卖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Canary Sam [110087AF] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0f4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't know, then how do you know they'll have the parts you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不知道，那你怎么知道他们会有你需要的零件？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ever get around to finishing that guide, I might have to buy a copy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那本生存指南要是写完，我可能得买一本。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018481_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you had a line, we wouldn't be friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要有底线咱俩就成不了朋友
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DAB] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000dcb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you haven't noticed, you're in a goddamn penthouse. I didn't get here scrubbing the floors of some motherfucking soup kitchen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你没注意到，你他妈的在一个顶层公寓里。我可不是靠在哪个他妈的施粥所擦地板才到这儿的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00b_00001f35_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you killed these men, why bury them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你杀了这些人，为什么埋葬他们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然你这么说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you think about it, radiation's a good way to kill someone. Can't see it, can't smell it. Just smear some toxic waste on the walls, pump your body full of Rad-X, and let nature do the murdering.
ESP.TRADUIT: 细想辐射杀人多妙——无色无味，墙上涂点核废料，自个儿嗑消辐宁，坐等天道好轮回。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000732c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you think them words wise, then you and me, we have a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你认为这些话是明智的，那么你和我，我们就有问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack000c_00001c12_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want a sample, try licking the bottom of your shoe. Then imagine something a hundred times worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想尝尝，可以舔一下你的鞋底。然后想象一下比那糟糕一百倍的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maury [11015DE9] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmauryvoice\x3dnpcmq01b_x3dnpcmaury3_00015e0e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want absolution, there's the church or the bottle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想要救赎，有教堂或酒瓶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempster4_000180de_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want information, I'd talk to someone smart like the Doc or Moira.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想要信息，我会去和像医生或莫伊拉这样聪明的人谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempster4_000180de_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want my opinion, I suggest we help the scientist. It's clear he can offer the best reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要听我的主意，我觉得该帮科学家。明摆着他给的好处最实在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370c1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to help, you're welcome to. Just don't let Vernon fill your head with nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想帮忙欢迎，但别让弗农给你灌迷魂汤
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop05_00003e5d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to sacrifice the flattery of all men for the criticism of one, then yes, get married.
ESP.TRADUIT: 若愿用万千谄媚换一人苛责，那就结婚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005964_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you would like to assist in this endeavor, you may take the little cowpoke under your supervision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想协助这项工作，你可以将这个小牛仔置于你的监督之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beepbeep0a_0000269c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you would like to assist this unit in this endeavor, you may take the child under your supervision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果您愿意协助本单元完成此项任务，您可以将这个孩子置于您的监督之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If your father is dead, does that mean his debts are absolved?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你的父亲去世了，那他的债务是不是就一笔勾销了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're asking if I'm a bitch, then yeah, I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是在问我我是不是个婊子，那对，我就是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02b_00003dba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're feeling homesick you're more than welcome to move in. Although I suppose it would be like living in a dollhouse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是想家欢迎你搬来住。不过住这儿大概像住在娃娃屋里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00024f44_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're getting cold feet, then I suggest you remember the dead bodies in my Pappy's basement. Now suck it up and let's get this done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你打退堂鼓了，那我建议你回想一下我老爸地下室里的那些尸体。现在振作起来，我们把这事办了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60d_00001fe4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're going to kill me, kill me. I know better than anyone there's no point in begging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要杀就杀，我比谁都清楚求饶没用
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're going upstairs with that woman, I'd recommend bringing a stimpak. Or a radiation suit.

ESP.TRADUIT: 要炸核弹镇最好先知会我，让我先抽醒你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079a4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're hearing this transmission, then at the very least you have a stake in my survival.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果您正在收听这段信息，那么至少您与我的生存休戚相关。
