ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're here to see Jenny, she died last year. But that doesn' mean you can't stay for dinner! I won't take no for an answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来找珍妮？她去年过世了…但留下吃晚饭无妨！甭想推辞！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcminefield_greeting_00001cbb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're looking for a sob story, you're sniffing the wrong asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想听一个悲惨故事，你找错屁眼了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a_00002c3e_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在找机器人零件，为什么要在汽车报废场里找？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're looking for work, you could come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我小时候，经常被人欺负。我真的不知道怎么反击，所以我就发疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're looking to buy a plot, it's fifty caps for the grave, one hundred for a headstone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 买墓地五十瓶盖，加墓碑一百
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00000834_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're referring to your mugger, then yes, it really is me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你说的是那个抢劫你的人，那么，是的，真的是我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're talking about Sarah, I think she'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你说的是莎拉，我想她会没事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're that curious, why don't you make one up and I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这么好奇，为什么不编一个，我来做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey02c_00004bcd_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're thinking about helping Hannibal, I'm all in favor. And if you're thinking about enslaving him, that's fine too. I mean, on the one hand, he seems nice, but on the other hand, slaves are handy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要帮汉尼拔？我举双手赞成。你要奴役他？那也行。怎么说呢，这人看着不赖，但多个奴隶总归方便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000065b3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I-It was an easy mistake. I'm always forgetting things....please, you have to believe me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我——这只是个简单的错误。我总是忘东忘西……求你了，你得相信我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_000096b8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be back at the hideout then. The secret base. Which may or may not be the electronics store.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我先回藏身处。秘密基地——可能是电器行，也可能不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([110033CF]x3dnpcFollowersARANAS) x3dnpcARANAS quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followersfired_0000f00f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会没事的。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我就在你后面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be the judge of what isn't and isn't relevant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来判断什么是有用或没用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_00009571_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be your shadow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将成为你的影子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc04a_00003018_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 广播一完我就去，亲爱的

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do my best, but I can't make any promises.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会尽力而为，但我不能做出任何承诺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do what I can.

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去跟他谈谈。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到达后会有更多细节。不过现在，你先去处理你的其他任务。这件事交给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000b1f7_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay you a five hundred caps to speak with the doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我付你五百瓶盖，让我和那个医生说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay you five hundred caps to speak with the doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我付你五百瓶盖，让我和那个医生说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay you two hundred caps to speak with the doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我付你两百瓶盖，让我和那个医生说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll play it by feel, no need to play any specific role.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会凭感觉来，不需要扮演任何特定的角色。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尽力而为。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我挨个抹他们脖子。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是会为了捍卫你笑的权利，而把一个赤党活活掐死。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我将等到进城后再换。我最不想看到的就是路上有个生气的孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a crazy person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一个疯子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a maintenance guy. I like fixing things, taking them apart, stuff like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是维修工。我喜欢修理东西，拆解它们，诸如此类的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon04_000053d6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm actually on my way out. Just wanted to say goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我其实正要离开。只是想来道个别。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm actually the town cook, believe it or not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实我是镇上的厨师，信不信由你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc04duplica_000065e4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm actually working on behalf of the Brotherhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我实际上是代表兄弟会工作的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid all the bullets in the world wouldn't help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕全世界的子弹都帮不了忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I don't coach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕我不当教练。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid you're going to have to say goodbye to your friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕你得和你的朋友说再见了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm always up for a discussion that involves me. What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凡事先问我都乐意。需要啥？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an excellent cook, when the situation calls for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在需要的时候，厨艺非常精湛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an impressive person all around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个全方位的杰出人才。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我是殡葬师，杀人越多生意越好

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018486_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000870e_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017db4_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_0000539c_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018477_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018491_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00014870_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_000063e3_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里更像是警告你。维吉尔把波托马克河边的工厂，以及你在邮局发现的那个死去的流放者都告诉我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac02_00004c9e_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 我是他的另一个表亲。你知道的，就是你们俩都从未见过的那一个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hoping a machine won't face that dilemma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望机器不会面临这种困境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2a_00007af2_2.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我正在研究的机器能帮助平息事态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3_000052ab_3.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责弹药，你负责其他所有事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BF] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect03\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect3_0000a3f7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm in need of a gun. Ever consider traveling the wastes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一把枪。你有没有考虑过在废土上旅行？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm in the process of building a machine, and I'm in need of some very specific parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在建造一台机器，需要一些非常特殊的零件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic1_00002312_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just as curious as you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你一样好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just disappointed you got yourself captured.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是对你被抓感到失望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just glad Timmy got what he deserved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是很高兴蒂米得到了他应得的下场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just in shock, is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是太震惊了，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_000096b9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just passing through. Excuse me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是路过。抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just saying, nobody likes a snitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是说，没人喜欢告密者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just saying, this asshole doesn't belong here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是说，这个混蛋不属于这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightbutch_000087e8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm learning a lot about history through these plays. Pre-War America must've been a fun place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 演这些戏让我懂了好多历史。战前美国肯定特好玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00001a88_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm like that to. Let's not listen together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是那样。我们不要一起听了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm like the Three Dog of drug users.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我简直就是吸毒者中的“三狗”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2c_00003474_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm listening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 洗耳恭听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002C12]x3DNPCFollowersZynx) Zynx EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_00002c22_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for a permanent home myself. Are you taking in new people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己也在寻找一个永久的家。你们接收新成员吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm making it my business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把它当成我的事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Mara, my friend over there is Sean, and you probably already met Kate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是玛拉，那边是肖恩，你应该见过凯特了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_00005603_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm more worried about how Dot's taking it. Jessica was a chem addict. She was already killing herself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我更担心多特怎么看待这件事。杰西卡是个瘾君子。她已经在自杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50g_00003e5b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm nineteen years old and my daddy says I'm all grown up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我十九了，我爸说我成年了

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm no fool. I'll take any help I can get. But Vernon and Dot would just get in the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是傻瓜。任何帮助我都会接受。但弗农和多特只会碍事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50c_00003e5a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm nobody's master. I would never force your hand. But choices come with consequences.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是任何人的主人。我绝不会强迫你动手。但选择会带来后果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_0001427c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a business man, but I do mean business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老子不是生意人，但老子说到做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000034ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a child! In about a week I'll be almost two digits old!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是小孩！再过一周我就快两位数大了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc0d_00001bfa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a coward, and I've put just as much work into this place as you or Dot. I'm staying too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是懦夫，而且我为这个地方付出的心血和你或多特一样多。我也要留下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130q_0000535e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a snitch! Hell, I never liked those two anyway! You believe me, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是告密者！天啊，我从来就不喜欢那两个人！你相信我，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053d4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not ashamed of what I did, but I'm not proud of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不为我所做的感到羞耻，但我也不为此感到骄傲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053b1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not averse to a little fun. The problem is, the law doesn't always agree on the definition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不排斥找乐子…问题是法律常对"乐子"有意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005951_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not doing anything of the sort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么都不会做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not doing nothing until you tell me what you're doing in my pa's basement!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我弄清你在我爸地下室干什么之前，我什么都不会做！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs00b_00001fb7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not entirely sure there's a point to saving Red. It would be like rebuilding a house near a volcano. It's not the foundation, it's the lava.
ESP.TRADUIT: 救瑞德这事我觉得没意义。好比在火山边上盖房子——地基倒没事，问题是岩浆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370ba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not even going to dignify that with a response. Leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至懒得回应你。走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a1_000053a1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to fight you if I don't have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没必要，我不会跟你打架。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not gonna put words in his mouth, but after seeing this blood, I can sure as hell read his lips.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会替他说话，但看到这些血，我肯定能读懂他的唇语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00c_00002ccb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not joking. We all know it was you. It had to be. Only you knew how much we were spending.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是在开玩笑。我们都知道是你。肯定是你。只有你知道我们花了多少钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cfa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not lying, damnit! How many times do I have to tell you, I had nothing to do with this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有撒谎，他妈的！我要告诉你多少次，这件事跟我无关！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000aaef_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not playing anything! What is it you're trying to say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么都没在演戏！你到底想说什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a1_0000539e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not saying anything until you explain to me how this man died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你向我解释这个人是怎么死的之前，我什么都不会说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not saying you have to hurt anyone. In fact, my people pride ourselves in finding ways to do things without shedding blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是说你必须伤害任何人。事实上，我们的人民以寻找不流血的方式做事而自豪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01c_00002333_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not scared of you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不怕你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfreemanvoice01\x3dnpcjacksonquest_attack_00015dc9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure I should do anything you say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定我应该听你的任何话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_00009d66_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure if that's any of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定这是否是你的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure what you mean, but if you've bought me even a moment's worth of time, then I am in your debt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定你是什么意思，但如果你为我争取哪怕一瞬间的时间，我就欠你一个人情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc180b_0000bebf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure why you're helping Mister Burke. What you ought to do is kill him, take his caps, and ask Simms for a reward. Then you get paid on both ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞不懂您帮伯克干啥…宰了他抢瓶盖，再找西姆斯领赏…两头吃多嗨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c5f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure. I heard there was a town of kids at Little Lamplight. That might be fine now, but we won't be kids forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我听说有个叫小灯镇的地方全是孩子。现在可能还行，但我们不会永远是孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003c82_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not taking orders from you. From now on I'm listening to Vernon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会听从你的命令。从现在开始我只听弗农的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not teasing, just stating the facts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有取笑，只是陈述事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempkrist_000180d4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm one of those normal weird people. You're one of those weird normal people. I think that's why we get along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是那种正常的怪人，你是那种怪的正常人，所以咱俩合得来
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_0000aa52_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm pretty sure we'd have to get married first for that sentence to make sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢肯定，要让这句话有道理，我们得先结婚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02b_000033db_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to decide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好决定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm right behind you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 紧跟着您。 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc4_000026a0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm right behind you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 紧跟着您。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslasherquest_goodbye_00003486_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm so close. There are still some missing sections in the journal. Please, I beg you, do me this favor. I need more time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就差一点了…笔记还缺几页。求您再帮这回，我需要时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0b6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm so excited!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我太兴奋了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marie [11005F1B] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef2\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01_00007395_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry about your friend. That seems to be the price of doing business in the wastes. Bodies, and blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 节哀吧…废土做生意总得付代价。横尸遍野呗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_0000b1e4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry about your friend. That seems to be the price of doing business in the wastes. Bodies, and blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 节哀吧…废土做生意总得付代价。横尸遍野呗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey110_0000aaeb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop12_00002658_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry Sally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，莎莉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcstage120p_00003cd0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry too. I'm going to miss Alicia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也很难过。我会想念艾丽西亚的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry you feel that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉你感觉如此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry you had to go through it. It's weird to say because none of it happened, but it doesn't make it any less real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很遗憾你经历了这一切。说起来很奇怪，因为这一切都没有发生，但这并不能让它变得不真实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001846c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry you had to see that. Chapel hasn't been the same since his father died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉让你看到这些，教堂自他爹死后就变了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00008124_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I can't fill out your forms. I don't know how to read.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但我无法填写你的表格。我不识字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I don't believe in superstitious nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉我不信迷信鬼话
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_000037a5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I don't understand that expression. What's a fish?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但我听不懂那个表达。鱼是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I made a promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但我做出了承诺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but this is goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉…该说再见了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_000026ad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, diagnosis is not a cure. I can't let you do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，诊断不是治愈。我不能让你这样做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I didn't have a chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我没来得及。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I don't know you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认识你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I don't want to talk right now. Maybe in the morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉现在不想聊，也许明早
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00003e5f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I was a in a bit of a panic when the ghouls came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，当尸鬼来时我有点惊慌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00a_00005a93_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, that was my fault. It's hard to know how children work when you live in town where none of them make it to her age.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，那是我的错。当你在一个孩子都活不到她这个年纪的小镇生活时，很难知道孩子是怎么回事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic5_00002664_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. But I'm going to kill you both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾。我要杀了你们俩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007271_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. Chet, Randy, and Marie are gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉。切特、兰迪和玛丽都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. I didn't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。我不知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. I didn't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不住…不知情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. I fucked up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。我搞砸了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. Were they your friends?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。他们是你的朋友吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm supposed to be the strong one. Look at me...I'm a mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本该是坚强的那个，看看我...一团糟
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_000063d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure a few of these scientists value that more than your father's life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信这些科学家中有一些人比你爸爸的命更看重这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba1e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure if I just wait here patiently, my turn will come up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耐心等…总会轮到我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [11001B2F] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001b30_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure I'll hear about you again soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您大名迟早再传我耳中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benedict [110056A2] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_goodbye_00005d58_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure it was an honest mistake. Maybe she thought we switched to the Times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信是个无心之失。也许她以为我们改订《时报》了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e28_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure that will pass in time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确定那会随着时间过去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpchs0a_000180fe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure that's what the Brotherhood had in mind when they built it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信那是兄弟会建造它时的初衷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure the soldiers of Anchorage will be happy to know their memorial is infested with mutant crabs and creatures from the Black Lagoon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安克雷奇士兵要知道纪念碑爬满变种蟹和黑礁湖怪物，准"开心"得很。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure they will, and your community will be stronger for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确信他们会的，你的社区也会因此变得更强大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure we will. Thank you for visiting the Internal Revenue Service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会的。感谢您访问美国国税局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcmarcusizzy_00001ff5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you did just fine. But modesty is never a bad thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确定你做得很好。但谦虚永远不是坏事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00bduplic_00007a52_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you would've just been maimed and tortured like everyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢肯定你也会像其他人一样被弄残、被折磨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised slavers haven't taken over this place. Children are like gold to them. And an entire cavern of them buggers would send every Tom, Dick, and Eulogy out west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 居然没奴贩占这地儿？娃子在他们眼里是金子！这一山洞崽子，怕不引得张三李四王五倾巢而出。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000732d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sweating so much, I could probably bottle it and hand it to a beggar. You want pure water? This shit came right from the source.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我汗出得像能灌瓶送给乞丐了。想要纯水？这玩意儿可是源头直出。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm taking you out of the game, Skip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要把你换下场，斯基普。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm talking about a gunfight of course, not the sexual nonsense you were referring to.

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm teaching the young un's the ropes. In exchange, they help run errands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正带俩菜鸟入行呢，跑腿抵学费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcprospectors_greeting_0000a409_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm telling you, I saw a message on the wall. Something about the trash...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉你，我看见墙上有信息，关于垃圾的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005a8e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm telling you, Uncle Roe's gonna miss the entertainment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赌五毛！罗伊舅舅准怀念这出好戏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maury [11015DE9] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmauryvoice\x3dnpcmq01b_greeting_00015e01_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the asshole? I was working two jobs, Mara, and every paycheck I earned was honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是混蛋？我打着两份工，玛拉，我赚的每一笔钱都是干净的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_00005d29_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the star of the show. Everyone else is just riding my coattails.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是主演！其他人全靠我带飞！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003582_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the unofficial town guard. I keep track of the weapons and on my off days I teach the locals how to shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是非官方的城镇守卫。我管理武器库存，在休息日教本地人射击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Randy [11005F20] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01duplica_00006cb8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm watching you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞪大狗眼盯死你呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcguard2voice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000a2e0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm what you call a product specialist or "booth professional."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是你们所谓的产品专家，或“展位专业人士”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c8f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm willing to pay caps up front to speak with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意预付瓶盖和他说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm willing to take that chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意冒这个险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with the Internal Revenue Service. Just here to collect taxes owed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是国税局的。我来这儿就是为了收税。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine having these people as your neighbors. I'm not sure if it's the bombs or the parties that ripped this house apart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟这种人当邻居？分不清是炸弹还是派对把房子掀的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00010c85_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imitation Outcast Power Armor
ESP.TRADUIT: 仿放逐者动力盔甲
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: PowerArmor Body

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a matter of speaking, yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从某种意义上说，是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a way. But we're not against technology per se, just the kind that can be used as a weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 某种程度上是。但我们并非反对科技本身，只是反对那种可以被用作武器的科技。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any case, thanks again. We all owe you a lot. And if you're ever in the area, be sure to stop by and say hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，再次感谢。我们都欠你很多。如果你再来附近，一定要过来打个招呼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a4_000053a0_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any case, the girl and I had a rather heated discussion, and I'm sorry to say I had to take action.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，我和那姑娘进行了相当激烈的讨论，很抱歉我不得不采取行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e2c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any case, when you have a moment, I'd like you to meet me in Springvale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，当你方便的时候，我希望你在泉谷镇和我见面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey200_00015057_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，你最好走。我需要费脑筋的事情越少越好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, be sure to stop by whenever you can. When you're this far out, sometimes it's just nice to see a familiar face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，一定要尽可能多地过来。当你离得这么远，有时候能看到一张熟悉的脸是很不错的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b4_00005397_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, I think I'll get started on something right now. Trust me, it'll be great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我觉得我现在就应该开始做点什么。相信我，会很棒的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_0000680a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, I'd say we're one of the more respected and beloved institutions in all of D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我会说我们是华盛顿特区最受尊敬和最受欢迎的机构之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs01_00001b0b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, one guy actually turned in Form 8037-H instead! Can you believe it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，有个人竟然交了8037-H表格！你能相信吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs03_00001b10_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, they say the entire town was descended from convicts. We're practically Australian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，他们说整个镇子都是囚犯的后代。我们简直就是澳大利亚人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher1_0000345d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, this unit is currently using multiple training scenarios, including but not limited to The Chosen One of Arroyo, and the Hero from Vault 13.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，本单元目前正在使用多个训练场景，包括但不限于阿罗约的天选之人和13号避难所的英雄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beepbeep0c_0000269e_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In life, always do what you think is best. That way, at least one person in this world will die happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人生在世，只管做自认最对的事。这样世上至少死得其所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005952_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In my haste to protect my research, I managed to convince them that quantum gravity was a chemical stimulant of some sort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了保护我的研究，我在仓促中设法让他们相信量子引力是一种化学兴奋剂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([11005510]3DNPCScribeRadioPA) 3DNPC Scribe Radio PA

ESP.ORIGINAL: In one holotape, they talk about this place called the World Wide Web? I bet plenty of spiders lived there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在一张全息磁带里，他们提到了一个叫“万维网”的地方？我敢打赌那里有很多蜘蛛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00006e58_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In other words, he's getting desperate. Which means we must be getting close to finding him. Did you manage to get the key?
ESP.TRADUIT: 换句话说，他快黔驴技穷了。这意味着我们离找到他越来越近了。你拿到钥匙了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01g_00010930_2.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 换句话说，我也不需要给你找一个蒸汽压力表组件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In peace, there's nothing so becomes a man, as modest stillness and humility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和平时节，谦卑静默方显男儿本色。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: In Pre-War times, sure, but nobody since. So it makes you wonder...who's making it ring?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在战前时代当然有，但之后就没有了。所以你会想...是谁让它响的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00c_000030dd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In terms of supplies, safety, and well being, we're about as big as we can get.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在补给、安全和福祉方面，我们已经达到我们所能承受的最大规模了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02c_00006cdc_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, I better get down there. Thanks for the heads up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然如此，那我最好下去了。谢谢你的提醒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [11005A13] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcarabos01b_00005a29_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, I might as well come back in a week.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然如此，我不如一周后再回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, I think it's best to wait until we find another series worth listening to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然如此，我觉得最好还是等到我们找到另一个值得听的系列再说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00003441_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the bathtub.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在浴缸里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the end she never got one. Never got to see the world. Then I look at the world and wonder if she wasn't better off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到头来她连一个生日都没过上。没能看到这个世界。然后我看着这个世界，心想她是不是过得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01d1_00003c91_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the end she never got one. Never got to see the world. Then I look at the world and wonder if she wasn't better off.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the end though, burying him felt right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但最后，还是觉得把他埋了是对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a4_00008134_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the end, we lived, they didn't. That's how it goes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，我们活了下来，他们没有。事情就是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the meantime, do me a favor and see if you can find these clues. Maybe together we can find a way in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与此同时，帮我个忙，看看你能不能找到这些线索。也许我们能一起找到进去的办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00002a42_2.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 与此同时，拿着。这是我的一点心意。和你给我的东西比起来不算什么，但我希望你还是收下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003c7f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the meantime, I'll be at the Muddy Rudder, doing my best to stay out of your way.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000cc9b_3.ogg
