ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that the stuff? Looks like it'll get you real fucked up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这玩意儿？看着能让人爽到升天啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000bec2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that what we had? A religious experience?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们经历过那种事吗？一次宗教体验？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that what you want? An admission, or the truth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你想要的吗？一个承认，还是真相？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is the man with the collar one of your friends? I don't recall inviting him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴项圈那位是您朋友？我可没发请柬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a difference?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有区别吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern05d_000074b1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a holotape series you're following at the moment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在在追哪个全息磁带系列剧吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a part of you that wants to go back to your old life?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有一部分想回到你以前的生活？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a way to make him better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有办法让他好起来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there an easier way to do this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有没有更简单的方法来做这件事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything at all you can tell me to help find him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以告诉我的，帮我找到他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything here we can use?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有什么我们可以用的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything I can do to help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有什么可以帮助你的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything in particular the Brotherhood is looking for here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会在这里特别寻找什么东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything more beautiful than a beautiful busty brahmin riding a caravaneer off into the sunset... Wait I don't think that came out right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有啥比丰满婆罗门骑着商队人奔向夕阳更美...等等这话好像不对
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d1_1.ogg Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d1_1.ogg Faction : Agatha's Faction Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything that I can do to extend your battery life?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能做些什么来延长你的电池寿命吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there something you were looking for? Perhaps I can help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在找什么吗？也许我能帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3a_000030b7_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is your first name by any chance Greg?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的名字是不是碰巧叫格雷格？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it refreshing to have new people around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇子添新丁…多清爽？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_hello_000180ee_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't she the Johnsons' daughter? What did she do exactly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她不是约翰逊家闺女吗？她到底干啥了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e26_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't this a little weird considering your history?
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到你的历史，这难道不有点奇怪吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It actually identifies you as a terrorist, but okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它实际上把你认定为恐怖分子，但好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It almost sounds like they're trying to kill us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来几乎像是他们想杀我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern03b_000074a9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It always rings right around this time! Whoever picked it up must have let something out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 它总是在这个时候响！接电话的人肯定把什么东西放出来了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_000030d4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears Talon Company and the mutants are fighting over the Capitol Building. Lobbying for a bills used to be much more discreet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鹰爪公司和变种人在争国会大厦。以前游说议案可低调多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0002a227_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It Came From the Vault! Vol. 1
ESP.TRADUIT: 它来自避难所!1

ESP.ORIGINAL: It Came From the Vault! Vol. 2
ESP.TRADUIT: 它来自避难所!2

ESP.ORIGINAL: It Came From the Vault! Vol. 3
ESP.TRADUIT: 它来自避难所!3

ESP.ORIGINAL: It Came From the Vault! Vol. 4
ESP.TRADUIT: 它来自避难所!4

ESP.ORIGINAL: It could be, but it'd be helpful if you could remember the entire message.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有可能，但如果你能记住完整信息会很有帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It didn't matter if you were yellow, white, or green, just boil up some water and eat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管你黄白绿皮，烧锅水就能嗦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000f4fe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It does sound like an awful lot of work though. I'll let you handle it. Just buzz me when you figure out I was being sarcastic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过听起来工作量挺大的。就交给你来处理吧。等你明白我在说反话时，再叫我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01c_00004bc2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It does sound nice. Fresh air, white picket fences...it's kind of romantic in it's own way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来确实不错。清新的空气，白色的尖桩篱笆……它以它自己的方式有点浪漫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_00018476_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't have to come to that. I've got something that'll let you walk around that bunker, once you get inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不至于那样。我有个东西能让你在进入地堡后，可以在里面随意走动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01b_00002330_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't look like we'll be able to get a confession with words. And I'd say this is more your field of expertise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 光动嘴是撬不开他牙缝了。这该算您专业领域？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_0000ab06_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter if you go left or right, the only difference is who has the sun at their backs when I eliminate them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你走左走右都无所谓，唯一的区别是我消灭他们时，谁的背后是太阳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Casilla [11002740] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcknightcasillavoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_0000b0ee_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter what I saw. I want you all to pack your things. We're leaving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到什么不重要。我希望你们都收拾东西。我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130g_00005352_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter what I think. I just know it's not worth the drama.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么想不重要。我只知道这不值得大费周章。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kate [110055E6] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo04_00005d10_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter what number you wore on your back. We were all wearing collars in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你背上戴着什么号码并不重要。到头来我们都戴着项圈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_00014286_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. As a member of this community, you do what needs to be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不重要。作为这个社区的一员，你做你需要做的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. Even if it was a clue, there's no point checking the cage for deathclaws when you can just leave it locked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不重要。即使这是一个线索，当你只要把它锁好就可以离开时，检查笼子里有没有死亡爪又有什么意义呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130o_0000535a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. Even if it was a clue, there's no point poking the deathclaw when we don't have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不重要。即使是线索，当我们不必去招惹时，去捅死亡爪又有什么意义呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_00005a95_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. I already know how this ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不重要。我已经知道结局了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel01_00008195_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. Your problems are your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不重要。你的问题是你自己的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't surprise me that your father is a hard man to find. Given what he knows, I imagine it isn't just relatives looking for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲难找这事我一点儿不奇怪。就凭他脑子里装的东西，找他的肯定不止亲戚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370ad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It feels good, doesn't it? We just struck down one of the most crooked organizations in all the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感觉很好，不是吗？我们刚刚击垮了废土上最腐败的组织之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60d_00002006_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It feels like a good day to dig a grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天适合挖坟
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00005831_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It feels wrong stealing from a museum. I get that there's no owners, but it still belongs to the public.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从博物馆偷东西感觉不对。虽说没主人了，可这些本该是公共财产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018460_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It gets noisier, trust me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 会吵起来的，相信我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It has eight hundred horsepower, a full nuclear engine, and goes 0 to 60 in point five seconds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它拥有八百匹马力，全核引擎，零到六十加速仅需零点五秒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c89_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a noble goal. However, it remains to be seen whether this scholar found the answer when so many before have failed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 志向崇高啊。但前辈全栽了，这位学者能成？悬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002749_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is Atom's spirit flowing through you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是原子的精神在你体内流动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child of Atom [1100820C] (mod) Quest : ([11008212]x3DNPCmegatonchurch) Megaton Church EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleatom01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpcchurch04a_00008223_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It isn't who I think it is, is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是我以为的那个人，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c42_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It just dawned on me that you were the fifth from our class to become a scribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刚发现您是班里第五个当上文书的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_hello_00002cd7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It looks like someone else was here. Unless your friend Alicia likes to flip over the table when making an exit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿有人来过…除非你朋友艾丽西亚有掀桌出门的癖好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00015f40_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It looks like the Enclave are trying to fortify Project Purity. We better head back to the Citadel and talk to Lyons. My guess is, it's gonna be a war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷好像在加固净水计划。得回大本营找里昂斯了。我看要打仗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It looks like there's another terminal downstairs that unlocks this control panel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 楼下还有台终端机能解锁这个控制板。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_00006794_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It looks like these soldiers shut the door and sealed off the air. Sometimes death is the only escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来这些士兵关上了门，隔绝了空气。有时候死亡是唯一的出路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fb9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It looks like they broke the control panel, but I doubt these Free Men wanted to be buried here alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来他们弄坏了控制面板，但我怀疑这些自由人想在这里被活埋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03chatt_000149a2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It looks like we're going to have to go in shooting, darling. I don't think the Enclave is stopping by for tea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来咱们得打进去了，亲爱的。英克雷总不会是来喝茶的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba13_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It may not be as good as Tommy's stuff, but it looks the part. I need you to plant it on the body. And hurry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能不如汤米的货，但看着像，去把东西栽赃到尸体上，赶紧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_0000338a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It mean drive big car! Have big gun! And small, small rocketship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 意思是开大车！拿大枪！还有小小火箭船
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc02c_000008d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It might be a good idea to go back to the Post and look at the logos in the building, as opposed to on a newspaper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好回邮局看大楼里的标志，别光盯报纸
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a1_00000c60_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It might even be prone to speeches, provided you allow it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它甚至可能倾向于演讲，只要你允许。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudreyfin_00016cc3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It might make what I'm about to ask you to do more difficult. But I hope you do it all the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可能会让你接下来要做的事变得更加困难。但我希望你还是会做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_00014293_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It offends me to be honest. What, just because I stick a needle in my arm that means I'm a fiend?
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，这让我感到被冒犯。怎么，就因为我往胳膊上扎针，就意味着我是个恶魔？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2_0000346d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It only wants to do as its programmed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它只想按照程序行事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2b_000030b1_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It probably should've. Funny how it always works out that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本来就该那样。事情总是这么发展，真有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpc00dduplic_00005f10_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems like the owner of this saloon has life figured out. He has a girl in his arm, a drink in his hand, and a ghoul to stand next to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙龙老板活得真明白：怀里搂姑娘，手上端酒杯，旁边还站着尸鬼保镖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000369fc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems some Project Purity scientists are now working for the Enclave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来有些净水计划的科学家现在正在为英克雷工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems the microcontroller processor is intact, but the battery is too damaged to power the commands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 微控处理器完好，可惜电池废得带不动指令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_00002615_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems to go that way more often than not. The weak devoured by the strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来事情往往都是这样发展的。弱者被强者吞噬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01f_00015712_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It should be a crime to wear those, by the way. But I suppose that's what they mean by lawlessness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说一下，穿那种衣服应该是一种犯罪。但我想这就是他们所说的无法无天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcquesttask_00015de8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like our friend has a guilty conscience. It's going to be so much fun forcing you to confess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来我们的朋友有内疚的良心。强迫你坦白会很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_0000aae4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like they were watching us the whole time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来他们一直都在监视我们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like your dad's in trouble! We better hurry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你爸好像出事了！赶紧的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It still hurts a bunch, but it a little less than before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还是很痛，但比以前好一点了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_booppostquest_00006012_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It takes a village to raise a child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 养孩需举全村之力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c56_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It tells you which way is up! You don't want to point your thumbs down when you mean up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它告诉你哪个方向是向上！你不想在表示向上的时候把拇指朝下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc3a_0000242f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It turns out the Doc fucked us. I put the revolver to his head and he confessed it all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 结果博士把我们给耍了。我把左轮手枪抵在他头上，他全招了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e5c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It turns out this prototype was incredibly durable. Hopefully the same will be true for the others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实证明，这个原型机非常耐用。希望其他原型机也能如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic0d_00002304_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It turns out we weren't the only ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原来觊觎此地的不止我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_greeting_0001428b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a manual on how to make a homemade explosive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一本关于如何自制爆炸物的手册。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02f_00002afa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a real good one too. Bullets flying, people dying, and me, face to face with their leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那真是一场好仗。子弹横飞，人倒地，而我，和他们的头目面对面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c40_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was about a year ago. Emma had just taken over the diner and asked me to come help her set up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约是一年前的事。艾玛刚接手这家餐馆，让我来帮她布置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_0000537f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was all for your sake, my dear. We needed to make sure you were ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这都是为你好，亲爱的。我们必须确保你准备好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice2\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000726a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was another baffling case. A real head scratcher. I was scratching my head so much you'd think I had fleas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这又是另一桩令人困惑的案子。一个真正的挠头案。我挠头挠得你都以为我长了跳蚤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcmackdamem_00004397_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was close, but I managed to escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很险，但我设法逃脱了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was important for him to have a private space for him and his boy, and I realized I needed the same for my daughter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他觉得有一个他和儿子独处的私人空间很重要，我意识到我也需要一个这样的空间给我女儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02b_00006cdd_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was just a joke, sorry. I meant nothing by it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那只是个玩笑，对不起。我没有任何恶意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was lie. The dame didn't know my left eye was blind from watching too many cartoons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个谎言。那个娘们不知道我的左眼因为看太多卡通片而瞎了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcmackdamem_000043a2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was me, lieutenant. The men wanted milk with their cookies. Should I have said no?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我，中尉。士兵们想用牛奶配饼干。我该拒绝吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000043af_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was me. I killed her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我。我杀了她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a2_0000539f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was me. I killed her. And it's my fault Jessica's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我。我杀了她。杰西卡的死也是我的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a3_000053a4_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was me. One of my neighbors called the house and I picked up the phone thinking it was Tommy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我。我的一个邻居打电话到家里，我以为是汤米，就接了电话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc04_000025eb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was my pleasure. Can you tell me how to get out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的荣幸。你能告诉我怎么出去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was no problem at all. I had a lot of fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一点问题都没有。我玩得很开心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was no problem, just trying to help out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，只是想帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was nothing short of a miracle that we didn't kill more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们没有杀更多的人，这简直是个奇迹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was nothing. Don't sweat it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。别放在心上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was on the weekend so I knew he wouldn't be there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那天是周末，我知道他不在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h_0000643a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was probably about two hours after midnight, give or take. It kept ringing for about a minute before the light went out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大概午夜后两小时，响了约一分钟灯就灭了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon01_00000965_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was probably raccoons. You know as well as I do there's nothing in this house that would catch a raider's eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大概是浣熊，你我都知道这屋里没东西能入掠夺者眼
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000df7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was real in its own way. You have just as much of a right to be angry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它有它自己的真实性。你同样有权利感到愤怒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was real late. I'd spent all night patching a hole in my camper when it started to ring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天很晚了。我整晚都在修补我的房车上的一个洞，这时电话响了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_0000537f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was self-defense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是自卫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was smart of you to come to me. These other kids wouldn't know a gun from a gumdrop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找我算找对人啦！其他小鬼连枪和软糖都分不清。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c66_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was smart to build a laboratory in the Jefferson Memorial. Thomas Jefferson loved water, almost as much as he loved slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实验室建杰斐逊纪念堂绝了…老杰爱水…仅次于爱黑奴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c7c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was so thick I couldn't tell a jarhead from a jimhat. But when it cleared, I was all alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尘太浓了，我分不清谁是谁。但当沙尘散去时，我只剩下一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c42_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was that scavenger Gina. She must've snuck it in with the supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是那个拾荒者吉娜。她肯定是把它混在补给品里偷偷带进来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was that scavenger Gina. She must've snuck it in with the supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是那个拾荒者吉娜。她肯定是把它混在补给品里偷偷带进来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was the cookies we had for breakfast that did them in ma'am. You can't eat cookies without dipping them in milk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是早餐的饼干害了他们，夫人。不蘸牛奶就不能吃饼干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000043b5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was their intent that this unit prepare the child for adulthood in their absence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本单元的意图是在他们不在场的情况下，为这个孩子准备好迎接成年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot1_000029ea_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was written on the walls...something about the trash...
ESP.TRADUIT: 它写在墙上……和垃圾有关……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130b_00005344_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't always this bad though. Alicia had this place smelling like an actual diner. Now it smells worse than a bathroom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过以前没这么糟糕。艾丽西亚在的时候，这个地方闻起来像个真正的餐馆。现在闻起来比厕所还糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maury [11015DE9] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmauryvoice\x3dnpcmq01b_x3dnpcmaury0c_00015e12_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't for you, or for her, really. I felt like I needed to do this for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是为了你，也不是为了她，真的。我感觉我需要为自己做这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudreyfin_00016cc0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't until someone knocked on his door that we realized he'd passed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到有人敲他的门，我们才意识到他已经去世了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00bduplic_00008120_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will interpret your comment as speculative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它会将您的评论解读为推测性的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beepbeep0b_0000269d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegiei_00003e70_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would be a shame to lose this forest, but not if it means torturing that poor tree.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毁掉这片森林可惜，可折磨那棵树更造孽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001849c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would be rude. So go ahead. Thank me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样会很无礼。所以去吧。感谢我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wouldn't be the worst thing in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不会是世界上最糟糕的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wouldn't have worked. I'm immune to pain anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那没用的。我反正对疼痛免疫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wouldn't hurt to try. But keep in mind that the bulkier you get, the slower you'll move.
ESP.TRADUIT: 试试也无妨。但要记住，你越壮，行动就越慢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect5_0000a3ed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would've been nice if he were alive to see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他能活着看到这一幕就好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd almost be like I was replacing her, you know? And I don't know if that's fair to any of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那感觉就像我在取代她，你懂吗？我不知道这对他们任何人来说是否公平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01d2_00003c8e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd be pretty fucked up, if it weren't true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这不是真的，那可真他妈的糟透了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq2_0000a2e5_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd have to be a major Pre-War gun runner, like L.O.B. Enterprises or Heckler and Koch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得是战前大军火商，比如L.O.B.或黑克勒-科赫
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd have to be a major Pre-War gun runner, like L.O.B. Enterprises or Heckler and Koch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得是战前大军火商，比如L.O.B.或黑克勒-科赫
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd have to be a major Pre-War gun runner, like L.O.B. Enterprises or Heckler and Koch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得是战前大军火商，比如L.O.B.或黑克勒-科赫
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd have to be a major Pre-War gun runner, like L.O.B. Enterprises or Heckler and Koch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得是战前大军火商，比如L.O.B.或黑克勒-科赫
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd have to be a major Pre-War gun runner, like L.O.B. Enterprises or Heckler and Koch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得是战前大军火商，比如L.O.B.或黑克勒-科赫
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a2_00000d21_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll be nice to go back home after all this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 漂泊多年…终可归乡了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_hello_0000b0eb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll be raining grenades, and possibly men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马上要下手雷雨了，可能还捎带几个大活人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([110033CF]x3dnpcFollowersARANAS) x3dnpcARANAS quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_0000f00d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll mean everyone will have to pull it a little more weight. Losing Randy was the big blow. He was our protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那将意味着每个人都必须多承担一点重量。失去兰迪是重大打击。他是我们的保护者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02_00006cd6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll probably be smart to setup a rotation to guard the doors. Maybe put up a few traps. I'll talk to Gina about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得安排门岗轮班，再弄点陷阱。这事我跟吉娜商量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c9b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll save everyone a lot of time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这会节省大家很多时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs03c_00001b18_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a BB gun that shoots live rounds. Figure it'll be easier to learn with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一把发射实弹的BB枪。我觉得用这个学起来会更容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01c_0000359f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a Brotherhood Outcast member. The cause of death is unknown. On the body is a holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是兄弟会放逐者的一员。死亡原因尚不清楚。尸体上有全息卡带。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a bunch of anti-war, hippie nonsense. No true patriot would ever hide away in a vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一堆反战、嬉皮士的胡言乱语。没有哪个真正的爱国者会躲在避难所里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins02_0000341d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a coincidence. You start connecting random dots and you'll convince yourself your mother was a molerat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是巧合。你开始把不相干的点联系起来，会说服自己你妈是只鼹鼠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50b_00003e58_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a constant tug of war between nature and nurture. The goal is to find memories and experiences that negate their predispositions for violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一场本性和后天培养之间的持续拉锯。我们的目标是找到能消除它们暴力倾向的记忆和经历。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob02_0000725f_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a date. You bring the gas masks, and I'll bring the shoes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就这么定了。你带上防毒面具，我带上鞋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey04b_00005978_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a gang of thugs and crooks, is what it is. Izzy may think she's running some charity, but in reality she's just an ordinary thief. Plain and sim
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是一个匪帮，一群骗子，就是这么回事。伊兹可能以为她在搞什么慈善，但实际上她只是个普通的贼。就这么简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs04_00001fbb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a good lead. I'm glad you kept your wits long enough to see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个好线索。我很高兴你保持足够清醒的头脑看到了它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a good place. In a weird way, I feel like I fit in here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个好地方。奇怪的是，我感觉我在这里很合适。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008080_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a little too soon for a new resident. People are still getting used to the idea of seven people, eight would be too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在入住新居民有点太早了。人们还在适应七个人的想法，八个就太多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03d_00006ce5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a lovely home. You should be proud.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个可爱的家。你应该感到骄傲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a real cliffhanger, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真是一个悬念，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas01_00003404_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a reminder. For me, and the men I kill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个提醒。为我自己，也为那些我杀的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack01_00001553_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a sad state of affairs when the Museum of Technology is more advanced than the present.
ESP.TRADUIT: 科技博物馆比现在还先进，这世道真够呛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000234a8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a show my son Wally and I used to do to preach against the evil of vault dwelling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我和儿子沃利曾经做的一个节目，用来宣传反避难所居住的邪恶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins02_0000341e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a toolbox. Hank's name is painted on the lid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个工具箱。汉克的名字被画在盖子上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a tough choice crossing this river. Caravans have to choose between raiders up at the fort, or mirelurks down below.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过这条河是个艰难的选择。商队得在上面的堡垒里的掠夺者和下面的泥沼蟹之间做出选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's actually a warzone out there. Soldiers would be useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 外面实际上是个战区。士兵们会很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's actually the gun you gave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这实际上是你给我的那把枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all so...perpendicular. But down at sea level the company's as good as the posture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都那么……垂直。但在海平面，公司的风气和他们的姿态一样好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_00002714_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's almost as if Carver was rounding up mercs that were expendable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就好像卡弗在招募那些可牺牲的佣兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's almost like he wants me to shoot him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他好像是想让我射他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03chatt_0001499f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an admirable goal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个值得称赞的目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an American institution. Just like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个美国机构。就像你一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's at VAPL-58 Power Station.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它在VAPL-58发电站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been an honor to fight with you, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能和你并肩作战是我的荣幸，士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's best if I cover the rear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我掩护后方最好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's different, but I like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很不同，但我喜欢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's done, thanks to you. You gave me just enough time to reset the targeting parameters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定了，多亏你。正好让我重置了瞄准参数。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_00004cc4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's done. But all you've bought yourself is time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情办妥了。但你给自己争取到的只有时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Dot now, remember? You're gonna confuse the customers if you keep calling me that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是多特，记得吗？再这么叫会搞晕顾客的
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdotcarneg_0000093f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's easy to get drawn to the fountain here, but watch the alleys. The real dangers sit in the shadows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里很容易被喷泉吸引，但要留意小巷。真正的危险潜藏在阴影之中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015674_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's exactly what I was shooting for. All these other jobs are just rote memorization. There's actually some artistry in cooking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这正是我想要的。所有其他工作都只是死记硬背。烹饪实际上需要一些艺术性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066E2] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00c_0000818f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's extremely wet down in this tunnel. I suppose that means we'll be eating Mirelurks for dinner tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这隧道里水可真多。看来今晚咱们得吃泥沼蟹当饭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba0c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's far more likely that you're insane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更可能的情况是你疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fifty caps to cross, unless you got a pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过桥费五十，持票除外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_greeting_000059c7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's frustrating to see a camp like this so close to Rivet City. But I guess they don't care, so long as they're safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城边上就有这种营地真憋屈。可人家安全就行，谁管别人呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9e2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's funny because Kate was the one who did time. You got a slap on the wrist. But it's all about you. It's always been about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可笑的是，坐牢的是凯特。你只是被轻轻拍了一下手。但一切都只关乎你。一直都只关乎你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_000063fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's funny, I get angry sometimes, you know. Like how could they do this to the world? How could they just blow it all up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很奇怪，我有时会很生气，你知道吗。他们怎么能对这个世界做出这种事？怎么能就这样把它炸掉？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_0000807c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's funny, I used to love nuka-cola. But then I had my first beer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好笑，我以前迷核子可乐，直到喝了第一口啤酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000141c1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's funny, people say karma will catch up to me someday. Well, either karma's slow, or I'm just really, really fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣的是，人们说业力终有一天会追上我。嗯，要么是业力太慢，要么就是我太快了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02_00006c9c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's funny. Everyone in this town is afraid of the bomb. But it's the leaks in the piping and the dirt in the water that should scare them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真有意思。镇上所有人都害怕那颗炸弹。但管道的渗漏和水里的污垢才应该让他们害怕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fc5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's going great. Randy's dead, which puts me in charge of the guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都很好。兰迪死了，所以我负责管枪了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc05_00006cad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's going to help us take back the Purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它会帮助我们夺回净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to know that you're still close after all this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么久了还能保持亲近，真好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to see you after all this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么久没见，很高兴再次见到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to see you too, Alicia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能再次见到你，艾丽西亚，真好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good what you're doing for Honest Abe. If your head ever got blown off, I would totally sew it back together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为诚实的亚伯做的这些事真好。要是你的脑袋被炸飞了，我肯定能把它缝回去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_0000aa5a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's got the PTSD, you dummy! Because in case you haven't noticed, that team from St. Louis has spent the past hour knocking the cover off the thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是因为它得了创伤后应激障碍，你个笨蛋！因为你可能没注意到，圣路易斯的那个队过去一小时一直在把球皮打掉！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_00003540_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's great that you helped Hannibal move into the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮汉尼拔搬进纪念馆挺好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001848d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's historically inaccurate. Vault people are not radioactive fish monsters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不符合历史事实。避难所居民不是有辐射的鱼怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's hot enough to roast a squirrel on the pavement. Believe me, I've done it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 热得能在人行道上烤松鼠，真的，我烤过
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_0000091d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's hot trash in a bottle. See with the Doc dead, we had a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那简直是瓶子里的垃圾。你看，医生死了，我们就有麻烦了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000b0fe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's in a safe place, believe me. But that's not our most pressing issue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它在一个安全的地方，相信我。但这不是我们最紧迫的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0a1_0000b06c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just a really, really big hole, so it doesn't matter who you are, everyone falls in. Aaaaaagh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是一个非常、非常大的洞，所以不管你是谁，每个人都会掉进去。啊啊啊啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq0c_000026ef_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just another corpse that won't stay buried. As far as I'm concerned, the raiders are doing them a favor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过是具不愿安息的尸体。要我说，掠夺者算帮他们解脱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a_0000815b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like a wagon made of metal and...point is, it's not a robot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它就像一辆用金属做的马车和……重点是，它不是机器人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like Casey said. He's a friend I brought over. I didn't know he had chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像凯西说的。他是我带来的朋友。我不知道他有化学品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like everything we knew about spacetime is wrong and everything we thought was dumb is kind sorta maaaybe...right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像咱们知道的时空全是错的，而那些蠢想法…大概可能也许…是对的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0bf_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like the name says. We collect revenue in order to better service the people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像名字说的那样。我们通过征收收入来更好地为人民服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs01_00001b0b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like, say I want to beat the shit out of somebody. Sometimes that guy's a child molestor, other times he's a priest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就好比，假设我想把某人揍一顿。有时候那个人是个恋童癖，其他时候他是个牧师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02b_000051c0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's me, Alicia, from Vault 101? You know, your favorite fry cook?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我，艾丽西亚，来自101号避难所？你知道的，你最喜欢的炸厨？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00f_00009643_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's much better to end where we are now. We can go forwards, backwards, leftwards, rightwards...we can go anywhere!
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好还是停留在我们现在的位置。我们可以向前，向后，向左，向右……我们可以去任何地方！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00c_0000343e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my blood. I cut myself shaving and never cleaned it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我的血。我刮胡子的时候割伤了自己，一直没清理。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my way of saying thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我表示感谢的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcblooper_0000b02a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's nice to meet you, Charles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴认识你查尔斯

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's no surprise these ghouls want a more powerful Jet. Chems have no effect on the dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些尸鬼想要更强大的杰特，这并不奇怪。化学品对死人没用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015682_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not a big deal. Look at me, I didn't study for it, and I turned out okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这没什么大不了的。看看我，我没为它学习，我也过得好好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mike [110081A1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmikevoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel04_000081aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not as bad as you think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有你想象的那么糟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not as hefty as the real thing, so don't try and wear it into a fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它不像真品那么重，所以别想穿着它去打架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_00002331_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not bullshit! Someone must've picked it up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是废话！肯定有人接了电话！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_000030d8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not important. All you need to know is, he got what was coming to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不重要。你只需要知道，他得到了他应得的下场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpc00cduplic_0000812f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not much of a story. I was so pumped up full of stimpaks and med-x's I didn't feel a thing when I was fighting it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这没什么好讲的。我当时注射了太多治疗针和镇痛剂，以至于我在战斗时什么都感觉不到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect7_0000a3ef_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not really music. More like loud explosions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不算音乐。更像是响亮的爆炸声。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not that I don't like children. I despise them. Let's finish our business here and move on to the next task.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是不喜欢小孩，是见着就烦。赶紧办完事撤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba17_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not that simple. This child here needs it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没那么简单。这孩子需要它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not the mutants outside that I'm worried about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我担心的不是外面的变种人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00a_0000569a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not the same vault, but it carries with it all the same burdens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是同一个避难所，但它承载着所有相同的负担。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_00014286_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not the size of the gun, or the fight in the dog. It's about wanting it more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不在枪的大小或狗的斗志，而在谁更想要
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_greeting_000051c3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not the technology that's a threat, it's the men who use them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 构成威胁的不是技术，而是使用技术的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not, but whatever. Just tell me what's wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 才不是，但无所谓了。你就告诉我出了什么问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not. Normally I'd charge five hundred, but the bitch under the bridge has been undercutting my prices.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不便宜。通常我会收五百，但是桥下那个婊子一直在压低我的价格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll0b_000059c4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not? But then why do they have plates with their names on them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是吗？但为什么他们有带自己名字的牌子呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc2b_000025e4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's nothing. You needn't concern yourself with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。你不需要担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcbutchdocsc_0000b091_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay. But a lot of people around here treat me like some kind of addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还好啦。但这里很多人都把我当成某种瘾君子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2_0000346d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's on, but who knows if it even works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它已经开启了，但谁知道它是否真的能工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's one hundred caps for one night. You're renting, not buying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一晚一百个瓶盖。你是租，不是买。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's only right we return it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 物归原主天经地义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a_0000815b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's our weapon. And we need to do whatever we can to shut it down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我们的武器，得想尽办法关掉它
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac08_00000d33_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's part of your programming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你程序的一部分。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's perfect. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太完美了。谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's pretty simple. Whenever we hear about someone making a lot of caps, we send our people after them to collect a percentage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很简单。每当我们听说有人赚了很多瓶盖，我们就会派人去找他们，收取一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b0d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's probably best if you take the lead and Hawk watches the rear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好是你带头，霍克殿后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac08c_00004ceb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's probably best to hand this over to Richard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好把这个交给理查德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's probably best you come outside and see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好出来看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's ridiculous. We can take back the Purifier by ourselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太荒谬了。我们可以自己夺回净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's so bad it's actually kind of good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太糟糕了，反而有点好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's so dark...and I think I hear screaming. I don't like it. We should get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太黑了...还有惨叫声。瘆得慌，赶紧撤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000080a4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's strange no one's disarmed the bomb yet. Then again, if it isn't broke, then I can't imagine wanting to risk a fix either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奇怪这炸弹还没人拆。不过既然没炸，谁愿冒险去动它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000355d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's taken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a_00000836_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's that kind of attitude that put us in this situation in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正是这种态度，才让我们一开始就陷入这种境地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_00001c7a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the Enclave who should be nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 应该是英克雷感到紧张才对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the end of the world as we know it, it's the end of the world as we know it, and I eat flies...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们所熟知的世界末日到了，我们所熟知的世界末日到了，我吃苍蝇……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00006e68_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the end of the world, they're living in a closet, and they all hate each other! I can practically smell the hi-jinks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世界末日，他们住在壁橱里，还互相讨厌！我都能闻到那股闹剧的味道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the graduate student journal you were looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是你一直在找的研究生日记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the high you get from the meds. It's kind of like iced tea. You gotta boil it up before you kick it down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一种从药物中得到的快感。有点像冰茶。你得先把它煮沸，然后再把它喝下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam1_000087c2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the holy grail of scientific knowledge, but when I try to explain this to Carver, he accuses me of deception.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是科学知识的圣杯，但当我试图向卡弗解释时，他却指责我欺骗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([11005510]3DNPCScribeRadioPA) 3DNPC Scribe Radio PA

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the least I can do. You saved my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我至少能做的。你救了我的命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b1_0000538f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the phone! Someone picked up the phone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是电话！有人接了电话！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_00002a28_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the probably ingredients that are lacking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是缺少配料。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the robot stuff that makes your hand go up. You know, for high-fives! They say you're not a real person if you can't give a good high-five.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是机器人部件让你的手举起来。你知道的，为了击掌！他们说如果你不能好好击掌，你就不是一个真正的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc0c_00001bf8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the system we have to use the shacks. Instead of cramming everyone into a few houses, we decided it'd be better if we rotated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们不得不使用棚屋的制度。与其将所有人塞进少数房屋里，我们决定轮换会更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01duplica_000065de_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time for us to part ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是时候我们分道扬镳了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time for us to part ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们该分道扬镳了

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time for us to part ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们该分道扬镳了

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time for us to part ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们该分道扬镳了

ESP.TRADUIT: 挺...别致。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Itsy Bitsy Spider
ESP.TRADUIT: 小小蜘蛛

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'v heard about The Railroad. Used to be it helped slaves escape their masters. Now they help androids escape people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说过"铁路"？以前帮奴隶逃主子…现在帮仿生人逃人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007357_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've always known androids existed. How else do you explain my sister Margaret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我早就知道有机器人存在。不然我妹妹玛格丽特的情况该怎么解释？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370c6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've always wanted a robot for a best friend myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己也一直想要一个机器人做最好的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've always wondered how people get messages across the wastes. I imagine you don't have mailmen. I guess people just rely on strangers like us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老琢磨废土的人咋传消息。邮递员肯定没有。估计全靠咱们这种路人帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018495_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've always wondered what the inside of the Citadel was like. No, that's not true. I've never wondered about the Citadel. And now that I've seen it, I know why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我老说想知道钢铁要塞里面啥样。假的。其实我压根不好奇。现在亲眼见了，总算知道为啥了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba15_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL:
I've arrived at Fort Independence to oversee the final phase of the project. According to the General, the move to Washington is ideal for a number of reasons, both strategically and from a secrecy standpoint.
On my off days they have me living at a home on Bradbury in Georgetown. My neighbors, the McClellans, seem like a nice bunch, if a little odd. Last week the father tried to lecture me about robotics believe it or not. I just nodded my head and played dumb.
I wish the folks in Washington would do the same. But no one seems to listen when I raise questions regarding the utility of the project. But as the General says, we have our orders, and the only thing we need to do is follow them.
ESP.TRADUIT:
我到独立堡来监督项目的最后阶段。根据将军的说法，从战略和保密的角度来看，搬到华盛顿是一个理想的选择。
我休息的时候，他们让我住在乔治敦布拉德伯里的一所房子里。我的邻居，麦克莱伦一家，看起来是一群不错的人，虽然有点奇怪。上周，那位父亲试图给我上机器人课，信不信由你。我只是多特了多特头装傻。
我希望华盛顿的人们也能这样做。但是，当我提出有关该项目的实用性的问题时，似乎没有人在听。但就像将军说的，我们有命令，我们唯一要做的就是服从命令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've asked multiple people actually and they all agree you're a deadbeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我实际上问过很多人，他们都说你是个无赖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been here for hours! Why won't anyone talk to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我等几小时了！为什么没人理我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [11001B25] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult03\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001b2a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been waiting for my number to be called for hours! I don't understand!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等叫号等得腿都麻了！搞不懂啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [11001B25] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult03\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001b2d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've brought the supplies you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了你需要的补给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've decided to let the kids keep doing their plays. We'll do target practice every other day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我决定让孩子们继续排戏。以后每隔一天练射击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003594_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've filled out all the right forms, but they won't give me the caps! It's ridiculous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 表格全填对了！他们愣是不发瓶盖！荒谬透顶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [11001B25] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult03\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001b2e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've found at my age the things you used to love often become a chore. Eating, sleeping, loving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上了年纪才懂，曾经所爱终成负累——吃饭、睡觉、做爱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005961_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a bad feeling about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉着要坏事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9e8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a can right here. I'm going to eat it right in front of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这里就有一个罐头。我要在你面前吃掉它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got bugs if you want 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你想要，我这儿有虫子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([1100E586]x3dnpcBoopFollowQuest) BoopFollowQuest EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got nothing to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟你没话说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some dirty water if you're interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你感兴趣，我这里有脏水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some hard liquor if you want it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想要的话，我这里有一些烈酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some purified water. It'd be a crime to waste it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些净化水。浪费它简直是犯罪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got the clues, but I'm still having trouble deciphering them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拿到了线索，但我仍然很难破译。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got the mini nuke and battery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拿到了迷你核弹和电池。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got to go now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got you now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我抓住你了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我殿后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard of Reilly's Rangers. What they don't have in numbers, they make up for in guts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过莱莉的游骑兵。他们人数虽少，但勇气十足。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fb0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard Outcasts wear their helmets when they sleep. Makes you wonder if they're more machine than man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说流放者睡觉都戴头盔。搞不好他们那身钢铁比血肉还多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_00002a49_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard slaves and slavers alike will buy Lincoln related artifacts. Well, he is the great unifier, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说奴隶和奴隶贩子都收林肯的遗物。毕竟他是伟大的团结者嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0002a229_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard the Talon Company is willing to undertake jobs other men won't do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说鹰爪公司愿意接别人不干的活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000220b5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard Three Dog say your dad's a good guy. A horrible father, but a good guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三狗电台总夸你爹是好人…不算个好爹，但是好人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've learned a lot from the old man, but my partner here thinks we should leave him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老头教了我不少，可这搭档总想甩了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BF] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect03\x3dnpcprospectors_greeting_0000b15a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've learned my lesson. I'm glad it didn't come at the cost of my children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我吸取了教训。我很高兴这没有以我孩子的生命为代价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003cdd_3.ogg
