ESP.ORIGINAL: I've lived a long life. Too long. But your friendship is proof there are still things worth living for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我活了很长的一生。太久了。但你的友谊证明，仍然有值得活下去的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01i_00014987_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never been a fan of Nuka-Cola Quantum. It has way too much sugar. At least, I hope that's sugar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我向来讨厌核子可乐量子味，糖多得吓人——至少希望那是糖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018487_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never been one to take the subway, but I believe this will connect us to downtown. That's where our friend Mr. Dog will be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从不坐地铁，但这趟能通市中心。咱们的狗先生就在那儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never had a ghoul before. Do I get to keep the tip?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没伺候过尸鬼呢…小费能留着不？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benedict [110056A2] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_hello_00005d5e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never liked government facilities. Of course, with no government, I suppose they're just facilities now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 向来讨厌政府设施。不过既然没政府了，现在就叫设施吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000355d4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never met other children. I hope they like eating bugs as much as I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没见过别的小孩…希望他们也爱吃虫虫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_00002682_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never seen ants like the ones in Grayditch. But if they're like most ants, we best aim for the antennae.
ESP.TRADUIT: 格雷迪奇这种蚂蚁真没见过。但要是和普通蚂蚁一个德行，咱们最好瞄准触须打。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370bd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never used a telephone, so I probably wouldn't even know how.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没用过电话，所以我可能都不知道怎么用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen a lot of weird tech in vaults, but never anything good. But the important thing is finding your dad. Let's worry about this "Project Purity" after you hug it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所怪科技见多了，没一样靠谱。先找你爹要紧，净水计划啥的等你们抱完再说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008de9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen bird droppings more pleasing to look at. They smelled better too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过鸟粪都比你好看。闻起来也比你好闻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen weirder things out in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在废土上见过更奇怪的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ivy
ESP.TRADUIT: 艾薇
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 女性 Race : Ghoul Clas : Settler

ESP.ORIGINAL: Izzy isn't asking you. I am. And I'm not someone you wanna fuck with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊兹没问你。我问你。而我不是你想惹的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Izzy Rae Stein
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊兹·雷·斯坦
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 女性 Race : Caucasian Clas : Vault Dweller

ESP.ORIGINAL: Izzy Rae Stein says your father owes money. Do you know her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊兹·蕾·斯坦说你父亲欠钱。你认识她吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jackpot, soldier! This right here is what we call the motherlode.
ESP.TRADUIT: 中头彩了兄弟！这他妈叫祖坟冒青烟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000799f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jackson
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰克逊
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : African American Clas : Soldier

ESP.TRADUIT: 他什么时候没再出来，我们大多数人甚至都没注意到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00bduplic_00008120_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of us like to keep to ourselves. We're a town of runaways and vagrants, so it's hard to trust people no matter how well you get to know them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们大多数人都喜欢独处。我们这个镇子里住的都是些逃亡者和流浪汉，所以不管你和他们有多熟，都很难信任别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc05_00006c8f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of us were normal guys, but there's always one who's a bit of an oddball. For us, that guy was Freddie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们大多数都是普通人，但总有一个古怪的。对我们来说，那个人是弗雷迪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50f_00006151_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most shoes I polished were so clean you could almost smell the caps on them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我擦过的大多数鞋子都干净得你几乎能闻到上面的瓶盖味。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank02_0000b1ef_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Museum of Technology West Wing
ESP.TRADUIT: 科技博物馆西厅

ESP.ORIGINAL: Must we always end our conflicts with violence? I really do despise your sort, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非得用暴力收场？说真的，我顶瞧不上你们这号人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000081a9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mutants, mercs...just another day in the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 变种人、雇佣兵……在废土上这不过是寻常的一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000029a1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My apologies then. A lot of kids grow up fast in the wastes. But you sure don't look the part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那抱歉，废土上很多孩子早熟，但你看着不像
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00b_00000d2d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My apologies. I'm just speaking out loud again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉。我又把心里话说出来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000726d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My baseball needs a doctor? Is it sick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的棒球需要看医生？它生病了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_0000353f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My buddy down in Rivet City said he basically swore off Jet and Psycho once he got a taste.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在铆钉城的朋友说，他尝过之后就基本上戒掉了狂暴和杰特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_000080ff_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My cooking's not as good as Dot's but it's mostly edible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的烹饪不如点做得好，但大部分是可食用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcbarter_000053c1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dear, I wouldn't be caught dead in that outfit, so I'll do my best to keep you alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 乖乖，这身行头送我进棺材都嫌寒碜，所以得保您长命百岁呀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000596c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My death will remind them of what's at stake. Your death will prove the battle can be won.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的死会提醒他们利害攸关。你的死将证明这场战斗可以胜利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_000142a3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dream is to make my own holotape. Okay, so maybe it's not a dream, maybe it popped in my head three seconds ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的梦想是制作自己的全息磁带。好吧，也许这算不上梦想，也许三秒钟前才突然冒出来的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00005a62_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My fascination with death is hardly morbid. It's inevitable, and dare I say, poetic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对死亡的迷恋绝不是病态的。它是不可避免的，我敢说，是诗意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002cd4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My friend wasn't himself. He was trying to take his own life any way he could.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的朋友不是他自己了。他想尽一切办法结束自己的生命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My girl!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好姐妹！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followershired_000083e0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My guess is he got tired of waiting in line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜他厌倦了排队等候。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My guess is one of Izzy's goons come here saying Pa owes taxes. She's been doing that shit to a whole lotta folks, but few pay them any mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜伊兹的一个打手来这儿说老爸欠税了。她一直对很多人做这种事，但没几个人把他们当回事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001fb9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My job now is to help you with yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在的任务是帮助你完成你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a3_00008133_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My main job is shuttling supplies over from Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我主要工作是从十便士塔运补给
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot03_00000937_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好兄弟！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followershired_000083df_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My men need a symbol of their own, an ever present reminder to let go of their fear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的战士也需要象征，一个驱散恐惧的永恒图腾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_greeting_0001428c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mistake. My gender detector must be broken. But then again, I'm not built to last. The Corvega V8 is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的错误。我的性别探测器可能坏了。但话又说回来，我不是为持久而设计的。而科尔维加 V8是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c8e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Jean-Baptiste, coach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫让-巴蒂斯特，教练。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000013e3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name isn't Jangles you dumb freak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我名字不叫叮当，你这个白痴怪物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name's Dot! Same as on the sign. And I've put too much into this place to leave now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫多特！和招牌上的一样。而且我为这个地方付出了太多，现在不能走！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130j_00005355_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My next score's gonna be huge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下票买卖够吃三年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BE] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect02\x3dnpcprospectors_greeting_0000aab3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My old master owned a shop. I'd wipe the counters, sweep the floors, and polish people's shoes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的老主人开了一家店。我负责擦柜台，扫地，给人们擦鞋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank02_0000b1ef_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My only motivation is to help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的动机就是帮助你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My pop's the one in charge. Go talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我老爹管事，找他去
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Susie [11006CC3] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006ce6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My sister's running a scam down below. Don't listen to anything that comes out of her mouth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我姐在桥下行骗，她放的屁别听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_greeting_000059c8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My sister's running a scam down below. Don't listen to anything that comes out of her mouth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我姐在桥下行骗，她放的屁别听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_goodbye_000059ca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My thoughts exactly. Maybe we can convince the Brotherhood to do more than stand idly by while you do all the work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完全同意。也许我们可以说服兄弟会，让他们不只是袖手旁观，看着你做所有的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba1d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My ticket number says "AB." But so far they've only called numbers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我号码是"AB"！可他们只叫数字号！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [11001B25] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult03\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001b2b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My tummy hurts...
ESP.TRADUIT: 肚肚痛…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022DB] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000022de_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My two favorite words in the English language. Or is it three? Let's trade. Let us trade. Fuck, I'm confused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我最喜欢的两个词。不对，是三个？咱们交易吧。让我们交易吧。该死，我糊涂了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([110033CF]x3dnpcFollowersARANAS) x3dnpcARANAS quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_000033f0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: My what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, this isn't some hallucination. Those voices sounded so familiar. Something about this feels real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这不是幻觉。那些声音听起来是如此熟悉。这感觉很真实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200g_00006439_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you don't get it. It's not just the name. It's almost as if they were in the room. But how can that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不明白。不仅仅是名字。他们说话的声音，仿佛就在房间里一样。但这怎么可能？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200b_00006430_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you got it all wrong. Carnegie's a sweet man. He's been looking out for me ever since we were teenagers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你完全搞错了。卡内基是个好人。我们十几岁起，他就一直在照顾我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a2_0000539f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you keep it. I can always make more. And who knows, talk to enough Outcasts and you might change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你留着吧。我总能再造。而且谁知道呢，多和一些流放者聊聊，你可能会改变主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01g_00002339_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you weren't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you're not. You're the furthest thing from sorry, and that's alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不是。你和难过一点关系都没有，这没关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00c_0000968d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Get back to your posts. And tell these monkeys to get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。滚回岗位去。叫这群废物赶紧消失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000d97d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Get back to your posts. And tell these monkeys to get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。滚回岗位去。叫这群废物赶紧消失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcguardscene_0000a2d8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I didn't earn my freedom to stay in one place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我挣得自由不是为了停留在一个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack02_00001554_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I put those demons to rest the moment I filled his grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我把他埋葬的那一刻，那些心魔就已经安息了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a3_00008133_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I told you. This is the last time. Find someone else to do your dirty work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我告诉过你。这是最后一次。找别人替你干脏活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel50h_00008118_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. They're always weak. There are no exceptions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。他们总是很弱。没有例外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03c_00001c0c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. You just look like one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。你只是看起来像一个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No...it can't be....
ESP.TRADUIT: 不……不可能是……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130c_00005345_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No...this can't be real...
ESP.TRADUIT: 不...这不可能是真的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc100commen_00000a25_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nobody cares about ghouls, Audrey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人关心尸鬼，奥黛丽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nobody sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人派我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nobody's but my own. That man may have taught me to not to fear, but I'm the one who killed our master.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我自己的，谁也不是。那个人可能教会了我不要害怕，但我是杀死我们主人的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack000d_000187ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: None of it is useful in the real world, of course. But what is? Doctors help us live. Artists teach us how.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在现实世界屁用没有——可什么有用呢？医生续命，艺术家教人活法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005966_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: None of us really know. You see, it was Church's turn inside one of the sheds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谁都不知道。你看，轮到**丘奇**进其中一个棚子里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00bduplic_00008120_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope! Just seeing how we're doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有！只是看看我们过得怎么样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjoneshammo_0000b0e4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. Still not right. Are you sure you read the clues properly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不对。还是不对。你确定你正确解读了线索吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac08_00004ce1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally I'd agree wholeheartedly, but it seems in our travels I've developed bit of a conscience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常我会完全同意，但看来在我们的旅程中，我培养出了一点良知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_0001497b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally I'd agree wholeheartedly, but it seems in our travels I've developed bit of a conscience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常我会完全同意，但看来在我们的旅程中，我培养出了一点良知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_0001570b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally I'd have them start by shooting radroaches, but that won't do since they keep one as a pet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本来该让他们先打辐射蟑螂练手，可惜他们养了只当宠物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c98_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally I'd love to dance. But it's not gonna play out that way. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常我很喜欢跳舞。但这次可不行。拿着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally I'd say that was the liquor talking, but given the way you handled yourself here, I almost believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常我会说那是酒后胡言，但看你在这里的表现，我几乎相信了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00d_0000569e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally I'd say that's cruel, but at this point, my best bet is to let you finish and then lick the can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常我会说这很残忍，但现在，我最好的选择是让你结束，然后我去舔罐头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher0d_00003455_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, any information is helpful. If not this time, for the next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常，任何信息都有帮助。如果这次没有，下次也会有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2c_000030b3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a bit. It's kind of hard when everything's all swirly. Where did that robot come from anyway? Is it the same place as the leprechaun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一点也不。当所有东西都天旋地转的时候，很难集中注意力。那个机器人是从哪里来的？和小矮妖是同一个地方吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_0000733d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a chance. It's not real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不可能。那不是真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a lot, but it doesn't take much to thin out the rotation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多，但要减少轮换人数并不需要太多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01c_000065e3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a one. Funny thing is, I was rich as a motherfucker back in Coyote Ridge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没带任何瓶盖吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2_00003477_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not all of it. Some of it took place in carefully choreographed environments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不全是。有些部分是在精心编排的环境中进行的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not always in that order, of course. God forbid they adhere to some kind of schedule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，顺序不一定如此。老天保佑他们遵守某种时间表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey03_00004bc5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not entirely, no. This streak of bodies I'm on is starting to weigh on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不完全是，不。我正在经历的这一连串尸体开始让我感到沉重。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000ab1c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not exactly an even trade, but hey, we didn't get into this business for profit, right? Right!?!?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是一个公平的交易，但嘿，我们进入这个行业又不是为了利润，对吧？对吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq5b_0000b0cf_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not gonna argue with you there. Because this plan I got is totally insane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会跟你争论这个。因为我这个计划完全是疯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00c_0000342d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not just you. Everything you stand for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不只是你。你所代表的一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not like you. I hear you're solving everyone's problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不像你。我听说你在解决每个人的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00i_0000b1d7_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not literally of course, We can't have your tears staining the suit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不是字面上的意思，我可不想让你的眼泪弄脏我的西装。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00b_0000ab1a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not many people are glad to see this face. But that's usually because I'm pointing a gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没多少人乐意看到这张脸。但那通常是因为我正指着枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack000b_000187aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not me. I'm already sold. Shut up and take my money. No, don't shut up! Keep talking! That's what the money's for! Words!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题。我已经完全被说服了。闭嘴，拿我的钱。不，别闭嘴！继续说！我给钱就是为了听你说话！听这些话！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas01c_0000340a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not mine, but Gabriel's. The people he's freed, they're just trying to return the favor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是我的，而是加布里埃尔的。他解放的人们，他们只是想回报他的恩情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank03_000096ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much different than it is now. You find a ruin. Look for things that are light but valuable. Leave everything else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和现在没什么不同。你找到一处废墟。寻找轻便但有价值的东西。其他都留下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect4_0000a3e7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much help, I know, but my advice is to not overthink it. Sometimes the answer's staring you right in the face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道没用，但建议别想太复杂，有时答案就摆眼前
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a1_00000c60_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much to tell, I'm afraid. Most people here don't do anything save live and breathe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恐怕没什么可说的。这里大多数人除了活着和呼吸，什么都不做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempster3_000180dd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much, other than the codename. Project ZX Ultra. It sounds fancy enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了代号"ZX超能计划"没啥收获，听着挺唬人
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac05_00000c5b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much. I hear Seward Square is a mess these days. Mutants, madmen, the works. Makes me glad I live out west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。我听说西沃德广场最近一团糟。变种人，疯子，什么都有。这让我庆幸我住在西部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins03_0000341c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not necessarily. Sometimes there's another option.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不一定。有时候还有其他选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不行！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00000a0f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now, can't you see I'm taking the test?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别吵！没看见考试呢吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066E2] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_00008188_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now. We're working the case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不行，办案呢
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00002cc5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not on these prototypes. Storage, memory, systems and processing is all integrated into a single unit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这些原型机上可不行。储存、记忆、系统和处理都集成在一个单元里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2a1_0000378a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not only that, I've spent most of my life underground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不仅如此，我大部分时间都在地下度过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. Anyone who talks to me without pinching their nose has to be a good person. So I figure telling you is like telling the wind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，其实不是。任何跟我说话时不用捏着鼻子的人，都得是个好人。所以我感觉告诉你，就像告诉风一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc04b_00006ca9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. My forefathers were murderers, assholes, and thieves, so I got killing in the genes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 倒也不是。我的祖先是杀人犯、混蛋和窃贼，所以我骨子里就有杀戮的基因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher1_00003466_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. Unlike you, I've got thick skin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不完全是。不像你，我的皮肤很厚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Underworld Resident [11009626] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul01\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul05b_00001622_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure if the town here turned into zombies, or zombies took the town. Good riddance either way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞不清是这镇子的人变成了僵尸，还是僵尸占领了这镇子。不管怎样，都好极了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_000051c9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure why these ghouls came at us. I mean look at me! You won't find a friendlier face in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真搞不懂这些丧尸为什么冲我们来。瞧瞧我！在这片荒原上，你再也找不到比我还友善的脸了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00003db2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure. Maybe I'm good at climbing, maybe I'm good at rigging traps, or maybe I just like eating bloatflies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不确定。也许我擅长攀爬，也许我擅长设置陷阱，或者也许我就是喜欢吃巨型苍蝇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas05_00003424_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not surprising. Bad things tend to happen wherever I go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不意外。坏事总发生在我所到之处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that he ever cared about Alicia's welfare. I think it's quite clear he's the one who set her up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他压根不在乎艾丽西亚死活。摆明是他下的套。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that he ever cared about Alicia's welfare. I think it's quite clear he's the one who set her up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他压根不在乎艾丽西亚死活。摆明是他下的套。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_00018e62_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I disapprove, I mean, truth be told, I didn't like her attitude either. Please don't kill me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是不赞同，我的意思是，说实话，我也不喜欢她的态度。求求你别杀我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053d0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I don't appreciate your candor. You go finish your business, and leave the Doc to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 倒不是我不欣赏你的坦率。你去完成你的事，医生交给我来处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightball1_0000bece_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I doubted it for a second. You're the toughest son of a bitch I've ever had the pleasure of calling a friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然没怀疑过！老子这辈子称兄道弟的硬汉里数你最扛造！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmortarquest_greeting_0000871f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I'd know how to use it mind you, but it's the thought that counts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是说我知道怎么用它，但心意到了就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc05_0000739a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that it mattered much. You do realize we don't have to kill the ones that are cowering in the corners? Ah well, I suppose they are holding guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过也没什么关系。你有没有意识到我们不必杀掉那些躲在角落里的人？好吧，我想他们手里确实拿着枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03chatt_0001499c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not to mention the liability costs if you hurt someone on the outside would be through the roof!
ESP.TRADUIT: 更别说如果你在外面伤人，我们要赔的信用点能堆到天上去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000726b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not to mention what would happen to the rest of D.C. if this thing fell into the wrong hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更不用说如果这东西落入坏人之手，华盛顿特区的其他地方会发生什么了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00003e44_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not to mention what would happen to the rest of D.C. if this thing fell into the wrong hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更不用说如果这东西落入坏人之手，华盛顿特区的其他地方会发生什么了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00b_00006798_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not to mention when the way you kept your head low before the bullets even started flying. Awfully suspicious, don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 更何况，在子弹开始飞之前，你就一直低着头。非常可疑，你不觉得吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_0000aad9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not to mention your vodka tastes like shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更别提你的伏特加喝起来像屎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynxiniti_00002c1a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not Vernon's, not Carnegie's, not Jessica's. And certainly not yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是弗农的，不是卡内基的，不是杰西卡的。当然也不是你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053bc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not what, but who. We're having difficulties with a new client. It's my fault, really. I should've known better than to let a mutant inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是什么，而是谁。我们在一个新客户那里遇到了麻烦。是我的错，真的。我本该知道不能让一个变种人进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00b_00002e7a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not without the original manufacturer. Even if we had the schematics, human hands are incapable of repairing things on the nanoscale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有原始制造商不行。即使我们有图纸，人手也无法修复纳米级的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic0b_00002302_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet. But I'll let you know if that changes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没有。但如果情况有变，我会告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjackquest_000187b5_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest Stage : 10 Index : 0

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing for commies, that's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然没有给共党的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins01_00003420_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing out of the ordinary there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里没有什么不寻常的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac08a_00004ce8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing says America like a good old fashioned convenient store, am I right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说还有什么比便利商店更能代表美国的？那简直就是美国精神的象征啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079af_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing seems to wake them up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 似乎没有什么能唤醒他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing yet. But after what I had for lunch, I gotta feeling the toilet is gonna need fixing pretty soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前还没有。但在我吃了午饭之后，我感觉厕所很快就需要修理了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11009627] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul02\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul03b_00001621_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing you should concern yourself with. But the phone will never ring again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么需要你担心的。但电话再也不会响了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing, besides being utterly bland and tasteless. But I was referring to the people more than the atmosphere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，除了极其平淡无味。但我指的是人，而不是环境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_000370b7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. But since when do my actions ever make sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。但我的行为什么时候有过逻辑了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. Here. Take your blood money. Because in about a minute, all of you are gonna get what's coming to you anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。拿去吧。拿走你的血腥钱。因为再过一分钟，你们所有人都会得到应得的报应。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcmarcusizzy_00001ff4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now do you have business here, or are you just wasting my time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你有正事要办吗，还是只是在浪费我的时间？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_00009575_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now enough with the emotional claptrap. Let's go hunt some raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，别再搞这些多愁善感的废话了。我们去猎杀一些掠夺者吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey200_00016c9e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I can't so much as look at a kid without...well, point is, it can't be me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我简直不能看一眼孩子，否则就会……嗯，重点是，不能是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina05a_000035a3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I could try and introduce them...but you know how it is with blind dates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 倒是能给他俩牵个线…但相亲这破事你懂的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_000087eb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I know they're on the expensive side, but I was thinking, if we can grow more at home, it might save us money in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道它们贵，但我想如果在家多种点，长远能省钱
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e22_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I know this is goodbye, but I hope it's not goodbye forever. You're going to come back and visit us, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这是告别，但我希望不是永远的告别。你会回来拜访我们，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b1_0000538f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I know this is goodbye, but I hope it's not goodbye forever. You're going to come back and visit us, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这是告别，但我希望不是永远的告别。你会回来拜访我们，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b2_00005391_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I know this is goodbye, but I hope it's not goodbye forever. You're going to come back and visit us, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这是告别，但我希望不是永远的告别。你会回来拜访我们，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b3_00005390_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now if you want to leave, you're welcome to. No one will call you a coward, not after tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果你想走，欢迎你走。今晚之后，没人会说你是懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130p_0000535b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now if you want to leave, you're welcome to. No one will call you a coward, not after tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果你想走，欢迎你走。今晚之后，没人会说你是懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_00005a96_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now it's starting to make sense. It must've been tough for you dad to leave you, but it sounds like what he's after is bigger than any of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在总算明白了。你爸抛下你肯定难受，但他追的东西比谁都重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018462_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that had to be one of the nastiest, most badly dressed mutants I've ever seen. Using shopping carts for armor is so last season. Suffice to say, I'm glad it's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对是我见过最恶心、最不会穿的变种人。拿购物车当盔甲？早过时了。总之，死了挺好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba05_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that they know I was here, I have to make it seem like I walked in, saw the body, and called the police.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在他们知道我来过这里，我必须假装是我走进屋子，看到尸体，然后报警。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc04_000025eb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that you mention it, the resemblance is uncanny. Perhaps you are Cosmos.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么一说，确实很像。也许你就是宇宙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's an image. Two people dancing on a broken rooftop, singing in the acid rain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是一幅画面。两个人在一个破败的屋顶上，在酸雨中唱歌跳舞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey04b_00005978_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's uncalled for! You're just jealous because I have a home and you don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说这太过分了！你只是嫉妒我有家，而你没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I know how much it means to you and your dad.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_0000733b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I know. We should tell our new friend the story of how we all met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我知道了。我们应该告诉我们的新朋友我们是怎么认识的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_00005cc3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I think I met her once back at the diner. Nice woman. She even complimented my jumpsuit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我想我以前在餐馆见过她一次。人很好的女人。她甚至称赞了我的连体衣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia05b_00015f0f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm crazy in the medical sense, psychology minor yay, but not crazy enough to walk into a nest of feral ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我是在医学意义上疯狂，心理学辅修，耶，但还没疯狂到走进一个野尸鬼巢穴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4c1_0000272c_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我只是在拿你开玩笑，亲爱的。如果你还没注意到，我可不是这里做决定的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyfin_0000ab11_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm sure I'll still be both of those things. But maybe only when the situation warrants it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我确信我仍然会是那两样东西。但也许只在情况需要时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000ab22_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm sure we'll find time for that. Particularly if you're in the audience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我敢肯定我们会有时间排练的。特别是如果你是观众的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003c7f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, is that what I'm being? Here I was trying to be a shoulder to cry on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我看起来是这样吗？我本想做个可以依靠的肩膀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00b_0000ab1a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's never enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那永远不够。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02g_00002afb_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这永远不会结束。有前传的续集，有三部曲的翻拍，接下来你就会发现，奴隶制被改写了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02c_000033dd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you. Did you change your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟是您？改主意了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_0000260c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I've considered it. Many times. But then I thought, "Why kill me when I can just kill everyone else?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我考虑过。很多次。但后来我想，“既然我可以杀了其他人，为什么还要杀自己呢？”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_0002de09_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, just lucky I guess. My favorite is the one on the balcony. An assault rifle by the looks of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，只是运气好，我想。我最喜欢的是阳台上的那把。从外形看是一把突击步枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_00010928_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, my mistake. I guess it was too good to be true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我弄错了。我猜好得不像是真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, right! You're smart. I bet you'd get all the high fives back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对了！你很聪明。我敢打赌你回家后会得到所有的击掌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc3b_00002430_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，糟糕。今天是他的休息日，抱歉。但如果你愿意留下你的姓名和一些反馈，我很乐意转达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb2c_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，所以我应该相信他们是自己出现在你家门口的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that makes perfect sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那完全说得通。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that one's for me. But it has junk in it, so I thought, maybe you wouldn't notice?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那个是给我的。但里面有垃圾，所以我想，也许你不会注意到？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc7d_00002626_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that reminds me, have you heard that new song they've been playing on the top 40 station?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那提醒了我，你听过流行榜电台播的那首新歌吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e3e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that was me. I thought she'd make good use of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那是我。我以为她能善加利用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that was me. I thought she'd make good use of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那是我。我以为她能善加利用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's the best part! We're gonna build it! Just like the Floronic man did in the Captain Cosmos holotapes!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那才是最棒的部分！我们要把它造出来！就像《宇宙队长》全息磁带里那个植物人做的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00003434_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, there was nothing wrong him, if that's what you're implying. It's his children who are morally bankrupt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没。他本人没什么问题，如果你是这个意思的话。是他那些道德败坏的孩子有问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey06c_00006023_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, there's no time for that, darling. In about ten seconds the one to my right is going to reach for her gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，没时间了，亲爱的。再过十秒钟，我右边那个人就会去拿她的枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_00010914_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，没必要为打翻的牛奶哭泣。尤其是在这种情况下，因为我把它打翻进了杯子里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01d_000142bf_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我们不能对表格做任何修改。那需要得到上级的批准。问题是，目前的官员没有一个还活着。

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我们国税局的人都非常认真。有些人可能觉得我们太认真了，但我们觉得这是一种赞美。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs00b_00001b04_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我们要拯救很多人。你、我，还有你的机器人朋友一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop04_00002690_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哟，赶上晚饭点了。呃...算了，我撤了。这辈子吃辐射蟑螂的份额早超标了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you got a canary? Well, la-dee-da, I'll just be over here with my steak. And bacon. And jelly beans. Not together of course that would be awful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟，您养金丝雀？啧啧啧，我啃我的牛排培根配糖豆去。当然不混着吃，那得多恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000272e_2.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你永远别对一个食尸鬼说那种话。那会带来厄运，你知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. That's actually really kind. She really said that?

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。那我建议你去买一本税法。反正我就是那样开始的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02c_00001b22_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 好 !

ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你听我说。如果我代替多特经营这家餐馆怎么样？做饭不就像修理东西一样吗？

ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但有个问题，我怎么出去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, can I talk to you outside? Away from the crazy person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，能出去聊吗？离这疯子远点

ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我明白了。你他妈疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I listened to the second holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我听了第二盘全息磁带。

ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我明白了。这是我的钥匙。我先花点时间告别，然后在出口等你。

ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我们会把他们救出来的。留下还是离开，我无所谓。

ESP.TRADUIT: 再想想，给你。拿着吧。反正我也不想要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought, it's best you stay here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再想想，你最好还是待在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought, stick with me for a little longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再想想，和我多待一会儿吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought, you're right. I can't let you live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 转念一想，你说得对。我不能让你活下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On that terminal is the location of a weapon. Something built specifically for a post-apocalyptic hellscape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个终端机上有个武器的位置。那是专门为末日地狱般的景象建造的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01d_00002337_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the Fort Independence terminal, you mentioned he lived in Georgetown near this McClellan family. You might find something there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 独立堡终端提过他住乔治城麦克莱伦家附近，去那儿找找
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a4_00000c5c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the other hand, you were the agent responsible for this case, weren't you? You should be more observant.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60a_0000201a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the paper is a crude drawing of a rocket scribbled with crayon. A line points to the bottom with the words ENJUN PAHTS next to it. The shape of the rocket resembles those found in Pre-War models like the one at the Museum of Technology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纸上是一幅用蜡笔潦草画的火箭草图。一条线指向底部，旁边是ENJUN PAHTS字样。火箭的形状类似于战前的模型，比如科技博物馆里的那个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once its there, I'll shut down all its other functions. That should allow it to run for decades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦到了那里，我就会关闭它所有的其他功能。那应该能让它运行几十年。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000029aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: One-two-three-four.

ESP.TRADUIT: 结果他从不出现，你一直存着，存着，存着，直到突然战争结束了，你甚至都没用过它！操！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_000026ff_5.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only the best, finest American goods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有最好的、最优秀的美国货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only you used to know how. You used to be a soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有你以前知道怎么做。你以前是个士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Onward, soldier! Forward march!
ESP.TRADUIT: 前进士兵！齐步走！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_goodbye_0000384a_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我来过这儿！请坐好，放松，摆脱地球的束缚，我们就要飞向星辰，飞向星辰……哔！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00003ef9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh, but I'm not sure I want to. The second you press it, the story's over.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh, I really like this preacher. He has a lot of good ideas.

ESP.TRADUIT: 请别这样。我喜欢你愤世嫉俗又刻薄的样子。

ESP.TRADUIT: 求你了。我求你了。你不能这么做！你不能！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretend to plant chems
ESP.TRADUIT: 假装种植化学品

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty much all of them were wanderers like you. Lost children in need of a home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们中几乎所有人都是像你一样的流浪者。需要家园的迷途儿童。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03_00006ce1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty much everything in this town is a grave marker, and they all tell their own story. The only thing missing is the body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座镇子里几乎每样东西都是墓碑，它们各自诉说着自己的故事。唯一缺少的就是尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fc2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty much, but right now I'm number two. I'm guessing number one already had his turn, so they should be calling me up any second now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 差不多，但现在我是二号。我猜一号已经轮过了，所以他们应该随时会叫我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60b_00002004_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty much. I...I mean I hate to say it, but fighting back...it felt good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 差不多吧。我……我的意思是我讨厌这么说，但反击……感觉很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008092_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 很快我们就会有足够的瓶盖，就不需要再欺骗任何人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pre-War tech's is like an apple in the Garden of Eden. Best not take a bite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战前科技就像伊甸园的智慧果——最好别啃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_00004ccb_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是他的自尊吧，但又没有哪个傻瓜到处散布他做了什么事的谣言。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher1f_0000346c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably maybe, but that's much better than improbably likely. You just leave him to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能吧，但这比不太可能好得多。你就把他交给我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00005a3f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能不会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably won't find supplies down in a tunnel like this. But we might find some dinner, ha-ha-ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 隧道里估计没补给，但晚饭有着落喽！哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008de4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Problem is, Coyote Ridge was using cigarettes for money. Out here, they only take caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还为了什么？为了化学品！我告诉你，辛迪·坎特利那里的货多得能让你永久超速运转。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2_00003476_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Problem is, it's too dark to see where he's going. My guess though? You follow the guard, you find the key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，那里太黑了，看不清他要去哪里。不过我猜？你跟着守卫，就能找到钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_00008106_3.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，这里的当权者不是最聪明的。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : 0A010303 Clas : Explosives Expert

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raider Armor
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠袭者护甲
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Light Body

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raider filth amuses me. If you want to be a counterculture group, you don't make a mess. You clean it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者搞破坏的样子真滑稽。想当反主流？该收拾而非乱砸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000369fa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raiders must've stripped the tires from these old cars. Must get cold out here. Probably wanted to make a bonfire. We'll just have to burn their bodies instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者肯定把这些旧车的轮胎都拆下来了。这儿肯定很冷。他们可能想生火取暖。那我们就只能烧他们的尸体了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015683_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raiders. I sent them on their way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者，送他们上路了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc01_0000083b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raiders? Since when do raiders run from anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者？掠夺者什么时候会逃跑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_000030ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Randy
ESP.TRADUIT: 兰迪
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : African American Clas : Vault Dweller

ESP.ORIGINAL: Randy thought it was best the three of us stayed behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兰迪认为我们三个人留下来最好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a3_00007a56_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rats, and I take it he didn't shout out a random number as he crumpled to the ground?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的，我猜他倒地时没有胡乱喊出一个数字？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_000142c0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ready for another adventure? The last one was great, but I bet this time will be even better!
ESP.TRADUIT: 新冒险整装待发？上回超赞，这回更带劲！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_00006010_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ready to get moving?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就动身？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Real good thing you did for the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为镇子做了大好事

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really, that guy made for great fireworks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，那家伙真是个不错的烟火。

ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？全部？那终于结束了。
