ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? And here I thought it was a cyst. Good to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我还以为是囊肿。知道就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01c_0001497d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? And it's loaded? Oh man, you're the best!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？而且上膛了？天啊，你太好了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcchildreng_00003c65_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? But that's the funnest part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？但这才是最好玩的部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02b_00001b21_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? I don't see how that's even possible. This place is more bullet than bar now. But far be it for me to call you a liar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我看不出这怎么可能。这里现在与其说是酒吧，不如说是子弹。但我不会说你是个骗子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? I never knew that. Did you get arrested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我从来不知道。你被逮捕了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cde_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? It does look familiar. Then again, I go through rifles faster than I go through books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？这玩意儿看起来确实有点眼熟。不过我用枪比读书快多了，所以记不住也正常。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq0e1_0000fae4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? It's a bit loud, isn't it? Reminds me of playing the drums though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？有点吵，不是吗？不过让我想起打鼓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3c_00002711_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Keep in mind I'm not the most trustworthy witness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？你要知道，我可不是最值得信任的证人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_00007342_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Maybe puny human is right. Room is not that great anyway, but Charles does not want to look like he made bad purchase.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？也许小矮人说得对，房间确实不咋地，但查尔斯不想显得自己买亏了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Charles [11003BD7] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01c1_000008a8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Thanks. I think I feel a little better now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？谢谢。我想我感觉好一点了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1a_0000267a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Thanks. I think I feel a little better now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？谢谢。我想我感觉好一点了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1a_00006048_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? That's the response you're going with? You don't want to see her? You're just going to trust two complete strangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？你打算这么回应？你不想见她？你就打算相信两个完全的陌生人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_0000aacc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Well you have to know that I had nothing to do with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？你得知道这事跟我一点关系都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053ca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? What've you got for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？你有什么给我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq5_00008806_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? You must go to some wild parties then. We're too lazy to go out, but responsible enough to clean up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？那你参加的派对肯定很疯狂。我们太懒了，不想出去，但又足够负责任去打扫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30300c_00005609_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reddin bit off more than she could chew. That's what happens when you charge ahead with eyes closed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞丁贪多嚼不烂。这就是闭着眼睛往前冲的下场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015670_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: RedRacer
ESP.TRADUIT: 红赛车
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pre-War Radio Broadcast [110034D9] (mod) Quest : ([110034DA]x3DNPCRadio3DNPCQuest) Atomic Radio EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcradio3dnpcvoice\x3dnpcradi_radiohello_00005180_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless of the way it went down, I'm glad you came back for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管事情怎么发生的，我很高兴你回来救我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_00015710_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, it will keep add your genetic imprint to the list of non-hostiles. Just hold still for scanning. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，它都会将您的基因印记添加到非敌对名单中。请保持静止以进行扫描。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beepbeep0b_0000269d_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, the children learned a valuable lesson, and no one human got hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，孩子们学到了宝贵的一课，而且没有人类受伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003ca8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly said the Theo left his crate on the stairwell. If you're running low on ammo, we might wanna head there first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱利说西奥把补给箱落楼梯间了。弹药不够的话最好先去拿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000b5dc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly's a little bitch. Hiding in that chop shop. I say fuck her. We don't need to waste our time saving her pathetic little friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉这小贱人。躲在这家汽车修理厂里。我管她呢。我们没必要浪费时间去救她那些可怜的小朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_00003da6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. It's all over now. Dot was the cause of all of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松。一切都结束了。多特是这一切的罪魁祸首。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Religion, freedom, greed, and lust. The motives change. The actors change. But war...war stays the same. War will never die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 宗教、自由、贪婪和欲望。动机改变了。演员改变了。但战争……战争始终如一。战争永不消亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplaymonol_000013c8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember the mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 牢记任务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchaskins_goodbye_00003422_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember the name. Sally Jones. Actress, singer, and shortstop for the Capital Congressmen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住这名字：莎莉·琼斯！演员、歌手，国会队游击手！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003583_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember what I said. No need to start anything now that things have settled down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住我说的，既然事态平息就别再挑事
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005365_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, stick to the story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住咬死说辞
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_000033a7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, we fight for Truth, Justice, and the Space-American Way. Cosmos no forget. Jangles shouldn't either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，我们为真理、正义和太空美利坚而战，科斯莫斯不会忘，小丑也不该忘
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_greeting_000008e4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Renting is like temporary ownership. You take it, use it, then give it back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 租用就像是暂时拥有。你拿走它，使用它，然后还回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Repopulating the Earth is a big job. Are you up for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 重建地球是一项艰巨的任务。你准备好了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Report sergeant! How goes the battle on the Eastern front?
ESP.TRADUIT: 报告，中士！东线战况如何？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconvb_000043a6_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 救人可能很无聊，但杀掠夺者总是很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say no more. You want me to kill them all and get you inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说了。你希望我把他们都杀了，然后让你进去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say something funny and I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说点好笑的，我就这么做。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([110033CF]x3dnpcFollowersARANAS) x3dnpcARANAS quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_000033f3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She asked for your code, not some Pre-War gentleman's handbook.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她要的是你的准则，不是什么战前绅士手册。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BE] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect02\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect2_0000a3e6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She calls me Jonesy. My name is Jones. It is as clear as Arial font. There is no additional consonant and sometimes vowel at the end of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她叫我琼西。老子大名琼斯！清楚得跟雅黑体似的！尾巴上没辅音更没元音！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002746_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She did. I never got married, so she was the closest thing I had to a daughter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是的。我从没结过婚，所以她是我最接近女儿的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50b_00003e63_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She got whisked away by some drifter. Didn't even pack her things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她被某个流浪汉带走了。连行李都没收拾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maury [11015DE9] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmauryvoice\x3dnpcmq01b_x3dnpcmaury1_00015e11_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She is you. You are her. Monkey from the moon. Sidekick to Cosmos.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是你，你是她，月球来的猴子，科斯莫斯的跟班
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc02a_000008d5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She is? That's...that's good to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是吗？这……这真是个好消息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_000096b3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She isn't all bad. It's only when she's within five hundred feet of you that you start getting annoyed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她不总是那么糟。只有当她在你五百英尺以内时，你才会开始感到烦躁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic0_0002708c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She killed the old woman who used to live here. The calls were from her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她杀了以前住在这里的老妇人。那些电话是她打来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She knew me from back when I sold chems to her old raider crew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她认识我，是从我以前卖化学品给她的老掠夺者帮派的时候开始的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam3_000087c4_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She probably found it lying around this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她可能是在这个地方捡到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She probably found it lying around this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她可能是在这个地方捡到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was a chem addict. She had her whole two months ahead of her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是个瘾君子。她本可以拥有她整个两个月的美好时光。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She would've liked it simple. Path of least resistance and all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她会喜欢简单的方式。阻力最小的路径，诸如此类。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sheeit, a little radiation never hurt anybody! Fuck, look at them ants. They're as big as a boner on a brahmin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，一点辐射又没伤害到任何人！操，看看那些蚂蚁。它们跟双头牛的那个一样大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar02a_000026c2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sheer disgust, really. These three made the mistake of using the bathroom as a holding cell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纯粹是厌恶，真的。这三个人犯了个错误，把洗手间当成了拘留室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_000142bd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She'll be losing a friend. I'm sorry, but I can't let you go through with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她会失去一个朋友。我很抱歉，但我不能让你这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's all of those things. And whatever she had to say, I guarantee you it's utter nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她就是所有这些东西。而且无论她说了什么，我向你保证那都完全是胡说八道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c45_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's always blaming me, always making me the scapegoat for her problems. Well that ends here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她总是责怪我，总是把她的问题归咎于我。这一切到此为止！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70e_000063f2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's been like this ever since we was kids. Always trying to copy her big bro. Never had an idea of her own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她从小就是这样。总想模仿她的大哥。从来没有自己的主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll2_000059c1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ship broke on crash landing. He thought Jangles dead. But Jangles here now. Only tail is gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 飞船坠毁时坏了，以为小丑死了，但他还活着，只是尾巴没了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc01c_000008cb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit man, I've done a lot of chems in my day, and talked to a lot of trees. This is the first time they've ever talked back though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的…老子嗑药嗨时没少和树唠嗑…头回见树回嘴的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007363_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit man, you're hardcore, burning that tree down. Let me guess, you wanted to inhale the fumes, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 烧树够狠啊兄弟！让我猜…想吸两口树烟嗨一把？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007366_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit! That is one fucked up barbecue!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！这烧烤也太他妈的变态了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00003db3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, as long as I'm getting paid, he's whoever Casey says he is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管他呢，只要我能拿到报酬，他说他是谁就是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, do I have to do everything myself? I guess we're gonna have to do this the old fashioned way then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，难道我什么都得自己做吗？我想我们只能用老办法了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60a_00001fdd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I ain't afraid to suck a man's dick if it means I get to live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，如果能让我活下去，我他妈不怕给男人口交。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher1e_0000346b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I didn't mean it as an insult. You saved our butts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，我不是想侮辱你。你救了我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00b_00006798_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I guess it's been a while since we've seen each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的，我想我们有一段时间没见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00f_00009643_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I had something to show you, but I left it in the garage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟糕，我有些东西要给你看，但我把它落在车库里了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I should've been thanking him. But you don't cross me and get to live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的，我应该谢谢他的。但你惹了我，就别想活着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000beb0_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I was just trying to have a chat. But if you're gonna be an ass, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟糕，我只是想聊聊。但如果你非要当个混蛋，随便你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I would've taken care of him for a few dollars under the table. But instead he goes and does this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，我本来可以私下收点钱替他解决的。但他却去做了这个？.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00a_000033b2_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，我本来可以私下收点钱替他解决的。但他却去做了这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00a_000033b5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, if you're looking for some help, maybe I can tag along with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，如果你在找帮手，也许我可以和你一起去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c39_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I'll go check her camper!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，我去看看她的房车！

ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在找工作，可以跟我来。

ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，我应该相信你就是这么走进来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, I'm supposed to believe you just walked right in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，我应该相信你就是这么走进来的？ ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00aduplica__00001f24_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, it takes talent to use this many chems and not see bugs crawling out of my eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈的需要用这么多化学品而不看到虫子从我眼睛里爬出来，这可是需要天赋的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2c_00003474_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, maybe I'm diabetic. Ever thought of that? I could have one of those diseases where your body's low on psycho.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗屁，也许我是糖尿病患者。有没有想过这个？我可能患了一种体内“精神”不足的疾病。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2_0000346d_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, you let a bunch of ghouls into the Tower, and them rich folk might die of heart attacks. It's a good thing they don't have hearts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放尸鬼进塔？那帮阔佬怕要吓出心脏病…幸好他们压根没心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007367_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit's been real. Have you been paying attention at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都太真实了。你到底有没有在听？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shooting stuff is fun, don't get me wrong. But I'm going to be a famous actress. I'll have bodyguards protecting me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开枪是挺爽，但我要当大明星的！到时候请保镖护卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c9d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shot in the head by a raider. Freddie got sloppy and let the guy flank him. Not sure why. Maybe it was the socks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 被一个掠夺者一枪爆头。弗雷迪大意了，让那个家伙侧翼包抄了他。不知道为什么。也许是袜子的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50f_00003e56_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show a little more respect. He's trying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多表现出一点尊重。他正在努力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me your map. Yeah, it's right there. Right next to old Dukov's place. Can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看你的地图。是的，就在那里。就在老杜科夫家旁边。不会错过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03f_00001c22_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 闭嘴，你这个混蛋……闭嘴……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shut up! Monkey can't be Jane or Fred! Only stupid name for stupid monkey!
ESP.TRADUIT: 闭嘴！猴子不能叫简或弗雷德！只有蠢名字配蠢猴子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc00b_000008ef_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 关闭程序

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sigh...
ESP.TRADUIT: 叹气……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Simon? Ohhhhh, you mean the kid I had with my wife, as opposed to you know, yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 西蒙？哦你是说我跟我老婆生的孩子，不是你知道的那个

ESP.TRADUIT: 很简单。在生活中，人们相信他们想相信的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since you're so helpful, maybe you can turn over some rocks, and find Jonesy's smile. Hey, it worked once before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然您这么能帮忙，不如翻翻石头找找琼西的笑脸？嘿，上回不就找着了嘛。

ESP.TRADUIT: 坐下来等你的电话号码被呼叫

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sixteen times a...hmph. Are you sure that's the question you want to ask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 十六乘以……嗯。你确定这是你想问的问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slasher has returned to Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 屠杀者回到铆钉城了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slasher's the name of a chem that mixes Psycho and Med-X. More popular out west I hear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 监狱里的人说我像“吗啡-X”一样坚韧，像“精神”一样疯狂。因此得名。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher3_00003484_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 春谷镇的奴隶贩子

ESP.TRADUIT: 睡到凌晨2点

ESP.ORIGINAL: Small Ranch
ESP.TRADUIT: 小树林

ESP.ORIGINAL: Small towns are supposed to be quiet. Safe. We should do what we can to keep it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小镇本该又安静又太平。咱们得守住这份安稳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smart buyers come through me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 识货的都找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Raider [110059B5] (mod) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaletroll\x3dnpctrol_goodbye_000059db_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smith Casey? That's a backwards name. Sounds like Casey Smith suffered from that dyslexia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 史密斯·凯西？这名字倒着念才对。凯西·史密斯怕不是读写障碍吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034ca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smoke brings attention from all sides. It's better if the raiders stumble onto this place. Makes them easier to shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 烟雾会引来四面八方的注意。最好是掠夺者偶然发现这个地方。这样更容易射击他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc03c_000022bb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sniper rifles like yours go really well with psycho. Helps keep your hand steady.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你那样的狙击步枪跟疯子很配。能让你的手稳当些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_000034c1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So are the people stuck in that sim forever? I don't think that's right. There's got to be a way to end their suffering, even if it means they die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 困在模拟系统里的人就永远出不来了？我觉得不对。总得帮他们解脱，哪怕得弄死他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018478_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So are we clear on what needs to be done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 行动方案都明确了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchaskins_greeting_00005a42_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So at what point will the word "peace" be stricken from the vernacular? After all, only a handful of us know what it really means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以"和平"这词何时该从字典抹去？毕竟真懂其意的活人…还剩几个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0003b9f3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So can you do it? Can you fix Beep Beep?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能修好哔哔吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_0000377d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So certain movements come natural. Same with certain behavior. It's all subconscious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以有些动作很自然。某些行为也是一样。这都是潜意识的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008091_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So Diego chose pussy over priesthood. Well, God needs to step his game up and put some naughty pictures in that Bible if he wants to compete.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪亚哥为娘们弃神职？上帝得在圣经里加点春宫图…不然竞争不过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034a0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So does Galaxy News Radio broadcast to the all galaxies, or just this one? Either way, it's not half as good as a holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 银河新闻电台是向所有星系广播，还是只向这个星系广播？不管怎样，它都不如一张全息磁带好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00006e5e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So far it's okay. But I'll have to hear more before I come to a conclusion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到目前为止还行。但我要听更多内容才能下结论。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So for Eightball to get locked up by one of her own, sheeit, I can't even imagine what kind of fucked up shit she did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以八号球能被自己人关起来，他妈的，我简直无法想象她做了什么操蛋的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam3_000087c7_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So go up there, plant the bear, and I'll trigger it from down below.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你上去，放上熊，然后我在下面引爆它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00003439_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So Grayditch is infested with fire-breathing ants? How does that work exactly? Won't they burn their lips?
ESP.TRADUIT: 灰渠镇闹喷火蚁？这啥原理？不怕烫嘴？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000734b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So he cuts himself, but when that isn't fast enough, he pops a few chems. I guess that makes sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以他割伤自己，但当这不够快时，他就吸几口药。我想这说得通。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00d_00001f34_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So he did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他确实说了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina05_00003599_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So he lent you his apartment, and you brought a friend over. Who is he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以他把公寓借给你，你还带了个朋友过来。他是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00b_00003376_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So here I am. Got a roof, some plumbing, and all the ants I can eat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我来了。有屋顶，有水管，还有吃不完的蚂蚁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar02_00001c03_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So his lackeys, they toss me into a ring with these rabid fucking animals, putting caps on which one was gonna eat my guts first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 于是他的手下把我扔进一个圈里，里面是这些他妈的疯狗，他们押瓶盖赌哪一只会先把我吃掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a_00003dc5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So how do you feel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你感觉怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I asked for the money up front, and when she left the room, I called the police.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我要求预付现金，当她离开房间后，我就报了警。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcmackdamem_000043a4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I can't just let him talk to anybody, not unless the price is right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我不能随便让他和任何人说话，除非价格合适。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_0000956f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I found myself wandering these tunnels, fumbling in the dark, when the floor collapsed beneath me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我发现自己在这片隧道里游荡，在黑暗中摸索，然后脚下的地板塌陷了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_00015f36_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I got down on my hands and knees and just started petting around the pavement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我趴地上用手摸索人行道
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon01_00000960_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I gotta ask, what day was doomsday? Do we celebrate that shit now? Seems like we should.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我得问问，毁灭日是哪天？咱们现在庆祝这玩意儿吗？感觉应该庆祝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034ae_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I ran into Gloria at the Super-Duper Mart the other day, shopping for energy weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前几天在超级商场碰到格洛丽亚买能量武器
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcminefield_hello_00000e16_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I spent most of the day just doing things I normally wouldn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我大部分时间都在做我平时不会做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066E2] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00b_0000818e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I still have my brother to deal with, but we can worry about that another time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我的兄弟还需要我去对付，但我们可以改天再担心这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcquesttask_0000ab28_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I take it you're the one responsible for this early nightcap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来今儿这"睡前酒"是您的手笔？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000081a9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I thank you for being so understanding. It's hard carving a life out here in the wastes, and not every decision is easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以谢谢你的理解。在废土上开创生活很艰难，不是每一个决定都容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053bc_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I trust you got your money's worth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你觉得钱花得值吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I'd find an actual Pre-War barracks. But not a place where they'd normally stay, like a Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以得找真正的战前兵营，但不是常规驻地比如要塞
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a3_00000c5f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So if you find one out there in the wastes, there's a chance it's been mine at one point or another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在废土中找到一把，它很可能曾经属于我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq0e1_0000fae4_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So if you say you believe in signs and ouija boards and all that shit, it's my cue to lock my brain and forget how to count to four.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以如果你说你相信预兆和通灵板以及所有那些狗屁，那就是我封闭大脑、忘记怎么数到四的信号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq1_000026f1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I'm really a machine? Does that mean I can't think for myself? Does it mean the others couldn't either?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我真的是一台机器？这是否意味着我不能独立思考？是否意味着其他人也不能？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90a_00007309_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So imagine my shock to find out you brought this man over and did god knows what in my tub.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以想象一下我的震惊，发现你把这个人带过来，在我浴缸里做了天知道什么事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc02duplicat_00001f3b_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So imagine my surprise to find myself stuck in one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，想象一下当我发现自己身处其中时的惊讶吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01_00004bba_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So is this like a church for mutants? Because the god they worship is really fucked up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这算变种人教堂？拜的神可真他妈邪门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c7a_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，看来整个核心功能都被重写了。真了不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So it looks like the entire core function has been rewritten. Amazing. Well, there goes that plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 核心程序居然全重写了…牛逼。计划泡汤咯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_000026aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So it turns out Ian West is just an ordinary cannibal. I'm almost disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞半天伊恩·韦斯特就是个普通食人族。白期待了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So just tell me who this mook is, and I'll make sure baby duck is right behind mama.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以告诉我这个笨蛋是谁，我保证小鸭子会紧跟在妈妈后面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So let me get this straight. Don made a dedication on American Top 40, the most popular show on radio, to another man's wife?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我理一下。唐在电台最火的节目《美国 Top 40》上，对另一个男人的妻子献歌？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo01_000055f8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long as I had that key, he could never lock that door on me again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我有那把钥匙，他就永远不能再把我锁在那扇门里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h_0000643a_5.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long as the mission is completed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要任务完成就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Casilla [11002740] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcknightcasillavoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_0000b0ec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long as we're around, the government can build itself back up piece by piece. And it'll take more than a nuclear holocaust to destroy the IRS.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我们还在，政府就能一点一点地重建起来。而且，要摧毁国税局，光凭一场核浩劫是远远不够的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs04_00001b19_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So no, I don't know jack shit about combat and tactics and whatnot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道在一场流血比赛中，我需要更长的时间才会昏过去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher4_00003485_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So now I know what it feels like to be Amata. You really are a knight in shining armor, aren't you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以现在我知道了阿玛塔是什么感觉。你真的是个白马王子，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia05d_00015f11_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So one day I woke up, walked into that house and killed them all. Every man, woman, and child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以有一天我醒来，走进那所房子，杀了他们所有人。每一个男人、女人和孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03ga_00001c2b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So our orders are not to do anything that can be seen as helping or hurting him. Not intentionally, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我们的命令是，不做任何可能被视为帮助或伤害他的事。无论如何，不是故意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq5_00002bde_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So President Eden's a machine too? Ha, at this point, I'm just going to assume everyone is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊登总统也是机器？哈，干脆当全世界都是机器人得了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So rest assured I'm gonna pump myself with so many drugs I won't feel the bullets until I'm reincarnated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以请放心，我会给自己注射大量的药物，直到我转世，否则我不会感觉到子弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_0000733b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So Richard's a murderer. Can't say I'm surprised.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以理查德是个杀人犯。我一点也不惊讶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So Sugar Bombs can be used to make drugs. Why does that not surprise me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糖衣炮弹能制毒？完全不意外呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017db6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So take it from someone who knows. If you want to survive in the wastes, don't lose sight of what's real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以听一个过来人的话。如果你想在废土生存，就别忘了什么是真实的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50f_00003e57_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that explains why Galaxy News sounds like it has cobwebs in its speaker. Audiophiles from here to Virginia will thank us for fixing it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难怪银河新闻台的动静听着像蒙了层蜘蛛网。从这儿到弗吉尼亚的音响发烧友都得谢咱们修好它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370ae_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that one day, when alien come to visit land of free men and nickel soda pop, they no think Captain Cosmos a liar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样有天外星人造访自由人和五分钱汽水的土地时，不会觉得科斯莫斯上尉是骗子
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc01_000008f2_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that one day, when alien come to visit land of free men and nickel soda pop, they no think Captain Cosmos a liar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样有天外星人造访自由人和五分钱汽水的土地时，不会觉得科斯莫斯上尉是骗子
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc01_000008f3_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the diner's back open?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以餐馆重新开张了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the Doc's dead huh. Well, so what? These chem fiends don't need to know that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以老东西嗝屁了？那又怎样？那群嗑药的傻子用不着知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the four-eyed fucker came through after all. Heh, that's too bad. I was looking forward to adding new furniture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以那个四眼混蛋到底还是成功了。呵呵，真可惜。我本来还期待着添置一些新家具。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightball1_0000bed3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the government figured they needed to build a robot to fight them. Your tax dollars at work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以政府就琢磨着造个机器人对付它们——纳税人的钱没白花啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_0000679e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the question you have to ask yourself is, do I look stupid to you? If so, you have my permission to shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你必须问自己的问题是，我看起来蠢吗？如果是，你被允许开枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2c_000026fe_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the Underworld doctors are working on a cure for ghouls? I don't know how to feel about that. Immortality has its benefits, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地下城的医生在研制治尸鬼的药？这感觉挺复杂。毕竟永生也有好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000255ec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So there's no financial gain to this quest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么这个任务没有经济上的回报吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So there's other androids out there. But it doesn't sound like they have the same freedoms people do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来还有别的机器人，但他们可没活人自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001848f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So these cats wearing leaves and branches, is that supposed to be camouflage? Smart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这帮人顶树叶当伪装？鸡贼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007362_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So they think it was muties. Spoiler alert, it wasn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以他们以为是变种人。剧透一下，不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00005a3e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this Caleb wants a picture of Lincoln so he can finish his sculpture. If I was more of a narcissist, I'd say snap one of me instead. But I don't think he'd get my legs right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个迦勒要林肯照片完成雕塑？我要再自恋点，就让他拍我的。不过估计他雕不好我的腿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9f5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is how the other side lives. Why don't I have floors like this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这就是另一边人的生活。为什么我没有这样的地板？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00002c9e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is it, huh? Are you nervous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 到站了？紧张不？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0001b9fa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is Talon Company headquarters. What are they selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是鹰爪公司的总部。他们在卖什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_0000aa4d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is Tenpenny Tower. Can't say I care much for the lifestyle, but a man has a right to choose his own coffin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是特佩尼大厦。虽说我不太喜欢这里的生活方式，但一个人有权选择自己的棺材。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000caa4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is the Citadel. I didn't expect it to be so...raw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是大本营？没想到这么...糙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9ec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is the GNR building. I feel weird getting to meet Three Dog. It's like meeting Elvis or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是银河新闻台大楼？马上要见三狗了，感觉怪怪的，像要见猫王似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9dc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is the Republic of Dave. Well, I'll tell you right now, the kingdom of Audrey doesn't think much of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是戴夫共和国？奥黛丽王国表示看不上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000355d5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is Underworld. The underwear of the earth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是冥界啊。地球的内裤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00003ef7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is where all the ghouls be hiding. Best not tell any Brotherhood folks though. Not unless they pay you first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼老巢啊…别告诉兄弟会…除非先给钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000349f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is where they broadcast GNR radio. I like it. Upstairs you got the sound, and downstairs you got the fury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原来银河新闻台在这儿播音。楼上放音乐，楼下动刀枪，妙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008ddd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this Leaf Mother wants to spread her trees across the Wasteland. Hm...I don't know if I like the idea of giving raiders more cover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叶母想把她的树种遍废土？呵...给掠夺者多添掩护？这主意我可不买账。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9fc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this slaver Leroy...I understand he's not in it for the money. That's even worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个叫勒罗伊的奴隶贩子...听说不为钱？这更他妈糟心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this Zimmer guy's saying android piss and shit like the rest of us? Fuck, that's human enough for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 季默说机器人也拉屎撒尿？操，那跟活人有屁区别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dd2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So unless you got it in a pill or a bottle, you best keep that shit away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以除非你把它装在药丸或瓶子里，否则你最好把那玩意儿拿开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02b_00002c47_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So unless you're one of them top hat wearing motherfuckers who likes sniffing her own farts, you're much better off paying me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，除非你是那些戴着高礼帽、喜欢闻自己屁的混蛋，否则你付我钱会划算得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Raider [110059B5] (mod) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll2_000059d7_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So unless you're one of them top hat wearing motherfuckers who likes sniffing his own farts, you're much better off paying me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，除非你是那些戴着高礼帽、喜欢闻自己屁的混蛋，否则你付我钱会划算得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Raider [110059B5] (mod) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll2_000059d9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So was she, and you had no problem killing her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她也一样，你杀她却毫无问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we don't need actual scraps to save Beep-Beep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我们不需要真正的碎料来救哔哔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we going to war then? Damn, shit's about to get real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以咱们要开战了？妈的，这下动真格的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_00007338_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we got all them Union folks collared. Now slaves will think twice before trying to escape. They'll still try it, but at least they'll be thinking about it first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给团结圣殿全戴上镣铐了。奴隶逃跑前会三思…虽然照跑不误，但起码会先惦记着锁链。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007356_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we take a bite instead. Just a chunk of rock off the tip. Pow pow instead of boom boom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我们咬下一块来代替。只从尖端弄下一小块岩石。biu biu代替轰隆隆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00004cb5_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we're delivering letters now. I suppose if we're going to travel the wastes anyway, we might as well as be carrier pigeons too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以咱们现在送起信来了。既然横竖要在废土跑路，顺便当信鸽倒也成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370c8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we're riding with the slavers. All right, I can dig it. Just so long as you put the collar on Hannibal and not yours truly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟奴贩合作？行！只要项圈套汉尼拔脖子上…别套老子就成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007355_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we're rolling with Hannibal now. Power to the people and all that. That's fine with me. I'm a people person, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟着汉尼拔混了？"人民力量"啥的…成啊！老子最会搞人际关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007352_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what are my choices now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你的选择是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what do you want to do now?

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, to ensure their inheritance was divided evenly, he locked his money away in a safe, and gave each of them a piece of the combination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，为了确保他们的遗产分配得均匀，他把钱锁在一个保险箱里，并给了他们每人一个密码的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey03_00004bce_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, where to next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一站奔哪儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000eb1d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you were welcomed to Oasis as a guest and you torched their entire house. The Hindu cows will be especially angry for this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以啊，人家奥阿西斯当贵客迎你进门，你反手把人房子烧个精光。印度神牛都得为这事气疯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9fd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're Audrey's friend, huh? My condolences.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，奥德丽的朋友？节哀顺变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000fba9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're still alive. That's the second one today. Boss must be in a good mood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还活着啊？今儿第二个了。老大心情靓着呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_000087b5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: So...can you do it? Can you fix Beep-Beep?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能修好哔哔吗？ ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: So...I can't get high off it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以……我不能用它来嗨？

ESP.TRADUIT: 婴儿苏打水

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of that money goes to wars you're fighting, some of it goes to wars you might fight in the future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其中一部分钱用于你正在打的战争，一部分用于你未来可能打的战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01d_00002337_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the people here look more like raiders than mercs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有些人看起来更像掠夺者，而不是佣兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the raider gangs believe this house is haunted. I admit, you make for a frightening ghost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几伙人认定这屋子闹鬼——说真的，你这鬼当得够瘆人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b135_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of these estates might've survived the bombing. But not the looting that came after.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些庄园可能在轰炸中幸存下来。但后来的洗劫却让它们难逃一劫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fbb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of these questions make me think our vault is doomed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些题看得我脊背发凉…咱避难所药丸啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000022f0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some people get paid in favors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人靠人情报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some people really are what they eat. They're as plain as Mac and Cheese. Don't be one of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人吃什么像什么，乏味如通心粉。您可别学。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005969_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some people say he's gathering people for a rebellion. Free men, mercs, and anyone who believes in his cause.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人说他正在集结人手搞叛乱。自由的人、雇佣兵，以及任何相信他事业的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank04_0000ab01_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some people want the world to be fair. Well, fair doesn't exist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人想要世界公平，但公平不存在
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_greeting_00002c31_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some say the slowest way to die is to live. But only when you're not having fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说苟活是最慢的死法——但仅限于你玩得不尽兴时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_000355cb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some would think our illiteracy a shame, but the Brotherhood believes it is a language only the worthy are allowed to speak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人嫌咱文盲丢人？兄弟会偏说这是天选之人才配讲的黑话！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002745_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someday you'll move on, and I'll go back to digging graves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总有一天你会离开，而我又要回去挖坟了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpc00cduplic_0000815e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somehow I find that hard to imagine. It's like looking at a picture. It's all so still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知为何我很难想象。就像在看一幅画。一切都如此静止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90d_0000730c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone gave Madison a gun, and she almost shot Sally during rehearsal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人给麦迪枪，排练时她差点崩了莎莉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003ca4_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone had to pay though for crossing me. It was either him or you. Good thing you weren't around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，有人必须为惹了我而付出代价。要么是他，要么是你。幸好你不在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000bed0_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone just died. Don't be so callous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人刚去世。别这么冷酷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something I can do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能为你做啥？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something went real kablooey here. I bet someone left the stove on. Classic!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿发生了大爆炸。我猜是有人忘了关炉子。太经典了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometime this planet look like home. Very suspicious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时这星球像家，很可疑
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_greeting_000008e2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I forget how dangerous radiation is for humans. In fact, given the state of things, I'm surprised ghouls aren't the most dominant species on this miserable planet. We're clearly the more adapted one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时忘了辐射对人类多致命。说真的，就这世道，尸鬼居然没成地球主宰才稀奇。明明咱们更适应环境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba16_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I hear whispers. Not sure if it's the dead or the dying. Best not to listen to either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时听见低语，不知是死人将死之人，最好都别听
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_0000583c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I look at the calendar and think, "Today would've been her birthday."
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时我看着日历，心想，“今天本该是她的生日。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01d1_00003c91_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I spit when I talk, and the wind will blow it right back in my eye! Now I wear goggles. So in your face, wind! But not in mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时我讲话会吐口水，风会把它吹回我的眼睛！现在我戴上了护目镜。所以风，你尽管来吧！但别进我眼睛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00003444_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I wonder if men and women suit each other. Or people, for that matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时怀疑男女是否相配…或者说人类是否相配。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000595d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I'm the kind that lights the bad guys up. Other times I'm the glue that keeps it all together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时我是那种能把坏人烧光的炸弹。有时我是把一切粘合在一起的胶水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar01_00001bff_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes we're too slow. Other times we're running the wrong race.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时我们太慢了。有时我们跑错了方向。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2a_000030b0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, it feels like those beliefs make sense. But no amount of luck is going to stop a bullet to the head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候，感觉那些信念很有道理。但再多的运气也挡不住射向头部的子弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50f_00003e57_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry about that. In the comics they always get up the moment you turn your back. So I wanted to make sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉啊...漫画里反派总在转身时爬起来。我得确认下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cd9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry about that. It's just when I see some bug that needs a killing, I don't feel right until I've turned it into barbecue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉。只是当我看到需要被杀死的虫子时，不把它变成烤肉，我就会感觉不舒服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar00b_000026ba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry Casey, I don't see anything. And you still haven't explained the blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉凯西，我没发现异常，而且你还没解释血迹
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00000818_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry Doc, but the way I see it, if we got the recipe for quantum, then we don't need you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，医生，但在我看来，如果我们有了量子的配方，那我们就不需要你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcbutchdocsc_0000b090_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry kid, I'm afraid not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，孩子，恐怕不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry kid. But better to lose out on a few caps than lose a piece of yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，孩子。但宁可损失一些瓶盖，也比失去一部分自我好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect1_0000a3e3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry to hear it. I had a friend from high school who got hooked on China White.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾听到这个。我有个高中朋友就是被中国白害了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼大厦大厅

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank god no one got hurt.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003cc7_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you so much for your help. We're both idealists, so sometimes it's hard for me to see the worst in people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太感谢你的帮助了，我们都是理想主义者，有时我真不愿把人性想得太坏。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc190e_0000b0b2_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplay04a_00002f03_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marie [11005F1B] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef2\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00bduplic_00007392_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，亲爱的。

ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。事实上，像你这样的人我们这儿不常见。大多数雇佣兵都是拿了钱就走人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00b_0000569b_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。我想我拿走它的那个人用不着了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. Give me a shout if you need anything else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。如果还需要什么，给我打个招呼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I appreciate it.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I appreciate the help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。我很感谢你的帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I do feel like a bit of a stranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。我确实感觉自己有点像个陌生人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I don't know if I can make it out there on my own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。我不知道我是否能独自在外面生存。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90f_00007295_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 谢了，有人偷袭我会掩护你

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. We'll take a look and see if we can't bring her her things.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. When will the diner open up again?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. You should go back to sleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢了，你该回去睡觉

ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。你无法想象她有多烦人。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq1_0000a2e4_1.ogg
