ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why Doctor Cheng and I have taken such painstaking measures to ensure the rehabilitation is thorough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么程博士和我采取了如此艰苦的措施，以确保改造是彻底的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob01d_0000725d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why I never really listen to the last episode of anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么我从不听任何东西的最后一集。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00a_0000343c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why I never use Med-X. I don't want anything to numb the experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我从不用镇痛剂的原因。我不想任何东西麻痹我的感觉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BE] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect02\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect7_0000a3f1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why I never went to juvie with Kate. McKinley never told the cops. He dragged me into his office and locked the fucking door.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么我没有和凯特一起去少年犯管教所。麦金利没有报警。他把我拽进他的办公室，锁上了那扇该死的门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_0000640c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why in addition to these supplies, I want you to deliver this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么除了这些补给，我还希望你送这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01a_00003c86_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why in addition to these supplies, I want you to deliver this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么除了这些补给，我还希望你送这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01b_0000359d_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why they need to see me die, and why it needs to be at the hands of my slaver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以他们必须目睹我死去，且必须死于奴隶贩子之手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_greeting_0001428d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The "goat?" You mean like an animal with hooves and horns? Take it where?
ESP.TRADUIT: “山羊”？你是说那种有蹄子和角的动物吗？带它去哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30320d_00005cd4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The aim is to teach the little juniper that these are challenges to be overcome or cured.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目的是教导这个小丫头，这些是需要克服或治愈的挑战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot2_00007af0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The air's different here. Smells cleaner. Like it's way too easy to breathe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的空气不一样。闻起来更清新。好像呼吸起来太容易了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000a2b3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Anchorage War Memorial. Someday kid, we'll get statues of our own! Just gotta save the world a few times first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站在安克雷奇战争纪念碑前，我就觉得咱们以后也能有自己的雕像，不过得先拯救几次世界才行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The androids are all still capable of self-defense. What we are trying to remove is the aggression.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些仿生人仍然有自卫能力。我们试图移除的是它们的攻击性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob01a_0000725b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The authority of the United States government, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是美利坚合众国政府的权威。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs04_00001b19_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The best part about clearing out a raider camp? You got all the pork 'n beans you can eat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 端掠夺者老窝最爽啥？豌豆烧猪肉管够！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000065ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bigger they are, the fatter the portions!
ESP.TRADUIT: 个头越大，份量越足！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmortarquest_attack_00008ddb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The block of concrete we were going to give to Haskins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那块我们本打算给哈斯金斯的混凝土。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The blood is irrelevant. He overdosed on chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 血迹无关紧要。他吸毒过量了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bones and the statues, on the other hand, wouldn't scare me if they came out of lagoon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于骨头和雕像，就算从臭水沟里爬出来也吓不到我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The book you gave me doesn't have any pictures. How come?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给的书没插图诶？为啥呀？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c67_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brass Lantern
ESP.TRADUIT: 黄铜灯

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brotherhood of Steel might help with your research.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钢铁兄弟会可能对你的研究有所帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brotherhood sure gots a hard-on for books. So while normally going to a library means you're smart, in the case of these raiders, it probably wasn't their brightest idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会对书真有瘾。正常人进图书馆算聪明，掠夺者进这儿纯属犯蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008de3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brotherhood? This is a bit troubling, to be honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会？老实说，这有点麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0c3_0000b082_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The cake looks pretty good. I wish mom would let me bake instead of building stupid robots. It looks a lot easier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蛋糕看着不错…真希望妈妈让我学烘焙而不是造破机器人…简单多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066D8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000066dc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The caravan queen will trade you everything she's got. For a price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商队女王会用她所有的东西跟你交易。但得付价钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([1100E586]x3dnpcBoopFollowQuest) BoopFollowQuest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcboop_followerstrade_00012821_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The cars and the freeway make this fort hard to sack. But it's also halfway between shitsville and nowhere. Only a brain-dead bloatfly would want it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汽车和高速公路让这堡垒难以攻破。但它也处于鬼镇和荒郊野外之间。只有脑子坏掉的辐射蝇才会想要它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_idlechatter_000051cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The catch is you may get into a skirmish or two.
ESP.TRADUIT: 附带条件是，你可能会卷入一两次小冲突。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The child is under the impression you're sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子以为你生病了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The chill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 寒意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Clara Bella
ESP.TRADUIT: 克拉拉·贝拉号

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Clara Bella Hotel
ESP.TRADUIT: 克拉拉贝拉酒店

ESP.ORIGINAL: The collar is like a gun. Out in the wastes, everyone has one. But not everyone can pull the trigger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 项圈就像一把枪。在废土上，每个人都有一个。但不是每个人都能扣动扳机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03g_00001c2a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The comedians in this city always make me laugh. One of these days I'm going to listen to their jokes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这城喜剧演员总逗我发笑，改天定要听完他们的段子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005968_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The cops file a report, ambulance takes the body, you go home with me owing you a favor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警察备案，救护车带走尸体，你回家，我欠你一个人情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc02duplicat_00001f3b_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Corvega Atomic V8?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可维佳原子V8？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Corvega is more than a car honey. It's a rocket.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，科尔维加不仅仅是一辆车。它是一枚火箭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c93_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The day we met I hit on your wife, killed your brahmin, and got you so drunk you nearly shot your little girl while she was still in your balls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱俩认识那天我调戏你老婆，宰了你婆罗门，灌你喝到差点把还在你蛋里的小女儿崩了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DAB] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000dca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL:
The dead man is wearing a jumpsuit from another vault. His throat has been cut. A note on his person reads:
"When a man is born with a collar around his neck, it becomes indistinguishable from his own skin. He must not fear tearing it."
ESP.TRADUIT:
死者穿着另一个避难所的连体衣。他的喉咙被割断了。他身上的一张纸条上写着:
“当一个人出生时，脖子上围着一个项圈，这与他自己的皮肤无法区分。他一定不要害怕撕破它。”

ESP.ORIGINAL:
The dead woman is wearing a Vault 101 jumpsuit. It's not anyone you know. The jumpsuit, loose at the shoulders, would better fit a man.
You notice blood on her collarbone. You open up the jumpsuit and find words written in blood.
It reads, "A collar takes many forms."
ESP.TRADUIT:
死去的女人穿着101号避难所的连身衣。不是你认识的人。这种连身裤肩部宽松，更适合男士。
你注意到她锁骨上有血。你打开连体衣，发现血里写的字。
上面写着"衣领有多种形式"

ESP.ORIGINAL: The dedications are great, aren't they? Best part of the show if you ask me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 献词很棒，不是吗？如果你问我，那是节目中最好的部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00b_00003376_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The diner's not really a business. It's just something to keep busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 餐馆不是真正的生意。它只是用来保持忙碌的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot02_0000536b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Doc and I finished our chat. He wanted you to know the product's ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和医生聊完了。他想让你知道产品已经准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Doc calls it the theory of everything. But three weeks in, and we got nothing to show for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 博士称之为万物理论。但三周过去了，我们一无所获。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e56_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Doc's little plan gave me an idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生的小计划给了我一个主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000beb0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The doctor calls it radiation poisoning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生称之为辐射中毒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child of Atom [11008210] (mod) Quest : ([11008212]x3DNPCmegatonchurch) Megaton Church EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleatom01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpcchurch04b_0000822a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Elders especially. Round table, square men, you know how it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤其是长老们。圆桌，方正的人，你懂的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_00002714_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Elders won't like this. Our tasks numbered two. We were supposed to make the discovery and keep it a secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长老们不会喜欢这样。我们的任务有两项。我们本应该做出发现并将其保密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjoneshammo_0000b0e8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Enclave likes to send their bots through these old Pre-War towns. Not sure why - it's not like anyone's home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷老派机器人穿战前小镇。搞不懂——又没人住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079a2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Enclave Soldier is dead. Near the corpse you find a piece of chalk, and a trail leading down the tile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷士兵死了。在尸体附近，你会发现一块粉笔，还有一条沿着瓷砖向下延伸的小路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Enclave? Shit. Well, if we're lucky, maybe the Enclave and the Outcasts will be too busy shooting each other to see us coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷？妈的，运气好的话英克雷和放逐者会忙着互掐顾不上我们
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a2_00000c5a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcpatientze_0000357b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The factory floor has been cleared out to make room for the project, although I do wonder if anyone has ever though about how it's supposed to get out. On the other hand, it's hard to imagine if any thought went into this project at all, as the whole thing seems to be based on fears born out of a late night monster movie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了给这个项目腾出空间，工厂的车间已经被清空了，尽管我很想知道是否有人曾经想过它应该如何出去。另一方面，很难想象这个项目是否有任何想法，因为整个事情似乎是基于深夜怪物电影产生的恐惧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The factory's near the Anchorage War Memorial, but entry requires a password.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工厂在安克雷奇战争纪念碑附近，但进去要密码

ESP.ORIGINAL: The feeling's mutual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同感。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The first dog went to market, the second stayed at home, but the third turned on the radio, and a superstar was born! Number Three Dog!
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一只狗去了市场，第二只留在了家里，但第三只打开了收音机，一位超级巨星就此诞生！三狗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00003062_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fourth amendment, search and seizure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第四修正案，搜查和扣押。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Free and Pure
ESP.TRADUIT: 自由与纯净

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fuck is Lucy doing in Megaton if her family's all the way in Arefu? Girl needs to get her priorities straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 露西全家在阿雷夫…她蹲兆吨镇搞毛？这妞脑子拎不清。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034cd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Garden of Eden...well, at least the name sounds promising. But how does your dad know it'll help with Project Purity?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊甸园...名字倒挺唬人。可你爸咋知道它能帮上净水计划？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018463_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL:
The General has asked that I make the password for the factory terminal something patriotic, as if that would be an adequate deterrent when the Chinese speak better English than we do.
But orders are orders. The clues for the password can be found at locations that represent the first four amendments to the Constitution. Hopefully that will be difficult enough to keep the Chinese out, but simple enough to let our people in, should the need arise.
ESP.TRADUIT:
将军要求我把工厂终端的密码写得爱国一点，好像中国人英语说得比我们好，这样就能起到足够的威慑作用。
但命令就是命令。密码的线索可以在代表宪法前四条修正案的地方找到。希望把中国人拒之门外的难度足够大，但如果需要的话，让我们的人进来又足够简单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ghouls are gone, but so are half my men. Some of the gang are so pissed they want to sell the Doc to slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼不见了，但我的手下也少了一半。帮派里的一些人非常生气，想把博士卖给奴隶贩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e5b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ghouls could have come from the Dunwich building to the south. I've heard that place is infested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼可能来自南边的邓维奇大楼，听说那儿闹鬼
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005367_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ghouls keep this place clean. Compare it to Megaton, or Mason Dixon, and you wonder who's the real zombie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼们把这里打扫得很干净。跟兆吨镇或者梅森-狄克逊比起来，你都会怀疑谁才是真正的僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000de9a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Glenn Miller Orchestra - Moonlight Serenade
ESP.TRADUIT: 格伦·米勒乐团 - 《月光小夜曲》
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pre-War Radio Broadcast [110034D9] (mod) Quest : ([110034DA]x3DNPCRadio3DNPCQuest) Atomic Radio EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcradio3dnpcvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpcradio3dnp_000034e6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guy had one too many chems. It's an open and shut case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那家伙吸毒过量了。这是个一目了然的案子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00a_00002cc9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Hall of Abraham Lincoln. It's nice to see some history that's actually before my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 林肯纪念堂啊...难得见到比我出生还早的历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000e46c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The harvest is gonna be smaller than usual. Everyone's saying it's gonna be a rough season.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年收成怕要减产…都说寒冬难熬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5E] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler01\x3dnpcsettlers_hello_00004c13_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The heart and mind are like two parents fighting. It's especially problematic because they live in the same house.
ESP.TRADUIT: 心与脑像对吵架的爹妈——同住一屋才真要命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0002a22d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The hell it ain't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈的说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightbutch_000087e9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The hits from coast to coast! American Top 40!
ESP.TRADUIT: 从东海岸到西海岸的热门金曲！美国四十大金曲排行榜！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Top 40 [11004E95] (mod) Quest : ([11004F36]x3DNPCRadioTop40) x3dnpcRadioTop40quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpcradi_radiohello_00004f3a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The holotape mentions the Capitol Post logo. I'm guessing the rest of the clues are visual too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全息磁带提到了国会邮报的标志。我猜其余的线索也是视觉上的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_00003e48_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The honor is all yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个荣幸是你的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The important thing is no one got hurt, and the children learned a lesson they'll never forget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重要的是没有人受伤，孩子们上了一堂他们永远不会忘记的课。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003cc6_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The important thing is that you're rehabilitated. Whether it was with McKinley or Sean, you chose to resolve your conflicts without violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重要的是你已经康复了。无论是面对麦金利还是肖恩，你都选择了非暴力方式解决冲突。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice2\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000726e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The important thing is you got the clue. My guess is the soldier was trying to relay the information to his brothers, so it should be trustworthy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重点是拿到了线索，估计那士兵想把情报传给兄弟会，应该可信
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfact_x3dnpcfac04a2_00000c5a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The inside of this building is like some alien world. Hard to believe it's ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这栋楼的内部就像外星世界。真难以相信这是我们的世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000ebe9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The instant stuff is like plastic too, good enough to survive a hundred nuclear winters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 速食面跟塑料似的，核冬天熬过百回都不带坏的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000f4ff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Internal what? The fuck you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 内部什么？你说啥呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs00a_00001fb5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The irony of which is kind of funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 讽刺的是，这还有点搞笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The IRS says you owe them money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 美国国税局说你欠他们钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The itsy bitsy spider went up the water spout! Down came grenades to wipe the raiders out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小小蜘蛛上水槽，下起手雷把掠夺者扫！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranasspi_00003328_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Keller family would've made for a great situation comedy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯勒一家要是拍成情景喜剧肯定很棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00003efe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The keys have always been in possession of the androids. There should be one on Mara's body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钥匙一直在仿生人手中。玛拉的尸体上应该有一把。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob90a_0000727b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The knight said it was really important, but not combat related.
ESP.TRADUIT: 骑士说这真的很重要，但与战斗无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Krauts are on the run ma'am! But we can't press the attack without further casualties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 德国佬正在逃跑，夫人！但如果我们不承受更多伤亡，就无法继续进攻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000043b2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last clue points to an address on Bradley Place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后线索指向布拉德利街某地址

ESP.ORIGINAL: The law of relativity is my favorite. Einstein is sexy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相对论定律最对我胃口，爱因斯坦真性感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002733_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Lincoln Memorial would be a fitting place for former slaves to hide. Fitting and obvious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 林肯纪念馆藏逃奴很合适——合适得过于明显。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000369f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The lines are cut off, put this power station is mostly intact. You'd think the raiders would've blown it up by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 线路断了，但发电站基本完好。掠夺者居然没炸掉它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000355d8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The literal message I wrote, not "you got the message" like a threat. You know what I mean. Messages, for learning!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我写的那个字面意思，而不是“你懂的”那种威胁。你懂我意思的。传达信息，是为了学习！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00a_0000342b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The little cowdoodle believes this to be a system malfunction, like the one that hogtied her creators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个小牛仔以为这是系统故障，就像困住她父母的那次一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_robot0a_000029d4_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The little cowdoodle believes this to be a system malfunction, like the one that hogtied her creators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个小牛仔以为这是系统故障，就像困住她父母的那次一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_robot0b_000029d5_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The longer we stay, the more they'll make sense. And that's not a good thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们待得越久，这些低语就越有道理。这可不是什么好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL:
The loot's more than I could've expected. Pre-War, but the bills might be worth something to a collector. Getting it out is another issue. I've tried attaching notes to the Enclave Robots passing through in hopes they might find my son.
Hopefully he'll find me soon. The food situation is getting worse by the day. If a raider or someone hostile shows up, I may need to take drastic measures. I know it's not right, but I've done it before, in the name of survival, and a full-sized adult should be enough to last me another month.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赃物比我想象的要多。战前的，但这些钞票对收藏家来说可能有点价值。把它弄出来是另一个问题。我试着给路过的英克雷机器人贴上纸条希望他们能找到我儿子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The machine hands you a ticket. It has the number 01 written on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器递给你一张票。上面写着数字01。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The machine I'm working on would at least give us some direction, and hopefully, a chance to save them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在研究的机器至少能给我们一些方向，希望能有机会拯救他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2_00002315_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The machine not only gives us a head start, it points us in the right direction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这台机器不仅能让我们抢占先机，还能指引我们正确的方向。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2a_000030b0_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mall
ESP.TRADUIT: 国家广场

ESP.ORIGINAL: The man at the diner said your friend moved to Springvale, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 餐馆的那个人说你的朋友搬到了泉谷镇，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreycan_00015f42_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The man was more useful as furniture. So we had him stuffed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个人当家具更有用。所以我们把他填起来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq1a_000087fe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The map on your Pip-Boy says this place is important. I'm beginning to think your Pip-Boy is drunk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哔哔小子地图标这地重要？怕不是喝高了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c6a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The master, he could have killed me right then. But Gabriel was right. He hesitated, and I didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主人当时本可以杀了我。但加布里埃尔是对的。他犹豫了，而我没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpchank02_000096aa_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The McKinley model could have resolved the conflict by notifying the police. Instead, it took matters into an unspeakable direction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦金利模型本可以通过报警来解决冲突。相反，它采取了某种难以启齿的方式。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mills Brothers - Chinatown
ESP.TRADUIT: 米尔斯兄弟合唱团 - 《中国城》
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pre-War Radio Broadcast [110034D9] (mod) Quest : ([110034DA]x3DNPCRadio3DNPCQuest) Atomic Radio EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcradio3dnpcvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpcradio3dnp_000034ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The more they pay attention to the crazy old man bit, the less they notice what I'm really up to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们越关注我这个疯狂老头的戏码，就越少注意到我真正在忙什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic1_0000ee25_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Muddy Rudder Bar
ESP.TRADUIT: “泥舵”酒吧

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mutants chose this location wisely. Refugees come to Rivet City for aid, and get eaten alive instead. But I wouldn't confuse it with intelligence. Even the basest animals know where to find their prey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 变种人据点选得妙。难民来铆钉城求援，反被活啃。但这不算聪明——最低等的畜生也知道去哪捕食。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba0b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The name's Mortar, by the way. Pleased to meetcha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说一下，我叫迫击炮。很高兴见到你。

ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说一下，我叫迫击炮。很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar00c_000026bb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The name's Mortar, by the way. Pleased to meetcha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说一下，我叫迫击炮。很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar00d_000026bc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The natives won't be happy you killed their magic tree. Assisted suicide is hard enough to explain to normal people, let alone people who wear branch
ESP.TRADUIT: 你砍了他们的神树，土著可不会高兴。帮人自杀跟正常人解释都费劲，更别说这帮戴树枝的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003c0d0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ninth Circle
ESP.TRADUIT: 第九层

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ocean can wipe my ass, and that's about as far as I'm letting it touch me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大海可以给我擦屁股，这是我能让它碰我的极限了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx04_00003dad_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The old Jefferson Memorial. Never figured this would be a place to put a lab. Then again, what the hell do I know about science?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁能想到老杰斐逊纪念堂居然被改成了实验室？不过我也不太懂科学那一套。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008de8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The old me might've screamed at the sight of robots and ghouls. Now I'm one of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前的我看到机器人和食尸鬼可能会尖叫。现在我成了他们中的一员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008080_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The old me would've screamed at the sight of a ghoul. Now I try not to judge things by their cover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搁以前看见尸鬼早叫唤了。现在嘛，尽量不以貌取人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017daa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The one exception is Molerat. He's new, and to be honest, I don't trust him enough to give him a gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的例外是鼹鼠鼠。他是新来的，而且说实话，我不够信任他给他一把枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Randy [11005F20] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01duplica_00006cb9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only chain of command is the one we use to choke the dogs into submission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的指挥链是我们用来勒住狗让它们屈服的链子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a2_00003dc6_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only problem is, its brain is no longer programmed to run diagnostics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麻烦的是它诊断程序彻底崩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_0000265e_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only problem was the "home" part. Like, it didn't tell you what kind of home you had to use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的问题是“自制”这部分。比如，它没告诉你必须用什么样的家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02f_00002afa_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only question is, are you man enough to handle it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的问题是，你够男人来驾驭它吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c89_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only way in is the cellar door, through the Jury Street metro. And to enter that, you need a key. The laowai who comes to the market has one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地窖门是唯一入口，得走陪审街地铁站。想进站？得找钥匙——集市上那个老外兜里有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000f501_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only way to stop people from dying is to leave well enough alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阻止人们死亡的唯一方法就是不要去管闲事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053b8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The original settlers were strictly ghouls, but over time we accepted a few humans into the fold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最初的定居者全是尸鬼，但随着时间的推移，我们接纳了一些人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3_0000231f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The other day a man told me about the science behind gender superiority.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前几日有男人大谈性别优越性科学依据——
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005957_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The other day Margaery sent me money for my birthday.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前几天玛格丽给我寄了生日钱
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DA7] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrivetcity_hello_00000db0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The other kids are smart. They can make the rocket. Roachard and me will ride it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他孩子可聪明了，会造火箭。我和罗查德要坐着飞上天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The other piece of advice would be to go to the type of buildings that would survive the nukes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一个建议是去那些能在大爆炸中幸存下来的建筑类型。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00c_00002a46_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The other side of the Atlantic. Not exactly hell, but from what I’ve heard, it’s pretty damn close.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大西洋的另一边。不完全是地狱，但据我所知，也差不了多少。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007484] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern02\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern01c_0000748c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The other side? What, you mean hell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大洋彼岸？你是说地狱吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern01b_0000748e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The others have been slow to warm up to him, but I have a feeling they'll come around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人对他亲近得慢，但我感觉他们会接受的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03_00006ce1_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The others, well, they tend to look really good in jackets. The strait kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一些人，嗯，他们穿夹克衫的样子很好看。就是那种紧身夹克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4b1_0000272b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The password you entered was incorrect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您输入的密码不正确。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The patient's dying doctor, we're going to need apply more band-aids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 病人快不行了，医生，我们需要敷更多创可贴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconvb_0000355d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Phantom doesn't have time for parents! She's too busy being the world's greatest cat burglar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 幻影没有时间理会父母！她正忙着做世界上最伟大的猫贼呢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_boop1_000030ab_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 重点是他们喜欢机器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The President we deserve. Adolf Hitler.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应得的总统。阿道夫·希特勒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The problem is he took that phrase literally. Now he's saying the room is his property and he refuses to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，他把这句话当真了。现在他说这房间是他的财产，拒绝离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_0000352f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The problem is it seems to hate me for being its center.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，它似乎因为我是中心而恨我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba20_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The problem is we'll first need to fill out form PQ-47B, for temporary hires. Or FA-39C, for temp to permanent hires.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，我们首先需要填写临时雇员的PQ-47B表格。或者是临时转长期雇员的FA-39C表格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b1a_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The problem with some people is when they're not drunk, they're sober.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人问题在于不醉时太清醒
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d2_1.ogg Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d2_1.ogg Faction : Agatha's Faction Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136d2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The programmers refer to this behavior as creative learning and believe it is vital to keeping the child engaged in her studies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 程序员将这种行为称为创造性学习，并认为它对于保持孩子投入学习至关重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot3_000030a5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The pursuit of knowledge is a noble goal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对知识的追求是一个崇高的目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The radio says Grayditch has been silent for a while now. Whatever we find, I doubt it'll be friendly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 电台说灰渠失联很久了。甭管撞见啥，准没好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00018483_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The raiders came into town one night and locked us up in one of the sheds. Didn't really say why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一天晚上掠夺者进了城，把我们关在一个棚子里。没说为什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel19g_00005f03_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The raiders thought we were unarmed, but Randy had a hidden stash none of the others even knew about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者以为我们没有武器，但兰迪有一个隐藏的藏匿点，其他人甚至都不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a2_00007a55_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers are tough, but they're running out of time. And more importantly, they're running out of bullets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵们很顽强，但时间不多了。更重要的是，他们的子弹也快用完了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fb2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The real Susie probably got snatched up by aliens, because the woman I was talking to was actually nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真正的苏西可能被外星人抓走了，因为我刚才说话的那个女人对我居然很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00g_00009645_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The redline here ought to take us downtown. You wanna find Three Dog, this is the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿的红线应该能带我们去市中心。你想找三狗，就走这条路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015681_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Republic of Dave, huh. It's pretty impressive this town's still standing. Maybe Dave knows what he's doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫共和国？这破镇还没垮挺意外。没准戴夫真有两下子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079a0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Republic of Dave? I would've gone with the United States of Daverica, but I like fancy titles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫共和国？要我就叫戴美利坚合众国，不过花哨名头也挺带劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000065b0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rest of the time, I hardly notice her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他时候，我几乎没注意到她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic0_0002708c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rest of you should arm yourself in case this thing isn't nocturnal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们其他人应该武装起来，以防这东西不是夜行动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rest of you should arm yourself in case this thing isn't nocturnal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们其他人应该武装起来，以防这东西不是夜行动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Romans fought for slaves and wealth. America built its empire on the wings of destiny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗马人为了奴隶和财富而战。美利坚在命运之翼上建立帝国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplaymonol_0000320f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rotation they have for the shacks. Instead of sharing the wealth, we each get a turn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 棚屋轮换制。财富不共享，轮流住单间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a_00006c9a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL:
The soldier's root programming seems to be a rather insidious mechanism. Not only have their bodies been engineered to perform specific animations, their chemical systems have been designed to reinforce that behavior.
In other words, when given the choice between resolving conflicts with or without violence, the body will reward them for using force. This makes it extremely challenging on a psychological level to push them toward peaceful solutions.
ESP.TRADUIT:
士兵的根程序似乎是一个相当阴险的机制。它们的身体不仅被设计成能做出特定的动作，它们的化学系统也被设计成能强化这种行为。
换句话说，当在用暴力或不使用暴力解决冲突之间做出选择时，身体会奖励他们使用武力。这使得在心理层面上推动他们走向和平解决方案极具挑战性。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The sooner we get there, the better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们越早到那儿越好。

ESP.ORIGINAL:
The world is nothing if not ironic. The entire project was based on the premise of nuclear war, and now that it's a very real possibility, our funding has been cut so the government can make more bombs.
The funny thing is, I never wanted to work on this project to begin with. But now that it's more or less complete, I've actually grown fond of the thing.
Either way, the General's right. When it's all said and done, there's no telling who or what will come out of the ashes. America, the Chinese, or the cockroaches. I'm heading down to the factory to put up the safety protocols. They'll need to crack the terminal password to get access to the project.
ESP.TRADUIT:
这个世界充满了讽刺。整个项目都是以核战争为前提的，现在这种可能性非常大，我们的资金被削减了，这样政府就可以制造更多的炸弹了。
有趣的是，我从一开始就不想参与这个项目。但现在它差不多完成了，我实际上已经喜欢上它了。
不管怎样，将军是对的。当一切尘埃落定，谁也不知道谁或什么会从灰烬中冒出来。美国，中国人，还是蟑螂。我要去工厂制定安全协议。他们需要破解终端密码才能进入项目。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The world is what you make of it. There are still places where civility rules.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世界由你创造。仍然有文明统治的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their brains out, that is. Anywhere else is just a flesh wound.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说把他们的脑浆吹出来。其他任何地方都只是皮肉伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey05_00005972_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Them fountain ladies are kind of hot. No wonder they stay close to the water.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c73_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Them Talon boys are really putting up a fight. My money's on the muties though. Those motherfuckers don't play.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034a8_1.ogg
