ESP.TRADUIT: 然后我希望我的残肢碎块四处飞溅，卡在那些坏蛋的喉咙里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'll be in Arefu. I need to see a merchant about some supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我回阿雷夫。得找商人弄点补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_followersfired_00008137_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'll go there immediately. Thank you so much, you have no idea how many lives this could save.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我马上就去。非常感谢你，你不知道这能拯救多少生命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3d1_000030cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then in that case, let's reason this out together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然如此，那我们就一起好好推理一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0c1_0000b080_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then it's a promise. In the meantime, you take care, and good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就这么说定了。同时，你多保重，祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0bf_00006146_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then it's my fault. I thought I checked every nook and cranny, but I must've missed a spot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是我的错。我以为我检查了每一个角落，但我肯定漏掉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003cc7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then let's be on our way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就动身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_goodbye_000355cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then let's see what's behind it. Come on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就让我们看看门后面有什么。来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h2_00006440_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then make your choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就做出你的选择吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_00014298_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then one day in the kitchen, I overheard the Overseer talk about the need for "population growth."
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一天我在厨房，无意中听到监督者谈论“人口增长”的需求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01_0000964b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then perhaps you'd consider leaving and taking the mutant upstairs with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么也许你可以考虑离开并带着楼上的变种人一起走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00c_00002e79_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then put me in your pocket, darling. I'll do my best to enjoy the ride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就把我揣兜里，亲爱的。我会好好享受这趟兜风。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followershired_0000596b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then stay. Help us defend this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就留下。帮我们防卫这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel50g_00008119_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then that makes you impartial. Maybe you can figure out who's really to blame.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那这让你变得公正。也许你能找出到底该怪谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30350b_00005d20_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then there's no way I'm going there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我是绝对不会去那里的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then these corpses should be pristine after the lead I fed them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么我喂了这些尸体铅弹之后，它们应该会很干净。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then they were talking to the both of us. Through the radio! But how?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那他们是在和我们俩说话。通过收音机！但这怎么可能？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200d_00006431_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then they won't mind if I stay up here a little longer. I need another minute before I go down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然如此，那他们不会介意我在这里多待一会儿。我下去之前需要再等一分钟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [11005A13] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcarabos01a_00005a28_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then they're dead. It's all my fault. I never should've let them leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那他们都死了。这都是我的错。我真不该让他们离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00bduplic_00007a53_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we have a problem. Because if you have a conscience, the needs of my town come first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们就有问题了。因为如果你有良心，我镇子的需求是第一位的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2d_000030b4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we have no issues. I've seen the damage chems can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们没有问题。我见过化学品能造成多大伤害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we should work to make the world a better place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们应该努力让世界变得更美好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we'll change the menu until they do. Stick to the lemons, Carnegie, that's all I can afford.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们就改菜单直到他们喜欢，坚持用柠檬吧卡内基，我只买得起这个
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdotcarneg_0000094b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then what are we waiting for. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们还等什么？走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then where is it? Where's this vicious, bloodthirsty animal you keep talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那它在哪儿？你一直说的这只凶猛、嗜血的动物在哪儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage30co_000030e8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then why are you still friends?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么还和他做朋友？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then why did you ask her to look for your toolbox, when it's right by the door?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么让她找你的工具箱，明明就在门旁边？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then why tell her to go to the Super Duper Mart when you knew it was dangerous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么明知道危险，还要让她去超级马特超市？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you are Greg Haskins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就是格雷格·哈斯金斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you can be an outcast. Not exactly the most appealing career choice, but it works for some folks. The crazy ones, usually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就可以成为流放者。这算不上最吸引人的职业选择，但对某些人来说很管用。通常是那些疯子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3d1_0000271d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you can start with preventing mine. If this was just about me, then why did it kill Jessica?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你也可以从阻止我的死开始。如果这只是关于我，那为什么它杀了杰西卡？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053b8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you need to get a better feel for your target. Me, I know whose face I hunt. And I'd never confuse him with someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你需要更好地了解你的目标。我，我知道我追捕的是谁的脸。我绝不会把他和别人搞混。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack000c_000187ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you read another terminal that says a scientist on that project is being transferred to Fort Independence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后你读了另一个终端，上面说那个项目的一名科学家正在被转移到独立堡垒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01e_00002338_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you should probably just make the switch and be done with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你最好还是直接转换，一劳永逸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you take your own advice and don't answer the phone. Just sleep through it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你自己听从自己的建议，不要接电话。睡过去就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130r_0000535f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you won't be much help to me. Get better or get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你对我没什么帮助。要么变好，要么滚蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you'd be smart not to piss them off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你最好别惹他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq1c_0000a9b4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you'd fit right in here, which is kind of scary if you think about it. It's best we get rid of them now before they turn you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你在这里会很适应，仔细想想这有点吓人。我们最好现在就把他们除掉，免得他们把你同化了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60c_00001fe3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you'll love our bubble top sedans. Same nuclear engine, but fun for the whole family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你会爱上我们的泡泡顶轿车。同样的核引擎，但能给全家带来乐趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_x3dnpcmisshandy_00035c91_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you're a fool. Because I won't think twice to stick my knife in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就是个傻瓜。因为我会毫不犹豫地把刀子插进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx00a_00002bf0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you're a slave. There's no point even thinking at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就是个奴隶。根本没必要思考。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel03_0000819f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you're lucky we showed up when we did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你们运气不错，我们来得正是时候。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you're one of the lucky ones. The rest of us need more time to sort things out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就是幸运儿之一。我们其他人需要更多时间来理清头绪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel03_0000819c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are cities even built around atomic bombs for heaven's sake!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，有些城市甚至就建在原子弹周围！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4a_0000b09c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are even people who live in vaults, for heaven's sake. They lock themselves in their tiny little cells like inmates...or fish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，甚至还有人住在避难所里。他们把自己锁在小小的牢房里，像囚犯……或鱼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_00004bc1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are many good things in life. But peeing, is definitely the best!
ESP.TRADUIT: 生活有很多好事，但撒尿绝对最棒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136cc_1.ogg Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136cc_1.ogg Faction : Agatha's Faction Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136cc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are over six million ways to die and yet we invariably choose from a collection numbering no more than twenty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死法超六百万种，可咱偏挑最常见的二十种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002744_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There hasn't been any police in this town since the Pre-War days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自战前以来，这个镇上就没有警察了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There hasn't until now. Mara is our first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在此之前没有过。玛拉是我们的第一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob01_00007260_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is no maybe. We're either good, and you walk on by, or we got problems, and I run you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有也许。要么你识相离开，要么我们出问题，我赶你走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack00b_0000155c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is no such disease. You're just an addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有这种病。你只是个瘾君子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is. It's a horror serial called "It Came from the Vault."
ESP.TRADUIT: 有。这是一部名为《它来自避难所》的恐怖系列剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02d_00002afd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There once was a man from Tenpenny, who dressed like my ex Benny. He spent like a glutton so I pressed the button and now he has no dimes to lend me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从前有个特佩尼的家伙，穿着打扮跟我前男友本尼一模一样。他花钱大手大脚，所以我按下了按钮，现在他连给我借钱的零钱都没有了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00006e64_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There seems to be a misunderstanding regarding the goods you purchased.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您对购买的商品似乎存在误会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a dead body in your old place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前的地方有一具尸体。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a locker back there with weapons and armor, I just found the one that fit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后面的储物柜里有武器和盔甲，我只是找到了合身的那一套。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90c_000072fc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was talk about a Super-Duper Mart opening up in our town. Never happened though. The mom and pop stores wouldn't let it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前听说镇上要开超级超市。没开成。街坊小店不让。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017db1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There’s a mutant inside the brothel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 妓院里有超级变种人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a body there. Carnegie's trying to set you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里有一具尸体。卡内基想陷害你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a key? Why is the trash bin locked?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有钥匙？为什么垃圾桶上锁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a legend that Wilhelm's Wharf is haunted by an old ghost-slash-prostitute. Calls herself Sparkle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传说威廉码头闹鬼…自称"闪耀"的妓女鬼魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c63_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a lot going on in this tunnel. You got rats nibbling at your feet and raiders chomping at the bit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这条隧道可真够呛，脚下有老鼠乱啃，旁边还有掠夺者盯着你，随时准备动手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a lot of interesting things here, I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿肯定有不少好东西，我敢打赌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_0000679c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a lot on the line. We can't let them get that Purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有太多事情悬而未决。我们不能让他们得到那个净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a rather large chasm between love and hate, and yet both call stupidity their neighbor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱与恨隔天堑，却共享愚蠢为邻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000595c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a reason why man's best friend is a mindless, stupid mutt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类挚友是蠢狗不是没道理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's also a manual in there that'll teach 'em the basics. But in the end it's not exactly rocket science.
ESP.TRADUIT: 里面还有本手册会教他们基础知识。但说到底，这玩意儿也不是什么高科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01c1_000035a9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's also Selma Watterson. Word is she gambled her way out of the poorhouse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一个叫塞尔玛·沃特森的人。据说她通过赌博摆脱了贫困。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b20_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's also the moral implications to consider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，还要考虑道德问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4c_0000beac_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's always strings. You just can't see them pulling on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总是会有附加条件的。你只是看不到它们在拉扯你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c31_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's comfort in that. Like, knowing it wasn't my fault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这让人感到安慰。比如，知道那不是我的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb36_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's dark forces at play here. You can hear the whispers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有黑暗势力在作祟。你能听到低语声。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000b6a8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's more to it than that. We all sat next to each other and didn't talk for like a year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不止这些。我们都坐在彼此旁边，有一年都没说过话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_00005cc5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's more where that came from!
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有更多这样的等着他们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmortarquest_attack_00007996_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no climbing the ladder. We're all stuck in this vault either way. Might as well take the path of least resistance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有晋升的阶梯。反正我们都困在这个避难所里。不如选择阻力最小的那条路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066E2] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00a_0000818d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no end to them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们没完没了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_hit_0000614b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no harm in just admitting it. It'll be good for you to get it off your chest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 承认了也没什么坏处。说出来对你有好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no need to mourn a bunch of nameless fools.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没必要为一个无名的傻瓜们哀悼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no shame in paying for it. I do it all the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为这事付钱没什么可耻的。我一直都这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no such thing as a fair trade. So why bother? Take what you will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世上没有公平的交易。那干嘛还要操心？想要什么就拿什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_00004bec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no way. I even opened it up and cut all the wires, just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不可能，我甚至拆开剪了所有电线以防万一
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon02_00000973_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's not much difference between a cross and a gun. Both are weapons. Both have preachers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 十字架和枪没区别，都是武器，都有传教士
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00005832_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing good about chems, I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕化学品没有什么好东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0d3_0000b07e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing interesting about any of this. Least of all, your opinion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都没什么意思。最没意思的就是你的意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcturnintes_000022ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing more important than family. Glad you're helping Lucy out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一家人在一起最重要。你能帮露西，我真的挺高兴的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079bd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing more stimulating than a disagreement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世上最提神醒脑的，莫过于意见相左。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005955_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing that can fix him. But here's the good news. You get to keep him just the way he is now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没东西能修好他。但有个好消息。你可以让他一直保持现在的样子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop02_0000264d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing to like about these wastes. We agree on that much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个废土没什么可喜欢的。这一点我们是达成共识的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing to tell. You were stealing hundreds of dollars a week. Not even McKinley was stupid enough to ignore that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么好说的。你一周偷几百美元。就算麦金利再蠢，也不会无视。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005d00_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nowhere else for someone like me. It was safe, quiet, and far away from home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我这样的人来说，没有别的地方了。这里安全、安静，离家很远。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053af_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's one last bit of business we need to take care of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还有最后一件事需要处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's only two people I give my caps to. My landlord, and my dealer. Last time I checked, Izzy ain't either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只把瓶盖给两个人。我的房东，和我的经销商。我上次检查的时候，伊兹哪个都不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Selma [11001640] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcselma01_00001b66_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's probably towns like this all over the wastes that crop up and disappear in a day. No point even marking them on the map.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土上这种朝生暮死的小镇多了去了，地图上都懒得标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00010c84_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's sale posters all over the walls. From the looks of it, they were trying to get rid of their entire stock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 满墙贴着清仓海报。看架势是想把存货全甩卖了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9e0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's something strange about this virus. It's causing her cells to mutate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个病毒有点奇怪。它正在导致她的细胞变异。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcpatientze_00003574_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's too many guards and not enough chefs in this town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这镇子警卫比厨子还多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maury [11015DE9] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmauryvoice\x3dnpcmq01b_greeting_00015dff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These ants would be really good for campfires. Just need to train them not to burn your house down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这蚁生篝火绝了！驯服别烧房子就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000734c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These assholes probably thought it was funny to put a name like "Greener Pastures" on a dump site. Wasn't funny then. Isn't funny now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些混蛋大概觉得给垃圾场起个“绿草废料处理站”这样的名字很有趣。当时不好笑，现在也不好笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fb5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These Brotherhood of Steel folks must really like Pre-War music. You'd think GNR was a new-fangled laser or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钢铁兄弟会对战前音乐真痴迷…把银河新闻台当新式激光枪似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c6d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These children are some tough sons of bitches. I wouldn't mess with 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这帮小兔崽子够野，我可不敢惹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008710_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These dumbfuck soldiers locked themselves in this basement rather than leave their post. And they say raiders are crazy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些蠢货士兵宁愿把自己锁在这地下室里也不愿离开岗位。还说掠夺者疯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: These ghouls didn't even give themselves a chance to live. Hmph, maybe they wanted it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些尸鬼甚至都不给自己留活路。哼，也许他们就是想这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fb7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These old markets are a good place to find supplies. Problem is, the raiders feel the same way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些老市场是获取补给的好去处。问题是，掠夺者也有同样的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0001566d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These raiders had a nice setup. Sturdy walls, soft beds, and all the mirelurks you can eat. Too bad they had to fuck it up by being raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者据点挺舒坦：墙厚床软泥沼蟹管饱。偏要当土匪糟蹋了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008de1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: These soldiers rely too much on their tech. I wonder how many of them actually know how to fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些士兵太依赖他们的科技了。真不知道他们当中有多少人真正懂得怎么战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0001567b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They all come down from the market every day at noon to eat lunch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们每天中午都会从市场下来吃午饭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4eb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They always say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们总是这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c1a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They always say to look out for the quiet ones. They're usually the ones with the strange fetishes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都说要提防闷不吭声的人。这种人通常有些怪癖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001ff73_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They attacked us first. We did nothing wrong in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们先攻击我们的。我们在里面没做错任何事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They call this a car fort? Looks to me like an old fashioned twenty car pile up. I know this shit because I'm a historian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们管这叫汽车堡垒？我看就是个老式的二十辆车连环追尾。我懂这个，因为我是历史学家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034bb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They call this a Charnel House. A place you put corpses so they don't make people sick. Maybe that's what them raiders are doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们管这叫停尸房。放死人的地方，免得传染。没准儿掠夺者就在干这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034b6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They call this place Greener Pastures. Normally I'm a fan of ironic names, but not when it's beaten into you with a sledgehammer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方叫"绿荫牧场"。平时我爱听讽刺名，但用大锤砸耳朵就过分了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0002a22a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They called me the motherfucking Marlboro Man. I had so many cigs in my pocket I could fuck up your lungs just by looking at you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个都没有。有趣的是，我在土狼岭那时富得流油。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher2_00003477_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They can try and run. But bullets fly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃？快不过子弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_goodbye_00002c39_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't let me have any talking roles. I'm not so good at learning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不让我演有台词的角色。我记性不太好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_0000304e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They mentioned a guest as well. That could be me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还提到了一个客人。那可能是我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They mentioned you had a key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们提到你有一把钥匙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They never got the chance to torture me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们没机会折磨我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They really do that? I confess, I don't know much about raiders. Only now do I see that's a failing and not a virtue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们真的会那样吗？我承认，我对掠夺者不太了解。直到现在我才意识到，这不是一种美德，而是一种缺陷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003cdf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say if you're ever in need of a helping hand, look at the end of your arm. But I suppose mine will do for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们说，要是你哪天需要援手，就看看自己的胳膊。不过我想我的胳膊现在就够用了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_00004beb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say in the Pre-War days, this is where people went when they got sick. Which is funny, because I'm feeling sick just standing here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说在战前，这里就是人们生病时来的地方。这挺有意思的，因为我光站在这儿就感觉要吐了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000029a0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say never give up. Unless it's hopeless. Then you totally should. I guess what I'm trying to say is, sayings are stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都说永不放弃？除非彻底没戏！要我说啊，俗话都蠢爆了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002731_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say you can dodge radiation, if only you could see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都说辐射能躲…要是看得见的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_greeting_000180df_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They turned the war memorial into a meat farming facility. There's no room for sentimentality in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们把战争纪念碑改成了肉食养殖场。在荒原上可容不得多愁善感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0001567d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They used to be Carver's men. Now they're mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们以前是卡弗的手下。现在是我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq1c_000087ff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll be getting people high on sugar water for some time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会让人在一段时间内因为糖水而兴奋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll be plenty of time to discuss that later. First we need to see if this prototype even works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在有足够的时间来讨论这个了。首先我们需要看看这个原型机是否真的有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3d2_000030ce_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're a bunch of well-meaning idiots, if you pardon my French.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说句难听的，他们就是一帮好心蠢货
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac03_00000c68_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're diagnostic robots. They access a database of symptoms, illnesses, and treatments and cross-reference them with a patient's medical history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们是诊断机器人。它们访问一个症状、疾病和治疗的数据库，并将其与患者的病史进行交叉参照。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic2c_00002313_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're family, darling. I'm one of the five.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是家人，亲爱的。我是五个人中的一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey03b_00004bd8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're from Andale. It used to be they'd come only twice a year, for drama lessons and the like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们来自安代尔。以前他们只一年来两次，上戏剧课之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplay01_00002f02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're gonna want to know about my friend here. You're gonna tell them you invited him over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会问这哥们的事，你就说是你请来的
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00001f33_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're good kids. I'm glad you convinced me to watch them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是好孩子。多亏你劝我去看了他们演出。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c97_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're in a better place. Although that's not really saying much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们去了更好的地方。虽然这话没什么意义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not perfect, but the law's the law. And it's my job to make sure it has teeth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们不完美，但法律就是法律。而我的工作是确保它具有牙齿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Randy [11005F20] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02duplica_00007a42_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not suspicious. They're bitter and looking for someone to blame. Right now, that person's me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不是怀疑。他们是心怀怨恨，想找个人来怪罪。现在，那个人就是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30350c_00005d21_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're obsessed with technology, and that's never a good thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们痴迷于科技，那从来都不是好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_00001c7a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're okay, for now. It's only a matter of time before they aren't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们现在还好。他们不好也只是时间问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're one and the same. And that's why it's so hard for him to say it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 名声和人是一体的。这就是为什么他很难说出口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30350a_000063d8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're only awful because you suck at them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们之所以糟糕，只是因为你们玩得太烂了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_0000560d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're probably just looking for an edge. Pre-War tech can be the difference between living in a country and ruling it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们可能只是想找个优势。战前技术可以决定是生活在一个国家，还是统治它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac08b_00004cea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're probably unhappy about having to share their time in the shack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们可能对不得不分享小屋里的时间感到不高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're raiders. What did you expect? A warning?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是掠夺者。你还指望什么？一个警告？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel19h_00005f04_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're real famous. Hell, you might've even met their captain, ha-ha-ha! That's a joke kid, you oughta smile more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们很有名。妈的，你可能还见过他们的队长呢，哈哈哈！开玩笑的，小子，你应该多笑笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c41_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're scared and hiding. As they should be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们吓坏了，躲起来了。他们理应如此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're scared of losing the ones they love. They're afraid to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们害怕失去所爱的人。他们害怕死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_0001427f_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're the ones who need to look over their shoulders. Me, I sleep with both eyes closed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该提心吊胆的是他们。我睡觉都睁着两只眼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack02_0000155d_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're what? But how? Never mind, I don't want to know. All that matters now is that I finish my work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是什么？怎么会？算了，我不想知道。现在重要的是我完成我的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4d_0000b09b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: They've taken me to the abandoned suburbs east of where you found this frequency. It shouldn't be more than a few miles hike.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们把我带到了你找到这个频率的东部废弃郊区。应该不会超过几英里的徒步路程。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([11005510]3DNPCScribeRadioPA) 3DNPC Scribe Radio PA

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thing is, a switch will mean an end to whatever program is currently running. That means no more play dates with the girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，一更换，当前正在运行的程序就会结束。这意味着不能再和那个小女孩玩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulah80a_00003789_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thing is, a switch will mean an end to whatever program is currently running. That means no more play dates with the girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，一更换，当前正在运行的程序就会结束。这意味着不能再和那个小女孩玩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulah80b_0000378b_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thing is, this place is ass deep in Super Mutants. He couldn't get the loot out. Got trapped inside for weeks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，这个地方到处都是超级变种人。他没办法把战利品运出来。被困在里面好几个星期。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs03_00001fba_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are looking up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 日子好起来了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006cb3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things have finally started to settle down around here, and we have you to thank.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿总算安定下来了，得谢谢你
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_000053e1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things were good at first. But then people started to get sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一开始一切都很好。但后来人们开始生病。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3_000052ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think you can lend me hand out there? Might give us a chance to talk some more before you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能搭把手吗？你走之前咱俩正好唠唠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_0000ab04_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This bar's kind of trashy. I think we should try the one downstairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这酒吧太破。咱们去楼下那家吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017dab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This building's in bad shape. Pillars knocked down, walls crumbling...best make sure nothing comes crashing on top of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这栋楼状况很糟。柱子倒了，墙壁也快塌了……最好小心别让什么东西砸到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0000de99_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This camp is well fortified. Place some mines around the perimeter and we can stay for the night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个营地防御工事坚固。在周边安放些地雷，咱们今晚就在这儿过夜吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015678_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This can't be happening...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不可能...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00000a10_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This changes nothing. Your mission is still active.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这改变不了什么，你的任务依然有效

ESP.ORIGINAL: This hospital should have a ton of medical supplies. Looks like we're gonna need 'em too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医院该有海量医疗物资。正好咱们也需要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000b5db_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a strange place for a party.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地方开派对有点奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is fucking pointless. Sean's not going to say he did it. And frankly, I don't blame him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈毫无意义。肖恩不会说他干的。说实话，我不怪他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kate [110055E6] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo03_00005d2d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is good news. If a prototype is already functional, I won't even need to build my machine! Little girl, can you take me to this robot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个好消息。如果一个原型机已经能正常工作，我就甚至不需要建造我的机器了！小姑娘，你能带我去找这个机器人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcboopbeu6_000030ca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is raider territory. Even if I clear this place, it might not be safe here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是掠夺者的地盘。即使我清除了这个地方，这里也可能不安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is ridiculous. I'm sick of being interrogated like a goddamn criminal, when I've never stolen a dime from anyone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太荒谬了。我受够了像个该死的罪犯一样被审问，我从来没有偷过任何人一分钱！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_000063f6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is so stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太蠢了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kate [110055E6] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_0000640d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is so typical of Mara. She gets everyone on her side and now I'm the bad guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉就这德行，拉拢所有人把我变成恶人
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_00005d19_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太蠢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is terrible. I can't believe you listen to this shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太糟糕了。我不敢相信你竟然听这种垃圾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the entrance to Uncle Roe's garage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是罗伊叔叔车库的入口。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the facility where the prototype was built, so it'd make sense the things I needed would be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是原型机建造的设施，所以我要的东西在这里也说得通。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic1_00002312_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the last time Cooper. I don't live here any more. You need to protect yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是最后一次了，库珀。我不住在这里了。你需要保护好你自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel50b_00007a6c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the main control console for the Project ZX Ultra Protectron. To use the machine, the password must be entered in the console downstairs. Doors will lock if hostiles detected. When area is clear, use the console to unlock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是ZX Ultra Protectron项目的主控制台。要使用这台机器，必须在楼下的控制台中输入密码。如果探测到敌人，门就会锁上。当区域清空时，使用控制台解锁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the only place in all of D.C. where you can get your hand on quantum gravity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全华盛顿特区就这儿能搞到量子引力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Canary Sam [110087AF] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is too dangerous. Go back to Beep-Beep and wait for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太危险了。回到哔哔身边等我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is too much...I...I need a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太过了...我...我需要静一静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000724f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't money. We use bottlecaps in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是钱。我们在废土上用瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't our vault, stupid. No wonder you failed the illustrious GOAT.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我们的避难所，笨蛋。难怪你没能通过那著名的G.O.A.T.考试。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't real, is it? He's just acting, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 假的吧？他肯定在演戏对不对？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c79_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't the vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是避难所。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't the way I wanted this to go down, but I had no choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也不想闹成这样，但别无选择
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_0000080d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't your property, and I'm here to tell you why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是你的地盘，我来告诉你为什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This journal you gave me? Fascinating stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给的笔记？真他妈绝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0bf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This looks like a good place to set up camp. Mostly because the camp is already set up for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地儿扎营不错。主要是营已经给咱们搭好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034b8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This looks like a good spot to relax. Just try not to think of all the bodies in that river, and the lurks that are feasting on them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方挺适合放松的。只是别去想那条河里那些尸体，还有正在啃食它们的潜伏怪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0001567a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This might sound weird to say, but molerats are kind of adorable. I doubt these raiders would agree though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说这话可能怪怪的...但鼹鼠其实挺可爱。掠夺者肯定不这么想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017db3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This next song is what we at the Top 40 call an old fashioned comeback story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一首歌是我们Top 40称之为老派东山再起的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Top 40 [11004E95] (mod) Quest : ([11004F36]x3DNPCRadioTop40) x3dnpcRadioTop40quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpctop40trac_00004f3e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place has no shortage of vermin. And I'm not referring to the molerats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿害虫泛滥，我说的可不是鼹鼠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00036a01_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place is empty. I thought for sure I'd see a soldier or two. Well, wherever they are, let's hope they didn't take their guns with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿空荡荡的。还以为准能撞见几个兵呢。但愿他们没带枪跑路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place is just weird, and I'm not talking about the raiders. Why is there an elevator for a two story building?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方处处透着怪——我指的不是掠夺者。两层楼装电梯图啥？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place reminds me of Mason Dixon. It may seem peaceful, but if you look in the shadows, you'll find the darkness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方让我想起了梅森-狄克逊。看起来很平静，但要是往阴影里看，就会发现黑暗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fbe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place still has working plumbing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地方还有能用的管道系统？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place stinks of death. Watch your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方满是死气，当心背后
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_0000583b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place stinks of raiders and molerats. Can't decide which one smells worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方充满了掠夺者和鼹鼠人的臭味。真难说哪个更臭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0001567e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place...it's like I'm back in my old town. I almost feel the urge to knock on the door instead of, you know, kicking it down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方...像回到老家似的。差点想敲门而不是踹门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000080a3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This raider camp looks like a decent spot to take a break. I think I'd rather sleep on the couch though. Those beds don't look sanitary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者营地倒是能歇脚。不过我还是睡沙发吧，那些床看着就不干净。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9e1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This saloon is a pile of filth, but at least it's honest. The other one downstairs feels like it's hiding something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这家酒馆脏兮兮的，但至少很坦诚。楼下的那家感觉像是在隐瞒什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fc4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This Sierra lady is a bonafide junkie. She just got real shitty taste in drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这塞拉娘们纯属瘾君子，嗑的药还贼他妈掉价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007350_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This smells like a crime of passion. Maybe she was leaving you for someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是在犯罪。也许她为了别人离开你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This Space-American odyssey bring him here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次太空美利坚奥德赛带他来到这里
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc02b_000008d6_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This store just smells like rich people. I think I'd rather wear a used rubber than the clothes they're selling here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这店一股阔佬味儿。宁可套用过的避孕套也不穿这儿卖的衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008de0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This suburb looks a lot more posh than the others. It just goes to show the bombs didn't discriminate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这片郊区看着比别处阔气。可见炸弹不挑贫富。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000141c0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This theory of his ain't worth shit to pigs. He says it'll be years before we can even prove it, let alone make use of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他这个理论对猪来说一文不值。他说我们得花好几年才能证明它，更别说利用它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [11013D8A] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccarvervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccarverholo_00004e5c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This town is so sad. Everything from the car on the street to the tricycle on the corner...it tells you where everyone was the moment the bombs fell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看着街上的汽车和角落三轮车...每样东西都在说炸弹落下时人们在哪儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00014872_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This town is weird. I mean it's really, really weird. When you compare it to raiders, mutants, and slavers, I don't know if that's better or worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这镇子邪门，真他妈邪门。跟掠夺者变种人奴隶贩子比...说不上哪边更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000141c3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This town isn't on the map. So we should probably remove everyone in it. We don't wanna turn the mapmaker into a liar now, do we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座城镇在地图上没有标注。所以我们或许应该把镇上所有人都清除掉。我们可不想让制图员变成个骗子，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_0000aa4f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This tunnel must've collapsed on every driver the moment the bombs fell. The roof is nothing more than a headstone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 炸弹一落，这条隧道肯定就塌了，压死了所有司机。这顶棚简直就是一块墓碑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015672_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This unit is programmed to remove all secondary functions when battery power falls below thirty percent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为电量低于百分之三十时，本单元会被编程移除所有次要功能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_robot0b_000029d5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This unit will have to take your word for it, cowpoker. It's not equipped to measure emotions not relevant to survival.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本单元只能相信你所说的了，牛仔。它没有配备测量与生存无关情绪的功能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beepbeep0b_0000269d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This unit will then log the hours into its databanks as part of the course. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后本单元会把这些时间记录到数据库中，作为课程的一部分。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beepbeep0a_0000269c_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This unit will then log the hours into its databanks as part of the course. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后本单元会把这些时间记录到数据库中，作为课程的一部分。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This week starts off with a complete unknown, and I mean that literally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一周始于一个完全未知，我是说字面上的意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Top 40 [11004E95] (mod) Quest : ([11004F36]x3DNPCRadioTop40) x3dnpcRadioTop40quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpctop40trac_00004f3c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This whole floor smells like whiskey. No wonder Congress never got their shit together. They were too busy being piss drunk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这层楼全是威士忌味儿。难怪国会那帮人搞不成事——整天醉醺醺的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000d71d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This whole thing is your fault. You should've just kept your mouth shut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都是你的错。你当时就该闭嘴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This will be worth your while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 包您不亏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jet [110056A0] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_000056ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This woman you're fetching Quantum for. I'm not sure what she means to you, but I feel like it's my duty to inform you she's insane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让你找量子可乐那女人。不知道她对你多重要，可我得告诉你：她脑子不正常。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370c3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This would be a fun place to take a date, if people still do that sort of thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方约会倒不错——如果现在还有人约会的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000080a1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: This wouldn't have happened if he just took the gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他拿了枪，就不会发生这种事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those are dangerous tools in the hands of a child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在孩子手里，这些是危险的工具。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those are the true forsaken. For they have forsaken his gift.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些是被真正抛弃的人。因为他们抛弃了他的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child of Atom [1100820C] (mod) Quest : ([11008212]x3DNPCmegatonchurch) Megaton Church EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleatom01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpcchurch03c_00008226_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those idiots are dead to me. And they can be dead to you, for a price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些白痴对我来说已经死了。只要你出钱，他们也可以对你来说死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those IRS assholes got what was coming to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 国税局的杂种活该！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_greeting_00001ffc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those jagbags? Hmph. I got a rule when it comes to gangs. Don't tell me your name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些混蛋？哼。我对帮派有个规矩。别告诉我你的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a_00003dbd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those people lie! If Charles did not buy room, what did he buy? What is this sex you speak of?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些人撒谎！查尔斯不买房间买啥？你说的性到底是啥？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Charles [11003BD7] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01b5_000008b5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those places are nothing but a simulacrum. A cheap imitation trapped in a snowglobe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些地方不过是个仿制品。一个困在雪花球里的廉价仿品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_00004bc1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog is back on the air, thanks to you. President Eden has some good ideas and all, but it's always good to get a second opinion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 托您的福三狗复播了。伊登总统主意不差，但兼听则明嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007328_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog? Never heard of him. But I admit, I don't really follow music much anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三狗？没听说过。但我承认，我现在不太听音乐了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00d_000033c2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog's right. Words can fight the good fight too. They just don't hit as hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三狗说得对，好话也能当武器——就是揍人不疼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008de5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three of them, in fact. I mean I know I'm charming but really, this is too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 整整三位！我知自己魅力难挡，可这也太夸张了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 三年。别担心，我没指望你懂那是什么意思。对你来说，三年可能只是一瞬间。

ESP.TRADUIT: 当你自由时，时间是不同的。你会沉浸在回忆里，也会忙着制定计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time waits for no one. Death awaits us all.

ESP.TRADUIT: 所有权、地契，这些东西在这里一文不值。你可能觉得这更像是我的个人目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey06_0000966b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: To a welfare loving, fart sniffing commie, it might. But not to you and me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于一个爱福利、闻屁的共党来说，也许是。但对你我来说不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins02_00005a54_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be fair, neither are you. I've been nudging my head toward the door for two minutes, and you still haven't figured out we have a guest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说句公道话，你也不是。我朝门那边示意了两分钟，你还没发现我们有个客人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo01_000055ff_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel01_000081ad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be honest, I don't know much about home decor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，我对家居装饰不太懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be honest, I'm just here for the chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，我来这里只是为了化学品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be honest, I'm more worried that big machine is going to target the wrong people. The Enclave soldiers? They're a distant second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，我更担心那台大机器会瞄准错误的人。英克雷的士兵？他们是次要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001b9fb_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 为了带你来这里。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01c_00008086_1.ogg
