ESP.ORIGINAL: Wastelander
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土游民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Sex : 男性 Race : Caucasian Clas : Vault Dweller

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wastelander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土佬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Casilla [11002740] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcknightcasillavoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002cfe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out, I might hold you to that promise. Come on, let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心，我可能会让你兑现那个承诺。来吧，我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h3_00006441_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch what you eat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 饮食须谨慎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maury [11015DE9] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmauryvoice\x3dnpcmq01b_goodbye_00015e05_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watered down whiskey should be a crime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兑水的威士忌应该是一种犯罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern04b_000074ab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Way better than fighting, am I right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 比打架强多了对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066D8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_00025c95_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all have our good days and bad. It's part of being human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都有好的时候和坏的时候。这是人类的一部分。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all have to do things we don't like to survive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都得做一些我们不喜欢的事情才能生存。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all saw the bodies! Someone must've seen the writing too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都看见了尸体！肯定也有人看到了那些字！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00b_00005a91_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are nothing if not a predictable lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类啊， predictability就是咱的本命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002744_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are very much alike. And that's why I'm letting you live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们非常相似。这就是我让你活下去的原因。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We ate at the same spots, took the same classes...we probably would've shared the same clothes if Sean could fit a size six.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吃同一家店，上同一堂课...要不是肖恩穿不下六码我们估计连衣服都共享
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_00005cca_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We both know that if you walk out that door, I will never see that journal again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都清楚，如果你走出这扇门，我将永远不会再看到那本日记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc190c_0000b0af_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We both were. The way your dad was with authority, I'm sure they would've paired you with someone incredibly revolting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们俩都是。以你爸爸对权威的态度，我敢肯定他们会给你配一个令人难以置信的讨厌鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01e_00009657_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can say I was touched by a dedication you made on air.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以说我被你空中献给我的献词感动了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc02duplicat_00001f3b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can start by searching the bodies for a key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以先搜寻尸体找一把钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03chatt_000149a4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can use that to find the rest of the clues.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以用它来找到其余的线索。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00d_00001c76_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can't worry about who did what when some dangerous beast is on the loose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有危险野兽在逃，没空管谁干了啥

ESP.ORIGINAL: We could borrow some from my Uncle, he's always willing to "lend" me some money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以从我叔叔那里借一些，他总是乐意“借”我一些钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5E] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler01\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c32_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did it! The last holotape! Are you going to press play, or am I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们做到了！最后一盘全息磁带！你按播放还是我按？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00005a59_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did it. The purifier's on. Your dad would've been proud.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成了！净水器启动了，您父亲在天之灵该欣慰啦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0001ba01_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did. Kate even had to spend a night in juvenile detention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们被逮捕了。凯特甚至在少年拘留所里待了一晚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cdf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We didn't need a real drug. We just needed something that felt like it was turning your insides out. And that's what we have here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不需要真正的毒品。我们只需要一种让人感觉五脏六腑都要翻出来的东西。而我们这里就有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000beb0_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We didn't need a real drug. We just needed something that felt like it was turning your insides out. And that's what we have here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不需要真正的毒品。我们只需要一种让人感觉五脏六腑都要翻出来的东西。而我们这里就有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000bed0_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We do it right, and no one will even know it's missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们做得对，甚至没人会发现它少了一块。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00004cb5_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't actually have lemonade on the menu, just to be clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 澄清一下，我们菜单上其实没有柠檬水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot03_0000536c_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't have time for this shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们没时间管这些破事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't solve issues around here with violence. If you felt threatened by Maddie's roach, we could've put it on a leash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这里不用暴力解决问题。如果你觉得麦迪的蟑螂有威胁，我们可以给它套上皮带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcstage110p_00003cb5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't want to focus on the interrogation and miss the smoking gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不应该只专注于审讯，而忽略了确凿的证据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_0000969b_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't want to focus on the interrogation and miss the smoking gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不应该只专注于审讯，而忽略了确凿的证据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_0000969a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We drank too much milk before the battle ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们战前喝了太多牛奶，夫人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000043b0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We feed them sugar water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们给他们喝糖水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We find him, and we find the next piece of the story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们找到他，我们就能找到故事的下一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas01_00004c63_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We found these holotapes that mention a Greg Haskins. I thought it might be you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们找到了提到一个叫格雷格·哈斯金斯的全息磁带。我以为可能就是你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We get along pretty well, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我们相处得很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We get along, more or less. Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们相处得还可以，或多或少。为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We get to that. Right now, you get on shoulder! Eat bananas! Throw feces!
ESP.TRADUIT: 先不说这个，现在上肩膀！吃香蕉！扔屎！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc00d_000008c0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We go back to Izzy's office and I pay my fine. But while I'm distracting her, you slip some Washo into their coffee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们回到伊兹的办公室，我去付我的罚款。但在我分散她注意力的时候，你把一些“沃硕”放进他们的咖啡里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs04_00001fbd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We go into that building, there won't be much cover. Best to shoot first and sort the bodies later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们进那栋楼，里面没什么掩护。最好先开枪，然后再收拾尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL:
We got a few visitors from Fort Independence today, here to do inspections. They seemed more concerned with our patriotism as opposed to our military readiness. In fact, they had Staff Seargeant Lacambra place the American flag somewhere where all the men could salute and acknowledge the "Stripes of Valor and Bravery."
Naturally, Lacambra placed the flag right over the toilet, which gave everyone a good laugh.
ESP.TRADUIT:
今天有几个从独立堡来的客人，来这里视察。他们似乎更关心我们的爱国主义，而不是我们的军事准备。事实上，他们让上士拉坎布拉把美国国旗放在所有人都能敬礼的地方，并承认“英勇与勇敢的条纹”。
自然地，拉坎布拉把国旗放在马桶上，这让每个人都笑了起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got separated during a tussle with a raider gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在和一群掠夺者帮派打斗时走散了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c40_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We had a deal. And I expect you to honor it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有个协议。我希望你遵守它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel10e_00008157_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We had propaganda in the sim too. Only the "red menace" meant the Russians and not the Chinese.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虚拟世界也有宣传画，不过"红色威胁"指俄国佬而不是中国人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000f1e8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have a lot in common! Do you also like to eat bugs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有很多共同点！你也喜欢吃虫子吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc1d_00001c5a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We heading out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就出发？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00008079_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We just have to make sure we keep our doors locked tight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只需确保把门锁紧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02_00006cd6_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We like to think so. But it's hard not to see why. We blew up the world once. It'd be pretty stupid if humanity didn't learn from that mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们希望如此，但很难不这么想，我们炸过一次世界，人类要是不吸取教训就太蠢了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac02c_00000c4f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We make sacrifices for the greater good. It's part of being human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了更大的利益，我们做出牺牲。这是人类的一部分。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We may not know their names, but they were people. Good ones. Just a little confused, I'd say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可能不知道他们的名字，但他们是人。好人。我只能说，他们有点困惑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01g_0001497f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We met in high school. The end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在高中认识的。结束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kate [110055E6] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_greetingx_00005cc4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We might get more food out of the roaches than on the shelves. Still, it doesn't hurt to look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从蟑螂身上得到的食物可能比架子上的还多。不过，看看也无妨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015680_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We might not even have to pretend! It'll be great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们甚至可能不需要假装！会很棒的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_boop0b_000030ad_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We must be in hell...this is literally hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一定在地狱...字面意义上的地狱
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc100a_00000a28_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to head to Springvale to talk to this Vault woman. You know, the one in the hideous jumpsuit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要去泉谷镇和这位避难所的女人谈谈。就是那个穿着丑陋连体衣的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcquesttask_00015de8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to save everyone we can. I don't know much about Super Mutants, but I can tell they're trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能救的人都得救。超级变种人我不太懂，但准是祸害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001847d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to take more walks. Doc Church says you need more exercise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得多散步！教堂医生说您缺锻炼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_hello_000180f7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We oughta give Caleb a picture of a dancing girl. I don't know about you, but I'd much rather look at that than Abe's raggedy ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该给迦勒弄张舞娘海报。反正我宁愿看妞也不愿瞅亚伯那烂屁股。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007353_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We rehabilitate androids. You see, the models here were originally designed to be soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在改造仿生人。这些模型最初是为士兵设计的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob01_00007256_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We rotate the housing every few months, so everyone gets a chance to have a house of their own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们每隔几个月轮换住房，这样每个人都有机会拥有自己的房子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02_00006cbb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should also keep an eye out for the main console. Entering the password in that should open the doors to the factory floor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们也应该留意一下主控台。在里面输入密码应该能打开通往工厂地板的门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac07_00004ce0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should be encouraging people to build settlements, not travel the wastes like animals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们该教人建定居点，而不是像野狗似的在废土乱窜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should check the rooms of this hotel. Make sure there aren't any prisoners being held hostage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该检查一下这家旅馆的房间，确保没有被扣为人质的囚犯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014fc1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should have one of those love-hate relationships!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该来一段那种又爱又恨的关系！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00003425_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should probably kill them before they start hogging your glory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 趁他们抢你风头前，得宰干净。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_00006c66_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should probably split up. Best pretend we don't know each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好分头走，装不认识。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_greeting_0000200a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should roast something by the campfire here, to you know, get rid of the raider smell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们在这儿的篝火旁烤点东西吧，这样就能把掠夺者的气味给除掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_0000aa50_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should rub honey all over ourselves. You catch more flies that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱该往身上抹蜂蜜，那样能招更多苍蝇
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00006e57_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should totally apply for citizenship here. I don't think the Davidites...or is it Dave-anese? Whatever, I don't think they like immigrants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们应该在这儿申请公民身份。我觉得大卫派……或者叫戴夫安人？不管怎样，我觉得他们不喜欢移民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_0000aa58_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should totally catch some.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该去抓一些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas05_00003424_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should totally have some fun with it! How about this. You be a customer, and I'll work the register.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该好好玩玩！怎么样？你当顾客，我来当收银员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb18_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We shouldn't waste time in places like this. Bust that safe open and let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不该在这类地方浪费时间。撬开那个保险箱，然后离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00015677_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We start by implanting memories into each model. From there, we put them in situations where they can work on their conflict resolution skills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们首先在每个模型中植入记忆。然后，我们把它们放在能锻炼解决冲突能力的场景中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob02_0000725f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We started out with four, and then grew to six. A few weeks back Molerat joined the fold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们开始时是四人，然后增长到六人。几周前鼹鼠鼠加入了群体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03_00006ce1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We think so as well. It's not their fault these androids were programmed to act the way they do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们也这么认为。这些仿生人的行为方式不是他们的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob01b_0000725c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We think you might be in danger. Are you sure it's safe here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们觉得你可能有危险。你确定这里安全吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We tuned the radio to that frequency you mentioned. Mostly static. Some storytelling. But no theory of everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 收音机调到你说的频段了。全是杂音。偶尔说书。没听见啥万能理论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0c0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were lucky. But it just goes to show these kids are better off staying inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算走运吧。但这事证明孩子们还是待屋里安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003cbc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We? Are you suggesting we work together? We don't seem like the type of people who dabble in the same circles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们？你是说我们一起合作？我们看起来不像是混一个圈子的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey03c_00004bd9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'd better help these Brotherhood soldiers. Three Dog is no use to you dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好帮帮这些钢铁兄弟会士兵。三狗死了对你可没好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba04_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'd get ants in the house every fall. There were probably thousands of them. Let's hope these ants are fewer in number.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前每年秋天家里闹蚂蚁，成千上万只。但愿灰渠的蚂蚁少点儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weddings always make me cry. It's hard not to tear up watching two people throw their lives away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 婚礼总让我掉眼泪。看两个人搭上终生很难不落泪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00024f43_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weird. I guess I just got lucky with my guy. I've got all twenty of his piggies in a box at home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奇怪。我猜我的那个家伙只是运气好。我把他所有的二十个脚趾都装在一个盒子里带回家了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas03_000033da_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back. Counting down to number 27 in this week, it's time for a special, long distance dedication.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来。本周倒数第二十七名，现在是特别的、长途点歌时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Top 40 [11004E95] (mod) Quest : ([11004F36]x3DNPCRadioTop40) x3dnpcRadioTop40quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpcradi_x3dnpctop40trac_00004f3d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back. What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来，能为你做啥？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_0000091e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome home, brother. I'm glad you can finally see it for what it really is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回家，兄弟。庆幸你终能看清真相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_greeting_00014277_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Casa de Molerat! I hope you enjoy your stay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临地鼠之家！祝您住得愉快
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006cae_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Dot's Diner, how can I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到多特餐馆，需要啥？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00000970_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Mason Dixon! I take it you're just passing through?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到梅森-狄克逊！路过歇脚？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006cd4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Mason Dixon, friend. My name's Cooper. How can I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到梅森-狄克逊，朋友，我叫库珀，需要啥？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00007a4f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to our facility. It's not often we get human guests.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到我们的设施。人类访客可不常见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007269_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the bomb show.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到炸弹秀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([110033CF]x3dnpcFollowersARANAS) x3dnpcARANAS quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followershired_00007516_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Clara Bella. I apologize for not greeting you at the door, but you've come at a bad time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临克拉拉贝拉。恕未能迎门…您来得不巧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00002e77_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Internal Revenue Service. Please take a ticket and wait for your number to be called.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临国税局。请取号等候叫号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_greeting_0000164b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Vernon's Chop Shop, what can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到弗农切肉店，要点啥？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00002a14_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well ain't you a lucky son of a bitch! I thought for sure they'd fill your pants with earwigs or something like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是个幸运的混蛋！我敢肯定他们会把你的裤子装满耳屎虫之类的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher0a_00007330_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well done, patriot, well done indeed. Today, we've dealt a great blow to the enemies of freedom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，爱国者，干得真漂亮。今天，我们给了自由的敌人沉重的一击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins01_00005a43_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well either way, you're here and he's not, so you might as well help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，不管怎样，你在这里，他不在，所以你不如帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00aduplica__00001f23_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well fine, this play was super lame anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，这出戏反正超级无聊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_000013e6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well for now, I guess we keep wandering. The Enclave's still out there, along with a thousand other things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，现在，我想我们继续流浪吧。英克雷还在外面，还有成千上万的其他东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001ba05_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well for one, I'm addicted to RadAway. And the chill doesn't amount to much if you're aren't burning up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，我对消辐射上瘾了。而且如果你没有被辐射灼烧，那种寒意也算不了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam1_000087c1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well fuck me, quantum gravity. The four-eyed fucker came through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的，量子引力。那个四眼混蛋成功了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightball1_0000becd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll get to that. First, can I get you a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们稍后会谈到。首先，要不要喝一杯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well good, because according to Vernon, it'll start ringing at any moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就好，因为按弗农的说法，它随时会响
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcsecondrin_00000992_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well hello there Miss Dangerous. What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟这不是危险女士嘛？有何指教？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blossom [110010A3] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\femaleadult02dc\x3dnpcclara_greeting_0000211a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well hello there Mister Dangerous. What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嚯这不是危险先生嘛？有何指教？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blossom [110010A3] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\femaleadult02dc\x3dnpcclara_greeting_0000211c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well he's furniture now. No need to worry your pretty little head over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在他成家具啦，用不着你操心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000c582_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well hey there cutie. How's it hanging?
ESP.TRADUIT: 小可爱～感觉如何呀？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blossom [110010A3] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\femaleadult02dc\x3dnpcclara_hello_00002122_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well honeybee, I don't know about this month, but maybe by winter Santa will put a little something extra in your stocking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯小蜜蜂，这个月不行，但也许到冬天圣诞老人会往你袜子里多塞点
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e23_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well hurry up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00b_00003399_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I could always boil you some water, and then pour it on your head. Although it'd be a shame to burn such smooth skin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒是可以给你烧点水，然后浇在你头上。不过烧坏了你那光滑的皮肤就太可惜了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_0000a415_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I could, but I've been on the family health plan now for two hundred years. It'd be awkward to change now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒是可以，但我已经在家庭健康计划里待了两百年了。现在改变会很尴尬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I could, but someone your size might want to stick with a handgun. Rifles give you a little more kick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能做到，但你这么大体格的人，可能还是用手枪比较好。步枪的后坐力更大一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect5_0000a3ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I don't think it was very funny. Still, you've earned the right to step on a few toes around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我觉得一点也不好笑。不过，你已经赢得了在这里踩几个人脚的权利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b4_00005397_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I hope she's happy. She nearly got one child killed and had another take the blame!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望她高兴。她差点害死一个孩子，还让另一个承担了责任！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003cc6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I told you, even if we had the combination, the contents are worthless. My only real goal was to make my little brother come in second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我告诉过你，即使我们有组合，里面的东西也毫无价值。我唯一真正的目标是让我弟弟屈居第二。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01f_0001497e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I'm sorry, but I don't remember half the things people told me in high school, let alone whatever shenanigans you and Kate were up to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我很抱歉，但我高中时别人告诉我的事有一半都不记得了，更别说你和凯特搞的那些小把戏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cfb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well in that case, maybe I can lure him out with chems. I have a feeling though he's not going to give the room up for a bottle of buffout.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，既然如此，也许我可以用化学品把他引出来。不过我有种感觉，他不会为了那一瓶蛮牛而放弃房间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01c_00002e82_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well lookee here, another a toxic waste dump. It's like a home away from home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟，又是个辐射垃圾场。跟回家似的亲切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_0000299a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well maybe I did tell McKinley she was ripping him off! And you know what, she deserved whatever she got!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，也许我确实告诉了麦金利她一直在骗他的钱！你知道吗，她活该得到的一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70g_000063f4_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well maybe I did tell McKinley she was ripping him off! And you know what, she deserved whatever she got!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，也许我确实告诉了麦金利她一直在骗他的钱！你知道吗，她活该得到的一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpcsean70h_000063f5_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll meet you at Takoma Garage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塔科马车库集合。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll meet you at the facility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 设施那儿碰头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_goodbye_00004cc9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll meet you at the VAPL-58 Power Station.
ESP.TRADUIT: VAPL-58电站见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll need a plan, and my man in Rivet City will have one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要一个计划，而我在铆钉城的人会有一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcquesttask_00010932_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well no, I'd prefer a pedicure and a foot massage before we go running after the Pride, but I'll settle for a Stimpak and a full clip. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不，我宁愿在追赶傲军之前先做个足部护理和足部按摩，但我会满足于一支治疗针和一个满弹匣。我们走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba24_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well no, not if someone else is in control of it. And it's not like I miss that crusty old town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不，如果是由别人控制的话就不会了。而且我也不怀念那个老掉牙的小镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_0001847a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们拭目以待。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see. This technology the government was making might benefit mankind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们拭目以待。政府正在制造的这项技术可能会造福人类。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well somebody did! This is right around the time I heard it ring. Someone picked it up, and now Jessica's dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯肯定有人接了！就在我听到铃声的时候。有人接了起来，现在杰西卡死了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00b_000030db_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll stay up here and wait for your signal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在上头等信号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_00007b9f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll take care of things from here. I think it's pretty clear who's responsible for all of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿交给我们，显然有人该背全锅
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_000033bc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll talk in a bit. First, I need to a get more ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 待会儿聊，我先去拿弹药
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00003e61_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll talk more later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们稍后再聊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll talk to you when it's time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到时候会找你谈
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00002cc6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well thank you gorgeous. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好呀，谢谢你，美女。跟我来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jet [110056A0] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_000056a6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well that's because I'm part of a militia. Mortar's Mercenaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是因为我是一个民兵组织的成员。迫击炮佣兵团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c41_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, I'll just take that back. Trash attracts molerats, and molerats attract scorpions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧，我就收回去了。垃圾会吸引鼹鼠，而鼹鼠会吸引蝎子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b4_00005392_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well this is certainly a surprise!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇这可真惊喜！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_0000644a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well too bad asshole, old Butchy ain't got a spoon to feed you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过没用，混蛋，老布奇可没有汤匙喂你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_0000c585_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well what do you know? It works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，你瞧？它管用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop08_00002654_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well you can go fuck yourself then. Right or wrong, I'm not a rat!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你他妈可以去死了。对也好错也罢，我不是告密者！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo04_00005d13_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well you can kiss them both goodbye! I didn't fight off the Nazis to let you vodka drinking scum straddle our land!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就跟它们俩说再见吧！我可不是为了打败纳粹，然后让你们这些喝伏特加的垃圾来霸占我们的土地！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00004c7f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well you heard wrong, shitbird. We don't buy chems, we sell them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你听错了，臭小子。我们不买毒品，我们卖毒品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq0a_000087d2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well your code is our loss, seeing as we can't get there without you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你的准则就是我们的损失，因为没有你我们到不了那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BE] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect02\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect1_0000a3e4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, a few years back I was part of this militia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，几年前我是一个民兵组织的一员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50f_00006151_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, according to our auditors, 300 caps each, after interest. Shouldn't be too hard to wrangle out of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，根据我们的审计员，每个人欠300个瓶盖，加上利息。应该不难从他们那里把钱弄回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b24_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, as long as you don't use EMPs or really sharp scissors. Wouldn't wanna damage the holotapes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，只要你不使用电磁脉冲或非常锋利的剪刀就行。我可不想损坏这些全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02a_000033dc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, as long as you enjoy yourself, I don't see the harm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，只要你玩得开心，我就看不出有什么坏处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least I'm not a bloodsucking zombie like you Audrey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，至少我不像你，奥黛丽，是个吸血僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB25]x3DNPCMQ02) The Free and Pure EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpcmq02_x3dnpctsenaudre_0000ee1c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least Ms. Petrovita gave you something of use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 佩特洛维塔女士好歹给了件管用的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370c5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least the ants are finally gone. Now Grayditch can go back to being a big ol' pile of nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好在那些蚂蚁终于被清干净了，灰渠镇总算能安静下来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079bc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least you finally stopped being neutral.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，至少你终于不再中立了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo04_00005d14_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, because computers rule at chess and cats are unemployed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，因为电脑下棋很厉害，而猫没有工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq4_00002704_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, better that than dead. But it won't be long before they join Richard, if they keep doing what they're doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，总比死了好。但如果他们继续那样下去，用不了多久他们就会步理查德的后尘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina01c_00003c88_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, did you get the gun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿到枪没？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00003397_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, did you hear what the voice in the box said? It said Greg Haskins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你听到盒子里那个声音说什么了吗？它说格雷格·哈斯金斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas01_00004c63_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, either way, you're here and she's not, so you might as well help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，不管怎样，你在这里，她不在，所以你不如帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00aduplica__00001f24_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, every cell had two beds, and a fucking shitload of them were occupied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里的每个牢房都有两张床，而且他妈的有很多都住满了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher1c_00003465_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, fancy meeting you here. I trust your visit with the Enclave was everything you expected it to be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 巧遇啊？英克雷之旅想必如您所愿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0003ba18_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, for one, she didn't even deliver the paper. I had to chase her down in my morning robes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，她甚至没送报纸。我不得不穿着晨袍追她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e27_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, good luck with everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, granted I wasn't gone for long. But it seemed like I'd be gone forever when the gun tapped the back of my head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然，我离开的时间不长。但当枪口抵住我后脑勺时，感觉就像我将永远离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_000142bc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, have you done as I asked?
ESP.TRADUIT: 照吩咐办妥了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchaskins_greeting_00004c65_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, Hawk and I will probably go through this entire factory for any Pre-War tech that might pose a threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我和霍克可能会把整个工厂都搜一遍，看看有没有可能构成威胁的战前科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01_0000679b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he don't look so smart now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他现在看起来可不那么聪明了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq2_0000a2e8_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he seemed nice enough, and it's bad business to turn away customers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他看起来还不错，而且拒绝顾客对生意不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_00002e7b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he seems like a pleasant fellow. Fortunately, what he lacks in manners he makes up for with gunplay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 倒是个妙人！虽说礼数欠奉，枪法着实补足了缺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_000187b9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he wouldn't be the first to try and poison a federal employee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他不会是第一个试图毒害联邦雇员的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirscollect_00002012_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, holotapes are everywhere. But finding one as good as "It Came from the Vault?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 全息磁带到处都是。但要找到像《它来自避难所》那么好的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00003440_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, how'd it go? Did you spike the coffee?
ESP.TRADUIT: 咋样？咖啡下药没？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I also don't want you making a beeline for the target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我也不想你直奔目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4e8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I can see why Project Purity was a disaster. There's a filthy looking statue of Thomas Jefferson sitting right in the middle of the chamber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纯净计划搞成灾难，看大厅中间那个脏兮兮的托马斯·杰斐逊雕像就明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba0f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I could take her with me, but I don't know how healthy that would be, given the situation in our town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我可以把她带走，但考虑到我们镇子里的情况，我不知道这对她来说是否健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulah80g_00002636_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I could take her with me, but she's going to hate me for terminating her friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我可以把她带走，但她会因为我终结了她的朋友而恨我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I could've told you that. No human would dare confuse the Capital Congressmen for anything resembling a baseball team.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我早就告诉过你了。没有人会胆敢把国会国会议员和任何像棒球队的东西混淆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba1b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I didn't put too much thought into it, if that's what you're asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我没怎么考虑过，如果你是问这个的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar02_00001c03_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't know that much about the Bill of Rights, but if it's freedom of the press, then we're probably talking about a newspaper company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我对《权利法案》了解不多，但如果是新闻自由，那我们可能在谈论一家报社。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00b_00001c74_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't mean to make light of the dead, but our chief concern should be the living.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我无意轻视死者，但我们最关心的应该是活人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11015DE5]x3DNPCMQ01b) Uncle Roe's Garage EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreycan_00015f41_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't think you'll be saying that when we see the carnage this weapon can cause.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想当我们看到这种武器能造成的浩劫时，你就不会这么说了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00d_00003e45_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't wanna scare you, but there's something spooky about it. I think I might've even heard it ring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不想吓你，但它有点诡异。我甚至认为我可能听到它响过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00a_00005a90_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't want them dead, but I can't say it'd be much of a loss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不想他们死，但我不能说那会是多大的损失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00d_00002a47_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不想吓你，但萨莉·詹金斯的母亲说这歌正流行，坦白说我有点担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e40_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I doubt it's the kind you can spend. Unless you know a man who has a thing for stacks of green paper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我怀疑是那种你能花掉的钱。除非你认识一个喜欢成堆绿色纸张的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey06_0000966b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I doubt they're referring to my face, what with my dashing good looks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我怀疑他们指的是我的脸，毕竟我有迷人的英俊外表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc03_00006c9b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I feel rather stretched out. How about another?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我感觉挺累的。再来一杯怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_combattonormal_000369f0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I got my dog with me, and raiders knocking on my doorstep. The way I figure, that's company enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我带着我的狗，还有掠夺者在我家门口敲门。依我看，这已经足够热闹了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gina [11003586] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright03\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcgina04_00003598_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 考完了…这下彻底没退路喽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000081b2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess this means goodbye. It was really fun playing pretend with you. We should do it again some time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来该散场啦。扮家家超好玩！下次再约！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_0000267f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess you couldn't from where you were standing. Not without a periscope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦对…您那角度瞧不着。除非有望远镜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_0000332e_2.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我希望你能留下来。我知道有时待在一个地方很难，但每个人都需要一个可以称之为家的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0bf_00006147_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope you told him where he could stick it. Somewhere dark and painful I assume.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我希望你告诉他把那东西塞进某个黑暗又痛苦的地方。我猜是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_0003ba1c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I just got hit in the face with a fire hydrant. I think I'm gonna need at least twenty stimpaks or my ass is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 消防栓怼脸上…没二十支治疗针老子屁股准开花。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c6f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I kinda broke the lock. Might've been the bobby pin, might've been the bubblegum. Anyways, it's stuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我把锁弄坏了。可能是发夹，也可能是泡泡糖。总之，它卡住了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00b_0000336d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I know better than to argue with my wife.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我懂得不要和我妻子争论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempster1_000180da_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I may not be a soldier, but I'll be damned if I let you just walk in here and take what's mine!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我可能不是个士兵，但如果你敢走进来拿走我的东西，我他妈的跟你拼了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053b4_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I may not be a soldier, but I'll be damned if I let you just walk in here and take what's mine!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我可能不是个士兵，但如果你敢走进来拿走我的东西，我他妈的跟你拼了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053bb_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I may not be able to read all this other shit, but that says "quantum" on the top, plain as your mother's tits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我可能看不懂所有这些狗屁，但上面写着“量子”，就和你妈妈的乳头一样清楚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcbutch165a_0000b096_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I meant for you to give it to Richard, with the hope he has enough sense to let the kids use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我是想让你把它交给理查德，希望他有足够的理智让孩子们用它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I missed you too. But lucky for me, I didn't extend them the same courtesy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我也想你。但幸运的是，我没有对他们同样客气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_0001497a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I must be getting sloppy. I owe you an apology, Top 40. This guy was definitely loading up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我真是老糊涂了，得给您道个歉Top40先生，这混蛋确实藏了货
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00000802_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose this is all father's fault in the end. He should've known the five of us wouldn't play nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想这最终都是父亲的错。他本该知道我们五个人不会和平相处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_000142c0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose we're nearing the end of this story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来故事要收尾了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0003ba1f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I think it's really looking great. I still have to decorate the walls and...oh my god! I have walls! Just saying it makes me smile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我觉得超棒。还得装饰墙面...天啊！我有墙了！光说说就开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marie [11005F1B] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef2\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a_00007393_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I think the story takes place in Andale, Virginia. So it's either there, or somewhere completely different!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想这个故事发生在弗吉尼亚州的安代尔。所以要么在那里，要么在某个完全不同的地方！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas04_000033fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I took a glance at the doctor's terminal before I left. From what I can tell it's all muscle memory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我离开前看了一眼医生的终端。据我所知，这都是肌肉记忆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008091_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I was trying to show Beep-Beep how to give people the thumbs up like Vault Boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我当时正试着教哔哔怎么像避难所小子那样竖起大拇指。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc3_00001c51_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I went outside yesterday, I went outside today, and I plan on going outside tomorrow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我昨天出去了，今天出去了，我明天也打算出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_x3dnpctavern05f_000074b2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I would prefer to garnish and prepare you first, but I've been known to eat a man raw on occasion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我更希望先给你装饰和准备一番，但偶尔我也吃生人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if anyone was his peer it'd be you. He was too creepy for the girls, and not enough of an asshole to be one of the boys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果说有人是他同类，那也只会是你。他对女孩来说太诡异了，对男孩来说又不够混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia04d_00009669_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if he did, then why the fuck am I wearing a collar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那他妈的为什么我还戴着项圈？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack02_0000155e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if it means I get to stay alive, then I'm not going to ask any more questions, I promise you that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果这意味着我能活下来，那我保证不会再问任何问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon195_000053d1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if that's your choice, I'm not gonna argue with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果那是你的选择，我不会反驳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053b2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you haven’t heard, pretty much every raider in the wastes is a chem addict. It's in the company fucking manual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你没听说过的话，废土上几乎每个掠夺者都是瘾君子。这他妈的写在公司手册里呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02b_00002c47_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you know anything about the military industrial complex, you'll know the United States army was well financed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你对军事工业复合体有所了解，你就会知道美国军队资金充足。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01d_00002337_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you see her, tell her a slave from vault 101's looking for her. Said they were old friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你见到她，告诉她一个来自101号避难所的奴隶在找她。说他们是老朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03hb_00001c2f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you see him, tell him a slave from vault 101 is looking for him. Said they were old friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你见到他，告诉他一个来自101号避难所的奴隶在找他。说他们是老朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03hb_00001c30_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll certainly try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，尽量试试。
