ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll certainly try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，尽量试试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcfollowert_0002f8a7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll leave you to it then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么我就留你自行处理了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm glad that whole business with The Family is over with. I still can't believe Ian killed his parents.
ESP.TRADUIT: "家族"这破事总算完了。伊恩杀亲爹妈还是难以置信...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001849a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm gonna be sad to see you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，看到你离开我会很难过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0b_0000538a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm gonna put an end to their bullshit right now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我现在就要结束他们的胡说八道！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcus Thatcher [11001FB1] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsmaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60b_00001fe2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm not a religious man, but I am a spiritual one. And in my Bible, there's a thing called "What goes around, comes around."
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不是个信教的人，但我相信精神。在我的圣经里，有句话叫“种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar04_000029ac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm programmed to be. But I don't know if it's something I want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我被编程成是这样。但我不知道这是否是我想要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01x_00008096_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm very sorry about that. Perhaps you'd be interested in some whiskey instead? I'll just need to see some ID.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，对此我很抱歉。也许你对威士忌感兴趣？我只需要看一下你的身份证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb21_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, in that case, forget I even brought it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，既然如此，就当我没提过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5E] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler01\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c49_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, in the "Witch and the Princess," symptoms of depression and anxiety are attributed to spells of magic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，在“女巫与公主”中，抑郁和焦虑的症状被归咎于魔法咒语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot2_00007af0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, in the emotional sense of the word, yes. But the heart is a vital human organ, just as the battery is critical for machines to function.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，从情感意义上来说，是的。但心脏是人体重要的器官，就像电池对机器的运作至关重要一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic0c_00002303_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it doesn't matter, I lost the key to that years ago. We burn all our trash now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，反正钥匙早丢了，我们现在都烧垃圾
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot03_0000092d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it looks like we're late to the party again. Not fashionably late, of course, just late.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又晚了一步，看来我们又迟到了。当然不是那种优雅的迟到，就是单纯的迟到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreysta_00004bab_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it takes a lot of hard work. A lot of our friends have gotten married and have kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这需要付出很多努力。我们很多朋友都结婚生子了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30320b_00005cd8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it takes a lot of hard work. A lot of our friends have gotten married and have kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这需要付出很多努力。我们很多朋友都结婚生子了。.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it was Molerat's turn, but now he's dead too. So I guess Susan's next up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，本来是轮到鼹鼠鼠的，但现在他也死了。所以我猜想下一个是苏珊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01duplica_00006c91_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it was so dark I couldn't even see my hands, let alone the matches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太黑了连手都看不见，更别说火柴
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon01_00000960_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it was very wet, and there wasn't much to do. But I feel like I really grew as a person during those years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那里非常潮湿，而且没什么事可做。但我感觉那几年我真的成长了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey02a_00004bcb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it would be fine if it was just that. But she didn't send me caps. She sent me NCR bills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 光这样还好，但她没寄瓶盖，寄的是NCR钞票
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DA7] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000dd6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it'd be fine if I was an actual molerat. But this hide of mine isn't made for the cold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果我真的是鼹鼠，那就没问题。但我的这身皮不抗寒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a5_00006ca4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it'll be here whenever you want to listen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你想听的时候它就在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's a phone booth. There's nothing remarkable about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那是个电话亭。没什么特别的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's comforting to know I'm not alone. But it's also scary to know that they're basically slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得知自己并非孤身一人，这让人感到欣慰，但同时知道他们基本上是奴隶，这又令人感到恐惧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcharkness_00018494_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's like I told you, I just got here. I lent this apartment to one of my dedicated listeners.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，就像我告诉你的，我刚到这里。我把这间公寓借给了我一个忠实的听众。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00002cc2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's like reading, except it's like, "Look Ma, no hands!" And no eyes! And no brain!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这就像阅读，只不过是“看，妈妈，不用手了！”而且不用眼睛！也不用大脑！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02_00002af6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's mostly common sense. Don't shoot a man in the back. Don't curse in front of a lady.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这大多是常识。不要从背后射杀一个人。不要在女士面前说脏话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scavenger [1100A3BD] (mod) Quest : ([1100A3B9]x3DNPCprospectors) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcprospect01\x3dnpcpros_x3dnpcprospect2_0000a3e5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's natural to be a little anxious moving to a new place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，搬到一个新地方有点焦虑是很正常的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Underworld Resident [11009626] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul01\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul01b_0000161f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's not a total loss. The processor's in a lot better shape than I expected, frankly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这并非完全的损失。坦率地说，处理器比我预期的要好得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic0d_00002304_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's not every day the voice of American Top 40 calls us about a body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不是每天都有“美国Top 40”的声音打电话告诉我们这里有具尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00002caf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's not rocket science. It's more like whistling. You just press your finger on the trigger and blow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这又不是什么火箭科学。更像吹口哨。你只需要把手指按在扳机上，然后吹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey05_00005972_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's one of them double meaning words.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，它是一个双关语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar01_00001bff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's one thing to go to a nightclub and hear it. It's another to play it on the radio. Children could be listening!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去夜店听是一回事，在电台播是另一回事。孩子们可能听到！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e43_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's too late for apologies now. The important thing is we convince the others not to do the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在道歉太晚了，重点是说服其他人别干同样的事
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon00a_00000956_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've always been partial to a little good cop, bad cop, but you can also try reasoning with him, or simply beating him into submission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我一直偏爱好警察和坏警察的戏码，但你也可以试着跟他讲道理，或者直接把他打到屈服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyint_00009695_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've got a nasty welt from where that guard jabbed his rifle into my neck, but seeing as he's dead, I suppose we're even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那个警卫把步枪戳进我的脖子，留下了一道难看的伤痕，但鉴于他已经死了，我想我们扯平了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01c_000142be_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've got ten fingers and ten toes, so I must be doing something right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我有十根手指和十根脚趾，所以我肯定做对了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas03_000033da_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've never been good with children, so I'll let you break the news. But if you need someone to give the gory details, I'm here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我向来不会哄孩子，坏消息你去说吧。不过要讲断胳膊断腿的细节，我随时能帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370c0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've never seen anything like it, before or since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我以前从未见过这样的事，之后也再没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03e_00001c49_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've seen your arms. So no, I guess I don't. What I can't figure out is, how they're still attached to your body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看过你胳膊，所以不，我猜没有，我想不通的是它们咋还连你身上
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DA7] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000ddd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, just know that I'm here if you need me. In fact, I suggest you take a little break.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你只需要知道，如果你需要我，我就在这里。事实上，我建议你休息一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000b1f8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe I can help, but if worst comes to worst, I'm not against just punching in a bunch of numbers and hoping the system locks up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，也许我能帮忙，但如果最糟糕的情况发生，我不反对随便输入一串数字，希望系统锁死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac06a_00004ca8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, not everyone can have lopsided eyes like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不是每个人都能像你一样有斜眼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, one out of two isn't bad! If this was baseball, we'd be in the Hall of Fame!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，二中取一也不错！如果这是棒球，我们就能进名人堂了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjoneshammo_0000b0e6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, privacy isn't what I'm after. I need a public eye. Someone who can find the truth and shine a light on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想要的不是隐私。我需要一双公众之眼。一个能找到真相并把它公之于众的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_0000439c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, so far you're helping, so we'll save the awkward conversations for after you betray me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，到目前为止你都在帮忙，所以我们把尴尬的对话留到你背叛我之后再说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00002a41_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, so long as it's just a night. I don't want the waiting list to get any longer than it already is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要别过夜就行。等候名单已经够长了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00aduplic_000065db_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, so much for the civilized approach. Because this clearly isn't working. Try using your fists instead of your tongue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那么文明的方法就到此为止了。因为它显然行不通。试试用你的拳头而不是舌头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudreyfin_0000aaed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, technically, it's kill, be killed, or be someone's bitch. Some people are happy to go with door number three.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，严格来说，就是杀人、被杀或者做某人的婊子。有些人很乐意选择第三个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher1e_0000346b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that and I'd need a second job to afford the rent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，还有就是我需要第二份工作才能负担得起房租。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc30320b_00005cd1_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that depends on how far you're willing to go. I'm sure there's a chem that'll fix her up just as good as any shrink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那得看你愿意走多远，我敢说有药能让她跟看心理医生一样好
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [11000DAB] (mod) Quest : ([11000DAE]x3DNPCrivetcity) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmale\x3dnpcrive_x3dnpcrivetcity_00000dcd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that depends on what you mean by "better." Or rather, the process you aim to use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这取决于你对“更好”的定义。或者更确切地说，你打算使用的过程。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01d_00004bc3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that didn't seem to bother your dad because he left before any of us. Hell, if they paired me up with him I might've stayed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这似乎没有困扰你爸爸，因为他比我们所有人都先离开了。天啊，如果他们把我跟他配对，我可能会留下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01b_00009652_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that monument he wants us to blow up? Kind of a big deal. I don't think a few grenades is gonna do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他要我们炸掉的那个纪念碑？那可是个大工程。我不觉得几颗手榴弹就能搞定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00a_00005a3a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that monument he wants us to blow up? Kind of a big deal. I don't think a few grenades is gonna do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他要我们炸掉的那个纪念碑？那可是个大工程。我不觉得几颗手榴弹就能搞定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas00b_0000342c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that was a lovely foray. I don't think I'd want to come back to this town though, ants or no ants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这趟走得挺有意思。但不管有没有蚂蚁，这破镇子我都不想再来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that would've been nice. I get what you mean though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那倒是不错。不过我明白你的意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel19i_00005f05_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's a shame, because Audrey would love an excuse to eat your brains.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那就可惜了，因为奥黛丽很想找个借口吃你的脑子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's going to leave a mark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这会留下个印记的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_combattonormal_000369ec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's not entirely a bad thing. I certainly wouldn't mind the attention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那不完全是件坏事。我当然不介意被关注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpchs0b_000180ff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's not entirely true, I don't like anything, least of all sneaking around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不全对…老子看啥都不顺眼，尤其烦潜行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000cc9b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's why you eat them first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这就是为什么你要先吃掉它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the guy you're looking for is with a group of people staying at the Weatherly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要找的那家伙，和一群人住在天气利酒店。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4eb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the old Mason Dixon line separated the North from the South.
ESP.TRADUIT: 梅森-迪克逊线曾分隔北方与南方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc04_00007a43_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the other day I found this key in my jacket. Never seen it before in my entire life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前几天外套里发现这把钥匙，这辈子从没见过
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc101exita_00000827_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the shacks get too crowded. Most of us have a hard time living in the same town, let alone sleeping in the same room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，棚屋太拥挤了。我们大多数人很难住在同一个镇上，更别说睡在同一个房间里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01b_000065e1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the spies in the holotape stories wear tuxedos and mix martinis with their ding-a-ling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，全息磁带故事里的间谍穿着燕尾服，用他们的小鸡鸡调马提尼酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpcaranaskin_00003411_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the war with the Germans is over. You can stay in our country and build Volkswagons. For now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，和德国人的战争结束了。你们可以留在我们国家，制造大众汽车。暂时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00005a4b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the whole water into wine bit does seem to be less pocus and more hocus if you ask me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你问我的话，把水变成酒那部分似乎更像是戏法，而不是魔法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_000142bb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the whole water into wine bit does seem to be less pocus and more hocus if you ask me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你问我的话，把水变成酒那部分似乎更像是戏法，而不是魔法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_0001570a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then I guess you'll be liking me less and less as time goes by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那我猜随着时间的推移，你会越来越不喜欢我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudreyfin_00016cc1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there goes that plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那个计划泡汤了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcboopbeuc_00003784_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's a reason we didn't talk to you for the rest of that summer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那年夏天我们不跟你说话是有原因的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005ce2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's always going to be some weirdness. Whole Brotherhood started on account of jocks and nerds trying to mount the higher horse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，总是会有些怪异之处。整个兄弟会就是因为运动员和书呆子都想骑更高的马而成立的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3b1_0000271b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's birds, and bees, and then you get to second base and...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，有鸟，有蜜蜂，然后你们就到了二垒……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this diner is rather grisly. Nice of the raiders to warn us they were coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这餐厅够瘆人。掠夺者还"好心"留了警告标语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000369f8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this is a delightful little wharf. I'd love to sit down and have a Chardonnay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小码头挺别致。真想坐这儿喝杯霞多丽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00036a02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this is an odd little town. So many dull looks and sweaty palms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这镇子可真够怪的。满大街都是眼神发直手心冒汗的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000255ed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this is Jury Street. There's two separate tunnels connecting from the main station. We want to take the door that's locked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿是陪审街。主站台连着两条隧道，咱们得走锁着门那条。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00005959_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this isn't American Top 40. If you want a fucking autograph, it'll have to wait until we deal with this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可不是点歌台，想要签名等处理完这破事再说
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00001f29_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this shopkeeper must be doing quite well if she can afford her own mercenary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 店主能雇得起私人佣兵，看来买卖做得挺红火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370be_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, those Brotherhood of Steel jerks won't let me up the tower, but you're different. You smell nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那些钢铁兄弟会的混蛋不让我上塔，但你不同。你闻起来很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00003439_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, Tommy's cousin was supposed to bring over the dope, so we're gonna need to replace that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汤米表弟本该带毒品来，现在得找补了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_0000338a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we did it his way last time and look where it got us? Nowhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，上次我们按他的方法做了，结果呢？一无所获。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq4_00002703_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we first need to take him to a special clinic. It's about two days' walk from here. Are you up for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们首先需要带他去一个特殊的诊所。从这里走需要两天。你愿意去吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop02_0000268e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we were play fighting, and I got a little too excited and broke the digeridoo on his high five hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们当时在玩闹，我有点太兴奋了，把他的击掌手上的迪吉里杜管弄坏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc1_00001bfe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we'll have to find out where this Gabriel makes his home. And even if we find it, I doubt we'll be welcome with open arms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们得找到这个加布里埃尔的老巢。即使我们找到了，我怀疑我们也不会受到热烈欢迎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcquesttask_00010932_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, well. Looks like the diner's gonna get a new fry cook. Sounds like something you should excel at.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，瞧瞧。看来这家餐馆要有一个新炸厨了。听起来你很擅长这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\maleuniquebrotch\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcturnintes_00008184_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we're all a little crazy. But there's a difference between cuckoo crazy and general anxiety disorder with a case of mild social phobia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们都有一点疯狂。但疯疯癫癫和伴有轻度社交恐惧的广泛性焦虑症是有区别的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4a1_0000272a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we're basically like knights. But instead of CLANG CLANG we're more like PEW PEW! Pewing is the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们基本上就像骑士。但我们不是“铿铿”作响，我们更像是“biu biu”！“Biu”是最好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_00002709_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what do we have here? Let me guess. You've heard of the mistress who makes all your fantasies come true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 稀客呀！让我猜——您定是听闻了"实现所有幻想的魔女"大名？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lily [1100106D] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00001a63_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what if I bought it out of my own pocket?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那要是我自掏腰包呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdotcarneg_0000094c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, when he first arrived, one of my girls approached him and told him it was one hundred caps for the room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他刚来的时候，我的一个姑娘上前跟他说，房间要一百瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_0000352f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, when I first found the place, I was just looking for a place to spend the night. But I thought, when life gives you lemons, make lemonade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当我最初发现这个地方时，我只是想找个地方过夜。但我想，当生活给你柠檬时，就做柠檬水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot03_0000536c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, when parents teach their kids to read, most use whatever Pre-War book they can find. Mine happened to use something called the "tax code."
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当父母教孩子读书时，大多数人会用他们能找到的战前书籍。而我的父母碰巧用的是一本叫做“税法”的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs01_00001b0c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, when you put it that way, I find it hard to disagree.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，既然你这么说，我就很难不同意了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01a_00010910_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, when you're good at keeping secrets, you deal with slaves and slavers alike.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，要是你擅长保守秘密，你就会和奴隶、奴隶贩子打交道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic4_0000ee35_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, whenever I get in a fight, my strategy is to just charge in and start flailing. Maybe give 'em the crazy eye while I'm at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以不，我根本不懂什么战斗和战术之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher4_00003485_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, wherever we are, we got company!
ESP.TRADUIT: 管它在哪，有客人来了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc100b_00000a29_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, with Marie dead and Randy too, I think Molerat will get the shack next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，随着玛丽和兰迪也死了，我认为鼹鼠鼠将得到下一个棚屋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01_00009566_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, with the Obelisk destroyed, I'm going to petition the government to create a new monument in its place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，既然方尖碑被摧毁了，我打算向政府请愿，在原址上建立一座新的纪念碑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00005a47_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, working for a slaver is a new experience. I suppose it's my fault. I did mention it's always good to try new things. This isn't what I meant when I said it though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给奴隶贩子打工倒是新体验。怪我，老说该尝试新事物——虽然当初不是指这种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003b9f7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you better not be thinking about heading too far east.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好别想去太东边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx04_00003dad_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you can try the terminal on the desk. I did see some notes, but they were for military grade security bots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你可以试试桌子上的那个终端。我确实看到一些笔记，但那是给军用级安全机器人用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac08a_00004ce8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you definitely had me going there for a second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你确实让我紧张了一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a4_000053a0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you did, didn't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你做了，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000b1ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you know how you buy a toy, and it says "no assembly required?" This is just in case Beep-Beep doesn't say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你知道你买一个玩具，上面写着“无需组装”吗？这只是为了以防哔哔没说那句话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc7c_00002308_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you must like doing favors then. Because that's pretty much all you'll be doing when she's around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你一定很喜欢帮忙了。因为她在的时候，你基本上就只能干这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopic0_0000ee2e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you saw what happened. I was here the whole time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你看到了发生了什么。我一直在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_000096bb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you should know, that slave from the vault said he was looking for you. Said you were a friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你应该知道，那个来自避难所的奴隶说他在找你。说你是他的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03ha_00001c31_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're in luck lady. That's exactly what I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，女士，你走运了。这正是我所做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcplayconv0_0000439d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're in luck. I'm having a sale. Just 50 caps for a lifetime pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走运咯！特惠价——五十瓶盖终身票。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_greeting_000059b9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you've come to the right place cousin. This isn't just the river where the quantum flows. It's the source.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你来对地方了，表亲。这里不只是量子流淌的河流。这里是源头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_000080f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you've seen the size of these sheds. They aren't fit for more than a few people. But it's really about privacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也看到了这些棚子的大小。它们只能容纳几个人。但这主要是为了隐私。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02a_00006cdb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well...maybe I do care, just a smidge. Especially when it concerns that harlot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……也许我确实有点在乎。尤其是当这事牵扯到那个妓女时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5F] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler02\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c43_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're acquaintances, nothing more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是熟人，仅此而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're always looking for new blood, and saving the Wasteland isn't something you'll see on most people's resumes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一直在寻找新鲜血液，而拯救废土可不是大多数人简历上会有的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00c_00001c75_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were any of the raiders I killed your friends?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀掉的掠夺者里有你的朋友吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're good, honest folks here. I think it's best if we keep it that way. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是好人，诚实的人。我认为最好保持这样。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053b2_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're licking tears and splitting ears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们撕耳朵舔眼泪去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_goodbye_00007515_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're looking for some sciency stuff. Laws, razors, not the shaving kind of course, unless you're into that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在找一些科学的东西。法律，剃刀，当然不是那种刮胡子的，除非你喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq4_00002702_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're not builders, and we don't have much in the way of materials. But yeah, I've considered it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不是建筑工，也没有太多材料。但是，我考虑过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02c_00006cdc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're rolling downhill, all thanks to you. See, I had one of Canary's friends check out that bottle you gave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多亏了你，我们正在顺风顺水。你看，我让金丝雀的一个朋友检查了你给我的那个瓶子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000bed0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're rolling downhill, all thanks to you. Surprised? You shouldn't be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多亏了你，我们正在顺风顺水。感到惊讶吗？你不该惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000beb0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're still doing plays too. But it's more to honor Uncle Richard's sacrifice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还在排戏，主要是纪念理查德叔叔的牺牲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c9c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're up a tree, buckaroo. This unit's power supply must be replaced with parts from a duplicate prototype.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们陷入困境了，牛仔。本单元的电源必须用另一个原型机的零件替换。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot4_000029ec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you always this pragmatic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一直都这么务实吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've a got a 50 foot machine at our backs. How could I be nervous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们背后有一台五十英尺高的机器。我怎么能不紧张？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've been trying, but it's like speaking to child. And this child will rip your head off just as easily as any doll's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一直在努力，但这就像跟个孩子说话。而这个孩子会像撕扯任何一个娃娃的头一样轻易地撕掉你的脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01d_00002e83_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got prop guns we use on set, so it's best I keep this one close. It's too dangerous to just leave lying around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 剧组道具枪我收着，乱放太危险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c68_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got word that a former slaver is living in one of the ranch houses near Springvale. Gabriel says we'll know her by the jumpsuit. The other one is not to be harmed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得到消息说一个前奴隶贩子住在春谷镇附近的一所牧场里。加布里尔说我们可以通过连体衣认出她。另一个不能受到伤害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've stopped. What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 停这儿干嘛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_000355ca_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about a reward?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奖励呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about bringing in additional doctors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那再引进医生呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the Brotherhood of Steel patrol?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那钢铁兄弟会的巡逻队呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the other siblings?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那其他兄弟姐妹呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the others?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel19l_00005f12_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the previous owners? Anything about them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那以前的主人呢？有什么关于他们的信息吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the radiation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 辐射呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the rest of the gang?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那帮派其他人呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the slaves? Did any of them survive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那奴隶呢？有幸存下来的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about you? Did you manage to find Gabriel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你呢？你找到加百列了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_000142bd_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about you? Do you think I'm a rat too?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你呢？也觉得我是叛徒？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_greeting_00005d2e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about you? What are you here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你呢？你在这里做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3z_000030b6_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about your ideology concerning outsiders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对外来者的意识形态是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about your parents? Did they ever take the test?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的父母呢？他们参加过考试吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about your relationship with Kate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和凯特的关系怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What am I, your fucking guide? Find a road, follow it, and wreck it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是你他妈的向导吗？找条路，跟着走，然后把它毁了。
