ESP.ORIGINAL: When Coyote Ridge got a molerat problem, we put mines all over the floor. Sure, a bunch of folks lost their legs, but at least we got rid of the vermin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 郊狼岭闹鼹鼠时…老子满地铺雷。腿炸飞一堆…好歹灭了害虫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c65_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When did you first hear it ring?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你第一次听到它响是什么时候？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When did you get that halo on your head? You buy that at Bannon's store?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你脑袋上那圈圣光啥时搞的？班农杂货铺淘的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000034a5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When did you grow those horns on your head? You buy that at Shrapnel's? I gotta get me some.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你头上那对角啥时长出来的？榴弹那儿买的？我也得整一对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000034a4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When did you move in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么时候搬到这里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When finished, meet Cosmos at tall monument. That look like good place to plant flag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完成后在高塔纪念碑见科斯莫斯，那地方适合插旗
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Cosmos [110008BE] (mod) Quest : ([110008B8]x3DNPCccquest) Truth, Justice, and The Space-American Way EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcccvoice\x3dnpcccquest_x3dnpccc04_000008dc_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When humans built a better mousetrap, it wasn't to starve all the dirty fleabags. Just worked out that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当人类建造出更好的捕鼠器时，目的不是为了饿死所有肮脏的跳蚤包。只是结果如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4a_00002707_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I couldn't stand the smell any longer, I decided to hell with living and wrestled away a gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我再也受不了那股气味时，我决定去他的生活，然后抢了一把枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01e_000142bd_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I escaped, my first thought was to return to Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我逃出来时，我第一个想法是回到101号避难所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_00015f36_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I finally came for the master, he had the remote in his hand. But all it took was a second, just a moment of hesitation for me to snap his neck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我最后对付主人时，他手里拿着遥控器。但只需要一秒钟，一瞬间的犹豫，我就能扭断他的脖子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack03ga_00001c2b_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I first picked it up, it was mostly static. But then I started to hear a voice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚接起来的时候，大部分是静电。但后来我开始听到一个声音。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_00005380_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I found the body, it was pretty easy to figure out who killed her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我发现尸体时，很容易就能猜到是谁杀了她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_00005380_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I got here, my first thought was, "Does anyone live in this dump?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 我到这儿的时候，第一个念头是，“这破地方有人住吗？”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar02_00001c03_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I grow up, I wanna be this guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长大要当这号狠人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c67_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I grow up, I'm gonna be just like Captain Cosmos!
ESP.TRADUIT: 长大我要当宇宙队长那样的大英雄！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_0000117b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I shoot a guy, I like to say "Yeah, and your mother was ugly too!" You know, add a little insult to those injuries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我开枪打人的时候喜欢说：“嗯哼，你妈长得也丑！” 懂吧，给伤口上撒点盐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034b0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I visited the Temple of the Union, it wasn't a man who led them. It was a symbol. The head of Abraham Lincoln.
ESP.TRADUIT: 踏足联盟圣殿那日，统领众人的不是凡人——是象征。林肯总统之魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_greeting_0001429f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I was kid, I'd got picked on a lot. I didn't really know how to fight back, so I just went off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我咬人，朝他们眼睛里扔土，甚至必要时踢他们的蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher3_00003478_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When is Uncle Richard coming back? Roachard wants to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理查德叔叔啥时回来？罗查德想问呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Madison [11002F38] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c9f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When it comes to what goes on in my uncle's bedroom, the less I think about it, the better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说到我叔叔卧室里发生的事，我越少去想越好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5E] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler01\x3dnpcsett_x3dnpcsettlers0_00004c52_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When it was done, this unit went from diagnostic functions to teaching the little cowprodder survivalist techniques through role play.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完成后，本单元就从诊断功能转变为通过角色扮演，教小牛仔生存技巧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot2_000029d6_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When men play god they open the doors to madness. Now it's up to us to close them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当人类妄图扮演上帝的角色时，他们便开启了疯狂之门。现在，轮到我们来将其关闭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_0001566e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When my parents died, it was Beep Beep who made me feel less lonely. Will you be there when it's time for him to go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父母去世时，是哔哔让我感觉不那么孤单。当他该离开时，你会在那里吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1a_00002675_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When my parents died, it was Beep Beep who made me feel less lonely. Will you be there when it's time for him to go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父母去世时，是哔哔让我感觉不那么孤单。当他该离开时，你会在那里吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1b_00002676_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When my parents died, it was Beep Beep who made me feel less lonely. Will you be there when it's time for him to go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父母去世时，是哔哔让我感觉不那么孤单。当他该离开时，你会在那里吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_boopfinaltalk1c_00002677_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When she turned away, I just left. It was stupid, I know. But I thought if I just held on to that key, I could escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她转过身去的时候，我就离开了。我知道这很蠢。但我想，只要我拿着那把钥匙，我就能逃脱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h_0000643a_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the cops come, you just tell them I lent you my apartment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警察来的时候，你就告诉他们我把公寓借给你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc02duplicat_00001f3b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the last merc died, I heard him and Eightball say something about a bigger share, acting all smart cause he could do the math.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当最后一个佣兵死的时候，我听到他和八号球说些关于更大的份额的事情，因为他会算术所以显得很聪明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq2_0000a2e8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When there was six of us, we each got four months a year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们有六个人时，我们每人每年有四个月。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01c_000065e3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When they didn't come back, we knew something went wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他们没有回来时，我们就知道出了问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a2_00007a55_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When they do get wise, we drop prices. When we can't drop'em anymore, we pump 'em full of psycho and jet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他们清醒过来时，我们就降价。当我们不能再降价时，我们就给他们注射狂暴针和杰特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000beb1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you blow the bad guys up, it makes for a real bonding moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 炸飞坏蛋能增进感情
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00006e61_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you have family like I do, it absolutely would.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有像我这样的家人，那绝对会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000ab21_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you picked up the phone, I heard a voice, telling me to go back to the diner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你接电话时我听到个声音，叫我回餐馆
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcsecondrin_000009ba_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When your dad's done cleaning up the water, I wonder if he can help me cook up some chems. I'd hate to see that mind go to waste.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等您爹净完水…求他配点药？天才脑子别浪费嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c7d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you're a socialite, you learn to do a lot of things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 名媛圈混久了，本事自然长——
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005966_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you're ready, I'll arrange for a meeting with a friend in Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你准备好后，我会安排你在铆钉城和我的一位朋友见面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey120_0000b1f8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you're that flush with cash, you can fund a lot of strange projects that range from scary to idiotic, or worse yet, both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钱多烧得慌就能资助各种奇葩项目，从吓人到弱智，或者两者兼备
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac05_00000c5b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whenever I see a fountain full of water, I start to wonder what kind of water doesn't dehydrate. Suffice to say, I'd be wary about taking a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每次看到装满水的喷泉，我就在想：到底啥水喝了不会脱水？反正我喝水得多留神。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba08_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are the chems? I was told you were making batches of quantum gravity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 化学品在哪里？我听说你在制造成批的量子引力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are we going to get the explosives?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们去哪里弄炸药？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I find this slaver's house?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以在哪里找到这个奴隶贩子的房子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can we find another holotape series?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪里能找到另一个全息磁带系列？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can we find the next holotape?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以在哪里找到下一盘全息磁带？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did the people in this town come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个镇子里的人来自哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you get the name Spider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的名字“蜘蛛”是怎么来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you learn about servos and microcontrollers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是从哪里学到伺服电机和微控制器的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do I go to get stuff fixed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪儿能修东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11009627] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul02\x3dnpcghouls_hello_00001627_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do the ants come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 蚂蚁是从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you get your supplies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的补给是从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you know Dot from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从哪儿认识多特的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you think Moira hides her supplies anyway? Because it sure ain't here. Maybe we oughta go digging in that crater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说莫伊拉把补给藏哪儿？反正不在这儿…要不弹坑里刨刨？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007347_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you think Talon Company got the money to make them uniforms? You think they hired somebody? Well, we gonna put them outta work at this rate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说鹰爪的制服钱哪来的？他们请人做的？呵，照这么下去，咱们要让他们失业了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00001c5f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where I'm going though, stomach pain is the least of my worries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我要去的地方，肚子疼是我最不担心的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgabriel05_000081b0_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is Alicia now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 艾丽西亚现在在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is your spaceship?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的宇宙飞船在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where there's trash, there's flies. Big, juicy ones in chains and spiked armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪里有垃圾，哪里就有苍蝇。穿着锁链和带刺盔甲的大块头，汁水饱满的那种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_0000aa59_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where? There loot in this place isn't worth the clothes on my back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在哪里？这个地方的战利品连我身上的衣服都不值！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000b1ed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where'd you learn to fight?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是从哪里学会打架的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's Audrey? What have you done with her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥黛丽在哪里？你对她做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's Carver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡弗在哪儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's my mommy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈妈在哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022DB] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000022e0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's the name Slasher come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: “屠夫”这个名字是怎么来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wherever I've gone, I've taught my men to let go of their fear. It's what keeps them safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论我走到哪里，我都教导我的手下放下恐惧。那是保护他们安全的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_0001427f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whether it was a collar around my neck or a number on my back, I've spent my entire life as a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论是脖子上的项圈还是背上的号码，我一生都作为奴隶而活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmqgabriel_00014288_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which Brotherhood faction are you with? Do you serve under Elder Lyons?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你属于哪个兄弟会派系？你在里昂斯长老手下服务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which could be a blessing or a curse, depending on your feelings about the DJ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是福是祸全看你对主持人的喜恶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which does happen to cover a very large swath of things. We should really stop being so creative in how we kill each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这确实涵盖了非常广泛的事物。我们真的应该停止在互相残杀的方式上如此有创意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac02a_00001c81_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is just "Ugh." The G.O.A.T. said I was a cook, not a baby making machine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当时就“呃……”G.O.A.T.说我是厨师，不是生孩子的机器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01_0000964b_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is more than I can say for myself, but we all have our cross to bear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比我强多了，不过谁还没点糟心事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a_00008126_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is what I suggest for all of you. Get some sleep. We'll talk about it more tomorrow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这也是我对你们所有人的建议。去睡一觉吧。我们明天再多谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130s_00005361_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which judging by the size of it, is anyone's hands but ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据它的尺寸判断，除了我们，谁的手都拿不住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00003e44_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which judging by the size of it, is anyone's hands but ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据它的尺寸判断，除了我们，谁的手都拿不住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00b_00006798_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which leads me to believe my suitors aren't exactly interested in chatting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这让我相信我的追求者们对聊天并不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which means I'll have to spend another year sleeping in the train car.
ESP.TRADUIT: 意味着我又得在火车厢里睡一年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00a_00006c9a_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which of course, makes it impossible to conduct business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这当然让生意没法做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpccb01_0000352f_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which would be all well and good if gambling profits weren't subject to IRS Form W2-G.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果赌博利润不受国税局W2-G表格的约束，那一切都好说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b20_4.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: While I can multiply any two integers, I have trouble doing the reverse - factoring numbers is almost like trying to speak backwards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 心算乘法我在行，因数分解却要命——简直像倒着说话！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_00002748_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: While I doubt there's enough of them to start harassing you on the road, I'd certainly take pause the next time someone at the bar winks at you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我怀疑他们的人数不足以在路上骚扰你，但我下次会警惕在酒吧里对你眨眼的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcquesttask_0001570e_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: While nobody here is a former slave, we've all been through hard times. This town here is our chance at living free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没人曾是奴隶，但我们都经历过艰难岁月。这座小镇是我们获得自由的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc04_00007a43_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: While this unit adapts to the little cowpuncher's preferences, its current personality matrix mixes in lingo from the Old West.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然本单元适应了小牛仔的喜好，但其当前的人格矩阵混合了老西部的俚语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot2_000026af_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whistleblowers are not rats. I think you did the right thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告密者不是老鼠。我认为你做得对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are these children?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些孩子是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are these people to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些人对你来说是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁来着？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patron [11000EF7] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00b_0000109b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you and what have you done with Mara?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底是谁？对玛拉做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you? Another spy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？又一个间谍？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpcaranaskin_00003415_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you? What are you doing in this store?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？你在这家店里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who can sleep after all that's happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 出了这些事谁还睡得着？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcsecondrin_0000098f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who collects the money?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁来收钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do you think killed the Brotherhood Outcast?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得是谁杀了钢铁兄弟会流放者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do you think would win in a fight behind Captain Cosmos and his monkey Jangles? Well, whatever the answer, I'm willing to bet it's racist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得太空队长和他的猴子“欢乐”打起来谁能赢？管他谁赢，反正我敢打赌答案准带种族歧视。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034af_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who else, but the greatest cat burglar you've never seen! La Fantoma! The Phantom!
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了你从未见过的最伟大的猫贼，还能有谁！夜魔侠！幻影！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_boop1b_000030af_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is this man you want dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让谁死？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who notified the police?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是谁通知的警察？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who runs the operation down below?
ESP.TRADUIT: 下面是谁在管理这个行动？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who said anything about "we?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁说过“我们”了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butcher [1100627F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcbutch165b_0000b097_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who sent you? Was it Stalin? Mao? Or was it President Roosevelt all along?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁派你来的？是斯大林？毛泽东？还是自始至终都是罗斯福总统？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Haskins [11004C66] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpchaskins04_00004c7d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the fuck are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈谁啊？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcbutchervoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_000087ce_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who was Chapel's father?
ESP.TRADUIT: 小教堂的父亲是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who was this old woman?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个老妇人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who was this woman?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个女人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa whoa whoa! That's a lot of blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嚯！血也忒多了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000735e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa...are those stars real?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇靠…这些星星是真的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000b0fc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa...is it me? Or is the world spinning?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇噢…是我晕？咋全世界打转儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patron [11000EF7] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_greeting_0000108f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa...is it me? Or is the world spinning?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇噢…是我晕？咋全世界打转儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patron [11000EF7] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_hello_00001092_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoever started this town put it in the wrong place. The rules in this era are the same as ancient times. No walls, no safety.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管是谁建的这个城镇，位置选错了。这个时代和古代一样，没有城墙，就没有安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_idlechatter_00014faf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoops. Didn't think you saw that. Awkward...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀。我以为你没看到。真尴尬……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whose turn is it this month?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个月轮到谁了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why a conductor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么是导体？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why a Steam Gauge Assembly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么是蒸汽压力表组件？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why am I your slaver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么我是你的奴隶主？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are holotapes better than radio? They just are. Trust me. I'm one of those whatchmacallits. Audio files.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为啥全息磁带比收音机好？就是好，信我，我是那个啥，音频文件
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00006e62_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you in search of this protoype?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要寻找这个原型？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you rehearsing plays?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要排练戏剧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you researching the theory of quantum gravity?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么研究量子引力理论？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't they moving?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么不动了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_greeting_0000808b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't you just tell them the truth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不能直接告诉他们真相？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you kill Alicia?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么杀了艾丽西亚？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you kill Carver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么杀了卡弗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you leave the vault?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么离开避难所？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you let a mutant into the brothel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么让一个变种人进妓院？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't you all try to escape together?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你们没有一起尝试逃跑？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't you say anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么什么都没说？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they call 'em "potato crisps?" Aren't they potato chips?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为啥叫"洋芋脆片"？薯片不就得了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11007483] (mod) Quest : ([11007481]x3DNPCmegatonmoriarty) MegatonMoriarty EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletavern01\x3dnpcmega_hello_00007482_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they call you Canary Sam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么叫你“金丝雀山姆”？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they call you Eightball?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么叫你八号球？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they call you Molerat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么他们叫你鼹鼠鼠？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they call you Mortar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么叫你“迫击炮”？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they gotta be eating people? That's some fucked up shit right there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为啥非得吃人？真他妈邪门…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00003499_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they gotta be eating people? That's some fucked up shit right there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为啥非得吃人？真他妈邪门…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000349b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you consider the Outcasts a problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么认为“弃儿”是个问题？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you consider the Outcasts a problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为何视流放者为祸患？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you like holotapes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么喜欢全息磁带？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you need scrap metal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么需要废金属？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you say that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么这么说？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you still wear your slave collar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么还戴着你的奴隶项圈？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you think they sent these men after you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么觉得他们会派这些人来追你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does Atom preach division? Are we not supposed to come together?
ESP.TRADUIT: 原子为何倡分裂？众生不该归一？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child of Atom [11008210] (mod) Quest : ([11008212]x3DNPCmegatonchurch) Megaton Church EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleatom01\x3dnpcmegatonchurch_hello_00008213_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does that not surprise me? Jesus Mara, he had a wife and two kids! That store was the only income they had!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么我一点都不惊讶？天啊，玛拉，他有妻子和两个孩子！那家店是他们唯一的收入来源！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sean [110055EE] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcseanvoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_00006406_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you explain it to me like I'm older than five years old.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能不能解释得像我比五岁大一些？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you lie down and I'll show you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不躺下，我给你看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why else? For the chems! I tell you, that Cindi Cantelli has enough gear to put you in permanent overdrive.

ESP.TRADUIT: 吃乔做的菜，唯一死亡的就是你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With lasers. But your idea is better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用激光。但你的主意更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002b07_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Marie dead, I guess that means someone else is getting her shack. Hehe, and guess whose turn it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛丽死了，看来她的棚屋该换人了，嘿嘿猜轮到谁了
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Molerat [11005EE4] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmoleratvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00005f08_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Molerat moving in, we all had to give him two of our weeks just to make things even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随着鼹鼠搬进来，我们都不得不给他两周的时间，才能让事情公平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01c_000065e3_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With only four of us, that means we all get half a year. It's not the way I would've liked it to happen, but it does give us more space.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有我们四个人，意味着我们每人都能得到半年。这不是我希望发生的方式，但它确实给了我们更多空间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc01_00009566_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Richard's dead, the situation's changed. There's no one else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理查德死了，情况变了。没有别人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Tetramethrin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 用四氟甲醚菊酯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002b05_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With that kind of attitude, we'll never rebuild this world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱着这种态度，我们永远无法重建这个世界。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the combination lost, does this mean your inheritance is gone forever?
ESP.TRADUIT: 组合丢失了，这是否意味着你的遗产永远消失了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the dish activated, we should be getting a crystal clear signal from GNR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天线启动后，该收到银河新闻台的清晰信号了——
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000370b0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the town raids, it must be so hard for these people to have a normal day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇子老被抢，这些人想过安稳日子太难了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001847f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the understanding that they could sell this product, they've allowed me to continue my research.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他们以为可以出售这种产品的前提下，他们允许我继续我的研究。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([11005510]3DNPCScribeRadioPA) 3DNPC Scribe Radio PA

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the war over, the government believes they should be discarded. It's our opinion they can be reintegrated into society.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战争结束后，政府认为应该将它们废弃。我们认为它们可以重新融入社会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob01_00007256_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the world in shambles, we need technology now more than ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世界一片混乱，我们比以往任何时候都更需要科技。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without question, my dear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毫无疑问，我的宝贝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcquesttask_0001570e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woman give him plenty more than room ever could. You see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女人给他的远比房间能给的多。你懂的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woman sell woman. Room is where Charles get good time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女人卖女人。房间是查尔斯寻欢作乐的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't you run out of space?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的空间不会用完吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woo! Now that's a grade A burn. I'm gonna need some ice for that one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！那真是A级嘲讽。我得找点冰敷敷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03b_00001c3e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woo, ouch. Well, I guess we are now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，真疼。好吧，我想我们现在就是了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortarque_00008722_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woohoo! Back in action!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呜呼！重新开工！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([1100E586]x3dnpcBoopFollowQuest) BoopFollowQuest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcboop_followersletsgo_0000e59a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woohoo! Let's blow stuff up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呜呼！炸翻天去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([110033CF]x3dnpcFollowersARANAS) x3dnpcARANAS quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followershired_000033de_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woohoooo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呜呼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136cf_1.ogg Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136cf_1.ogg Faction : Agatha's Faction Quest : ([110136C8]x3dnpcJunkieQuest) 3dnpcJunkieQUest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoicem\x3dnpcjunkiequest_greeting_000136cf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Word is he's been asking about me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说他一直在打听我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Word's out all over the Wastes. Big Town, Megaton, any trader east of the Mississippi will tell you all about Quantum G.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这消息传遍了整个废土。大镇、兆吨镇，密西西比河以东的任何一个商人都会告诉你关于量子G的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_00008102_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wore it for about a whole week, and even got my superior to sign off on something he'll most assuredly regret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我戴着它整整一个星期，甚至让我上司签了名，他肯定会后悔的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4d_00002723_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Work...with Arthur? Oh no darling, my brothers and sisters are not the sort of people you want to partner with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和……亚瑟合作？哦不，亲爱的，我的兄弟姐妹不是那种你想合作的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey06a_000066d4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Worse than pets. They think we're family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比宠物更糟。他们认为我们是家人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Underworld Resident [11009626] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul01\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul04e_0000161d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you consider joining the Temple of the Union?
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑加入联合圣殿吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you have preferred an armed escort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你宁愿要一个武装护卫吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you like to hear about our state of the art, nuclear powered convertibles?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想了解尖端核动力敞篷车吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11035C83]x3DNPCmissHandyquest) Miss Handy EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobotmisshandy\x3dnpcmiss_greeting_00035c95_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you? Our current collector hasn't been back for ages, so it'd really help if you could replace him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意吗？我们现在的收税员已经很久没有回来了，所以如果你能顶替他，那真的会有很大帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs02_00001b1a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't fit in a bra, anyway. Good thing I'm not wearing one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正塞不进胸罩里。还好我没穿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11004C64]x3dnpcHaskins) Haskins Dialogue EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpchask_x3dnpcaranaskin_00005a31_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, big question. I don't know. I used to be so outgoing. Kate and Sean used to follow me everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，好大的问题。我不知道。我以前很外向。凯特和肖恩以前总跟着我到处跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01_00008089_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, I didn't expect you to kill him, but you got rid of him all the same. I'm impressed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嚯，没成想您直接下死手…不过结果一样，佩服！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00005699_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, it's been so long since I've seen a real tree. But part of me thinks this is another lie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多少年没见过真树了...可总觉得又是骗局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000874c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, it's heavy. Maybe Beep-Beep won't need it after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，好重。也许哔哔根本不需要它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpc7c1_00002310_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, so it's like that, huh. You and Kate really know how to dish out the tough love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，原来是这样，是吧。你和凯特真的很懂得严酷的爱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01z_00008098_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, that sounds harsh. I never liked Gabe...he was always so moody, but I wouldn't wish that on anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，这听起来太苛刻了。我从不喜欢盖博……他总是喜怒无常，但我不会希望这种事发生在任何人身上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia04a_00009666_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, that's neat. Okay, what's sixteen times a billion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，真厉害。好的，十六乘以十亿是多少？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002af4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, these rangers really put up a fight. We better get them out of here though. I don't think they've slept a wink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵真能扛啊。得赶紧带他们撤，这帮人眼皮都没合过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000b5dd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you were never this worried about me when we were in the vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，我们还在避难所的时候，你可没这么担心过我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia04_0000965f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you're really nice! Does that mean you always finish last? Well, not this time. I'm gonna give you my best laser as a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你人真好！这是否意味着你总是最后一名？嗯，这次不会了。我要把我最好的雷射枪作为奖励给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq5c_00002bda_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you're smart. I heard some people say ghouls were scary but you're really nice. You should play with us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你真聪明。我听说有人说尸鬼很可怕，但你人真的很好。你应该和我们一起玩！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop05_00002650_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. And I thought my old high school was bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嚯，跟我那破高中一比都算好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00017daf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. I didn't expect it to be so...quiet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，没想到会这么...安静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007288_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. I didn't expect it to be so...quiet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，没想到会这么...安静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007308_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. That's some offer. Wait a minute...what's the catch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇。这个提议很棒。等等……有什么附加条件吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02_000033d4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. This must be the lab. I hope we didn't shoot anything important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嚯，这肯定是实验室了。但愿没打坏重要东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9e6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wrong place, wrong time? Looks like you were just as surprised as I was when he drew that weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 错误的时间，错误的地点？看来他拔出武器时，你和我一样惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00d_000033b4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wrong, Scribe Hammond. Five is a prime number. It is a cyst suppurating on the chin of an otherwise perfect square.
ESP.TRADUIT: 错，文书汉蒙德。五是一个质数。它是一个在完美正方形下巴上流脓的囊肿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002ceb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wrong, sir. I've been here all my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 错了，先生。我这辈子都住在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 错了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: W-Well I do know a bit about theoretical physics. But I'm afraid that might not be the answer you or the people in that house are looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我确实懂一些理论物理。但我恐怕这可能不是你或那栋房子里的人正在寻找的答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0d2_0000b07b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: W-well I don't know. I'm a physicist. I don't know a thing about chemistry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我——我不知道。我是一个物理学家。我对化学一窍不通。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc4c_0000beac_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: W-Well I know what I said. But your question hardly serves as an adequate example of this talent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我、我当然知道我说了什么。但你的问题很难作为一个恰当的例子来展示我的才能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002b02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: W-Well, you'd be helping to advance the cause of science! There is no nobler goal in all the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃——好吧，你是在帮助推进科学事业！这在全世界都是最崇高的目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc0a2_0000b06b_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，格雷格·哈斯金斯那种爱国者不可能躲这儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, they might save us from the mutants. But they won't save us from ourselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，能救咱躲变种人，但救不了咱自己
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac03_00000c68_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, we'll have to see what the coroner says.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我们得看看验尸官怎么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00c_00002ccb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well, you won. So you're the boss. Not much else too it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，嗯，你赢了。所以你是老大。没什么别的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02c_00002c46_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, who needs the world when you got friends like me and Beep Beep!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，当你有我和哔哔这样的朋友时，谁还需要整个世界！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_boop0a_0000268c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯嗯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯嗯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you too! Be sure to check your results with Brotch the Crotch. Maybe we'll even be working together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，你也是！记得和臭脾气布罗奇一起检查你的结果。也许我们还会一起工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [110066E2] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia00d_00008190_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你的时机至少可以说相当不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs60a_0000201a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. But in the end knowing you got out safe was the only thing that mattered to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。但最终，对他来说，知道你安全出来了才是唯一重要的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001ba02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Ever since I joined that raider crew, I don't take fights that bore me. But you were a challenge. You remind me of my first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。自从我加入那伙掠夺者后，我不会打那些让我觉得无聊的架。但你是个挑战。你让我想起了我的第一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02a3_00003dc7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Good idea. Okay, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。好主意。好的，给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patron [11000EF7] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_x3dnpcdrunk00a_00001099_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. He was half naked, holding what I think was a five iron with a skull on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。他半裸着，手里拿着一个我猜是五号铁杆的东西，上面有个骷髅头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_x3dnpcmortar03_00001c42_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I do. But I don't care if you did. I mean, we were stealing. Telling McKinley was the right thing to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。我这么觉得。但我不在乎是不是你。我的意思是，我们是在偷东西。告诉麦金利是正确的做法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kate [110055E6] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckatevoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo04_00005d16_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I don't blame you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我不怪你
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon01b_00000966_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I got a feeling Lyons and them Steel folks are cooking up one hell of a surprise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我有一种预感，里昂和那些钢铁兄弟会的人正在准备一个天大的惊喜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_00007337_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I miss him lots. Just like I miss Mama and Papa too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我很想他。就像我也很想妈妈和爸爸一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcbeep_booppostquest_00006012_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I remember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对。我记得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo02_00005cc2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I think the best way to get over what happened is to get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我觉得忘掉过去最好的办法就是回去工作
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdot02_0000092c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I was just thinking about that simulation. Tranquility Lane, you called it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我只是在想那个模拟。你称它为宁静巷？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpctranquili_00018470_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I wish I'd been a little bit faster. It's my fault he's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我希望我能再快一点。他死了是我的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcrichardge_00003ca5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I'll be fine. Before we met, I used to wonder what would've happened if I never took that job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我会没事的。在我们相遇之前，我曾想过如果我没有接受那份工作会发生什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmarabonu_0000eb36_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I'm not sorry for what I did. I'm angry I didn't do it sooner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我不为我做的事感到抱歉。我只是后悔没有早点做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00b_0000812e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. It's a few days hike, but having what looks like a bodyguard with me will help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。虽然要走几天，但有像你这样的保镖跟着会很有帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic4_00002663_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. It's kind of scary how natural it comes to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。这对我来说如此顺其自然，有点吓人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcmaramq096_0001ba00_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Knowing me, you might have an easier time changing the sign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，以我的记性，改招牌可能更容易
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcdotcarneg_00000941_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Let's do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我们走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc404_x3dnpcmara90f_00007301_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Mason Dixon can go to hell, but I wouldn't mind digging a few graves along the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。梅森·迪克森可以下地狱，不过我不介意在路上多挖几个坟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00d_0000815d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Maybe that's why I'm with you. Never felt what it was like to be on the other side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。也许这就是我跟你在一起的原因。我从没感受过在另一边的感觉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynxmonol_00001c50_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。现在长老认为它在图书馆档案里。

ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。现在你知道了。也明白我为何非走不可。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00a_0000812d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. She used to be muscle for one of the raider gangs that ran the metro.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。她曾经是管理地铁的掠夺者帮派的打手之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam3_000087c6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. She was a tough son of a bitch too. But Super Mutants are on another level.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，她也是个狠角色，但超级变种人是另一个级别

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc01_0000083a_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。这就是我不得不离开的原因。也是我永远无法回来的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc00d_00008130_1.ogg

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303200h_0000643a_1.ogg
