ESP.ORIGINAL: You again? Ha, people know you better than they know me, and I live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是您？哈！街坊认您比认我这本地人还熟！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_greeting_000180e2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You almost sound disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听起来几乎有点失望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and me both. You because you're tough, me because I'm on a shitload of chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们俩都是。你是因为你很坚强，我则是因为我吸了大量的化学品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslashermq_00007335_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are a murderer, and that woman deserves her vengeance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是杀人犯，那女人该找你报仇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are one of us. Whether that starts today or tomorrow is besides the point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我们中的一员。这无论是从今天开始还是明天开始，都无关紧要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpchs0c_000180fd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You aren't going to find anything in Megaton, because back then Megaton didn't exist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在兆吨镇找不到任何东西，因为那时兆吨镇还不存在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00c_00002a46_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better hurry too. I took a peek outside, and we've got more hostiles at the front door.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好也快点。我向外面偷看了一眼，前门有更多的敌对分子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac08_00004cf0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bumble around a bit, and there's less of a connection between, you, me, and our Free Man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好东晃西晃一阵，这样我们、你、还有我们的自由人之间的联系就不那么明显了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenq_x3dnpczentopica_0000f4e8_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can cook and make babies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会做饭，还会生娃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can drag my name through the mud, but I'm not going to let someone tarnish an entire institution with some wild tale about drugs and sodomy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以把我的名字搞臭，但我不会让任何人用一些关于毒品和鸡奸的荒唐故事来玷污整个机构。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc01_00001f39_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can find Confessor Cromwell out preaching by Atom's Gift.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克伦威尔牧师常在"原子恩赐"那儿布道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_greeting_000180e4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can have any open spot save the one under my feet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我脚下这块随便挑
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00000834_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can keep the stupid book. I don't need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 破书还你！我才不要！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sally [11003204] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c78_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can move on. Pretend you never saw it. I'll guard the phone every night and make sure nobody else gets hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以继续生活。假装你从未见过。我会每晚守护电话，确保没有别人再受伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpccarnegie1_0000537d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can never be too careful. All right, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心总没错。好了，拿去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can see how that story doesn't make much sense. It's better if you just tell the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，这个故事说不通。你最好还是说实话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcbrooks01c_0000337f_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can talk to me, you can talk to Sam. Hell, you can even talk to Butch if you're fixing for a headache.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以跟我说话，你可以跟萨姆说话。去他妈的，如果你想头疼的话，你甚至可以跟布奇说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq3eightba_0000956f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can try and warn the fiends, but I doubt they'd listen. Too much brain damage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以试着警告那些疯子，但我怀疑他们会听。他们的脑子受损太严重了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Canary Sam [110087AF] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsquantum_0000b0ff_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can try, but it won't matter. Every single building is a house of cards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以试试，但这没用。每一栋建筑都是纸牌屋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc01b_000022c3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't be fucking serious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈在逗我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't be serious! You heard the phone! You saw the diner!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是开玩笑吧！你听到电话了！你看到了那家餐馆！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130f_00005351_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't charge me a toll for land you don't own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能对我没有所有权的土地收费。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't do this. I'm Casey fucking Clarkson! I'm the voice of Top 40 radio!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能这么干！老子是凯西·克拉克森！点歌台Top40的金嗓子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00000819_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't with these laws. They don't fight fair. Especially gravity. She's kind of dick. Always with the put downs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能对抗这些定律。它们不公平。尤其是引力。它有点像个混蛋。总是打击别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2b_000026fd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You carry yourself like a military officer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你举止像个军官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You come to see the play? I've never acted in front of an audience before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来看戏的吗？我还没给真人演过呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00001a87_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could burn them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干脆烧了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could come with me. I have plenty of holotapes you can listen to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以跟我来。我有很多全息磁带可以给你听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could do that, but you'd probably need to sneak in anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以那样做，但你可能无论如何都需要偷偷溜进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac01a_0000232f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could have been gentler, no doubt about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你明明可以更温柔些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could try the Temple of the Union. Some of the free men might know what happened to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以试试联邦圣殿。一些自由人可能知道他发生了什么事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempster2_000180dc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could've given me some warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你本可以提前给我一点警告。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did a fine job kid. We swept this pile of dust right under the rug, and you my friend, are one hell of a broom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得漂亮小子，咱们把烂摊子扫地毯下了，而你他妈是把好扫帚
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_00003392_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did good kid. It was fun working with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得不错小子。跟你搭档挺痛快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hawk [11000D24] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult02\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_00002a40_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did good, helping Hannibal. Slavery's bad news, and we need men like him to fight it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮汉尼拔做得对。奴隶制是毒瘤，就得靠他这种人抗争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dcf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did more than give a hand. That was practically overkill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你何止搭把手，简直用力过猛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't bring any caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里，我只是另一个可怜的瘾君子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't have to do this. Really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真没必要这样。真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't have to mention the body. But what's done is done. Hopefully you're someone we can trust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你本不必提尸体，但事已至此，希望你是可信之人
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_0000539d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't see a goddamn thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈什么都没看到！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_x3dnpc130e_00005350_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't tell us about the blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没告诉我们有血。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00002cc0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't think I'd let him get away with trying to play me did you? All things considered, he got off easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会以为我能让他耍我还能安然无恙吧？总的来说，他算是便宜了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightballn_0000c584_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do realize I can just walk under it, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当我不能从底下钻过去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do that darling, and the only person you'll kill is yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是敢那么做，亲爱的，唯一会死的只有你自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey04a_00005977_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do this for me, and I'll make sure you're taken care of. Casey Clarkson doesn't forget his friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为我做这件事，我保证你会得到照顾。凯西·克拉克森不会忘记他的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpc00b_00001f35_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do. Maybe you ought to give me some of your caps so you don't buy more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有啊。要不分我点瓶盖？省得你再买。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't get it, do you asshole. You don't have a choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不懂，对吧，混蛋。你没得选。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx01b_00002c02_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't seem too shaken over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看着倒挺镇定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't sound too enthusiastic to leave though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你听起来不太想离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_0000b0ed_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't think it'll ever find you, but the truth is, it doesn't have to. It's already here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得自己永远不会被它找上，但事实是，它根本不必去找你。它已经在这里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't understand, doc. This isn't any ordinary cooties virus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不明白，医生。这可不是普通的“讨厌鬼”病毒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplay_x3dnpcpatientze_00003576_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't wanna do that bub. I got a bomb strapped to my chest. You kill me, you get your ass blown off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不想那么做，老兄。我胸口绑着炸弹。你杀了我，你他妈的屁股也会被炸飞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [110059AF] (ID) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll0c_000059c2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You entered the correct password.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您输入了正确的密码。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You entered the correct password. Power to the main console restored. Re-booting systems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您输入了正确的密码。主控制台电源恢复。重启系统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You entered the incorrect password. Project ZK Ultra activating emergency defense measures. Locking on target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您输入的密码不正确。ZK超级计划启动紧急防御措施。锁定目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever feel like your grenades are talking to you? Like they're sitting in your hand saying "pull the pin, pull the pin, pull the pin!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有觉得你的手榴弹在跟你说话？就像它们在你手里说：“拔掉保险销，拔掉保险销，拔掉保险销！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_idlechatter_00006e66_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever get so high you forget people's names? I don't think I'm at that point George, but you tell me if I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你嗨到记不住人名过没？乔治，我觉得我还没到那境界，要不你鉴定下？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_00003498_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever get so high you forget people's names? I don't think I'm at that point Martha, but you tell me if I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你嗨到记不住人名过没？玛莎，我觉得我还没到那境界，要不你鉴定下？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_00003497_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever need anything, just ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要帮忙尽管开口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_goodbye_00006c97_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever stop at a stop sign, just because? I mean, what if some fool in a sports car comes barreling down the other side?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会不会就为遵守而停在停车标志前？我是说，万一哪个开跑车的蠢货从另一边冲过来呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034aa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever take the vault tour here? It's like walking through a goddamn zoo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逛过避难所观光没？活像逛他妈动物园。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000349c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever try on one of them Pre-War suits? It's like wearing clothes made of sandpaper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你穿过那些战前的套装吗？就像穿着砂纸做的衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstrade_000034be_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever wipe your ass and think, who was it that taught me how to do this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你擦屁股时可曾想过——这手艺谁教的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_000034b4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You exist. You contribute to the decay of civility. Not that I blame you. I'm just as guilty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的存在，你助长了文明的衰落。我并不是在责怪你。我同样有罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey00a_0000968a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You find everything okay, ma'am?
ESP.TRADUIT: 找齐东西了吗，女士？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0000eb26_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You find everything okay, sir?
ESP.TRADUIT: 找齐东西了吗，先生？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00008076_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You find vital research notes written by a Pre-War graduate student. You can return this to Scribe Hammond or allow the Doctor to decipher and publicize the research.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你发现一个战前研究者写的重要研究笔记。你可以把这个还给文员哈蒙德或者让博士破译并公布研究结果。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You found an old woman's corpse inside. The body has yet to fully decompose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在里面发现了一具老妇人的尸体。尸体还没有完全腐烂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You from these parts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 本地人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You fuck me Butch and I'll have to kill you. And that'd be a violation of my parole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，你他妈的动我一下，我就得杀了你。而那将违反我的假释。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightbutch_000087de_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You fucking asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F1B]x3dnpc303) x3dnpcroom404 EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpc303_x3dnpc303convo06_00005cef_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get a five hundred caps, and we have a deal. Until then, it's best you get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给我五百瓶盖，我们就成交。在那之前，你最好滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_00009576_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get about five minutes, tops. Talk too much, and my man will run out of patience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最多有五分钟时间。废话太多，我的手下会失去耐心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_00009577_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get about five minutes, tops. Talk too much, and my man will run out of patience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最多有五分钟时间。废话太多，我的手下会失去耐心。.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq3_00009578_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get angry? I've seen pictures of the old world, and it's so much better now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你生气？我看过旧世界照片，现在强多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get out by proving your humanity, which you and Mara have done. You by default, Mara through her decisions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你通过证明自己的人性来出去，你和玛拉都做到了。你是因为你的本质，玛拉是通过她的决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice1\x3dnpc404_x3dnpc404rob02d_00007263_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get the key, you go to the factory, and you find your man. Because this vault dweller you're chasing, he's too smart to leave the supply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿了钥匙冲进厂子逮人！您追那避难所居民精得很，肯定猫在补给堆里呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000f4f3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get used to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会习惯的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You go down there, enter the password, then come up here and we'll blow the sucker up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你下去输密码，再上来咱们炸了这鬼东西
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_x3dnpcfac00a_00000d36_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You go on ahead. I just need to make some last minute calibrations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你先走，我调个参数马上来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_00002681_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You go out there often?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你经常去那里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You gonna make a dedication on air?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要做电台悼念环节？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00000809_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it partner. Simulations vary from gunfights to strategy to medical care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你懂的，伙伴。模拟内容从枪战到策略，再到医疗护理，多种多样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beep Beep [110029CA] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbeepbeepvoice\x3dnpcbeepboopquest_robot2_000029d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it wrong. I'm not one of them, and I never will be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你搞错了。我不是他们一员，也永远不会是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [11000EA6] (mod) Quest : ([1100154E]x3DNPCJACKsonquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcjacksonvoice\x3dnpcjack_x3dnpcjack02_0000155d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it wrong. It's not the fight so much as the way it ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你搞错了。重要的不是打斗本身，而是它的结局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynx_x3dnpczynx02c_00002c2a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it. Kicking back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白。这就歇着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026C7]x3DNPCfollowersmortar) Post-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_000026d8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it. Lock and load.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白。子弹上膛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026C7]x3DNPCfollowersmortar) Post-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_000026d7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got rid of him, and you didn't need to spill any blood to do it. I'm impressed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您兵不血刃就摆平了他？佩服！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Viviette [110027CF] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00003bd6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got the wrong guy! I'm just a nobody, who's going to owe me any favors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你找错人了！我只是个无名小卒，谁会欠我人情？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [1100965C] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchankvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcgoodcopba_0000b1ee_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You gotta be one hungry motherfucker to eat a person. Wouldn't be surprised if you were the kind of person who fucked your mother too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 饿成这逼样才吃人？您这种连亲娘都睡的货…老子也不意外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0000349a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have a point, love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得有道理，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e2b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 承蒙关照。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright02\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00009387_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have my thanks. I believe the quote here is "No one has ever become poor by giving."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我谢谢你。我想这里的名言是：“没有人会因为给予而变得贫穷。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Richard [11003209] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to admit, they have a right to be suspicious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得承认，人家有理由怀疑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to get out of here. Someone's planted a bomb up here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得赶紧走！有人在这儿装了炸弹！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to help us! I don't want to die!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得帮我们！我不想死！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_greeting_00005a8d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to remember though, the bigger the town, the harder it is to maintain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你得记住，城镇越大，维护起来就越难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cooper [11006CCA] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoice\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc02c_00006cdc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to respect the laws of the town you live in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 住在镇上就得守镇子的规矩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to turn his speech functions back on. Press the big red button on his back panel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须把他的语音功能重新打开。按下他背板上的那个大红按钮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_x3dnpcbeuboop04_0000264e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to understand that had I not turned to his men, I would have never had time to acquire the missing pages of the journal!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须明白，如果我当时没有投奔他的手下，我永远不会有时间去获取日记的那些失落的页面！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adlai Covington [11004E68] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcdoccovvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcdoc1_0000b064_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have, but there's some inconsistencies with your story. For one, I don't see any evidence of chem use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了，但你的故事有些前后矛盾的地方。首先，我没有看到任何使用化学品的证据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_000033a1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You hear a faint whisper through the static. She says, "Thank you."
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在静电声中听到微弱的低语。她说:“谢谢你。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: You hear a lot about ghosts in the wastes, and even the walking dead. But my corpses stay buried.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土多传鬼魂甚至行尸，但我的尸体永远安息
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_greeting_00005837_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You heard right. But if you want the high end stuff, you'll have to wait. Our chemist is having some issues with the product.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听对了。但如果你想要高端产品，你得等。我们的化学家在产品上遇到了一些问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_3dnpcsq5_0000b0c2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You heard what the doctor said. Their personalities were wiped. They're just dolls now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听医生说的。他们的个性都被抹除了。他们现在只是一些玩偶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara02_00008099_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You helped killed Gabriel's men. Whose side are you on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你帮助杀死了加布里埃尔的人。你站在哪一边？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You hiding out here too? Well, it's a good spot. No mutants, fresh air, and you can't beat the view.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您也躲这儿？好地方啊——没变种怪，空气鲜，视野更没得挑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [11005A13] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpchaskinsvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_00005a20_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just ask a complete stranger to follow you around God knows where and they say..."Yes?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只是让一个完全陌生的人跟着你走到天知道什么地方，他们就说……“好吗？”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq4c_00002722_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just made the best decision of your life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你刚做了这辈子最正确的决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Raider [110059B5] (mod) Quest : ([110059B8]x3DNPCtrollsiblings) Bridge Trolls EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaletroll\x3dnpctrol_x3dnpctroll3_000059d8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just point and shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是瞄准，然后射击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just point and shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是瞄准，然后射击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You keep thinking in terms of people. You're a symbol. To the outside world, you are Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你总是以个人的角度思考问题。你是一个象征。对外界而言，你就是101号避难所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110081B9] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB26]x3DNPCMQ03) The Value of a Man EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq03_x3dnpcmq03greet_00014285_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You kill real good. I like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你杀得真棒，我喜欢

ESP.ORIGINAL: You killed Doctor Covington?
ESP.TRADUIT: 科温顿博士是你杀的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You killed her you fucking bastard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你杀了她你这混蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carnegie [11000930] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice\x3dnpcdotsdiner_attack_00000a36_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You killed that old woman. Now she wants her vengeance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你杀了那个老妇人。现在她要报仇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know about quantum gravity? Yeah, I bet you do. Shit, all you junkies know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道量子引力吗？是啊，我敢打赌你知道。妈的，你们这些瘾君子都知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcsq2a_00008807_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know how it is. Healthy mind, bad ticker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您懂的吧？脑袋灵光，心脏罢工。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_greeting_00002615_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know how miners use canaries in coal mines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道矿工们在煤矿里用金丝雀吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpccansamvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpccanarysam1_000087be_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know how the trees are old and bald? They're basically the plant version of ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道那些树为啥又老又秃吗？它们基本上就是植物版的尸鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034bd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know I don't work like that Audrey. The shouwei may not have ears, but they still have eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我不是这么干事的，奥黛丽。守卫们也许没有耳朵，但他们还有眼睛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100AB25]x3DNPCMQ02) The Free and Pure EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpcmq02_x3dnpcaudreytze_0000f4e1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know I like having more than six shots, dear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我喜欢六发以上，亲爱的
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11000DE6] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e0e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know I love you Kristen, but that bomb makes me feel sick. I don't know if I can pray to something that wrenches my guts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克里斯汀，你知道我爱你，但那颗炸弹让我感到恶心。我不知道我是否能向一个让我五脏六腑翻腾的东西祈祷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dempster [110180BE] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdempstervoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempkrist_000180eb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know it's funny, when you turned on the radio, the first thing I expected to hear was some bizarre futuristic music. But the songs are the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说来好笑，你打开收音机那会儿，我以为会听见什么未来风的怪音乐。结果放的还是老歌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0001b9dd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know just once I'd like to rifle through someone's personal belongings and be embarrassed for suspecting foul play. Unfortunately, today is not t
ESP.TRADUIT: 真希望哪天翻别人东西时，能因为冤枉好人而觉得害臊。可惜今天不是那天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00020cc1_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know just once I'd like to rifle through someone's personal belongings and be embarrassed for suspecting foul play. Unfortunately, today is not that day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真希望哪天翻别人东西时，能因为冤枉好人而觉得害臊。可惜今天不是那天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know me, always taking the path of least resistance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你懂我，总是选择阻力最小的那条路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia01_00009658_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know me, I don't like drama. So when Hank came along and offered to put me up, I jumped at the chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你懂我，我不喜欢戏剧。所以当汉克过来，提出要收留我时，我抓住了这个机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alicia [11008F9A] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaliciavoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcalicia03_00009659_3.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know Mr. Clarkson, now may not be the place for this, but I was wondering if you could make a dedication on air to my wife.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克拉克森先生，现在说这个可能不太合适，但我想知道你能不能在节目里给我妻子献一首歌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Brooks [110025EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcbrooksvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcbrooksdedi_00002cb7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what an appendix is right? It's like extra information in the back of a book. Completely useless!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道阑尾是什么吧？它就像书后面的额外信息。完全没用！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas02e_00002afc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你懂我的意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kristen [110180C0] (mod) Quest : ([110180B8]x3DNPCDempsterKristenquest) Jackson Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpckristenvoice\x3dnpcdemp_x3dnpcdempkrist_000180ea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what people are saying about you, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道坊间怎么传您吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Settler [11000E5E] (mod) Quest : ([11004C08]x3DNPCsettlers) Settler Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemalesettler01\x3dnpcsettlers_hello_00004c34_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what people in the old world used to eat for cheap eats? Noodles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道战前人吃啥最便宜吗？面条！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tzen [1100D9FA] (mod) Quest : ([1100EE17]x3DNPCZenquest) Tzen Quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctzenvoice\x3dnpczenquest_greeting_0000f4fd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what would make us really rich? A cannon that shot raiders into space, just like all those Russian monkeys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道啥能让咱暴富吗？把掠夺者射上天的炮，就像那些俄国猴子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaranasquest_greeting_000033e0_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know why Zimmer can't replicate his android, right? Because he was high when he made him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道齐默造不出第二个仿生人吗？当初是嗨着造的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00007358_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know you want a piece of this. Gimme some sugar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 馋了吧？给点甜头嘛。 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ivy [110019E4] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know you want a piece of this. Gimme some sugar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 馋了吧？给点甜头嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benedict [110056A2] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleadult02\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00005d5d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, because I chop onions and meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我切洋葱和肉
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vernon [11000950] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotmalevoice2\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcvernon03_00000975_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, I expect politicians to be stupid. But this President Eden? He's abusing the privilege.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，我预料政客们会愚蠢。但这个伊登总统？他滥用职权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_00008dd5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, I thought you were different. But it turns out you're just as judgmental as everyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗，我以为你与众不同。但结果你和所有人一样爱评判别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpc160dot0a5_000053bb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, the longer you stand there, the longer the rest of us have to wait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您杵得越久，咱们等得越焦心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gabriel [110022E1] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcgabrielvoice\x3dnpcmq01_greeting_000022ef_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, we should make some armor out of them Mirelurk shells. Them motherfuckers are a tough nut to crack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该用沼蟹壳打护甲…那玩意儿硬得硌牙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_00006c79_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, where we love to hate, and hate to love, and it leaves us hating ourselves but loving each other?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道的，那种爱恨交织，恨中带爱，最后恨自己却爱着对方的关系？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, you didn't need a virtual reality machine to get to Tranquility Lane. Take enough Med-X and you'll be there in a heartbeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道不？去宁静巷哪用得着虚拟舱——嗑够吗啡-X秒到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_000034cb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You learn to dance like Fred Astaire, you learn to smile like Chaplin, and drink like Sinatra.
ESP.TRADUIT: 学弗雷德·阿斯泰尔跳舞，效卓别林假笑，仿辛纳屈酗酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_00005966_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You leave this place and carve a life on your own terms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离开这儿，按自己心意活出个人样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You let me worry about that. All I care about is whether the battery has enough life in it to get back to town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我来担心那个。我只关心电池是否有足够的电量回到镇上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulahtopic3d3_000030cf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You let the blood flow until the shaking stops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让血流到不抖为止
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_greeting_000051c2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You like that you ugly bastard?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢这样吗，你这丑八怪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmortarquest_attack_0000799a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look dangerous. I like that. I might even let you talk to me, but I'll have to think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看着挺危险，我喜欢，或许会赏脸跟你聊聊，但得考虑考虑
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Susie [11006CC3] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006ce9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look good. Well, evil, but good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这身真不赖。好吧，透着一股邪气，但够威风。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [11000A72] (mod) Quest : ([11000A5D]x3DNPCfactory) Factory Sealed EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfacmaleadult01\x3dnpcfactory_greeting_0000233d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look just fine. Trust me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看你气色挺好。信我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like the cat who ate the canary. Although I don't really get that expression. Canaries taste bad and smell worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您笑得像偷腥的猫？虽然搞不懂这说法——金丝雀又难吃又熏人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Hammond [110026EB] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribehammondvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_0000272e_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like your true self.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来像真正的自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like you've got something on your mind. If so, it's best to talk to an adult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你像有心事？最好找大人聊聊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mack [11002C4B] (mod) Quest : ([1100320D]x3DNPCplayquest) To Raise a Child EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleplaywright01\x3dnpcplayquest_greeting_00003c64_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look troubled. What's on your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 愁眉苦脸的，想啥呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You looking for a good time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 寻开心不？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ivy [110019E4] (mod) Quest : ([11000F4F]x3DNPCClara) Clara Bella EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcfemaleadult01\x3dnpcclara_greeting_00001a49_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You looking to have some fun? I might know a place if you wanna hang out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想找乐子？我知道几个好地方
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Susie [11006CC3] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_greeting_00006ce7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You lost me at "wear this jumpsuit." But if you insist on going through with this, I'll be waiting for you here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说“穿上防护服”的时候我就打退堂鼓了。但你非要进去的话，我在这儿等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba11_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You made it out! I was starting to get worried there for a second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您脱险了！刚才心都提到嗓子眼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_greeting_0001b9ef_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You make it sound like we have something to lose. Look around you. Zombies couldn't make it any worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的好像我们有什么可失去的。看看你周围。僵尸也无法让情况变得更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctombquest_x3dnpc01d_000022c2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You making eyes at me, asshole? You keep doing that and I'll pop them off with my fucking thumbs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你朝我抛媚眼混蛋？再这样我用拇指把你眼珠子抠出来
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_greeting_00002bea_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You making eyes at me, bitch? You keep doing that and I'll pop them off with my fucking thumbs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你朝我抛媚眼贱货？再这样我用拇指把你眼珠子抠出来
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zynx [11002BDF] (mod) Quest : ([11002BE1]x3DNPCZynxQuest) Zynx EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpczynxvoice\x3dnpczynxquest_greeting_00002beb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may not realize it, but you just did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能没意识到，但你刚刚做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulah80f1_00003e3d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean from the Pre-War television show?
ESP.TRADUIT: 战前电视剧里那个？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean Izzy? Look, I don't know what kind of radroach crawled up her ass, but this harassment has got to stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说伊兹？听着，我不知道是哪只辐射蟑螂爬进了她的屁股，但这种骚扰必须停止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Selma [11001640] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult02\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcselma01_00001b66_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean like, use the dynamite like a club? Okay, you're the boss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说...拿雷管当棍子抡？行，你是老大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([110033CF]x3dnpcFollowersARANAS) x3dnpcARANAS quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_000033e6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean that business about the phone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说电话那件事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dot [11000903] (mod) Quest : ([11000912]x3DNPCdotsdiner) Dot's Diner EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdotvoice\x3dnpcdots_x3dnpcstage50e_00003e55_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean the big hunk of steel that ran past me? Yeah, I think he'll be all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说那个从我身边跑过去的一大块钢铁？是啊，我觉得他会没事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Puzzled Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaranasvoice\x3dnpcaran_x3dnpcaranas110_00003436_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean the one by that Negro fellow? About twisting? I may have heard it once before, but I'm not sure. You know I'm a public radio man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说那个黑人伙计唱的？关于扭扭的？我可能听过一次，但不确定。你知道我是听公共电台的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham [11000DE5] (mod) Quest : ([11000DF0]x3DNPCminefield) Rivet City Conversations EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleminefield\x3dnpcmine_x3dnpcminefield_00000e3f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean they made that up too? Wow. I wonder if you even have oceans. Or water!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说他们也编造了那个？哇。我怀疑你甚至有没有海洋。或者水！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [11007235] (mod) Quest : ([11006443]x3DNPCFollowersMara) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaravoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpczmara01w_0000809d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean this dump actually has a waitress? I was just making a joke. I need to pay more attention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说这个破烂地方竟然还有女服务员？我只是开个玩笑。我得更仔细点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_x3dnpcslasher0b_00003456_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean you haven't heard? Man, it's like, the grooviest high you'll ever have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说你没听说过？天啊，那可是你这辈子能遇到的最爽的快感了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcjunkievoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcjunkietopi_000080fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned the two of you were once human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你们俩以前也是人类？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned you were waiting to see if I was worth your time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说要看我值不值得浪费时间？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might wanna do as Chapel says. He doesn't like it when he has to ask twice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好照教堂说的做，他不喜欢说第二遍

ESP.ORIGINAL: You refuse to kill these men, and you're setting back society by hundreds, no, thousands of years!

ESP.TRADUIT: 你把钥匙从秋千底下拿出来了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你从卡温顿医生的尸体里找到了日记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You saved Project Purity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拯救了纯净计划。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You saved Project Purity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拯救了纯净计划。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, once upon there was a very rich man, with five very petty children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，从前有一个非常富有的人，有五个非常小气的孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem almost proud to be a rat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你似乎很为自己是只老鼠而自豪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem nice enough, but the waiting list is already long enough as it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来人不错，但这里的等待名单已经够长了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty Lou [110065D7] (mod) Quest : ([110065D9]x3dnpcMasonDixonDialogue) Mason Dixon EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmasondixonvoicef\x3dnpcmaso_x3dnpc00b_000065dc_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should talk to her. I'd probably just make things worse.

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think the brain is overrated?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得脑子没用？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to travel with class, you use my bridge.

ESP.TRADUIT: 你一直都是个好人。如果没有你支持她，阿玛塔可能坚持不了那么久。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were an heiress?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前是千金小姐？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You what? Hold on, do you realize what you're saying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说什么？等等，你明白你在说什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beulah Clarke [110022F5] (mod) Quest : ([11001BF0]x3DNPCBeepBoopQuest) Little Bo Beep EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcdoctorvoice\x3dnpcbeep_beulah80f_00003e3a_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 屁话真多。看这世界不顺眼？自我了结算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't even know I'm here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你根本不会察觉我存在！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boop [11001BEE] (mod) Quest : ([1100E586]x3dnpcBoopFollowQuest) BoopFollowQuest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcboopvoice\x3dnpcboop_followerstactic_0000e58f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't even know I'm here. So make sure you don't step on any stray needles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你根本不会察觉我存在。所以千万别踩到散落的针头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([11003481]x3DNPCFollowersSlasher) Quest to Handle Followers EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcfoll_followerstactic_00003491_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't even know I'm there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你根本不会察觉我在那儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([110036D5]x3dnpcTombFollowerQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_followerstactic_000187cf_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You! You picked it up, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你！你接了是吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, on the other hand, are a machine. An android, to be precise. If you don't believe me, take a peek through the looking glass to my right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而你则是机器。准确说是仿生人。不信的话，看看我右边的观察窗吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mara [110055EC] (mod) Quest : ([11001F17]x3dnpc404) Through the Looking Glass EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcrobovoice2\x3dnpc404_greeting_00007249_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd think he'd have the courtesy to buy me a drink first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会以为他至少会先请我喝杯酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcaudrey01b_00010911_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd think if you could simulate reality, you'd choose a place that was slightly less insane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能会想，如果你能模拟现实，你会选择一个不那么疯狂的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Fear Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_x3dnpcvanillaqu_000370b2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll get no argument from me. The world, however, may be a tougher sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会从我这里得到任何争论。然而，这个世界可能更难被说服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_0000b132_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to blow it up, right? I guess what I'm asking is...can I help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得把它炸掉，对吧？我想问的是……我能帮忙吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spider [1100322A] (mod) Quest : ([11003307]x3dnpcARANASquest) Itsy Bitsy Spider EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to excuse Butcher. He doesn't know his own mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 屠夫那憨货别见怪，他脑浆都嗑成糊了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Junkie [11009579] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_greeting_000087eb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to forgive me then, because brevity is not my strength.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你得原谅我，因为简洁不是我的强项。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll need more than a one guard to outlive me. Have you got my supplies?

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chapel [1100082D] (mod) Quest : ([11000833]x3dnpcTombQuest) Tombstone EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpctombvoice\x3dnpctomb_x3dnpcchapel10c_00008150_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll need to fill out a form of course, and submit it to our Taxpayer Assistance Center.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，你需要填写一份表格，然后提交给我们的纳税人协助中心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会看到的。

ESP.TRADUIT: 等你长大就明白了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 年轻人，瞧你这副样子，我看你干啥啥不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your brother's dead, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你哥哥死了，其实。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your dad's in Rivet City? Well, what do you know. I guess great minds do think alike.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您爹在铆钉城？哈！英雄所见略同啊。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你保持距离挺好。咱们聊点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father made a noble sacrifice. Let's make sure we don't waste it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲牺牲得很伟大。咱们别让他白死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Sad Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba14_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father's quite the charmer. No doubt Doctor Li will do whatever he asks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲挺有魅力。李博士肯定会听他的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([11004BDA]x3DNPCFollowerQuest) Followers Quest EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcfoll_idlechatter_0003ba12_1.ogg

ESP.TRADUIT: 你的第一个任务就是下去告诉医生他被解雇了。他可以上来拿他的遣散费。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your loss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您的损失。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your loss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您的损失。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your name's Dot? Like on the sign?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你叫点？跟招牌上那个点一样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your opinions aren't relevant to this conversation. Do you have a ticket or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的想法跟这次谈话无关。你到底有没有票？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Izzy Rae Stein [11001AF4] (mod) Quest : ([110010DB]x3DNPCirs) Death and Taxes EmotionType : Anger Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcirsfemaleadult01\x3dnpcirs_x3dnpcirs00b_00001af7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your panties, Butch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，你的内裤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscribesquest_hello_000080e9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your panties. The more you talk, the more twisted they get. And you know how bad you are with knots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的内裤。你说话越多，它们就缠得越紧。而且你知道你有多不擅长解开绳结。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eightball [11006281] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpceightballvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpceightbutch_000087dc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your presence is required downstairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 楼下需要你过去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your town is full of disgusting hobos and vagrants. I think he fits right in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的镇子充满了恶心的流浪汉和无家可归者。我想他很适合这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your wife says that too Brooks? We have more in common than I thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你妻子也这么说吗，布鲁克斯？我们比我想象的要有更多共同点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Detective Conrad [11002C98] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcconradvoice\x3dnpc101_x3dnpcdetective0_00002ca2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a cowgirl now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在是个女牛仔了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a cyst, Hammond. A blight on this land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个囊肿，汉蒙德。这片土地上的祸害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jones [1100273F] (mod) Quest : ([110026E0]3DNPCScribesQuest) Quantum Gravity EmotionType : Disgust Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\3dnpcscribejonesvoice\3dnpcscrib_3dnpcscribescen_00002cec_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a detective, aren't you, why don't you tell me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个侦探，不是吗？你为什么不告诉我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a fool if you think I'm going to kill these folks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为我会杀这些人？那你可太蠢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a ghoul. Your whole body is a soft spot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个尸鬼。你的全身都是软肋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Martha [11009627] (mod) Quest : ([1100962A]x3DNPCghouls) Underworld Conversations EmotionType : Neutral Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmaleghoul02\x3dnpcghou_x3dnpcghoul05a_0000161c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a good man Casey. A bonafide institution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个好人凯西，活体电台纪念碑

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a little young to be hiring hookers, don't you think? But hey, far be it for me to come between you and a good time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雇妓女是不是嫩了点？不过嘛...春宵一刻值千金，不扫你的兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mortar [110026B1] (mod) Quest : ([110026B0]x3DNPCmortarquest) Pre-Quest Dialogue and Conversation EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcmortarvoice\x3dnpcmort_idlechatter_000079a8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a pig. The waitress has a name, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个猪猡。那女招待有名字的，知道吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a real piece of work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是个极品

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a sharp one, darling. I need to be careful not to grab you from the wrong end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是个敏锐的家伙，亲爱的。我得小心，别从错误的末端抓住了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Audrey [11004BA8] (mod) Quest : ([110022DD]x3DNPCMQ01) The Ties that Bind EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcaudreyvoice\x3dnpcmq01_x3dnpcaudrey03_00004bd3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a shitberg, you hear me! You're a fucking iceberg made of shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你个粪山听见没！你他妈是屎堆的冰山！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a true American. A bonafide patriot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是真正的美国人。如假包换的爱国者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a wastelander too, huh? Yeah, I'm pretty much learning as I go. But I think it's looking great so far!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也是个废土客，是吧？嗯，我差不多是边学边做。但我觉得到目前为止看起来很棒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're alive! Not that I was expecting otherwise. I just figured you'd be missing a leg or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还活着！倒不是说我觉得你会死。就是以为你至少得缺条腿什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slasher [11003446] (mod) Quest : ([1100344B]x3dnpcslasherquest) x3dnpcslasher quest EmotionType : Surprise Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpcslashervoice\x3dnpcslas_greeting_0000732f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're also under arrest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被捕了

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're back. Did you find the terminal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。找到终端机没？

ESP.TRADUIT: 你们死定了。 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're doing a lot of good out there. It makes me wanna vomit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在外面干了不少好事，让我想吐

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Casey Clarkson [11001F12] (mod) Quest : ([11001F19]x3dnpc101) x3dnpcroom101 EmotionType : Happy Audio (bsa): sound\voice\3dnpcfo3bundle.esm\x3dnpccaseyvoice\x3dnpc101_greeting_000033c9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've set mankind's progress back by centuries. And worse yet, I feel I may have had a hand in its demise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让人类文明倒退几世纪。更可悲的是…我竟成了推手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup, this is the world now. Welcome to America, 2277. Sorry about the mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这就是现在的世界。欢迎来到2277年的美国。很抱歉一片狼藉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup. There's not much to do save picking your nose and scratching your ass, and vice versa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。除了抠鼻子和挠屁股，以及反过来，没什么可做的。
